6464521340.name: 灵枢-黄帝内经-白话版
6464521340.description: 《黄帝内经灵枢》是中医学的重要经典之一，涵盖了丰富的医学理论和治疗方法。为了帮助更多人深入学习和理解《黄帝内经灵枢》，我们设计了一款专注于提供白话文翻译同时集成中医经典内容的App，以便更好地传承和发展中医学知识。 一、简介 1.1 使命 《黄帝内经灵枢》App的使命在于通过白话文翻译，使这一古老的医学典籍更加贴近现代人，帮助用户深入理解中医学的深奥之处。同时，提供灵枢中的经典内容和实用的医学知识，助力用户更全面地了解中医理论和治疗方法。 1.2 特色功能 白话文翻译：将《黄帝内经灵枢》中的文言文翻译成白话文，保留原意的同时，让用户更容易理解古老的医学经典。 经典内容阅读：提供《黄帝内经灵枢》的详细内容，用户可随时随地学习中医经典的重要篇章。 章回导航：设计了便捷的章回导航功能，使用户可以迅速定位到感兴趣的章节，方便有目的地学习和阅读。 搜索功能：可根据关键字搜索定位，帮助用户快速找到所需内容。 二、主要功能介绍 2.1 白话文翻译 通过深入研究《黄帝内经灵枢》原文，我们精心制作了白话文翻译，确保每一句话都能够贴近现代人的思维方式，去除文言文的障碍，使用户更容易理解医学经典的内涵。 2.2 经典内容阅读 《黄帝内经灵枢》App提供了完整的经典内容，用户可以逐章逐节地阅读，深入学习其中的医学理论和实用知识。 通过《黄帝内经灵枢》App，我们希望用户能够更轻松地深入学习中医经典，理解其中的医学智慧，为中医学的传承和发展贡献一份力量。期待着用户的使用和反馈，共同推动中医学知识的传播和应用。 免责声明：此应用程序信息仅作为学习参考使用，用户在使用应用程序包含的信息做医疗诊断之前请咨询专业医生。 Disclaimer: The information in this application is only used as a reference for learning. Users should consult a professional doctor before using the information contained in the application to make a medical diagnosis.

6758785773.name: FencingLab
6758785773.description: FencingLab — AI Fencing Coach Transform your fencing with AI-powered video analysis. Record or upload your bouts, and FencingLab breaks down your technique, tracks your progress over time, and delivers personalized training recommendations. What FencingLab does: Analyzes fencing videos using advanced AI to identify actions, timing, and technique Tracks improvement across sessions with progress charts and skill scores Provides tactical matchup analysis against specific opponents Supports Foil, Épée, and Sabre Works for athletes and coaches managing multiple fencer profiles AI Analysis Options: Gemini AI — cloud-based analysis for detailed, high-quality feedback Local AI — on-server processing with no third-party data sharing Subscription: FencingLab offers auto-renewable subscriptions that unlock Gemini AI analysis. A 7-day free trial with 5 complimentary credits is included at sign-up. Subscriptions are billed through your Apple ID. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in App Store Settings. Privacy: When Gemini AI is selected, your video is sent to Google's servers for analysis. Local AI keeps all processing on our servers with no third-party sharing. Your privacy choices are always in your control in the app settings. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6761271109.name: 好狗友
6761271109.description: 1 本应用是一款基于ai 驱动的，适合于毛孩子能与家人一起互动，在这里狗狗是真正的家庭一个成员，社区的一个成员，而不是被管理的宠物。这是我们开发这个产品最核心的理念。也希望能找到同频的用户 2 在这里狗狗和你一样有自己的情绪和想法 ，和你一样不但是属于你的家庭，还是你所在的真实社区的一个成员，毕竟狗狗对你们小区的了解其实比你还熟，毕竟狗狗下楼玩的次数远超过你。狗狗每回都能顺利回家，你确经常按错电梯 3 在这里你早晚两次的小区内遛狗 你一定会遇上同样的毛孩子，我们鼓励狗狗们互动，加为好狗友，遛狗前可以看看有没有好狗友，让狗狗们一起快乐玩耍。说不定狗狗的朋友比你还多呢。 4 狗狗的朋友圈是一个充满爱和欢乐的应用 ，希望你生活中也是如此 充满爱与欢乐 狗狗爱你们。

6756740018.name: Invoice Maker » Estimate GO
6756740018.description: Stop wasting your evenings on paperwork. Secure your business data and get paid immediately with Invoice Maker. Designed specifically for contractors, freelancers, and small business owners, Invoice Maker allows you to create, sign, and send professional PDF invoices directly from the job site—with the peace of mind that every document is instantly backed up to the cloud. WHY PROS CHOOSE INVOICE MAKER: ● Never Lose Your Business Data (Cloud Backup) Your account automatically secures every invoice, estimate, and client detail in the cloud. Whether you lose your phone, break it, or switch devices, your financial records are safe. Simply log in, and your business is right there with you. ● Create Invoices in Seconds No complex setup. Just add your client, items, and hit send. It’s the fastest workflow to get back to what you do best, with real-time synchronization so your work is always saved. ● Get Paid Faster Automatically include your payment details in the invoice message. ● Protect Your Work & Evidence Avoid disputes. Attach "Before & After" photo evidence to your invoices and collect client signatures right on your phone screen. All photos and signatures are securely uploaded to your account, ensuring you always have proof of work. ● Professional & Clean Your invoices represent your brand. Send beautiful, clean PDF documents that make you look like a pro. KEY FEATURES: Automatic Cloud Sync: Your data is backed up instantly to your secure account. • Device Restoration: Log in on a new iPhone and retrieve your history instantly. • Estimates to Invoices: Convert quotes to bills in one tap. • Client Management: Import directly from your contacts. • Offline-First Mode: Work from basements without signal; data syncs automatically when you reconnect. • Payment Status: Track who has paid and who is pending. • Tax: Calculate totals automatically. Perfect for: Plumbers, Electricians, Landscapers, Handymen, HVAC Technicians, Roofers, and any pro who needs secure, reliable invoicing. Subscription Information: Invoice Maker offers a weekly/monthly and yearly subscription to unlock unlimited invoices and advanced sharing features. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Terms of Use: https://invoicemakerestimate.blogspot.com/p/terms-and-conditions.html Privacy Policy: https://invoicemakerestimate.blogspot.com/p/privacy-policy-for-invoice-maker.html

6757371194.name: Capture Notes & Ideas - Prod
6757371194.description: Most ideas aren’t bad. They’re lost. Thinking is a resource. Most people waste most of it by accident — wrong moment, wrong friction, no tool at hand. The gap between having an idea and losing it is where most good thinking goes. Prod exists because that’s a waste worth fixing. Capture in seconds Ideas are fleeting. Prod gets out of your way so you can catch a thought the moment it arrives. No setup, no ceremony. Review with a swipe Not every idea needs action right now. Swipe to mark ideas as Active, Paused, or Archived - you can also send an idea to be actioned elsewhere. Stay focused on what matters without losing anything. Timely prods The difference between an idea and something real is usually just timing. Prod handles the timing. Discover your patterns Learn when your mind is sharpest. Prod tracks your ideation habits — your most productive times, your best days, your streaks — so you can work with your creativity, not against it. Prod is not a project manager. It is not a notes app. It is the thing you reach for in the first three seconds of an idea arriving — and the reason that idea still exists tomorrow. Available on iPhone, iPad. Some features require a subscription or in-app purchase. EULA — https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6746672144.name: Classic Investment Calculator
6746672144.description: Classic Investment Calculator - Comprehensive Financial Planning Tool Plan your financial future with precision using Classic Investment Calculator, a powerful macOS app designed for serious investors and financial planners. Calculate compound growth, compare investment scenarios, and visualize your portfolio's potential over time. Key Features: Multi-Currency Support - Calculate investments in USD, EUR, and other major currencies Flexible Contribution Schedules - Set up monthly, quarterly, or annual contributions with occasional lump-sum additions Variable Return Rates - Model changing market conditions with custom return rate steps over time Visual Analytics - Interactive charts and doughnut graphs to visualize growth composition Investment Comparison - Side-by-side analysis of multiple investment scenarios Spare Cash Analysis - Optimize additional contributions for maximum impact Detailed Projections - Month-by-month breakdown with opening/closing balances and growth Tax Considerations - Factor in capital gains tax for realistic projections Data Export - Export calculations to CSV for further analysis Whether you're planning retirement, comparing investment options, or analyzing the impact of additional contributions, Classic Investment Calculator provides the sophisticated tools you need with an intuitive interface. Perfect for financial advisors, investors, and anyone serious about long-term wealth planning.

6753267585.name: Classic Loan Calculator 2
6753267585.description: Classic Loan Calculator is now a unified macOS and iOS experience with iCloud sync. Build and compare loans in seconds: enter your principal, interest rate, and term to get a full amortization schedule with a clean, liquid-glass interface. Go deeper with side-by-side comparisons, a spare-cash optimizer to see whether investing or paying down debt saves more. All calculations stay in sync across your devices via iCloud, with robust import/export for backups. Highlights: Instant payments and full amortization schedules with interest vs. principal breakdowns. Loan comparison: baseline vs. selected loans, delta coloring, and CSV export. New Spare Cash Optimizer modes: Minimize total interest. Minimize monthly payments. Find the best strategy automatically. paydown vs. invest scenarios, break-even insights, grouped results, CSV export. Multi-currency with seeded rates, manual refresh, and per-loan currency selection. Flexible interest: fixed, manual steps, or periodic cadences (monthly/quarterly/semestral/annual). Partial paydowns: occasional and recurring, plus custom start dates. Number-format settings: grouping/decimals applied across UI and exports. iCloud sync between MacOS, iPhone and iPad. JSON import/export with security-scoped access for backups or migration. Fully localized UI (14+ languages) and modern liquid-glass visuals.

6758226566.description: Site Tools & Asset Register – Professional Site Management Site Tools & Asset Register is a professional site register designed for Construction, QA/QC, Safety, Asset, and Property & Strata Management Teams. Works offline with data stored locally on your device. The app helps you record, manage, and track tools, assets, safety items, and test equipment directly on site, eliminating paper registers and spreadsheets. Built for clarity, flexibility, and real-world site use. Key Features Create and manage site-based asset registers Record tools, equipment, safety items, and test instruments Track asset IDs, serial numbers, manufacturers, and manufacturing dates Optional calibration tracking with due dates Optional safety inspection tracking Attach photos and notes to each asset Clear status indicators (In Service, Out of Service, Due, Expired) PDF export for professional site and project records Works fully offline, ideal for site conditions Clean interface with Light & Dark mode support The app is intentionally general-purpose, suitable for: Tools registers Asset registers Calibration registers Safety equipment registers Intended Use & Disclaimer Site Tools & Asset Register is a documentation and record-keeping tool only. It does not replace: Site supervision Safety management systems Statutory inspections Licensing, competency, or regulatory requirements Users are responsible for ensuring compliance with project specifications, local regulations, codes, and standards. 6741094184.name: 本地大模型助手
6741094184.description: PrivAI 是一款基于 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏模型 的智能应用程序，专为注重隐私、便捷性和多功能性的用户设计。通过先进的蒸馏技术，我们将大型复杂模型的能力压缩到更小的模型中，确保在保持高性能的同时，显著降低计算资源的需求。PrivAI 不仅支持 DeepSeek-R1，还新增了对 Llama2 和 Qwen 模型的支持，为用户提供更丰富的 AI 体验。 核心功能亮点： 多模型支持：除了原有的 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏模型，PrivAI 现已支持 Llama2 和 Qwen 模型，满足不同场景下的需求。 离线 AI：无需网络连接，随时随地享受强大的 AI 生成能力，确保隐私和数据安全。 隐私保护：所有数据均在本地处理，绝不上传至云端，确保您的隐私安全无虞。 快速响应：高效模型设计，瞬间生成精准内容，提升使用体验。 温度系数调整：支持自定义温度系数，灵活控制生成内容的创造性和多样性。 预制 Prompt：内置多种预制 Prompt，帮助用户快速启动任务，提升效率。 拍照输入文字：通过拍照功能快速提取文字内容，简化输入流程，特别适合处理纸质文档或手写笔记。 简洁易用：直观的界面设计，适合所有用户，轻松上手，开启智能生活。 适用场景： 学习：快速解答问题，辅助知识整理，提升学习效率。 创作：生成灵感文案，助力写作、设计和创意表达。 工作：高效处理文本，自动生成摘要、翻译或问答内容，提升工作效率。 日常：随时随地获取智能建议，方便生活决策。 技术优势： 蒸馏模型：通过蒸馏技术，PrivAI 的模型在保持高性能的同时，显著降低了对内存和计算资源的需求，适合在资源有限的设备上运行。 本地处理：所有数据均在设备本地处理，确保响应速度更快，同时保护用户隐私。 多样化任务支持：模型经过微调，支持文本生成、摘要、翻译、问答等多种任务，覆盖广泛的应用场景。 使用要求： 设备要求：PrivAI 必须在 8GB RAM 及以上 的苹果设备上运行，推荐使用 iPhone 15 Pro 及以上版本以获得最佳体验。 模型加载：首次使用时需要加载模型文件（约 1GB），请确保设备具备足够的存储空间。 网络环境：加载模型时需要良好的网络环境（需能够访问 Hugging Face）。为方便用户，App 内提供了镜像站地址，但加载速度可能较慢，请耐心等待。 新增功能详解： 温度系数调整：用户可以通过滑动条调整生成内容的“温度”，低温生成更保守、准确的内容，高温则更具创造性和多样性。 预制 Prompt：内置多种场景化的 Prompt 模板，如“写作助手”、“翻译助手”、“学习助手”等，帮助用户快速启动任务。 拍照输入文字：通过拍照功能，PrivAI 可以快速识别并提取图片中的文字内容，支持多语言识别，特别适合处理纸质文档或手写笔记。 为什么选择 PrivAI？ 隐私至上：所有数据处理均在本地完成，确保您的数据永远不会离开设备。 多功能性：支持多种模型和任务，满足学习、工作、创作和日常生活的多样化需求。 高效便捷：离线使用、快速响应、拍照输入等功能，让 AI 助手真正融入您的日常生活。 无论是学习、工作还是创作，PrivAI 都能成为您的得力助手。立即下载，体验全新的智能生活！

6755650709.description: 小财主 - 儿童理财教育应用 让孩子在游戏中学会理财，培养正确的金钱观念和消费习惯！ 核心功能 预算管理 为孩子设置月度预算，培养计划消费的好习惯。实时查看预算使用情况，学会合理分配零花钱。 支出记录 轻松记录每一笔支出，包括金额、类别、用途说明。通过详细的记录，让孩子了解自己的消费模式。 智能统计 自动生成月度统计报告，按类别分析支出趋势。帮助孩子发现消费规律，学会优化开支。 奖励机制 设置奖励比例和惩罚倍数，鼓励孩子节约用钱。通过正向激励，培养储蓄意识。 多孩子管理 支持管理多个孩子的账户，每个孩子都有独立的预算和记录。适合多子女家庭使用。 数据导出 支持将数据导出为 JSON 或 CSV 格式，方便备份和分析。 隐私保护 完全本地存储：所有数据仅保存在您的设备上，不上传任何服务器 无广告干扰：纯净的使用体验，专注教育功能 无追踪技术：不使用任何分析工具或追踪技术 无需注册：无需账号密码，即开即用 教育价值 通过实践学习，让孩子： 理解金钱的价值和用途 学会制定预算和计划消费 培养储蓄和节约的习惯 建立正确的消费观念 提高财商素养 适合场景 家长希望培养孩子的理财意识 孩子开始有零花钱需要管理 学校开展财商教育课程 希望通过实践学习理财知识 重要提示 本应用完全本地化运行，所有数据存储在您的设备上，不会上传到任何服务器。我们承诺不收集、不分享、不追踪任何个人信息。 开始培养孩子的理财能力，让财商教育从娃娃抓起！

6757276895.name: 在阅

6759266245.name: CalAlarms：日历提醒
6759266245.description: Calendar notifications are easy to miss. CalAlarms fixes that by turning your upcoming events into real device alarms that cut through silent mode and Do Not Disturb — just like your morning alarm. HOW IT WORKS CalAlarms reads your iPhone calendar and automatically schedules alarms before each event. No manual setup. No forgetting. Your phone wakes you up for what matters. 1. Pick which calendars to monitor 2. Set how far in advance you want to be alerted 3. CalAlarms handles the rest REAL ALARMS, NOT NOTIFICATIONS This is the key difference. CalAlarms uses Apple's AlarmKit to schedule actual device alarms — the same kind that wakes you up in the morning. They ring even when your phone is on silent. No more missed meetings because a notification got buried. BUILT FOR VIDEO CALLS Filter your alarms to only fire before events with video call links. CalAlarms detects Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and WebEx links in your events automatically. Get an alarm before every call, skip everything else. LIVE ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN When an alarm fires, a Live Activity appears right on your Lock Screen with event details. See what's coming up and dismiss when you're ready — no need to unlock your phone. STAYS IN SYNC CalAlarms syncs automatically in the background: When you open the app When your calendar changes On a regular background schedule When you move between locations Your alarms always match your latest calendar. FULL CONTROL Choose alarm offset: 1 to 60 minutes before each event Schedule alarms up to 30 days in advance Toggle individual alarms on or off Include or exclude all-day events Filter by specific calendars iCloud sync across your devices PRIVACY FIRST CalAlarms reads your calendar data on-device. Nothing leaves your phone. No accounts to create, no data collected.

6501991264.name: FretFluent - Fretboard Notes
6501991264.description: FretFluent: Master the Notes on Your Guitar Fretboard FretFluent is the ultimate app to help you master the guitar fretboard and internalize every note on the neck. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced guitarist, this interactive game trains you to recognize notes, build muscle memory, and navigate the fretboard effortlessly. Set Up & Play: Begin your journey with FretFluent using either an acoustic guitar or an electric guitar plugged into an amp. The app actively listens and recognizes the notes you play, displaying them at the bottom of your screen. As the notes slide down the strings toward a target zone, be ready to play the note when it enters the zone. Engaging Practice Sessions: Keep your guitar practice engaging and effective. FretFluent is designed to help you learn and memorize the fretboard through interactive gameplay that makes each session enjoyable and productive. Customize Your Journey: Personalize your learning experience to match your individual pace and preferences. Within the settings, you can choose which notes and strings to focus on. Begin with a single string, internalize each note completely, and then add more strings. You can also adjust the game speed to challenge yourself as you advance. Master Every Note: FretFluent is perfect for anyone eager to deepen their familiarity with their instrument. Whether you are starting your musical journey or are an experienced guitarist, this app helps ensure every note on the fretboard becomes second nature.

6751239297.name: O2 Buddy: Blood Oxygen SpO2
6751239297.description: O₂ Buddy makes your blood oxygen readings effortless to see, understand, and track - on your iPhone, your Home Screen, and your wrist. Your Apple Watch already measures your blood oxygen throughout the day and night. O₂ Buddy turns those readings into something you can actually use. SEE YOUR TRENDS Switch between 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, and 90 days with a tap Every day shows its full range alongside its average, so you see the whole picture - not just the last number Watch your average rise or fall compared to the period before DAY VS NIGHT Compare your daytime readings against your overnight ones, side by side Wear your watch to sleep and see how your oxygen behaves while you rest EVERY READING IN CONTEXT Tap any reading to see where it falls within that day Compare it against readings taken around the same time on other days Know instantly whether it's normal, below normal, or low ON YOUR WRIST A fast, glanceable Apple Watch app with your recent readings and 7-day trend Complications in circular, rectangular, corner, and inline styles - including a color-coded gauge ring and a 7-day trend sparkline Readings sync from your iPhone as soon as they're recorded ON YOUR HOME SCREEN A widget for your latest reading A widget for your 7-day trend LOW OXYGEN ALERTS Optional notifications when a reading falls below a threshold you choose PRIVATE BY DESIGN Read-only access to Apple Health Your data stays on your devices - never uploaded, never shared, never sold Also includes Light, Dark, and Automatic appearance, 12- or 24-hour time, and built-in FAQs and support. O₂ Buddy is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose or treat any condition. Blood oxygen measurements are recorded by Apple Watch and stored in the Health app.

6756836222.name: SpO2 Watcher
6756836222.description: RESTORE YOUR SPO₂ INSIGHTS ON APPLE WATCH SPO₂ Watcher is a specialized utility designed for users who want full visibility of their blood oxygen data directly on their wrist. While some devices may not display these readings natively, your sensor is still active and securely recording data to the Apple Health app. SPO₂ Watcher acts as the essential bridge, retrieving that data from HealthKit and restoring it to your watch face and dashboard. — KEY FEATURES — ● RE-ENABLE WATCH VISIBILITY If you lack a native on-device option to view your blood oxygen levels, our app provides the solution. 6761575159.description: 你想提早退休（FIRE）嗎？距離財富自由還有多遠？ 退休倒數幫你設定退休目標、追蹤資產進度、每月提醒儲蓄， 讓你每個月都能清楚看到離退休又近了一步， 一步一步實現財富自由的夢想！ 【核心功能】 目標計算模型 提供每月支出法、FIRE 4% 法則、提領模型或自訂金額， 找出最適合你的退休規劃方式。 資產追蹤 輸入股票、現金、不動產等資產，一個 app 統整淨值。 台股、美股、新加坡股市即時報價，支援即時匯率換算。 儲蓄計劃 設定每月儲蓄金額，搭配每月入帳提醒，系統幫你追蹤進度。 退休倒數 首頁根據即時股價計算退休日期，並追蹤資產成長歷史。 大筆支出試算 評估一筆支出會讓退休日期延後多少，幫你做出明智的消費決策。 通膨與房貸支援 目標金額自動納入通膨調整與退休後房貸規劃。 雲端同步 建立帳號後，所有設定自動同步雲端，換手機資料永不遺失。 立即下載試算你的退休日期， 或許退休比你想像的更近喔！

6444155808.name: Moroccan Darija Dictionary
6444155808.description: Speak Darija with confidence! Learn the Moroccan Arabic you’ll actually hear, build sentences that sound right, and use your words to connect: with family, friends, and everyday life. This app helps you learn Darija easily: Sound natural fast: Every word and sentence includes clear audio from Moroccan speakers so you hear real pronunciation, rhythm, and stress. Learn in context: Sentences aren’t just small talk, they show how Darija grammar works so you can build your own phrases and start speaking sooner. Translate without perfect spelling: Search the way you speak, and the app finds the right entries. Find the word you mean, even if you don’t know the exact spelling. Learn what people really say: Discover common synonyms and French / MSA alternatives Moroccans use in daily conversation. Make it yours: Save your favorite words and create custom Collections. Organize your words by lessons, verb types, themes, or the phrases you always need with family. Learn anywhere: Everything works fully offline. No data? No problem! Ideal on planes, in cafés, or with spotty connections. Optional add‑on to boost your learning progress: Conjugation & Quiz Pack (in‑app purchase) 230 common verbs fully conjugated in past, present, and future with full audio recordings from native speakers: see the patterns, learn them and use the right form in real life. Conjugation Quiz helps you conquer difficult verbs Preposition Quiz: what was the right preposition again? Bring your Darija to the next level by using the correct prepositions Who it’s for Are you married to a Moroccan and want to talk to your partners family? Take part in the family conversations and connect to the community Are your parents Moroccans living abroad and you want to connect to your heritage culture? Understand your uncles and aunts when they speak their minds over atay. Planning a longer stay in Morocco? Go beyond "Salam", "Chokran" and English/French. Learn everyday Darija for everyday life. One‑time purchase, no subscription. Learn what you need, hear how it’s said, and start speaking with ease.

6755726394.name: 闪配单词
6755726394.description: 闪配单词是一款创新的英语单词学习应用，通过翻牌配对游戏的方式让背单词变得轻松有趣。 核心功能 翻牌配对游戏 通过翻牌找到英文单词和中文释义的配对，在游戏中自然记忆单词。精美的卡片设计和流畅的动画效果，让学习过程充满乐趣。 多难度等级 提供初级、中级、高级、特级四个难度等级，分别包含5、10、15、20个单词对，适合不同水平的用户循序渐进地学习。 丰富词库 内置12个专业词库，覆盖各个学习阶段： 基础教育：小学词库、中学词库、高中词库、大学词库 剑桥英语：KET词库、PET词库、FCE词库 国内考试：四级词库、六级词库 国际考试：托福词库、雅思词库、GRE词库 学习进度追踪 自动记录每个单词的学习情况，包括匹配成功次数、尝试次数和掌握状态。通过数据可视化了解自己的学习进度，有针对性地复习薄弱单词。 成绩系统 记录每个难度等级的最佳完成时间，挑战自我，不断突破。查看历史成绩，见证自己的进步。 个性化设置 支持音效开关，可调节字体大小，根据个人喜好自定义学习体验。 为什么选择闪配单词 游戏化学习 将枯燥的背单词过程转化为有趣的游戏，提高学习兴趣和效率。 科学记忆 通过反复配对练习，加深对单词的印象，符合记忆规律。 全面覆盖 从小学到GRE，满足不同年龄段和考试需求的学习者。 进度可视 清晰的学习数据帮助了解掌握情况，制定合理的学习计划。 适合人群 学生：从小学到大学的各年级学生 考试备考者：准备四级、六级、托福、雅思、GRE等考试 英语学习者：希望提升词汇量的英语爱好者 家长：帮助孩子学习英语单词 立即下载，开始你的单词学习之旅。

6749509640.name: GTK - Guitar Player's Toolkit
6749509640.description: During the many phases of my guitar playing journey, I used a number of tools, theory books, tuners, metronomes, practice techniques, and information to help me get my head around some of the concepts like chord composition, triads, scales, modes, transpositions, or working out what a chord looks like on a fretboard. Despite being a much better guitarist than I was, I built these tools because I still use them. Now you get to use them too. The Guitar Player's Toolkit includes the following tools: Chord Theory 1) Chord Master A comprehensive chord library containing around 3600 chords. Create custom chords Know where to put the fingers, but don't know the name? Use this tool Know the notes, but don't know the name? Use this tool. Use the triad library to learn the finger positions across different string sets, inversions, and starting frets use the key based diatonic progressions library to help with song writing and melody construction All chords can be played with guitar accurate sounds to suit Nylon, Classical, and Steel strings. 2) Scales Show notes across every key - major, minor, diminished, augmented, but also modes, pentatonics, blues, jazz, Arabic / middle eastern, exotic, symmetrical, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and so on. Compare up to 4 scales, triads, or chords at once on a single, colour-coded fretboard in Scale Sharing, with shared notes marked and notes of interest highlighted. See diatonic chords for scales that have them (Major/Minor and modes, Harmonic Minor/Major, Melodic Minor), and explore a triad library across different string sets and inversions for any chord progression you build For scales with a diatonic chord sequence, toggle between the scale's note description and its chord sequence 3) Position Finder Want to play a scale in a specific key, but at a place in the fretboard that suits you? Want to play without having to slide your hand up and down the fretboard? This tool shows you the notes in the scale, and where they sit on the fretboard around the fret you choose — so you can play in position without sliding your hand up and down the neck. Toggle between key context and mode context to quickly see how the same shape works across different modes. 4) Chord Transposer Sometimes a song includes chords that you either don't like, or don't suit your voice. Use this tool to transpose all chords to a different key, or just recalculate them using a capo 5) Circle of Fifths Invaluable for song writing - shows the relationship between keys and chords and also allows you to work with modes. 6) Mode converter Convert from one musical mode to another, in any key. Practice tools: 7) Note Practice Use this to learn where every note is on the fretboard Set a tempo/pace to practice at. Choose the strings, notes, and enharmonic format, and you'll be given a note and a string number to play. Hear the note and compare it to what you hear on your guitar. See the note on the fretboard to help you learn. Start with a single string, and work up to string pairs or collections. 8) Triad Practice Triads are 3 notes that make up chords. Learn these across string sets, and extend your mastery of the fretboard. Like Note Practice - pick your chords, string set, type of chord (Maj/Min/Aug/Dim), an inversion (Root/1st/2nd), and a tempo. Hear the chord/triad and compare it to what you hear on your guitar. See the triad on the fretboard to help you learn. Start with a single string set, Maj/Min and increase the complexity in terms of diminished/augmented, and multiple string sets Practical 9) Tuner A chromatic tuner to identify what note is being played. Use this to tune your guitar to whatever tuning scheme suits you 10) Metronome Provide a regular beats per minute and beats per measure. You can also manually tap a tempo to match a beat in your head.

6752220456.name: 生日提醒+
6752220456.description: 再也不会错过任何生日（或纪念日）了。 生日提醒（Birthday Reminders）是用最私密、最简单的方式来关注你关心的那些人。它直接从通讯录抓取生日，无需手动录入。每个周一，你会收到一份简单的每周摘要；在生日当天上午 9 点，你会收到提醒，让你能准时送上祝福。 孩子 + 纪念日： 在父母条目下添加通讯录里没有的孩子和纪念日，这样家庭里的每个重要日期都能涵盖到。还可以附加笔记，记录礼物点子和相关背景。 Apple Watch + 小组件： 通过表盘复杂功能在手腕上查看即将到来的生日，还能添加主屏幕小组件，一眼扫过去就全清楚了。 隐私至上： 没有云端同步，没有追踪，没有广告。所有数据都留在你的设备上，完全离线运行。 功能亮点： 自动从通讯录导入 父母条目下可添加孩子和纪念日 每周一提醒 提前 2 周提醒（可配置），方便买礼物 当天上午 9 点提醒 礼物灵感笔记功能 带有复杂功能的 Apple Watch App iPhone 主屏幕 + 手表小组件 100% 本地运行：无云端，无追踪，无广告 备份功能（导出和导入你的本地数据）

6756878789.name: 回响 - 运动体感木鱼
6756878789.trackName: 回响 - 运动体感木鱼
6756878789.description: [功能简介] 回响是一款专为 Apple Watch 打造的体感电子木鱼应用。利用手表的精密加速度传感器，挥手即可敲击，摆脱屏幕束缚。无论是冥想、解压还是日常修行，抬腕即达内心的平静。 [核心功能] 1. 体感敲击模式 Gravity-Dip 算法精准识别手腕转动，像敲真木鱼一样挥动手腕，无需触碰屏幕。三档灵敏度可调，配合防误触机制，走路甩手也不会误触发。 2. 双指捏合敲击 支持 watchOS 11+ 双指捏合手势，轻轻一捏即可敲击，极致便捷。 3. 运动攒功德模式 全新功能！走路、跑步时自动检测步数，每一步自动积一功德。运动与健康兼得，让修行融入日常。 4. 关联正念 自动记录正念时长，同步到 Apple 健康 App。功德积累与正念练习合二为一，每次敲击都是一次呼吸间的修行。 5. 5 种木鱼外观 经典木鱼、狗头木鱼、招财猫、金元宝，还有春节限定摔炮造型。不同心情，不同选择。 6. 6 种音效 木鱼声、金币声、掌声、猫叫、狗叫、鞭炮声。可自由搭配，打造专属修行体验。 7. 真实震动反馈 Taptic Engine 精心调校，还原木槌击木的沉稳手感。每 100 次触发里程碑庆祝反馈。 8. 动态视觉动画 木鱼缩放弹跳、涟漪波纹扩散、功德文字向上漂浮淡出，视觉效果灵动有趣。 9. 自定义漂浮文字 支持自定义输入（最多5字），或选择预设：功德、金币、生命值。所有页面实时同步。 10. 春节限定彩蛋 每年 1-2 月自动开启摔炮模式，用力甩手腕触发爆炸特效，红橙白三色随机，6 种搞笑文案，节日氛围拉满。 11. OLED 省电设计 纯黑极简界面专为 Apple Watch OLED 屏幕打造，大幅降低功耗，长时间使用无惧电量。 12. 完整的统计系统 总功德累计、单次会话计数，数据自动持久化保存，重启不丢失。 13. 丰富的设置选项 音效选择、灵敏度调节、自定义文字、静音开关、语言切换、数据清除，一切尽在掌控。 [支持语言] 中文、英文、日文、韩文、泰文，自动跟随系统语言。 [关于回响] 回响是一个独立开发项目，致力于用科技传递禅意。你的每一次敲击，都是与内心的对话。

6758929719.name: 婦科考一考（香港中醫考牌）
6758929719.trackName: 婦科考一考（香港中醫考牌）
6758929719.description: 本 App 專為香港考生打造，所有內容嚴格跟從香港執業試五版教材，解決坊間資料版本不一的痛點，確保學習內容與考試要求完全一致。 為什麼選擇「婦科考一考」？ 1. 香港考試專用版本 完全基於香港執業試五版教材編寫，涵蓋歷年考試重點。針對香港考試在婦科證型分類、方劑選擇及臨床應用的特殊要求進行優化，避免版本偏差，讓你溫書更安心。 2. 全面婦科學習內容 五大範疇全覆蓋： 完整收錄月經病、帶下病、妊娠病、產後病及婦科雜病（如癥瘕、不孕）的全部證型。 核心資料庫： 包含病機分析、主症特點（含兼次症）、舌脈特徵、治法、主方與附方、詳細加減用藥。 3. 互動遊戲模式（溫書不再枯燥） 配對遊戲： 證型與方劑、脈象舌象、病機與治法趣味配對，訓練直覺反應。 填空挑戰： 方歌與記趣填空，支援中文輸入，強化對「四物湯」、「完帶湯」等重點方劑的記憶。 選方遊戲： 模擬臨床辨證，根據婦科證型（如氣滯血瘀、腎虛水泛）選擇正確方劑。 問答測驗： 多選題形式測試病機、用藥等知識，即時解析錯誤。 4. 系統化複習圖表（一目了然） 提供證型總覽、方劑對照、病機分析、舌脈總結、加減用藥等五大圖表。 支援按系統（經、帶、胎、產、雜）及疾病篩選，重點內容高亮顯示，助你快速建立知識體系。 核心功能與優勢 臨床卡片： 翻卡式學習，利用碎片時間記憶重點。 精準對標： 內容編排完全按照執業試辨證論治要求。 離線可用： 無需網絡，隨時隨地開啟溫書模式。 高效工具： 結合方歌趣記與遊戲，攻克最難背誦的婦科加減法。

6473904105.name: ملكة: للباحثين عن شريك الحياة
6473904105.description: "مِلكة" هو تطبيق زواج، صُمم ليلبي احتياجات الباحثين والباحثات عن شريك الحياة بما يتوافق مع تعاليم ديننا الاسلامي وعادات وتقاليد مجتمعنا. مميزات تطبيق ملكة: أولاً: التصفح والبحث 1.	تصفح مجاني: استكشف ملفات شخصية متنوعة دون الحاجة إلى اشتراك. 2.	بحث متقدم: استخدم تصفية النتائج لتحديد معايير البحث والعثور على الشريك المناسب. 3.	القبيلة: إمكانية البحث وفق معايير محددة مثل الانتماء لقبيلة معينة. 4. استعراض الطلبات: المرسلة والمستقبلة لتتمكن من اضافة الاشخاص الملائمين فقط. 5. قائمة المفضلة: لتتمكن من العودة للاشخاص اللذين يناسبونك مبدئيا بسهولة. ثانياً: جودة المجتمع 6.	مجتمع راقٍ: يتماشى مع تعاليم الإسلام. 7.	تقييد الإضافات: عدد المضافين محدود بـ 5 لضمان الجدية في التفاعل. ثالثاً: التواصل والتفاعل 8.	تواصل آمن: المحادثات تبدأ بموافقة متبادلة فقط، مع خيارات أمان متقدمة. 9.	طلبات التواصل الفردية: شراء طلبات تواصل بشكل منفصل دون الحاجة للاشتراك في باقة شهرية. 10.	أسئلة متجددة: أسئلة متنوعة يمكن الإجابة عليها بالصوت أو النص، مع إمكانية اقتراح أسئلة تُرسل لجميع المستخدمين لتعزيز التفاعل. 11. حالات ظهور متعددة: متاح للتواصل، طور محادثات هاتفية، علاقة جادة، غير متاح للتواصل رابعاً: الخصوصية والأمان 12.	الفلتر الذكي: تحكم كامل في من يمكنه مشاهدة ملفك الشخصي من خلال فلترة كلمات محددة للحجب. 13.	خيارات التصفح: أ. وضع التصفح الخفي بالكامل. ب. إمكانية إخفاء إشعارات زيارة الملف الشخصي. ج. تخصيص الجنسيات اللتي يمكنها رؤية حسابك. 14.	إبلاغ سريع وآمن: تقديم بلاغات بسهولة عبر تصوير الشاشة ورفعها مباشرة مع ضمان السرية. 15.	خصوصية تامة: فريق ملكة يضمن سرية كاملة ولا يطّلع على المحادثات نهائياً. 16. ارسال صور تفتح لمرة واحدة: مثل تطبيقات التواصل الشهيرة يمكنك ارسال صورة لعرضها لمرة واحدة، ويمنع تصوير الشاشة. خامساً: الدعم والاستشارات 17.	مستشارون متخصصون: دعم من مستشارين ذوي خلفيات علمية ومهنية لتوجيهكم في رحلة البحث عن شريك الحياة. 18.	فريق دعم فني: فريق سريع ومتعاون لحل أي استفسار أو مشكلة تواجه المستخدمين. سادساً: تصميم وتجربة المستخدم 19.	معلومات شاملة: ملفات شخصية تحتوي على أنماط الشخصيات، لغات الحب، والاهتمامات لفهم أعمق للشريك. 20.	انماط عرض مريحة: 6760805727.name: 几点死 - 看见结局, 改变人生
6760805727.trackName: 几点死 - 看见结局, 改变人生
6760805727.description: 这是啥？这是一个把“你还剩多少时间”变成一个可以看到、可以变化的东西的应用。 它怎么玩？先给你一个预计下线时间，然后你每天的行为会直接影响它，好的习惯会让时间变长，不好的习惯会让它提前，同时你可以转轮盘，带来一点不确定的变化。 这个时间靠谱吗？它不是一个“答案”，更像一个起点，重点不在准不准，而在你能不能改变它。 我能控制多少？你能控制一部分，比如你今天怎么过、有没有自律，这些都会被记录并影响结果。 那续命大转盘是干嘛的？它让结果不会被完全算死，也不会完全随机，你会既有掌控感，又会有一点期待。 为什么要搞这么复杂？因为大脑更容易喜欢这种“有规则但不完全确定”的系统，太确定会无聊，太随机会放弃。 那最后有什么用？你会开始在意每天的选择，因为你看得到它们在一点点改变你的结局。 所以本质是什么？不是在预测你什么时候结束，而是用一个更容易让人坚持的机制，让你慢慢改变生活，养成好习惯，或者戒掉那些反复出现的问题。

6760734365.name: Slumba
6760734365.description: Sleep shouldn't be complicated. Slumba gives you a beautiful, handcrafted soundscape — and lets you blend it exactly the way you want. THE MIXER Most sleep apps give you a volume slider. Slumba gives you something more intuitive. Each soundscape layers three sounds together, and you blend them by dragging a single glowing point across a soft triangle. Ease it toward rain and the storm deepens. Nudge it to the center and everything balances. Find what feels right tonight, set your phone down, and let it carry you off. FIVE SOUNDSCAPES Noise — White, Pink & Brown Noise Storm — Rain, Wind & Thunder Ocean — Waves, Breeze & Gurgle Creek — Stream, Rustle & Birds Campfire — Fire, Night Air & Crickets Noise is always free. Try the rest free for 5 minutes — one small purchase unlocks everything. Forever. SLEEP TIMER Set a timer for 15, 30, 45, 60, or 120 minutes and Slumba fades your sounds gently to silence. No sudden cutoffs. Just a slow, peaceful fade — and then sleep. YOUR PHONE CAN STAY FACE-DOWN Once you're in bed, you shouldn't need to touch your phone. Slumba makes that easy. The Apple Watch app lets you start a soundscape, switch presets, and set a timer from your wrist. The Lock Screen widget shows your timer counting down without unlocking. Add the toggle to Control Center and starting Slumba becomes a single tap before you set your phone down for the night. On iPhone 14 and later, the Live Activity keeps your timer visible in the Dynamic Island while you do your bedtime routine. ON YOUR HOME SCREEN The small home screen widget shows what's playing at a glance. The medium widget goes further — when nothing is playing, it shows all five soundscapes as soft buttons you can tap to start one directly, without opening the app. SLUMBA KNOWS WHEN IT'S BEDTIME Connect Slumba to your Sleep Focus and it can start your chosen soundscape automatically when your bedtime routine begins — without you having to remember. Ask Siri to play a specific soundscape, or set a timer hands-free. "Play Ocean on Slumba." That's all it takes. BUILT FOR SLEEP No accounts. No subscriptions. No ads. No tracking. Just sounds that help you sleep. APPLE WATCH The best thing about the Apple Watch app is what it saves you from doing — reaching for your phone when you're already comfortable. From your wrist you can start any soundscape, switch between Noise, Storm, Ocean, Creek, and Campfire, and set a sleep timer for exactly as long as you need. The countdown rests softly on screen. When the time comes, Slumba fades out on its own. Your phone can stay face-down. The room can stay dark. You don't have to move.

6754535044.name: Casito: Shared Life Organizer
6754535044.description: Casito is the shared household app that keeps couples, families, and roommates organized in one calm, synchronized space. Manage your grocery list, split chores fairly, and plan life together — without switching between five different apps or losing track of sticky notes on the fridge. Built to reduce the mental load of running a home, Casito helps you share responsibilities, remember the little things, and save your energy for what actually matters. A shared grocery & shopping list that syncs instantly The digital fridge list. Add an item at work; your partner sees it at the store in real time. Never forget the milk. Gentle notifications keep everyone in the loop — no nagging. Custom categories. Organize by store, recipe, or aisle with your own emojis. Share the household load fairly Transparent chore tracking. See who's doing what, so housework is split evenly. Zero nagging required. Mark a task done and the whole household updates instantly. Less friction. A shared space means no more "did you do X?" Plan your life together Travel & vacations. Shared packing lists and trip itineraries. Dates & fun. Wishlists, date-night ideas, movies and shows to watch. Home management. Track apartment maintenance, shared bills, and errands. One upgrade covers the whole home Casito is free to use with zero ads and no data selling. If you upgrade to Pro for unlimited lists and custom themes, only one person pays — your single subscription instantly unlocks Pro for everyone in your household, free. Why people choose Casito Real-time sync across everyone in your home Works offline — your lists are always there, even on a flaky connection Calm, clutter-free design instead of a busy productivity app No ads, ever. We don't sell your data. Perfect for couples moving in together, growing families, and shared flats Built by a real couple, to solve the same problems you have Casito isn't built by a massive tech corporation. We're a real couple and a two-person indie team based in Barcelona. We built Casito because we needed it — we were tired of the unequal mental load, the scattered notes, and the daily "did you buy the milk?" We couldn't find an app that felt like a calm, shared home, so we made one. Terms of Service: https://www.casitoapp.com/terms-of-service Privacy Policy: https://www.casitoapp.com/privacy-policy Download Casito today — the simplest way to share life together.

6751640981.name: SwiftClip
6751640981.description: SwiftClip 是一款轻量、高效、隐私优先的剪贴板管理工具。 通过强大的批量复制与文本合并功能，帮助你高效管理和复用内容。 无需登录、无需云同步、无广告 —— 所有数据仅存储在本机。 1.为真实效率场景而设计 适用于日常高频操作： 表单填写（批量粘贴更高效） 消息回复（常用话术快速复用） 笔记整理（链接 / 文本统一管理） 代码片段（开发者效率工具） 让每一次复制粘贴都更高效。 2.智能剪贴板管理 自动监听剪贴板 自动保存复制的文本、链接、邮箱、电话、代码片段 智能识别与去重 自动识别内容类型，避免重复存储 剪贴板历史记录 支持搜索、编辑、删除、置顶 3 批量复制 & 文本合并（核心功能） 批量复制（Batch Copy） 选择多个片段，自定义顺序，一键复制 文本合并（Merge） 支持多种分隔符： 换行 / 空格 / 逗号 / 分号 / 竖线 / 横线 合并预览 粘贴前可查看最终结果 批量操作 支持批量删除与管理 4.标签与组织 自定义标签管理片段 支持标签筛选与搜索 支持多标签分类 让内容更有条理、更易查找 5.隐私与安全 Face ID / Touch ID / 密码保护 应用锁保护敏感数据 不收集、不追踪、不上传 所有数据仅保存在设备本地 6.数据导入与导出 支持导出为 JSON / CSV 支持导入数据（合并 / 替换模式） 便于备份与迁移 为什么选择 SwiftClip 极速体验，轻量流畅 完全本地，隐私优先 面向真实使用场景设计 无广告、无账号、无打扰 一切尽在一键之间 无论是复制链接、整理内容，还是复用文本片段 —— SwiftClip，让你的每一次粘贴都更高效。

6760714192.description: Invoice Master is the ultimate tool for freelancers, small business owners, and consultants who need a professional, streamlined way to manage their billing on the go. Stop wasting time with complex software—create, manage, and send professional PDF invoices in seconds. Key Features: Professional PDF Invoicing: Generate clean, high-quality PDF invoices and estimates ready to be sent to your clients via email, WhatsApp, or any messaging platform. Custom Branding: Make every document your own. Easily upload your Company Logo to maintain a professional brand identity. Digital Signatures: Add a personal touch and formalize your agreements. Draw your Signature directly in the app to be automatically applied to your invoices. Client & Product Management: Save time with a built-in database. Manage your client contact details and product catalogs with stock tracking for faster document creation. Payment Tracking: Never miss a payment again. Get a clear overview of your "Paid," "Unpaid," and "Overdue" invoices at a glance. Financial Insights: Monitor your cash flow with intuitive dashboards that show your monthly performance and outstanding balances. Secure Backup & Restore: Your data is precious. Use our robust Backup and Restore functionality to ensure your business records are safe and easily transferable between devices. Dark Mode Support: A beautiful, modern UI designed for efficiency and eye comfort, whether you're working day or night.

6756186677.name: CardWall
6756186677.description: CardWall keeps your important cards organized in one simple, private place. Store photos of membership cards, loyalty cards, insurance cards, ID cards, medical cards, business cards and more. Add notes, mark favourites, search your collection and filter by category so the card you need is easy to find. Your cards and photos are stored locally on your device. CardWall also includes backup and restore, so you can export your card library and keep a copy safe. CardWall Pro unlocks extra tools for larger and more organized card collections: Unlimited cards Searchable tags Custom categories Face ID Lock for added privacy Expiry dates and reminders for cards that need renewing Whether you want to keep a few everyday cards handy or manage a larger collection, CardWall helps you carry less and find things faster.

6761258120.name: Mobile MA
6761258120.description: Mobile MA ist die eleganteste Art, deinen Music-Assistant-Server zu steuern – auf allen deinen Apple-Geräten. Ob zu Hause oder unterwegs: Mobile MA verbindet sich mit deinem Music-Assistant-Server im lokalen Netz oder per Fernzugriff und bringt deine gesamte Musik, Radios, Podcasts und Hörbücher an einen Ort. DEINE GERÄTE, DEIN SOUND Ein Zuhause für alle Player: Lautsprecher per Fingertipp gruppieren, die laufende Wiedergabe nahtlos übertragen und jeden Raum einzeln steuern. Multiroom-Szenen für Apple TV, Apple Watch und CarPlay. Klang nach deinem Geschmack: Klangregelung für Bässe, Mitten und Höhen, Smart Fades und eine Pro-DSP-Suite mit parametrischem EQ. ÜBERALL DABEI iPhone und iPad, Apple Watch (auch wenn das iPhone nicht in Reichweite ist), Apple TV und CarPlay. Widgets, Sperrbildschirm und Siri. ENTDECKEN UND MERKEN Persönliche Empfehlungen, Radiostreams und Hörbücher mit Kapiteln. Songs für später merken – oder direkt aus dem Radio in deine Bibliothek holen. EINFACH EINGERICHTET Dein Server wird automatisch im Netzwerk gefunden – anmelden mit Benutzername und Passwort, fertig. Mobile MA ist ein unabhängiger Client für den quelloffenen Music-Assistant-Server und steht in keiner offiziellen Verbindung zum Music-Assistant-Projekt. Nutzungsbedingungen (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6760315590.name: GrocSnap: Grocery Tracker
6760315590.description: Stop guessing where your grocery money goes. GrocSnap is a free grocery budget tracker that scans any receipt in seconds, tracks your spending automatically, and shows you which store is actually cheaper. No manual entry. No spreadsheets. Just clear insights. RECEIPT SCANNER Point your camera at any grocery receipt and GrocSnap reads every item and price automatically using OCR technology. Works at Walmart, Kroger, Costco, Aldi, Target, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, and any other store. No manual typing — just snap and track. GROCERY BUDGET TRACKER Set a monthly grocery budget and track your real-time progress. Get alerts before you overspend. Earn streak rewards for hitting your monthly budget goals — build lasting savings habits and stay motivated every shopping trip. STORE PRICE COMPARISON See exactly how much you pay per item at each store you shop at. GrocSnap builds a personal price history from your scanned receipts so you always know where your groceries are actually cheaper — not advertised prices, but what you actually paid. Compare Walmart vs Kroger vs Costco vs Aldi based on your real shopping data. SPENDING ANALYTICS Get monthly spending breakdowns by category, store, and individual item. Track grocery expenses over time and spot trends instantly. Understand your household spending habits in seconds — not hours of spreadsheet work. See which categories are eating your budget and where you can cut back. SMART SHOPPING LIST Build your grocery shopping list right inside the app. Check items off as you shop and stay organized on every trip. Plan your shop before you leave and arrive at the store ready — no forgotten items, no impulse overspending. SAVINGS TRACKER Track how much you save each month as you shift spending to cheaper stores and smarter categories. Watch your grocery savings grow over time. Build streaks by hitting your budget goals and see your progress month over month. WHO IT'S FOR Families managing a household grocery budget Budget-conscious shoppers tired of overspending Anyone who wants to track grocery expenses without spreadsheets People who want to know which store is cheapest for their items Shoppers looking to reduce their monthly food bill Couples and roommates managing shared grocery spending WHY GROCSNAP IS DIFFERENT Generic expense tracker apps tell you "you spent $200 at Kroger." GrocSnap tells you which items cost more than last month and which store would have saved you money. Unlike cashback apps like Fetch or Ibotta, GrocSnap gives you real spending analytics — not just reward points. Unlike general budget apps, GrocSnap is built specifically for grocery tracking with receipt scanning built in. No bank account linking required. No subscription needed to get started. Just scan your receipts and start understanding your grocery spending today. FEATURES AT A GLANCE Grocery receipt scanner with OCR Monthly grocery budget tracker Store price comparison tool Spending analytics by category Smart grocery shopping list Savings tracker with streak rewards Household expense tracking Works at any grocery store No manual data entry Free to download Download GrocSnap free and start tracking your grocery spending today.

6479621399.name: Shavian & Quikscript
6479621399.description: The Shavian alphabet (or Shaw alphabet) was posthumously created as an alphabet for the English language, intended to replace Latin. Each character in the Shavian Alphabet requires only a single stroke to be written on paper. The Shaw alphabet was later evolved by its designer Kingsley Read into Quickscript (also known as the Read alphabet and Second Shaw).

6761624745.description: 《靈體淨化器-收容所收集器》—— 捕捉、收藏、互動 核心玩法 這是一款氛圍向的娛樂工具。它能幫你探測周圍環境中可能存在的異常能量波動，並嘗試「净化、收容」它們。 每次成功收容後，螢幕會閃現一枚象徵守護的吉祥圖騰，僅作為趣味回饋。 新功能：靈袋 所有捕捉到的靈體都會被存入你的「靈袋」中。 打開靈袋，你會看到一個個被收容的小靈體。 點擊任意靈體，它會做出掙扎動作（扭動、閃爍或撞击效果），彷彿不甘心被關住。越稀有的靈體掙扎越激烈！ 工具一覽（全集中在同一個界面） 虛擬波紋掃描儀：獨家算法，模擬追蹤附近異常訊號的位置與強度。 磁場波動計：獨家算法，即時反饋環境中的電磁場變化,內建擬真雷達结合獨家算法，用於追蹤異常訊號，具備高靈敏度的電磁場 (EMF) 偵測功能。 異象快拍：拍照後自動分析畫面中的異常光影、霧團或圖案，支援隨時開關。 靈袋入口：一鍵查看所有已捕獲的靈體，並與它們互動。 幫助提示：點擊「？」可查看完整操作指南。 注意 若你容易受驚或心理敏感，請勿使用本 App。使用中請確保自身處於安全場所。一旦感到不適或恐懼，請立刻關閉 App、離開該區域，並找人陪伴。 免責聲明 本 App 依賴手機內建感應器運行，所有探測結果與靈體表現均為模擬娛樂效果，不保證科學準確性。超自然現象無法被實證，請勿將 App 資訊作為真實判斷依據。本工具僅供娛樂消遣，不承擔任何使用風險。

6446227143.name: 单词秀 - 学英语、背单词必备
6446227143.trackName: 单词秀 - 学英语、背单词必备
6446227143.description: 【为什么要选择单词秀背单词？】 趣味学习，轻松掌握： 游戏化挑战，让背单词变得和打怪升级一样刺激！ 每日词霸、全球PK赛，用有趣的小测验检测你的词汇量增长。 智能复习，牢固记忆： 智能算法，根据你的掌握情况定制复习计划。 循环记忆，让每个单词都深深印在你的脑海里。 【单词秀学习单词有哪些科学原理？】 1、间隔重复：这是一种记忆技术，通过在不同的时间间隔复习学习材料来增强长期记忆。【单词秀】通过智能算法安排复习计划，确保每个单词在即将遗忘之前得到复习。 2、主动回忆：这种方法要求学习者主动尝试回忆信息，而不是被动阅读。 【单词秀】中的测验和挑战鼓励用户主动回忆单词，这可以加深记忆痕迹。 3、艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线：这个原理表明，信息遗忘的速度最初很快，但随着时间的推移逐渐减慢。【单词秀】根据这个原理设计复习间隔，帮助用户在遗忘发生前巩固记忆。 4、分布式学习：分布式学习是指将学习时间分散开来，有助于记忆效果。【单词秀】鼓励用户每天学习，而不是一次性长时间学习，这有助于提高记忆效果。 5、测试效应：通过测试自己的知识可以增强学习效果。【单词秀】中的测验和挑战就是一种测试效应的应用，它帮助用户巩固记忆并识别知识盲点。 6、正向激励：当学习者的行为得到积极的反馈时，他们更有可能继续这种行为。【单词秀】提供成就和奖励系统，激励用户持续学习。

6751258487.name: 篆书字典
6751258487.description: 篆书，起源于两千多年前的象形文字，形态灵动，富有神韵。 它不仅是文字，更是承载中华文明的艺术形式。 篆书字典 是一款专注于「篆书查询与学习」的实用工具 App，让你轻松走进古文字世界，领略汉字演变之美。 主要功能 篆书字形查询 输入 简体或繁体汉字，即可快速查询对应的篆书字形，学习古文字写法。 创意印章，一键保存。随时展卷，随心所摹。 手势放大字形： 支持双指缩放，自由放大细节，清晰观察篆书笔画结构与线条之美。 字形图片保存： 一键保存篆书字形图片，方便临摹、学习或设计使用。 汉字文化学习： 从现代汉字回溯古文字形态，帮助理解汉字的来源与演变。 适合人群： 书法爱好者 篆刻与印章设计者 汉字文化学习者 国学与古文字爱好者 教师与学生教学辅助使用 让古老文字走进你的日常。 一起探索汉字之美，感受篆书的神韵与力量。 轻启灵犀，创造美好--由此开始。 【Note】Some features require in-app purchases. Free usage limits apply; additional use requires purchase. Privacy Policy：https://intelegraphics.github.io/support.html EULA: https://intelegraphics.github.io/user_agreement.html

6761295809.name: GuitarPT
6761295809.description: Practice your next favorite song at half speed, bar by bar. GuitarPT turns any track into your personal practice room. Load an MP3, M4A or video file, and GuitarPT automatically detects BPM and chords — entirely on-device, no server, no internet required. Set markers, define loop sections, drop the tempo to 50%, transpose without pitch artifacts. Once the part sits, kick the speed back up. No setup, no fuss. Need a chord chart? Build a leadsheet in the built-in editor using a gesture-driven circle-of-fifths key picker, a smart chord palette and a clean section layout. Play it back with piano, bass and drums across 8 styles — rock, jazz swing, bossa nova, funk and more. Or snap a photo of a handwritten chart and have it digitised via OCR. On stage? Performance mode shows large chord displays with live highlighting of the current chord. Multiple devices? With iCloud sync your songs, markers, leadsheets and setlists are everywhere — iPhone, iPad, all in sync. PLAYER Audio and video player with an interactive waveform Time-stretching from 25% to 150% — without pitch artifacts Pitch shifting of ±12 semitones, independent of tempo One-touch marker grab and drag Up to 3 loop sections per song CHORD ANALYSIS (fully offline) Automatic BPM and chord detection with 145 chord types Slash chord detection (Am/C, G/B …) Confidence indicator per chord Enharmonic notation based on key (Ab instead of G#) Re-analyze with a single tap LEADSHEET CREATOR Circle-of-fifths key picker with swipe gesture Section structure (Intro, Verse, Chorus, Bridge, Solo, Outro) Playback with piano, bass and drums across 8 styles Performance mode with a large chord display Photo import via OCR (OpenAI Vision) Export/import as .guitarpt.json or .zip LIBRARY Songs, leadsheets, projects and setlists Song-leadsheet linking Recording with live waveform Band-folder import from shared iCloud folders Search, sorting and drag-to-reorder iCLOUD SYNC Songs, markers, loops, leadsheets, setlists and photos automatically synced Audio, video and image files via iCloud Drive Download-on-demand Sync log and storage overview in Settings PRIVACY All audio analysis runs on your device. No account required, no trackers, no data sent anywhere. The OpenAI API key is optional and only used for the photo import. Available in English and German.

6445962675.name: Coptic Dictionary Premium
6445962675.description: This is the premium version meaning it is ad-free with all the same content as the normal version. This Coptic dictionary contains over 5000 entries with translations in English and many in French and German. It has been reformatted using entries from the Comprehensive Coptic Lexicon which was released under the following license: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. The dictionary contains native Coptic and Greek loanwords. You can favorite words (or add your own) and then quiz yourself on the words in your favorites list. You can also quiz yourself on random words in the dictionary. You can search in romanized Coptic, English, French, or German. Not all entries are available in every language.

6760305033.name: Ancient Light
6760305033.description: Ancient Light transforms your iPhone into a camera of the nineteenth century. Twelve authentic historic photographic processes - each faithfully simulated through the physics of tone, silver chemistry, grain, paper, emulsion, and light. Not filters. Processes. THE TWELVE PROCESSES -- Daguerreotype (1839) - The first successful photograph. A mirror-like silver surface with luminous shadow detail and seven scanned frame choices, plus No Frame. Tintype (1853) - The photograph of the working class. Robust, immediate, metallic, with regular or square format options and optional worn plate borders. Albumen (1850s) - Warm egg-white paper prints mounted as cabinet cards, with soft sepia-brown toning, aged cream stock, rounded corners, and a ruled inner border. Sepia - The warm brown tone of silver sulphide that preserved Victorian portraits through a century and a half. Cyanotype (1842) - Sir John Herschel's iron-based process. Deep Prussian blue. The print that gave photography the word "blueprint." Anthotype (1839) - Made from crushed plant pigments. Delicate, fugitive, botanical. The most poetic photographic process ever devised. Platinum (1873) - The process of fine art portraiture. Cool, shadow-rich, with a tonal range silver could never match. Autochrome (1907) - The Lumiere brothers' starch-grain colour process. Dreamy, pointillist, the first practical colour photography. Emulsion - A damaged instant-emulsion look with faded color, warm highlights, scorched edges, amber leaks, scratches, and oxidized surface wear. Bromoil (1907) - Oil-based ink on bleached gelatin. Painterly and stippled, with inky shadows and pale milky highlights. Lippmann (1891) - Gabriel Lippmann's Nobel Prize-winning interferential process. Warm amber ageing, long-exposure softness, and glass plate scratches from a century of handling. Infrared (1930s) - Light beyond the visible spectrum. Luminous white foliage, darkened skies, ethereal skin tones. The spectral world captured on heat-sensitive emulsion. WHAT ANCIENT LIGHT CAN DO -- All four optical lenses - ultrawide (0.5x), wide (1x), 2x, and telephoto (5x) - selectable from the viewfinder Shoot once, save many - save multiple historic versions from a single capture On iPhone Pro: saves both a filtered JPEG and the original 48MP ProRAW DNG as a paired asset Emulsion process with faded instant-film color, warmer highlights, lighter grain, and scanned edge damage Albumen cabinet-card output with warm paper tone, aged stock texture, rounded card corners, and ruled border Infrared process with glowing foliage, dark skies, and spectral black-and-white tonality Tintype options - choose regular or square format, with period borders or no borders Seven Daguerreotype frame styles plus No Frame, selectable directly from the viewfinder Higher-resolution Daguerreotype frame output, scaled to the photo instead of the source frame artwork Adjustments apply to the photograph while preserving Daguerreotype frame artwork Full adjustment suite - exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, black point, saturation, vibrance, warmth, sharpness, and vignette Auto enhancement with one tap Precision crop tool with inset handles and rule-of-thirds grid Landscape side-panel layout keeps the image large while all controls stay accessible Photographer credit field - your name travels with every saved file in the IPTC metadata Process, frame, and Tintype options stored between sessions iPhone and iPad, all orientations No subscription. No ads. No account required. Ancient Light is a single purchase. Everything in it is yours.

6761702673.name: HomeReps: Home Workout Tracker
6761702673.description: Prop your phone up. Start your set. HomeReps watches you and counts every rep — hands-free. No tapping, no wearable, no account. Most rep counters make you stop mid-workout to tap a button. That's not counting — that's interrupting. HomeReps uses on-device AI to watch your movement and count pushups, squats, situps, pullups, and more bodyweight exercises automatically. You just move. The phone does the math. — HOW IT WORKS — 1. Pick your exercise 2. Prop your phone so it can see you 3. Start moving — HomeReps counts every clean rep out loud 4. Finish. Your set is already saved. — WHAT YOU GET — ◆ Auto Rep Counting On-device pose detection counts pushups, squats, situps, pullups, and more. No buttons, no bluetooth, no fuss. ◆ Build Your Routine Create custom routines with pushups, squats, situps, pullups, and more. Set your targets, hit start, and let HomeReps count every set automatically. ◆ Streaks That Stick Every workout feeds your streak. Miss a day and you'll feel it. Hit a week and you'll chase a month. ◆ History That Remembers Every rep, every set, every day. Watch your volume climb over weeks without touching a spreadsheet. ◆ Works Anywhere Living room floor. Hotel carpet. Park bench. If your phone can see you, HomeReps can count you. ◆ Camera Stays On Your Phone Pose detection runs entirely on your device. Camera frames are processed in real time and immediately discarded. No video is ever recorded, uploaded, or stored. No account is required. — WHO IT'S FOR — People doing bodyweight workouts at home who are tired of tapping a screen between reps Runners, climbers, and lifters who want a simple way to log accessory work Anyone who's tried to build a pushup habit and lost track by set three Beginners who want the phone to handle the counting so they can handle the form — PRIVACY, SERIOUSLY — HomeReps runs pose detection entirely on your device. Your camera feed is processed locally, in real time, and then discarded — no video, no images, no pose data ever leaves your phone. Your workout records stay on your device too. There is no sign-up and no cloud sync. — WHY HOMEREPS — Just workout. We handle the rest. Prop your phone, do the work, and let your streak grow. That's it. Download HomeReps. 6758232186.name: 轻松识字：识字卡片，高效识字软件，小学生快速提升识字量
6758232186.trackName: 轻松识字：识字卡片，高效识字软件，小学生快速提升识字量
6758232186.description: 这是一个让你轻松、快速提高识字量的汉字学习 App，适合幼儿识字、儿童识字和小学生识字。 如果有长辈识字需求，也同样适用。 1. 沉浸式学习氛围 ⋅ 没有复杂流程，也没有多余动画片和游戏干扰，打开就能开始识字学习，更专注于汉字本身 ⋅ 界面干净、配色柔和让眼睛更放松，长时间看也不容易疲劳 2. 学习没有压力 ⋅ 不需要刻意规划时间，点开就能开始认字，想停就停，更容易长期坚持 ⋅ 哪怕每天只花 5 分钟，也能持续积累识字量 3. 卡片式识字，更高效 ⋅ 通过刷卡片的方式学习汉字，轻松完成认字、测验和记忆 ⋅ 覆盖字形辨认、拼音、笔画笔顺、词语和例句 4. 小学汉字全面覆盖 ⋅ 涵盖常用汉字与小学语文教材全部字表，满足一年级到六年级识字任务 ⋅ 不再浪费时间找资源 ⋅ 比刷短视频还轻松，用学习替代娱乐，快速提升识字量，就是这么简单 ⋅ 我们的目标是：每天 5 分钟，二年学完 3000 字 快速开始使用： 1. 选择课本 ⋅ 点击顶部的课本按钮，选择一本课本开始学习 2. 开始学习 ⋅ 回到 App 首页，点击学习按钮（或者中间的卡片堆），开始学习 ⋅ 每组包含 10 个汉字，每天可根据时间学习一组或多组，逐步增加识字量 3. 按计划复习 ⋅ 今天学习的汉字，从第二天开始安排复习，App 会自动根据复习的情况安排复习时间 4. 调整难度 ⋅ 进入设置页，可以调整学习和复习的难度，比如：跳过句子填空、词语填空或笔画书写练习等，让学习难度更适合自己 使用条款: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 隐私政策: https://staticfiles-a6h.pages.dev/privacy

6740051429.description: 用AI看清每一次挥拍，让训练事半功倍。 NiceShot是专为网球爱好者打造的AI训练分析应用。通过视觉技术帮助您看清正手、反手与发球的每个细节，与大师示范对照，让复盘更高效。 【AI动作分析】 自动识别正手、反手、发球等动作类型；智能切分高光挥拍片段，过滤无效画面；录制与分析同步进行，结束后即可查看数据报告。 【视频管理】 支持实时录制与相册导入，视频按时间整理。全局统计提供近12周训练热力日历，按每日累计训练时长着色，助您把握坚持节奏。 【复盘与对比】 多维数据看板呈现步数、消耗与各动作占比；播放器支持慢放与按动作类型筛选。视频详情提供动作时间轴，快速定位每一次击球。可将您的动作片段与标准示范同屏对比，参考挥拍速度等指标，内置大师示范与骨骼连线对比，结合AI建议辅助改进动作。 【高光导出】 支持将精彩片段导出保存，记录每一个进步瞬间。 【多设备支持】 支持英语、简体中文、繁体中文；适配iPhone与iPad。 使用条款 (EULA)：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6758133969.name: DocKit: PDF Scanner & Toolkit
6758133969.description: Dockit is a smart document scanner and full PDF toolkit — AI-powered filters, a complete set of PDF tools, and everything works fully offline. Scan documents with your camera and get clean, professional results instantly. Smart filters run entirely on-device to auto-detect edges, correct perspective, remove shadows, and produce crisp scans whether you're capturing a receipt, a contract, an ID card, or a passport. DOCUMENT SCANNER Scan in four modes built for different needs — General for any document, Document for standard paper sizes like A4 and Letter, ID Card for capturing both sides of an identity card, and Passport for travel documents. Every scan is processed locally with no data sent anywhere. ORGANIZE YOUR PDFs Merge multiple PDFs into one, or split a file your way — by page range, by file size, or at fixed intervals. Reorder, rotate, delete, or extract pages with a few taps. CONVERT & EXTRACT Turn PDFs into images or build a PDF from your photos in seconds. Extract text from any PDF or use OCR to pull text out of scanned images — all offline. SECURITY & SIGNING Sign documents digitally, add custom watermarks, protect files with a password, or remove protection from any PDF. Your documents, fully under your control. COMPRESS & OPTIMIZE Reduce PDF file sizes significantly without losing quality — useful for sharing, emailing, or simply freeing up storage. PRIVACY BY DESIGN Dockit works entirely offline. Nothing is uploaded and no data is collected. What's on your device stays on your device. SUBSCRIPTION & PREMIUM FEATURES Dockit offers a free version with core scanning features. Advanced tools require a subscription. Premium features include: OCR (text recognition) PDF compression Digital signatures Password protection for PDFs ID card and passport scanning Extended scan limits Subscription details are shown in-app before purchase. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6760224165.name: AppLauncherPro
6760224165.description: AppLauncher Pro lets you build a clean Home Screen widget for quick access to your favourite apps and services. Choose your layout, pick a theme, customize app icons and create a launcher widget that fits the way you use your iPhone or iPad. Configure popular apps in seconds or add your own custom apps with a URL scheme. AppLauncher Pro also includes premium features for users who want more flexibility, including additional widget styles, saved presets, advanced tuning and premium layout tools. Please note: Some apps may not support public URL schemes and some launch options may change depending on the app version installed on your device. 6756068591.name: CardStar
6756068591.description: CardStar is a modern flash card app for iPhone, iPad and Apple Silicon Mac that helps you create and organize cards and study card sets your way. Create cards and organize them into separate card sets for different topics, subjects or projects. Use CardStar for learning, revision, languages, facts, reference collections and much more. CardStar also includes powerful quiz features and on-device AI card generation on devices with Apple Intelligence enabled. Generate complete study sets from your own prompt, review the results and save them as a new card set. Whether you want to build your own study system manually or speed things up with AI, CardStar gives you a flexible way to manage and practice your cards across your devices. Key Features: Create flash cards with title and content Organize cards into separate card sets Search across card titles and content View all card titles in list view with sorting options Print or export all or selected cards Study with Quiz Mode (tap to reveal) Use normal and reverse quiz directions Mark cards for review in quiz mode Import cards from plain Text or CSV files Backup and restore your complete card library Initial on-device AI card set generation on devices with Apple Intelligence enabled Available on iPhone, iPad and Apple Silicon Mac CardStar Pro features: Unlimited AI card sets and AI additions Multiple Choice quiz mode Guided AI templates with ready-to-edit prompts Study stats and quiz history Weak-card insights and review Retry Missed Questions Timed multiple choice RTF import for rich text study notes

6749086047.name: Photo to ZIP - Image to Zip
6749086047.trackName: Photo to ZIP - Image to Zip
6749086047.description: Bundle multiple photos into one convenient ZIP archive in seconds. Photo to ZIP makes it simple to collect, compress, save, and send pictures without complicated desktop tools. SELECT, CREATE, AND SEND Choose multiple photos from your library, create a single ZIP file, then save it to Files or share it wherever you need. It is ideal for email attachments, project handoffs, organized backups, and quick transfers. KEY FEATURES Select multiple photos in one batch Create a single ZIP archive quickly Save archives directly to the Files app Share completed files with other apps On-device processing for better privacy Works offline when you need it Clean interface with Dark Mode support HOW IT WORKS 1. Choose photos from your library. 2. Create the ZIP archive. 3. Save or share the finished file. Whether you are backing up memories, organizing an album, sending client images, or reducing the hassle of moving many files, Photo to ZIP keeps the workflow fast and straightforward. SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS Monthly and yearly auto-renewing options may be available. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. 6759851743.name: JSON Editor & Diff
6759851743.description: Edit, validate, repair, and compare JSON faster on macOS. JSON Editor & Diff is a native macOS app for developers who work with API responses, config files, and large JSON documents every day. Keep two documents open side by side, clean them up instantly, and spot differences with clear JSONPath-based output. What you can do: Edit JSON in dual panes: Source and Destination Validate JSON in real time while you type Format and minify JSON with normalized output Repair broken JSON (removes comments and trailing commas) Compare two JSON documents with path-based diffs Browse structure in Tree view Search independently in each editor with current/total match count Use keyboard shortcuts to format, minify, and repair the active editor Built for focused desktop workflows: Native SwiftUI + AppKit text editing Fast, responsive editing for everyday development tasks Clean interface designed for debugging and data inspection If you frequently inspect payloads, debug APIs, or review JSON changes before shipping, JSON Editor & Diff helps you work with confidence and speed.

6758919297.name: ScreenVault
6758919297.description: ScreenVault helps you turn a cluttered screenshot library into an organized, searchable personal archive. The app scans your screenshots, extracts text with on-device OCR and organizes them into useful categories such as recipes, shopping, travel, bills, health, ideas, events and more. You can search by extracted text, title or tags, review important screenshots as flashcards, archive items you want to keep out of the main feed and clean up screenshots safely when they are no longer needed. ScreenVault is designed with privacy in mind. Screenshot analysis happens on your device and your screenshots and extracted text stay private! ScreenVault Pro unlocks advanced workflow tools for larger screenshot libraries, including unlimited flashcards, custom titles, tags, custom categories, advanced filters, saved smart filters, batch actions, batch tag and title edits and bulk cleanup tools. Key Features: Automatically import screenshots from your photos library Extracts readable text from screenshots with OCR Organizes screenshots into smart categories Search by extracted text, screenshot title or tags Manually change categories when needed Mark important screenshots as flashcards for review Archive screenshots without deleting them Delete screenshots from ScreenVault or photos Export and share original screenshots Privacy-focused on-device processing ScreenVault Pro: Unlimited flashcards Custom screenshot titles Tags Custom categories Advanced filters by category, tag and date Saved smart filters for frequently used filter combinations Batch archive, delete and category changes Batch tag edits Batch title prefix and suffix edits Bulk cleanup tools, including deleting all items in the Deleted tab

6754511446.name: Invoice Maker & Bill: SmartIQ
6754511446.description: SmartIQ is the ultimate Invoice Maker and Estimate Creator designed specifically for freelancers, contractors, and small business owners who need to create professional invoices on the go. Say goodbye to complex accounting software and embrace a simple, powerful billing app that saves you hours every week. Why SmartIQ is the Best Invoicing Solution? Whether you need a simple receipt maker, a detailed estimate generator, or a comprehensive business invoice tool, SmartIQ adapts to your workflow. Designed for speed, our app ensures that you can send a billing statement or quotation to your client before you even leave the job site. NEW: Seamless Quotation Workflow Never type the same info twice. With our new Quotation tool, you can send a price proposal to a client, and once they approve, convert it into a professional tax invoice instantly. It’s the perfect workflow for contractors, freelancers, and service providers who need to move fast. Comprehensive Features for Business Growth: 100+ Professional Templates: Stand out from the competition. Choose from a vast library of invoice templates that are A4-ready and fully customizable to match your brand identity. Global Tax & Compliance: Built-in support for GST, VAT, and Sales Tax. 6756861706.name: OnTrack - Gym Accountability
6756861706.description: The gym accountability app that actually works. You know the cycle. You set a goal, go strong for a week, then skip "just one day" that turns into a month. The guilt builds, the membership goes to waste, and you start over in January. OnTrack breaks that cycle. You pick a partner, someone you actually know, and hold each other accountable. When you check in at the gym, they see it. When you skip, they know. HOW IT WORKS 1. Set Your Goal - Pick your gym and choose how many times you want to go each week. 2. Add Your Partner - Invite a friend, partner, or coworker. Someone you'd hate to disappoint. 3. GPS-Verified Check-Ins - Snap a photo when you arrive. GPS confirms you're actually there. No faking it. 4. Build Your Streak - Watch your consistency grow week after week. Break your streak? Your partner knows instantly. 5. Stay Motivated - Encourage each other through the hard days. One message can be the difference between showing up and giving up. WHY IT WORKS WHEN WILLPOWER DOESN'T Summer is coming. You don't have time for another false start. You're 65% more likely to reach your fitness goals with an accountability partner. Not a bot. Not a reminder you swipe away. A real person who will call you out. Real accountability with people you actually know GPS-verified check-ins mean no excuses, no lies Weekly streaks make consistency addictive Real-time notifications keep you both committed Track your progress and celebrate milestones together Stop feeling guilty about skipping the gym. Start showing up with someone who won't let you quit. OnTrack is completely free to use. TERMS: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6756080778.name: Off 2: 离线航班追踪
6756080778.description: Off 2 是一款即使 wifi 失效也能继续工作的航班追踪应用。 当其他应用在客舱门关闭的瞬间失去信号时，Off 2 使用您 iPhone 的 GPS 和气压计，在 35,000 英尺高空、飞行模式下、在海洋上空，实时追踪您的航班。无需互联网，无需订阅，无需借口。 — 扫描登机牌 点击登机牌上的条形码（QR、PDF417、Aztec、DataMatrix），Off 2 会自动填充所有信息：航空公司、航班号、航线、日期、座位、订座代码。从登机到起飞，几秒搞定。 — 实时追踪，即使离线 在令人惊叹的 3D 地球仪上观看您的飞机移动 — 真实的位置、高度、到达时间。昼夜分界线精确显示您将在何时穿越日出。 — 分享您的航班 起飞前给家人发送实时链接。他们可以在地球仪上实时看到您的飞机移动，看到 ETA 倒数，在着陆时收到通知 — 即使您在空中没有信号。 — APPLE WATCH 复杂功能 剩余时间、ETA 和进度直接显示在表盘上。即使 iPhone 应用关闭也会自主更新。 — 实时活动 您的航班显示在锁屏和 Dynamic Island 上。无需解锁，无需打开应用。 — 多段行程 规划包含多个航班和中转的复杂旅程。逐段编辑时间 — 调整会自动向前传播。 — 35,000 英尺高空乘客聊天 通过蓝牙和 WiFi 在同一航班上找到其他 Off 2 乘客。无需互联网。分享您的座位，交换零食，在高空结识朋友。 — 想知道飞行员看到了什么？解锁飞行员模式 在您的座位上，体验驾驶舱视角。QNH/QFE 气压高度表、EPA（能量路径角）指示、飞行计划解析、巡航时的真实飞行高度层显示——还有 3D 地球上的航班回放、外接蓝牙 GPS 接收器、自定义离线地图，以及完整的飞机性能数据库。一次购买，永久拥有——无订阅。（应用内购买） — 飞机数据库 浏览 200 多种飞机及照片——按类别（航空公司与公务机）、制造商和机型。完整性能数据包含在飞行员模式中。 — 令人惊叹的 3D 地球仪 昼夜可视化、大圆航线、点击居中。可选：将您自己的 .mbtiles 文件放入 Off 2 文件夹以使用自定义地图。 — 隐私优先 无账户。无追踪。无广告。除非您主动分享，否则您的飞行数据永远不会离开您的手机。 — 39 种语言 完整翻译为 39 个 App Store 地区，包括阿拉伯语、中文、法语、德语、印地语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语、俄语、西班牙语、泰语等。 — 高分辨率地球（飞行员模式） 开启可选的高精度底图，放大时世界会清晰四倍：海岸线、岛屿、地形和夜间城市灯光。只需下载一次，之后与其他功能一样完全离线运行。 您之前那个航班追踪应用一直梦想成为的样子。

6443428322.description: Meiji输入法是一款日语键盘（帮助你解决日语汉字键入问题） = = = 产品功能 = = = 【手写识别精准】超大词库，再潦草也能精准识别 【手写识别PLUS】阿拉伯数字、符号、英文26字母都OK！ 【假名、罗马音注音】手写内容支持假名、罗马音注音，再也不用担心日文汉字不会读了。 【高音质朗读手写内容】可以朗读手写的内容并支持语速调节。（进入我的-设置-声音-朗读手写内容，即可开启使用） 【画笔颜色自定义】想要什么颜色的笔随便选！ 【画笔粗细自定义】想要画笔多细多粗，拖拽一下就OK！ 【键盘高度自定义】大屏手写很自由 【稳定输入】不断优化，保证稳定性 【颜文字】不断更新卡哇伊的表情 【离线使用】无需联网，操作很自然 【主题跟随】外观跟随系统深浅色模式 【偏旁部首】除了内置手写识别键盘，还加了偏旁部首键盘用于解决日语汉字键入问题 【iPad小键盘】支持悬浮小键盘，学习日语更效率 【Tip 1】如何启用Meiji输入法？ 第一步：安装后，进入系统设置 -> 通用 -> 键盘 -> 添加新键盘 -> 第三方键盘 选择 Meiji输入法 -> Meiji输入法 -> 开启完全访问 -> 完成 第二步：打开任意输入框 -> 长按地球键 选择【Meiji输入法】 【Tip 2】如何自定义键盘的高度？ 打开任意输入框 -> 键盘设置为【Meiji输入法】键盘 -> 点击键盘右上角的「」按钮即可调整 【Tip 3】由于系统缓存的原因，如果下载后无法找到Meiji输入法，请尝试重新启动需要使用Meiji输入法的App或重启设备（或更新最新的稳定的iOS系统）。

6479872912.name: Fight IQ
6479872912.description: Fight IQ is your ultimate companion in the world of combat sports. Here’s why it’s a game-changer: Document your journey – Whether it's MMA, boxing, muay thai, judo, BJJ, karate, or any other martial art, Fight IQ is where you log every sparring session. Track your opponents' details – age, weight, height, strengths, weaknesses, and favorite techniques. Analyze your bouts – Dive deep into your sparring sessions, noting every technique executed, scored, or countered. Document your insights and learning moments to level up your game. AI coaching at your fingertips – Our AI coach delves into your fights, recognizing patterns, tracking your progress, and delivering personalized advice. From optimal combinations to defensive strategies, body conditioning to mental preparation, it's like having a dedicated coach in your corner. Share the excitement – Flaunt your scorecards and share the wisdom from your AI coach with friends or on social media platforms. Let the world see your progress and celebrate your victories. Seamlessly sync across devices – With iCloud backup, access your data anytime, anywhere, on any device linked to your iCloud account. Your fight journey stays with you, no matter where you go. Whether you're a seasoned combatant or just starting out, Fight IQ welcomes you. Record, analyze, and conquer – it's all here. Fight IQ includes both a free version and a subscription version with premium features. You can subscribe and pay on the App Store, using your Apple ID. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renew may be turned off after purchase by going to the ‘Go Premium’ page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost. Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://fightiqapp.github.io/#privacy

6760254021.name: Cully - 照片清理器
6760254021.description: 整理你的照片库。日复一日。 超过20,000张照片，不知从何下手？重复照片、模糊的图片、2019年的截图？Cully把这一切变成你真正能做到的事。 方法很简单：选一个随机日期，浏览那天的照片 — 所有年份同时呈现。每次会话，生活的不同片段。留下最好的，删掉其余的。每天五分钟，你的图库变得更轻盈。 使用方法 点击随机，Cully选择一个日期。你会立即看到那天所有年份的全部照片。 滑动浏览你的网格。点击选择，双指捏合缩放查看细节。 iOS会确认每次删除。照片移至"最近删除"，可在30天内恢复。 功能 隐私优先：无需账户，无云端，无追踪。你的照片永远不会离开你的设备。 智能随机：优先未整理的日期。 分享原图：长按任意照片即可以完整画质分享。 Live Photos 和视频：直接在网格中播放。 日期选择器：挑选特定日期 — 已整理的日期会被标记。 你的统计：查看你删除了多少照片，释放了多少存储空间。 温和提醒：可选通知帮助你坚持下去。 锁屏小组件：一眼查看你的删除统计。 iCloud同步：统计数据和设置在所有设备上同步。 iPhone和iPad：为每种屏幕尺寸优化的布局。 快捷操作：从主屏幕直接启动。 双指缩放：放大任何照片，做出更好的判断。 为什么选择CULLY？ 在摄影中，"to cull"意味着检查你的照片，只保留最好的。我们创建Cully是因为我们遇到了同样的问题：一个不断增长的照片库，却没有好的方法来整理它。 无需账户。无需云端。没有AI。没有分析。没有订阅。打开就用。 Made in Berlin.

6756138936.name: MediaControl
6756138936.description: MediaControl est un coffre privé local pour vos contenus sensibles. L’app réunit une **caméra photo**, un **enregistreur vidéo**, des **galeries sécurisées** en miniatures 80×80 (sans zoom), un **bloc-notes privé**, et un **navigateur éphémère** qui ne conserve aucune trace. L’accès est protégé par **mot de passe + Face ID/Touch ID** pour éviter toute ouverture accidentelle. FONCTIONNALITÉS Caméra privée : capturez des photos qui ne vont pas dans Photos iOS ni iCloud. Vidéo privée : enregistrement local avec normalisation audio douce pour améliorer l’écoute sans saturation. Galeries protégées : miniatures fixes 80×80, sélection multiple, **partage** via la feuille iOS, **suppression définitive** (poubelle). Notes privées : créez, modifiez, partagez et supprimez vos notes (titres, texte, horodatage). Navigateur privé : session sans cookies/cache/historique persistants (stockage non-persisant), blocage simple des traqueurs courants. Recherche intégrée dans Notes et navigation fluide dans les galeries. SÉCURITÉ & CONFIDENTIALITÉ Accès double : **mot de passe obligatoire** puis **biométrie** (Face ID/Touch ID). Option d’autoprotection : après plusieurs échecs d’authentification (si activé), l’app peut **effacer toutes ses données locales**. 100 % local : aucun envoi automatique vers des serveurs tiers, pas d’analytics, pas de publicité, pas de sauvegarde dans la Pellicule. Confidentialité renforcée : pas de cookies applicatifs persistants, pas de profilage. PARTAGE & EXPORT Partage contrôlé : vous choisissez quand et comment partager (Mail, Messages, apps compatibles). Export par câble : connectez l’iPhone à un Mac/PC et récupérez vos fichiers via Finder/iTunes (onglet Fichiers de l’app), sans passer par la Pellicule. Suppression facile : appui long ou sélection multiple puis icône **poubelle** dans Photos/Vidéos/Notes. ERGONOMIE Interface simple et lisible, actions directes (Sélectionner, Partager, Supprimer). Miniatures réduites par conception pour limiter l’exposition involontaire des contenus. Indicateurs visuels clairs (lecture, sélection, actions de barre d’outils). COMPATIBILITÉ iPhone, iOS 16 ou version ultérieure. Optimisée pour les appareils récents. POUR QUI ? Utilisateurs qui souhaitent séparer strictement leurs médias personnels de la Pellicule iOS. Créateurs, professionnels, parents, voyageurs, toute personne qui veut garder la main sur la visibilité, le partage et la suppression de ses contenus. ASSISTANCE Page d’aide (Notion) et support par e-mail. Conseils de démarrage, gestion des autorisations Caméra/Micro, export par câble, résolution des problèmes courants. POLITIQUE DE CONFIDENTIALITÉ Données stockées localement, jamais envoyées sans action explicite de l’utilisateur. Détails complets disponibles sur la page dédiée (lien dans la fiche App). EN RÉSUMÉ MediaControl vous redonne le contrôle : **capturer, classer, partager, supprimer** — en local, sous votre responsabilité, avec une **protection double** (mot de passe + biométrie) et un **navigateur sans traces persistantes**. Une solution discrète, simple et fiable pour vos photos, vidéos et notes privées.

6762385358.name: 奶蛙 - 魔性音乐弹奏解压抽象洗脑
6762385358.trackName: 奶蛙 - 魔性音乐弹奏解压抽象洗脑
6762385358.description: 欢迎来到奶蛙奏乐音乐键盘，一个让你根本停不下来的音效盘。 每个按钮都是奶蛙经典音效。 从魔性的"哈哈哈哈哈"到好玩的"嘎嘎滴辣虾"，从可爱的"卡脚塞"到洗脑的"戏弄壁诺机"。每一个音效，都是奶蛙宇宙里的名场面。 点击、循环、叠加，玩出花来 轻点即播，按住进入循环模式——奶蛙永不停歇，直到你放过它。更绝的是：你可以同时循环多个按钮。三个、四个、五个一起叠，瞬间组建一支奶蛙交响乐团，莫扎特听了都想转行。 随机自动敲击 懒得动手？点一下随机播放，让 app 自己敲。坐享一场奶蛙随机演唱会，适合发呆、摸鱼、以及让朋友怀疑你的精神状态。 按下去就是爽 每次点击都有 3D 按压动效、金色粒子爆发、还有浮出的经典台词。手感拉满，解压神器。 纯粹，干净，没有套路 无广告。无订阅。无数据收集。打开就玩，关掉就走。 iPhone 和 iPad 通用，横竖屏都支持。因为奶蛙的快乐，不分方向。 下载。按一下。试试能不能忍住不笑。 你忍不住的。

6480389336.name: 庇护所
6480389336.description: 伴随着震动与恐惧，庇护所的闸门在你身后打开。在这个严酷的后末日时代，你将如何保证家的延续？ 《庇护所》是一款后末日题材的模拟经营游戏，重新定义了什么叫做“核后家庭”。你作为幸存者，必须收集尽可能多的补给品，将它们带到你的地下庇护所，因为在荒芜的未来这里很快就会成为你唯一的家。 当所有希望都破灭，你会如何对待这个荒凉的新世界？当你每天面对无数的道德考验与选择时，你会怎么办？因为这个选择可能直接决定你家庭的生或死。在生命的苦痛中，在这个冰冷可怖的地下庇护所中，与幽闭，辐射，精疲力竭做斗争。你必须离开这个缺乏保障的庇护所，到外面去，到这个荒无人烟的废土中，找寻必要的补给，哪怕是只能让你的家庭再多活一天的补给。 经营你的避难所：保证它的安全与舒适，确保你的家庭有足够的资源生存下去。保护你的免受掠夺与骚扰！ 自定义形象：你的家庭对你来说是独一无二的；你可以自定义他们的性别、名字与外观。 RPG元素：随着你家庭的发展，他们的状态也会随之进化。属性，优势，劣势这些都会因你的选择而变化。 合成系统：创造用于生活的家具，或是用于战斗的武器。 探索：派出你的家庭成员探索并收集资源 雇佣系统：雇佣形形色色的外来者，让他们融入你的家庭，获得他们的忠诚。 动态遭遇系统：你的家庭会遭遇各种各样的威胁，比如不同派系间的争斗，或者是残忍的野兽。 回合制战斗：对那些不可理喻的人，暴力是你最后的手段。 宠物：你的宠物也是家庭的一员。选择狗，猫，鱼，蛇或者马成为你的宠物。 车辆：让探索变得更快更安全。

6757230704.name: 空气手枪-手表游戏
6757230704.description: 将你的手机和智能手表变成一个随身携带的动作音效模拟器。利用先进的重力感应技术，只需挥动手腕或晃动设备，即可触发逼真的声音效果，带来身临其境的交互体验。 应用内置丰富的音效库： 魔法系列：体验冰锥破碎、法杖施法、飞剑穿梭等奇幻声音。 冷兵器系列：包含刀剑挥舞、弓弩发射、拳头击打、鞭子抽击等真实打击感音效。 枪械系列：模拟各种真实的枪支射击声音。 完美支持手机与手表双端联动，无论是朋友聚会整蛊、角色扮演还是个人娱乐，都能带来极高的可玩性。更多精彩音效将持续更新，快来体验挥动触发的乐趣吧！

6762485805.name: 口袋档案
6762485805.description: 口袋档案是一款面向个人用户的轻量文档整理工具。 你可以直接拍摄，或从相册导入已有图片，把证件、合同、发票等资料整理到同一个地方，并导出为 PDF 便于存档和分享。 核心特点： 支持拍摄或从相册导入文档图片 支持继续补页、替换页面、删除页面 支持按分类整理文档 支持重命名、备注与基础整理 支持导出 PDF 到本机并分享 支持把整份文档合成为一张长图并保存到系统相册 主要资料保存在本地设备，减少对云端依赖 适合谁： 想把身份证件、票据、合同整理清楚的个人用户 重视隐私，希望资料尽量保留在本地的用户 希望用简单工具快速归档日常文件的用户 权限说明： 相机权限：用于拍摄文档图片 照片权限：用于导入本地图片 相册写入权限：用于把导出的长图保存到系统相册 隐私说明： 本应用不要求注册账号 不提供云同步 不会在未经你主动操作的情况下上传你的文档内容 当你主动导出或分享文件时，相关文件会按你的操作流转到系统分享目标

6762412284.name: 时光锚点 Days Anchor - 倒数 纪念 小组件
6762412284.trackName: 时光锚点 Days Anchor - 倒数 纪念 小组件
6762412284.description: 时光锚点 Days Anchor 是一款简洁优雅的倒计时与累计日应用，帮你追踪生活中每一个重要的日子——无论是期待已久的旅行、即将到来的生日，还是已经坚持了多少天的新习惯。 主要功能 倒计时与累计日：既能倒数未来的日期，也能累计过去已经发生的日子。到达目标日期后，倒计时会自动切换为"已过天数"显示。 四种小组件样式：文字样式以极简的大号数字呈现，支持数字居上或居下切换；点阵样式按年份与天数分组，直观感受时间跨度；进度环以环形进度展示剩余比例；进度条横向显示，一目了然。点阵与进度条还可切换圆形、圆角、方形三种形状。 丰富的主屏幕小组件：小号与中号两种尺寸，随手一屏便能浏览所有重要日期。 重复事件：支持每周、每月、每年三种重复周期，过了日期自动滚动到下一次发生日。 农历支持：春节、中秋等按中国农历重复的日期自动按农历周期推算，闰月与大小月均正确处理。 iCloud 同步：事件在 iPhone、iPad 之间无缝同步，换设备无需重新录入。 到期提醒：可自定义提前几天、几周、几个月提醒，以及当天提醒的具体时间，重要日子绝不错过。 19 种精选配色：饱和、柔和、深色三大色系，每一种颜色都在小组件与深浅模式下保持清晰可读。 自定义颜色：不满足于预设？可手动选取任意颜色。 标签与置顶：用标签分类整理事件，将最重要的那几个置顶到首页最上方。 分享为图片：将任意事件生成精美图片，便于分享到社交网络或发给朋友。 适用场景 旅行倒计时：距离下一次出发还有几天 纪念日：结婚、恋爱、入职、搬家已经过了多少天 生日与节日：每年自动重复，生日当天准时提醒 习惯追踪：戒烟、健身、学习、早起已经坚持了多久 育儿：距离预产期还有几天，宝宝已经成长多少天 发布日期：专辑、电影、新品上线的倒数 隐私说明 所有事件数据仅存储在你的设备与你本人的 iCloud 账户中，不与任何第三方共享。 让每一个重要日子，都清晰可见。
