6762050905.name: TapFi
6762050905.description: Is that a capital I, a lowercase l, or a one? You know the moment. The WiFi password is scrawled on a chalkboard, laminated in a welcome pack, or Blu-Tacked behind the kettle in the Airbnb. You type it carefully. Wrong. Three times. TapFi ends that. Point your camera at the sign and you're connected. That's the whole app. WHAT IT ACTUALLY DOES TapFi reads the network name and password off almost anything: printed cards, chalkboards, stickers, receipts, and handwriting that would embarrass a doctor. Then it joins the network for you. It also knows the ways signs lie. Spaces that aren't really in the password. Capitals that are actually lowercase. Two networks listed and no hint which one is real. TapFi quietly tries the sensible variations until one connects, and only keeps the one that actually worked. WiFi QR codes are read instantly, on your device. Hidden networks that don't broadcast their name work too. THEN IT GETS BETTER Every network you join lands in an encrypted list, so next visit is one tap. And when someone asks for the WiFi, stop spelling it out across the room. TapFi turns any saved network into a clean, printable QR card. AirDrop it, save it to Photos, or print it and stick it by the door. Guests scan it with their camera. They don't need the app. If you run a cafe, a B&B, or a spare room that's never empty, that card alone pays for the app in a weekend. THE BORING BUT IMPORTANT BIT Passwords live in your iPhone's Keychain, encrypted, on your device. No account. No ads. No tracking. No subscription. You buy it once, and it reads WiFi signs forever. That's the deal.

6762640612.name: Forge Database Manager
6762640612.description: Stop paying for four tools. Forge opens SQL servers, cloud warehouses, NoSQL clusters, federated query engines, file dumps, and key/value stores in one native app — no Electron, no subscriptions. Built with SwiftUI for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. One purchase, every Apple device. NINETEEN DATABASE ENGINES PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB — full read/write with inline cell editing CockroachDB, TimescaleDB, Amazon Redshift — wire-compatible, zero extra setup SQLite + libSQL — local files, full CRUD Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL — TDS protocol in pure Swift over NIO + NIOSSL Oracle — pure Swift NIO. No Instant Client, no SQL*Plus, no JDBC Snowflake — SQL API v2 with key-pair JWT auth. No drivers, no ODBC Google BigQuery — serverless cloud warehouse, service account JWT Trino / Presto — federated queries across Hive, MySQL, Postgres Turso — remote libSQL over Hrana HTTPS, bearer-token auth Apache Cassandra, ScyllaDB — CQL v4 over NIO DuckDB — embedded analytics. Query Parquet / CSV / JSON via SQL Redis — browse keys by type (string, hash, list, set, sorted set) like a table ClickHouse — analytics queries via native HTTP Elasticsearch — indexes browse like SQL tables THREE FILE FORMATS AS DATABASES CSV — auto-detected separators, quoted fields, duplicate headers handled JSON, NDJSON, JSON Lines — arrays and streaming SQL Dump — open mysqldump or pg_dump files and browse without executing a statement DRY RESTORE — UNIQUE TO FORGE Inspect any SQL dump as if it were a live database. Memory-mapped lazy parsing with a cross-session cache. Browse a 400 MB backup in seconds. No risk, no server, no restore. AI BRIDGE — UNIQUE TO FORGE Run a local MCP server that exposes your databases as tools to Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, Cline, and any AI assistant. List tables, inspect schemas, run queries — in plain English, on every supported engine. Read-only by default. Credentials never leave your Mac. UNIVERSAL BACKUP Scheduled backups for every engine: SQL dump for SQL databases, JSON for Redis (types and TTL preserved). Cron expressions, retention, streaming gzip, "Backup Now" one-shot. Runs in the background on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. EDIT IN PLACE Double-click a cell to edit. Save many cells across rows in one transaction. Schema-aware INSERT and DELETE. Duplicate row with one click. Import CSV/JSON straight into a SQL table via a 4-step wizard. Every SQL engine, Oracle included. SMART DATA GRID Click headers to sort. Type to filter. Export results as CSV, JSON, or SQL INSERT. Right-click any cell to copy values or rows as JSON. Works on every engine. TABLE INSPECTOR A side pane shows the selected table's columns, types, primary key, foreign keys, and indexes — without leaving the data browser. Toggle on demand. SCHEMA COMPARE Diff tables and columns between two connections. Catch drift before it bites in production. SSH TUNNEL Reach databases behind a bastion host. Password or private-key auth (ed25519, RSA, with passphrase). Pure Swift, no openssh dependency. Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. PORTABLE & SECURE Export connections as a single encrypted bundle (ChaCha20-Poly1305 + PBKDF2-SHA256), import elsewhere with a passphrase. Drag a .sqlite/.csv/.json/.sql.gz file onto the sidebar to open it. Passwords in Apple Keychain. SSL/TLS for remote connections. No telemetry, no cloud dependency. LIVE DATA WITH DIFF HIGHLIGHT Toggle auto-refresh on any table to watch data change in real time. Forge re-runs your query every 5 seconds, 15 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute, or 5 minutes — new rows light up green, changed cells light up yellow. Pauses automatically when you're editing. Twenty-two data sources. One app. Zero Electron.

6760802436.name: 转盘做决定
6760802436.description: 一款功能强大的随机决策工具，通过趣味转盘帮你快速做出选择。无论是日常生活中的小决定，还是团队活动中的公平抽选，都能轻松搞定。 主要特色： 1.自定义转盘 - 创建无限个转盘，满足不同场景需求 2.权重调节 - 为每个选项设置不同权重，灵活控制中奖概率 3.指定必出 - 需要时可指定某个选项必定中选 4.临时禁用 - 本轮不想出现的选项可临时屏蔽 5.本轮不重复 - 开启后已中选项自动排除，避免重复 6.历史记录 - 完整记录每次转盘结果，支持按转盘筛选和统计 7.数据统计 - 可视化图表展示各选项命中次数和概率分布 8.流畅动画 - 可调节转盘速度和震动反馈，体验更佳 9.本地存储 - 所有数据保存在本机，不联网，隐私安全 【为什么选择我们】 简洁易用 - 界面清爽，操作直观，上手即用 功能完善 - 从基础随机到高级权重控制，满足各类需求 隐私保护 - 无需注册登录，数据完全本地化 持续优化 - 定期更新，不断改进用户体验 【适用人群】 选择困难症患者 需要公平抽选的团队 举办活动的组织者 追求趣味决策的年轻人 课堂互动的教师 直播抽奖的主播

6753931366.name: Good Dad
6753931366.description: Being a great dad isn't about perfection—it's about presence. Good Dad is your daily companion for mindful, intentional fatherhood. Get personalized reminders that adapt to each child's name and age, helping you show up as the dad you want to be—now available in 9 languages and designed to support families with multiple children. PERSONALIZED FOR YOUR WHOLE FAMILY Every reminder is tailored to each of your children. Whether you have one child or five, Good Dad creates personalized prompts for every unique relationship. Add your kids' names and birthdays, and the app customizes over 100 reminders specifically for your family—from "Ask Emma about her day" to age-appropriate prompts for toddlers, teens, and everyone in between. Plus, you'll automatically receive birthday reminders so you never miss celebrating their special days. MULTI-CHILD MINDFUL REMINDERS Fathers with multiple children receive reminders designed for their whole family. Each notification is personalized with the right child's name and age-appropriate guidance, helping you be intentional in every relationship and present for each unique bond you're building. New reminders help you foster healthy sibling relationships too. DAILY MINDFUL REMINDERS Receive gentle nudges throughout your day to be present, patient, and connected. Each reminder is a simple action you can take right now—no guilt, no pressure, just practical ways to strengthen your bond with your children. 14 THOUGHTFUL CATEGORIES Love & Connection – Express affection and build deeper bonds Patience & Grace – Practice understanding in challenging moments Presence & Mindfulness – Be fully present with your kids Understanding & Space – Give them room to grow and feel Modeling Good Character – Lead by example in all situations Self-Care & Reflection – Take care of yourself as a father Fun & Play – Create joyful moments and lasting memories Daily Routines – Make transitions smoother and more meaningful Discipline & Boundaries – Set loving limits with intention Education & Learning – Support their growth and curiosity Health & Wellness – Build healthy habits together Emotional Intelligence – Help them understand feelings Adventure & Growth – Encourage exploration and trying new things Sibling Relationships – Foster healthy bonds between your children 100+ ACTIONABLE REMINDERS Browse our complete library of reminders, each crafted to help you be more present. Search by category, save your favorites, and schedule reminders that fit your family's rhythm. NEVER MISS A MILESTONE Birthday reminders ensure you're always prepared to celebrate your children. Set how far in advance you want to be notified, so you have time to plan something special for each child. AVAILABLE IN 9 LANGUAGES Good Dad brings mindful fatherhood to families worldwide: English Spanish Portuguese French German Italian Japanese Korean Vietnamese FLEXIBLE & NON-JUDGMENTAL Choose when and how often you receive reminders. Get daily notifications or browse the library whenever you need inspiration. There's no wrong way to use Good Dad—just your way. FOR EVERY DAD Whether you're a new father finding your way, a busy dad juggling work and family, or a seasoned parent wanting to stay intentional, Good Dad meets you where you are. No judgment, no perfection required—just gentle reminders to help you connect. THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER Fatherhood happens in small moments: a question asked at dinner, presence during bedtime, patience when things get messy. Good Dad helps you catch those moments before they pass. YOUR JOURNEY, YOUR PACE This isn't about adding more to your to-do list. It's about remembering what matters most. Each reminder takes seconds to read and moments to act on—small intentions that add up to meaningful connection. Start being the present, mindful dad you want to be. Download Good Dad today.

6757367503.name: BetterYou: Screen Time Control
6757367503.description: BetterYou helps you stay off distracting apps when it matters. Create focus modes for work, study, sleep, or anything else—each with its own app and category limits using Apple’s Screen Time controls. Start a session in seconds or let your week run on a schedule you define. Features Focus modes your way — Built-in presets plus custom modes, icons, and colors. Multiple time windows per mode, reminders, and optional auto-start when a schedule begins. Timed sessions — Quick-start timers with presets or custom lengths. See focus time on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with Live Activities. Two commitment levels — Normal supports breaks (up to 30 minutes) with a cooldown so breaks stay intentional. Hardcore removes breaks and early exit—ideal when you need maximum lock-in. Blocking that fits real life — Pick apps and categories per mode, tune exclusions where you need flexibility, and keep essential apps reachable. Encouraging shields — When a blocked app opens, a clear, on-brand shield reminds you why you’re focusing—with optional messages you choose for the session. See your progress — Charts and totals for week, month, or all time. Focus time reflects real work, not time on break. Log what you did — Record productive activities and optional session notes so wins don’t disappear. Your data, your devices — Sign in with Apple where enabled, and sync modes, history, and settings across devices with iCloud when available. Privacy / requirements BetterYou uses Screen Time and Family Controls to apply limits you choose. An iCloud account may be used for sync. You stay in control of what gets blocked and when. 6759132470.name: QuickScroll for Safari
6759132470.description: QuickScroll for Safari makes web reading effortless and enjoyable. Automatically scroll through articles, comics, manga, and web pages with two powerful modes designed for different reading styles. KEY FEATURES Two Scrolling Modes for Every Reading Style Smooth Scroll Mode Continuous smooth scrolling at your custom speed. Perfect for articles, news, blogs, and long-form content. Adjust speed on-the-fly to match your reading pace. Natural reading flow without jerky movements. Page Scroll Mode Scroll one section at a time with configurable pause duration. Ideal for reading comics, manga, webtoons, and image-heavy content. The page scrolls down, pauses for you to read, then automatically continues. Fully customizable scroll distance and pause time between each scroll. Instant Jump Navigation Quickly jump to the top or bottom of any page with one tap. No more endless scrolling through long articles, comment sections, or comic chapters. Save time and navigate efficiently. Hands-Free Reading Ideal for reading while eating, exercising, cooking, or multitasking. Your content scrolls automatically at the speed and style you choose. Keep your hands free for other activities. Fully Customizable Controls Adjust smooth scroll speed from slow to fast Set page scroll distance for each jump Configure pause duration between page scrolls (1-30 seconds) Pause and resume anytime with one tap Fine-tune settings for different content types Remember your preferences for each mode Works on Any Website Compatible with all Safari-supported websites including news sites, blogs, articles, documentation, comic sites, manga readers, webtoons, social media feeds, and more. PERFECT FOR Reading Articles and News Long articles and blog posts News feeds and online magazines Research papers and documentation Technical tutorials and guides Social media timeline browsing Forum threads and discussions Reading Comics and Visual Content Manga and manhwa Webtoons and webcomics Image galleries and portfolios Screenshot tutorials Photo stories and visual essays Graphic novels and digital comics General Use Cases Studying and learning materials Reading while eating or drinking Accessibility needs requiring hands-free control Speed reading practice Recipe following while cooking Anyone who wants effortless web browsing HOW IT WORKS Getting Started 1. Install QuickScroll Safari extension 2. Enable it in Safari settings under Extensions 3. Visit any website in Safari 4. Tap the QuickScroll extension icon in the toolbar 5. Choose Smooth Scroll or Page Scroll mode 6. Adjust speed and timing settings to your preference 7. Enjoy hands-free reading Using Smooth Scroll Mode Select Smooth Scroll from the mode picker Choose your preferred scrolling speed using the slider Tap start to begin automatic scrolling Speed adjusts in real-time as you move the slider Perfect for continuous text reading with natural flow Pause anytime and resume right where you left off Using Page Scroll Mode Select Page Scroll from the mode picker Set how far to scroll each time using distance control Set how long to pause before next scroll (1-30 seconds) Perfect for comics where you need time to read each panel Auto-advances when the pause time completes Ideal for content that benefits from reading in chunks Instant Navigation Tap the jump to top button to instantly scroll to page top Tap the jump to bottom button to instantly scroll to page bottom No more repetitive scrolling gestures Navigate long pages in one second PRIVACY FIRST QuickScroll respects your privacy completely. No data collection, no tracking, no analytics, no ads. The extension works entirely on your device and does not send any information to external servers. All settings are stored locally on your device only. We do not collect, access, or store: Browsing history or URLs Personal information Usage statistics Any other data

6753812694.name: Aquarium Routine
6753812694.description: Routines are the foundation of aquarium success. Every thriving reef or freshwater tank starts with consistent care, not luck. It's 2025 and we're still using cumbersome, overcomplicated, and boring aquarium logs or managers that try to do EVERYTHING. You can literally hear the enjoyment of using them sucking the life out of hobby like a poorly installed overflow. Aquarium Routine understands something that others don't. We literally don't need all that. Instead, it is a light weight but powerful app that does everything in its power help aquarists build healthy (human) habits with effortless routine tracking, gentle reminders, and a living reef that grows with every completed task. There is much behavioral psychology in this app as there is ingredients for what makes a successful aquarist. Build better tank habits through healthy routines Schedule routines like water changes, testing, and cleaning Stay on track with smart reminders & calendar sync One-tap task completion keeps it fast and satisfying See your progress Coral growth visualization shows your consistency over time Streak tracking and punch card views make progress visible Milestones and badges celebrate your dedication (because nobody truly understands us) Smart logging for power users Log water changes, tests, dosing, and maintenance (sure why not) Automatic logging from completed routines (YES, THIS!) Track trends, spot issues early, and keep your tank stable Features that make it different Routine-first UX designed for real aquarists Beautiful, calm visualizations (no clutter) Insights that help but don't overwhelm Whether you’re running a nano reef, planted freshwater, or a full-blown display tank, Aquarium Routine adapts to you. It’s the simplest way to stay consistent and see your care come to life. For details regarding your privacy, see our privacy policy: http://aquariumapps.com/apps/aquarium-routine/privacy-policy.html

6753579471.name: Learn Svelte JS with AI
6753579471.description: Learn Svelte: The Ultimate Svelte JavaScript Framework Tutorial! Ready to build lightning-fast web development applications without the overhead of a Virtual DOM? This app is your complete guide to Svelte and SvelteKit. Master the JavaScript framework that compiles code to tiny, vanilla JS bundles. With 116 lessons, a powerful AI Assistant, and detailed progress tracking, learning modern JavaScript and Svelte has never been more efficient. What is the Svelte Framework? Svelte is a revolutionary JavaScript framework that shifts work out of the browser and into the compile step. Instead of shipping framework code to the client (like React or Vue), Svelte compiles your components into highly efficient, imperative JavaScript code during build time. Benefits of Svelte for Web Development: Performance: Smaller bundle sizes result in significantly faster load times and better Core Web Vitals scores. Simplicity: Built on familiar HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, Svelte has minimal boilerplate and intuitive reactivity. Developer Experience (DX): Excellent tooling, easy component creation, and simple state management using Stores. Key Features for Svelte Learning AI Assistant Ready: Get instant answers on Svelte syntax, debugging tips, best practices for JavaScript state management, and examples directly related to your web development content. Structured Svelte Curriculum: Progress through 116 lessons covering all core Svelte concepts: Basics of Svelte, Svelte Components, Reactivity in Svelte, State Management with Stores, Forms and Data Binding, Handling Events, and Styling in Svelte. Powerful Search: Quickly locate specific topics across your entire Svelte course, including JavaScript fundamentals, SvelteKit patterns, and advanced web development concepts. Motivation & Tracking: Stay consistent with streak tracking, daily goals, and detailed overall progress metrics. Download Svelte Pro today and start building web applications faster with the most efficient JavaScript framework!

6751760761.description: Apple Watch 节拍器专业版 – 腕上节拍器 专为 Apple Watch 设计的终极专业节拍器应用 – 随时随地，尽在腕间。 借助节拍器专业版，您将获得一个专为音乐家设计的强大节拍器，让您的音乐练习更轻松、更智能、更精准。得益于直接在您腕部提供的触觉反馈，您可以感受节拍，而不仅仅是听到它——这对于鼓手、吉他手、钢琴家以及所有希望随时随地保持节奏的音乐家来说，是再理想不过的。 功能 Apple Watch 上的精准节拍器，可调节 BPM（每分钟节拍数），从慢速到超快速节拍。 支持任意拍号——练习 2/4、3/4、4/4、6/8 等拍子。 触觉节拍器反馈——无需声音即可感受节拍。 适用于吉他练习、钢琴练习、打鼓、小提琴、贝斯或任何乐器。 敲击定速功能——通过敲击即时设定您的速度。 极简、简洁的设计，专为练习或现场演奏时快速访问而打造。 与您的智能手表同步的节拍器应用——即使没有 iPhone 也始终可用。 为什么选择节拍器专业版？ 与传统节拍器应用不同，节拍器专业版通过 Apple Watch 振动为您提供即时反馈。没有干扰，无需将手机放在附近。只需抬起手腕，即可开始练习。 无论您是学习掌握节奏的初学者音乐家，还是需要可靠节奏训练器的专业演奏者，节拍器专业版都是 Apple Watch 上保持节奏紧凑的最佳节拍器。 为获得更佳体验，请在您的 Apple Watch 设置中将触觉反馈设为“突出”： 手表 → 声音与触感 → 触感：突出

6760178056.description: 炼丹，是一款以中式道家炼丹为灵感打造的轻休闲体验 App。 在这里，你可以为一天先定丹意，从事业、爱情、财运、气运，到学业、健康、社交、生活，选择此刻最想回应的方向，开启一炉属于自己的丹修时刻。点燃丹炉后，你还可以通过真气注入、火候调控与机缘加持，参与成丹过程，让每一次炼丹都更有仪式感与参与感。 你将在每日短短几秒内，完成一次轻量却有氛围的炼丹体验： 先定丹意，选择今日所求 开炉炼丹，体验真气、火候、机缘互动 随机生成不同品级与方向的丹药结果 收集丹药，点亮属于自己的丹药图鉴与修行记录 分享你的今日成丹结果，传递好运与趣味 App 特色： 东方美学氛围 以中式道家炼丹为灵感，结合丹炉、丹意、心火与成丹设定，营造独特的东方玄学休闲体验。 轻量不肝 每天只需很短时间，就能完成一次炼丹，不需要复杂配方，不需要重度养成，轻松打开即可游玩。 有参与感的炼丹过程 不只是点击获得结果，你还可以在炼丹时注入真气、调整火候、加入机缘，让成丹过程更有变化与仪式感。 丰富丹意与收集乐趣 八大丹意方向，多种品级与丹药结果，既有随机惊喜，也有持续收集的乐趣。 本地优先，体验轻巧 核心玩法可本地运行，打开即玩，响应更快，也更适合碎片化体验。

6759858720.name: 腕叶
6759858720.description: 腕叶 — 将你的知识整理成书，随时随地在手腕上阅读 腕叶 是一款专为 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 设计的知识管理与阅读工具，让你把网页文章、笔记和灵感整理成可结构化的书籍，并在 Apple Watch 上随身阅读。 核心功能： 创建书籍与章节 — 在 iPhone 上创建属于你的书，每本书可包含多个章节，按主题分类管理，让知识井井有条。 轻松添加内容 — 支持直接输入或粘贴文本，也可以通过内置浏览器的“阅读模式”抓取网页正文，选择章节即可导入。 Apple Watch 同步阅读 — 将书籍或章节内容同步到手表，随时随地阅读，无需翻手机。阅读进度自动同步回 iPhone，让你在任何设备上保持一致。 高效的阅读体验 — Watch 上支持分页或滚动模式阅读，旋钮翻页，流畅自然。章节列表清晰显示完成度，帮助你合理安排阅读节奏。 快速解析网页 — 支持通过网页获取文章或小说并保存文章到指定书籍和章节，瞬间整理你的灵感和收藏内容。 使用场景： 上班途中或步行时在 Apple Watch 上快速阅读文章 将网页文章、教程、论文等资料整理成自己的电子书 在学校阅读记录的笔记？ 或是在上班时候开个小差看看表上存的小说 ... 在不同设备间无缝同步阅读进度 为个人项目、学习笔记、工作报告建立结构化书籍 腕叶 打造的是一种“随身书库”的体验，让你的知识像书一样可整理、可随身携带、可在手腕上快速获取。无论是学习、工作还是兴趣收藏，腕叶 都是你高效管理和阅读内容的理想工具。

6466177414.name: FolderX - 状态栏启动台
6466177414.description: FolderX：您的Mac生产力利器 告别繁琐的窗口和应用程序切换，从此改变您在Mac上的工作方式。现在，FolderX已经登陆App Store，您可以彻底改变在Mac上的工作方式。 FolderX是一个强大的工具，可以让您在Mac的状态栏中添加文件夹标签。只需点击标签，一个方便的下拉窗口就会打开， 让您可以在计算机上打开、复制、粘贴、拖拽和删除任何目录、文件甚至应用。 但这还不是全部，FolderX 提供了多种功能来提高您的生产力： 文件共享： 右键菜单生成共享链接，在局域网内通过HTTP共享文件或文件夹 Finder右键菜单：方便地创建新文件（doc、ppt、pdf等），并轻松切换隐藏文件的可见性，支持自定义。 无限文件夹标签：可在状态栏上添加无限数量的文件夹标签，没有数量限制。 无缝拖拽：轻松在全屏或非全屏模式下将文件拖放到当前聚焦的应用程序中。 悬浮窗口：简单操作即可使所有文件夹悬浮在屏幕上，甚至在全屏模式下也可以。 快速文件预览：在全屏和非全屏模式下，快速预览文件，而不会中断您的工作流程。 可定制的下拉窗口：调整每个文件夹的下拉窗口大小，以适应您的偏好。 高效的文件夹搜索：轻松在文件夹中搜索特定文件，最大程度地提高您的组织和文件检索能力。 多功能文件显示：选择文件的图标视图和列表视图，并根据您的偏好对其进行排序。 无论您是创意专业人士、忙碌的企业家还是工作繁重的学生，FolderX都是完美的伴侣，可以帮助任何人简化工作流程，最大限度地提高生产力。 不要让文件管理拖慢您的步伐。 立即下载FolderX，体验直接从Mac的状态栏访问文件和文件夹的便利和效率。 现在是时候使用FolderX掌控您的工作流程了。 ===== 您的订阅包括免费试用期，免费试用期在您的iTunes 帐户确认购买后开始。试用期结束后，您的订阅将自动开始并自动续订。除非您在当期结束前至少24小时在您的账户设置中禁用自动续订或取消您的订阅，否则您的iTunes 账户将收取下期费用。有关条款与隐私政策，请访问: https://www.swiftwave.cc/terms-privacy

6751222982.name: CureX:break bad content
6751222982.description: "Take control of your habits and build a more focused, disciplined, and productive lifestyle with this powerful self-improvement app designed for daily growth and consistency. Your daily habits shape your future. The actions you repeat every day define your success, mindset, and overall lifestyle. This app helps you take charge of those actions and turn them into positive routines that lead to long-term results. Whether your goal is to improve focus, increase productivity, or build better habits, this app provides the tools you need to succeed.Staying consistent can be difficult, especially in today’s world full of distractions. This app is designed to simplify your journey by giving you a clear system to track habits, monitor progress, and stay accountable. It helps you stay committed to your goals and maintain discipline over time. With a clean and easy-to-use interface, you can quickly add habits and track your daily progress. Each completed task helps build momentum and motivates you to keep going. The app makes it simple to stay organized and focused without feeling overwhelmed. Visual progress charts and detailed insights allow you to clearly see your improvement over time. You can understand your patterns, identify areas for growth, and make better decisions for your daily routine. Seeing real progress helps build confidence and keeps you motivated. To support your mindset, the app includes daily motivational content and self-improvement tips. These short and effective insights are designed to help you stay positive, focused, and mentally strong, even when facing challenges. Distractions are one of the biggest obstacles to productivity. This app includes smart tools that help you reduce time spent on unproductive activities. By controlling distractions, you can use your time more effectively and focus on what truly matters. The app also features a leaderboard system that adds a sense of challenge and motivation. You can track your performance, push your limits, and stay inspired by improving your progress over time. This makes the journey of self-improvement more engaging and rewarding. Another important benefit is increased self-awareness. By tracking your habits daily, you become more conscious of your actions and choices. This awareness helps you stay aligned with your goals and make better decisions in your daily life. The app is designed to be simple yet powerful. It works smoothly and fits easily into your daily routine without adding complexity. Whether you are just starting your journey or already working on self-improvement, this app supports you at every step. Key Features: Simple habit tracking system Daily progress monitoring Visual charts and performance insights Motivational content and daily tips Focus tools to reduce distractions Leaderboard for added motivation Clean and user-friendly design Who can use this app? Students who want better focus Professionals aiming to improve productivity Individuals building positive habits People trying to reduce distractions Anyone focused on personal growth Consistency is the key to success. This app helps you stay consistent by giving you the right tools, structure, and motivation. Every small step you take moves you closer to your goals. Stay committed with regular tracking and reminders that keep you aligned with your progress. Over time, you will notice improved focus, better discipline, and a stronger mindset that helps you overcome challenges. No matter where you start, improvement is always possible. With dedication and the right system, you can create meaningful changes in your life. Start your journey today. Build better habits, stay focused, and take control of your life one day at a time." This app require premium to access premium features, EULA:- https://ektaundhad.blogspot.com/2025/10/end-user-license-agreement-eula.html

6762519501.name: AlarmTune
6762519501.description: AlarmTune 是一款闹钟应用程序，可让您对每个闹钟进行独立的音量控制，让您按照自己的意愿起床。大多数闹钟应用程序将您的闹钟音量与系统音量联系起来。这意味着，如果您在睡觉前关掉音乐，早上的闹钟可能不会叫醒您。 AlarmTune 通过让您为每个警报单独设置自定义音量级别来解决此问题。为什么要调闹钟？您的手机音量和闹钟音量不应该是同一音量。无论您是需要响亮叫醒服务的重度睡眠者，还是喜欢轻柔轻推的浅睡者，AlarmTune 都可以让您决定如何准确地叫醒您。

6751784271.name: RawShare: RAW Transfer
6751784271.description: RawShare is a utility for photographers who need to move high-resolution images from their Sony camera to their phone. While some official tools are limited to JPEG-only transfers on certain models, RawShare allows you to access and download both RAW (.ARW) and JPEG files. This gives you the ability to edit and share the full quality of your photos directly from your mobile device. What RawShare Does: If you have found that other Sony camera apps lack RAW support for your specific model, RawShare provides a dedicated way to access those files. It utilizes the Wi-Fi connection between your camera and smartphone to move uncompressed data. Key Features: Full RAW Support: Download .ARW files directly to your phone for professional editing. JPEG Export: Wireless transfer for quick sharing. File Browser: View thumbnails on your camera and choose exactly what to download to save phone storage. Direct Sharing: Send files straight to your photo library, cloud storage, or messaging apps. Focused Interface: A simple tool for transferring your photos without extra features. How it Works: This app utilizes the "Send to Computer" Wi-Fi function built into many Sony Alpha and Cyber-shot models. Connect your smartphone and your camera to the same Wi-Fi network Open RawShare to browse and transfer your images. Tested Camera Models: The following models have been verified for RAW/JPEG transfer: Sony Alpha: A7 III, A7R II, A6400 Sony Cyber-shot: HX-50V, ZV-1 (M1) Known Unsupported Models: A7C, A6400A, A6400AK (These models do not include the "Send to Computer" function). Note: I am still testing compatibility across the Sony lineup. If your model isn't listed or you have questions, please reach out at rawshare.app@gmail.com. Privacy & Data: Local Transfer: Your photos move directly from your camera to your device. No external servers are used. No Tracking: No personal data is collected. Anonymous crash reports are sent via Firebase to help keep the app stable on different phone models. Disclaimer: This app is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, authorized, or endorsed by Sony Group Corporation. "Sony" and "Sony Alpha" are registered trademarks of Sony Group Corporation.

6760364261.description: 你了解自己为什么会有这样的感受吗 InnerPulse 是一款内置临床问卷（PHQ-9、GAD-7）的心情记录工具。每天记录心情，发现哪些因素让心情变好或变差，并长期追踪自己的心理健康。所有数据都保存在你的设备上。 你的資料屬於你 InnerPulse 完全在本機運作。所有資料都留在你的 iPhone 上。沒有帳號、沒有雲端、沒有追蹤、沒有廣告。透過 Face ID 保護。一次購買，永久使用。沒有訂閱，沒有隱藏費用，可透過家人共享與家人一起使用。 如何使用 INNERPULSE 1. 記錄心情。在日記中以 1 到 10 的刻度記錄心情，視需要寫下幾句話，並可獲得依情境提供的書寫提示。 2. 連結影響因素。每筆紀錄都可從超過 110 個因素中挑選，涵蓋 11 個生活領域：睡眠、飲食、工作、運動、社交、數位使用、自我照顧、健康、娛樂、環境與財務。你也能在數秒內建立自己的因素與分類。 3. 連結 Apple 健康（選用）。如果你允許，InnerPulse 會根據你的健康資料建議因素，或自動啟用。例如：運動、睡眠、生理週期、補水。資料明確時自動處理；資料不清時會詢問你。天氣也不用再手動輸入。只要在設定中啟用，晴天和雨天就會自動以因素的形式被建議。 4. 填寫臨床問卷。在問卷分頁中回答受認可的篩檢量表：PHQ-9、PHQ-4、GAD-7 與 K10。你會得到客觀的評估結果，必要時可帶到下次門診。（這不是診斷，診斷由專業人員給出。） 5. 看懂你的分析。分析分頁深入呈現你的資料。你會看到： 哪些因素真的影響你的情緒，方向是正向還是負向 你在一週中的哪些日子通常感覺較好或較差 你的問卷結果在數週、數月之間如何變化 全年情緒的走向，「年度像素」檢視中每天為一個像素 日常難以察覺的趨勢、模式與相關性 6. 自訂外觀。從四種設計主題中選擇，搭配流暢的轉場動畫。InnerPulse 配合你的喜好，而不是反過來。 帶走你的資料 你可以隨時將資料匯出成 CSV，或以 PDF 報告分享，適合帶去諮商會談，或自己留作紀錄。先前匯出的資料或來自其他裝置的資料，也能透過 CSV 匯入功能還原。 InnerPulse 並不能取代專業建議或治療。

6756660625.name: 感刻 - 感官创作·看见自己
6756660625.trackName: 感刻 - 感官创作·看见自己
6756660625.description: 你的呼吸可以绽放一朵花。 你的声音可以绘就一朵曼陀罗。 你的触碰可以创造一个世界——一笔到底，无需撤回。 感刻改变你感知自我的方式。 每一件创作都是一面镜子：呼吸之花随你的吐息绽放，声音曼陀罗随你的声音旋转，一笔画追随你的指尖，以不可思议的精准。 打开双摄，看见从未说谎的眼睛里的自己。 五感。五种创作。一种只属于你的艺术形式。 为什么选择感刻？因为最好的艺术不是 AI 生成的——而是你创造的。 无订阅。无数据收集。无伪装。一次付费，永世归你。 呼吸。倾听。触碰。你不是在冥想。 你在创作。

6754876029.name: stashy
6754876029.description: stashy is a native iOS and iPadOS client for your self-hosted Stash media server. It connects directly to your GraphQL endpoint and gives you a fast, polished interface for browsing, playing, and managing your library. Without any third-party tracking. Core features Direct connection: Connect to your Stash server via GraphQL (Stash v0.26+). Library browsing: Scenes, Performers, Studios, Galleries, Tags, Groups, and Markers. Search & filters: Advanced filtering and sorting across all content types. Video playback: Built-in player with HLS streaming, quality selection, subtitles, PiP, and resume support. Feeds: Scroll through scenes, markers, clips, and images in a reels-style view. Customizable home: Configure dashboard rows, tabs, and layout to match how you browse. Multi-server: Save and switch between multiple Stash servers. Device sync: Support for Handy, Intiface, and LoveSpouse during playback. Privacy first: Direct communication with your server only. No analytics or third-party tracking. Introducing stashy+ stashy+ unlocks premium features with an optional subscription or one-time Lifetime purchase. Core browsing and playback stay free. Included with stashy+: AI Subs: On-device live captions and translation in the scene player (beta) AI Motion: Real-time video analysis to sync connected devices to on-screen motion (beta) Downloads: Save scenes for offline viewing Tools: Overview statistics, O-Count heatmap, Session Timeline, Charts, Performer Match, and RateMe Custom app icons: Personalize stashy on your Home Screen Available as Monthly, Yearly, or Lifetime. Users who purchased stashy before 3.0 receive stashy+ Lifetime via Restore Purchases. Requirements: Self-hosted Stash server (v0.26+). Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6760335078.trackName: Slabox 评价卡/球星卡盒子
6760335078.description: Slabox 是面向 PSA 评级卡收藏玩家的扫描与收藏管理工具。 用相机扫描 PSA 证书编号即可快速添加卡牌，并在一个清晰的收藏库中管理评级、证书编号、图片、文件夹、人口数据和分享素材。无论你收藏宝可梦卡、运动卡、TCG 评级卡，还是高价值卡盒，Slabox 都能帮助你更快找到、整理和展示重要藏品。 主要功能： 使用相机扫描 PSA 证书编号 手动添加卡牌，或通过照片 OCR 识别添加 查看卡牌详情、评级、图片和人口数据 用文件夹和自定义收藏整理卡盒 按名称、证书编号、评级或收藏搜索 将喜欢的卡牌显示在主屏小组件中 为 Instagram、朋友圈和聊天生成精美分享图 在评级或购买前检查卡片居中度 支持 Action Button 与 Siri Shortcuts 快速启动 内置居中检查工具可从卡片照片分析左右和上下边框，帮助你在送评或购买前做出更稳妥的判断。 Slabox 让 PSA 收藏玩家可以在一款专注的 iPhone 应用中完成扫描、整理、查看和展示。

6760278399.name: Tarsi - Budget Tracker
6760278399.description: Tarsi - Your Personal Finance Companion A simple yet powerful finance app that helps you track everything in one place, from daily expenses to long-term goals. Whether you’re just starting or already managing multiple accounts, Tarsi keeps things clear, organized, and easy to use. SEE YOUR MONEY CLEARLY Track your expenses and income in seconds. Monitor balances across cash, bank accounts, credit cards, and investments, all in one place. See your net worth in a single screen and understand exactly where your money goes with clean, simple breakdowns. You can also create investment accounts for US stocks and crypto, with access to the latest market data so your portfolio stays up to date without manual tracking. Tarsi supports light and dark mode, so you can use it comfortably anytime, anywhere. TALK TO TARSI (YES, EVEN OFFLINE!) Just say it. Tarsi handles the rest. Log expenses, transfers, and income by typing or using your voice. You can say things like “Starbucks 250”, “Salary 30k”, or “Paid credit card 5k last week” and Tarsi will understand and record it instantly. It works offline, so your data never needs to leave your device. You can also attach images or scan receipts using OCR, so your transactions are not just recorded but documented. PLAN AHEAD WITH CONFIDENCE Forecast your cashflow, track recurring bills, installments, and subscriptions, and view upcoming payments alongside expected income in one timeline. You can quickly tell if you can afford something before spending. STAY ON TOP OF YOUR FINANCES Set budgets with categories and subcategories and track your progress visually. Manage savings goals, monitor debts, and keep track of money owed to you. Tarsi includes ready-made bank account templates, so you can quickly add your accounts with just a few taps and start tracking right away. SIMPLE FOR BEGINNERS. POWERFUL FOR ADVANCED USERS Tarsi is easy to start with, even if you’ve never used a finance app before. As you grow, Tarsi grows with you. From budgets and goals to cashflow forecasting, debt tracking, installment tracking, and detailed insights, everything you need is already built in. CREATE MULTIPLE PROFILES Tarsi allows you to create multiple profiles, whether for personal use, family, or separate business accounts with built-in tools. GET FEEDBACK AND GROW YOUR MONEY Tarsi doesn’t just track. It helps you improve. Every time you log an expense or income, Tarsi gives you simple, helpful feedback so you understand how that decision affects your finances. Over time, it learns your patterns and gives you tips and insights to help you spend smarter, save better, and stay consistent. QUICK NOTES AND DAILY SUMMARY Use quick notes to list upcoming expenses, reminders, or anything you don’t want to forget. Tarsi also gives you a daily summary of your income and expenses so you can quickly review how your money moved without digging through your history. BACKUP, EXPORT, AND FULL CONTROL Your data is always yours. Tarsi automatically saves daily backups on your device so you don’t lose your data. You can export everything anytime as CSV or JSON, making it easy to move, review, or keep your own records. You can also generate income and expense statements for a selected period whenever you need them. PRIVATE BY DEFAULT Your financial data stays with you. Tarsi does not require an account, does not track you, and does not send your financial data to the cloud. Everything runs locally on your device. WHY TARSI? Tarsi is inspired by the Philippine tarsier, a small endangered animal known for its large, watchful eyes. Just like the tarsier, Tarsi helps you see your finances clearly. It gives you a full, honest view of your money so you can make better decisions every day, while also raising awareness about this unique animal and the importance of protecting it. Start tracking your money the right way. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6762118557.name: 货运笔记 · 货运记账、运输记录
6762118557.trackName: 货运笔记 · 货运记账、运输记录
6762118557.description: 货运笔记是一款面向货车司机、货运老板和小型物流商户的纯离线运输台账工具，用来记录每一趟出车、每一笔成本、每一笔回款，以及车辆与客户的经营情况。 它将出车记录、成本核算、利润统计、客户欠款、车辆提醒和 CSV 导出整合在一个简洁易用的 App 中，帮助用户更快完成运输记账、对账和经营复盘。 所有功能都在设备本地运行。无需登录、无需联网、不收集数据、不做云同步，也没有广告、订阅或后台追踪。它适合希望长期保留经营数据、同时又重视隐私与稳定性的运输从业者。 重点功能包括： 记录每趟出车：日期、路线、运费、里程、时长、备注 管理运输成本：油费、过路费、停车费、维修费、餐费等 自动计算利润，并按车辆、客户、时间维度查看经营表现 支持应收管理和分次回款登记，自动计算剩余应收与回款状态 支持车辆保险、年审、保养、营运证、驾驶证等提醒事项 支持票据照片与离线 OCR 识别，加快录入速度 支持 CSV 导出，便于对账、备份和迁移 无论你是单车司机、夫妻车队、个体货运经营者，还是小型物流商户，货运笔记都可以帮助你用更低的成本把运输收支记清楚、把欠款管起来、把经营情况看明白。 欢迎提交功能建议或改进想法。所有反馈都会被持续查看，并用于指导后续更新： 邮箱：842797413@qq.com 或在 App Store 评价中留下你的想法

6755179514.name: 集思笔记
6755179514.description: 「集思笔记」是基于卢曼卡片盒记录法的笔记 App，用三种卡片，把你的灵感、文献和永久知识拆开记，又在背后串联起来。 不强迫你一开始就很“系统”，只要先记下当下那一句，后面整理、关联、写作都会变得更轻松。 适合谁： 经常有灵感一闪而过的人：创作者、产品经理、工程师、独立开发者 想系统整理读书/论文的学生、研究者 想搭建个人知识库、为写作积累素材的人 三种笔记，一眼区分 灵感卡： 一句话想法、语音片段，快速记下脑海一闪而过的东西 支持语音记录，后续可以转成文字再整理 文献卡： 书本、文章、网页摘录 + 自己的一句理解 支持文字摘录和拍照摘录（保留原文截图） 永久卡： 用自己的话重写观点、结论，形成可反复引用的知识卡片 支持 Markdown，适合长文、文章骨架和输出草稿 关键特性 快速记录： 首页底部一键新建灵感 / 文献 / 永久卡 文本、语音、图片三种入口，保证“当下好记”优先 标签与搜索： 用标签为卡片打上主题、项目、场景 支持按标题/正文/标签搜索，快速找到之前的想法 卡片之间的关联： 把相关灵感、文献、永久卡相互关联，形成知识网络 在详情页看到“关联卡片”，从一张卡自然跳到另一张 整理回顾与提醒： 为灵感、文献设置整理截止日期，避免“一记了之就忘” 支持到期提醒，让你定期回看、升级为永久卡 为永久卡设置回顾计划，可不定期回顾，加深理解 废纸篓与归档： 误删可从废纸篓恢复 不常

6760586113.description: 「猫影相册」专注让你的相册更清晰、更好找：不需要注册账号；不会上传照片到我们的自有服务器；你始终掌控自己的照片与整理结果。 1）照片整理 相簿归类、标签管理、收藏标记 浏览更高效，整理后的结构更清晰 2）拍照自动整理 拍照后自动整理到你选择的相簿/标签 适合“拍完就想分好类”的习惯 3）桌面组件 多尺寸组件，随时在桌面看到喜欢的照片 支持多种来源（随机/标签/固定；相簿来源为 Pro 权益） 更多能力 清理释放空间：快速定位可清理内容（如视频、实况、截图、大文件等） 废纸篓：误删可恢复；在废纸篓中确认删除后才会同步删除到系统照片 App 拼图工具：长图拼接、横图拼接、宫格裁剪 照片日记与统计：记录与趋势一目了然 免费额度说明（当前版本） 照片整理：初始赠送 **30 张**，每日 **20 张** 拍照自动整理时长：初始赠送 **10 分钟**，每日 **5 分钟** Pro（可选：订阅/终身买断） 解锁更高权益：照片整理更高额度/可达无限、拍照自动整理更高时长/可达无限、组件更高刷新频率、组件相簿来源等 订阅自动续期，可在系统设置的 Apple ID 订阅中管理/取消 服务条款：https://shadowcats.netlify.app/terms 隐私政策：https://shadowcats.netlify.app/privacy 联系我们：3d.slipbox@gmail.com

6762088156.name: 维生素记录·吃药提醒·营养补剂管理
6762088156.trackName: 维生素记录·吃药提醒·营养补剂管理
6762088156.description: 在对的时间，吃对的补剂——别再浪费你已经花钱买下的东西。SuppTime 用 60 秒为你搭好个人方案，当两种补剂互相抵消时提醒你，并在每一种真正起效的时间点通知你。 60 秒生成专属方案 回答关于年龄、精力、睡眠、运动和饮食的 7 个快速问题。SuppTime 分析你的情况，推荐当下对你最重要的五种补剂——每一条都附带理由和背后的研究。 真正有用的相互作用提醒 铁和钙争夺吸收通道。锌会消耗铜。维生素 K2 影响华法林。绿茶阻碍铁吸收。SuppTime 在这些冲突拖累效果之前就标出来，并明确告诉你两者该间隔几个小时。 有科学依据的服用时间 82 种补剂，每一种都有最佳时段：清晨、早餐、午餐、下午、晚餐、睡前。脂溶性维生素配含脂肪的一餐。镁放在晚上。铁空腹服用。每条建议都标注来源。 处方药与用药管理 把处方药和维生素放在一起管理，专属 Rx 标记让治疗用药永远不会和营养补充混淆。 健康 App、Apple Watch 与小组件 在手腕上直接打卡。在主屏幕查看今日安排。将 28 类营养素直接写入「健康」App——维生素 D、镁、锌、铁、欧米伽-3、咖啡因等。 衡量真正坚持下来的部分 连续天数、7 / 30 / 90 / 365 天的依从率图表，以及不会在休息日拉低分数的「跳过」选项。 从设计之初就注重隐私 无需账号。没有服务器。不做追踪。数据留在你的设备上，仅通过你自己的 iCloud 同步。100% 离线可用。 高级版 免费版支持 3 种活跃补剂。高级版解锁无限补剂、一键预设组合、完整历史记录和 Apple Watch。按周订阅或一次性买断终身——由你决定。 重要提示：SuppTime 是一款整理与信息工具，并非医疗器械。它不诊断、不治疗、不预防任何疾病。开始任何补充剂方案前请务必咨询有资质的医疗专业人士，尤其是在服用处方药或有健康问题的情况下。 使用条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6760431134.name: Track Cannabis - CannaControl
6760431134.description: CannaControl - Your Cannabis Consumption Companion Discretely monitor and track your cannabis consumption or abstinence, in app or from the home or lock screen. Benefits: Helps you be honest about your current cannabis (aka weed, marijuana, pot, refer, ganja, etc) habits Makes it easy and fun to track to understand patterns, without being a nuisance Helps you set intention goals to modify (ie lower) use Encourages those ready for a break to reach their desired goal Empowers those who want to end cannabis consumption Key Features: CannaTrack lets you easily log your cannabis use. CannaMod* helps you moderate use, and track against a specific goal/limit. CannaBreak* tracks your use breaks, with options from 1, 7, 14, 30, or custom day lengths. CannaQuit* empowers you to quit for good, and track your date of cannabis sobriety. Free Subscription Full access to CannaTrack Limited access to Trends 7 day free trial of Pro Pro Subscription* All Modes Unlocked: Full access to CannaMod, CannaBreak, CannaQuit Trends: Full access to Daily/Weekly Recaps Widgets & Live Activities: View and log info directly from the lock or home screen - without opening the app iCloud Sync: Track across any device Apple Health: Log state of mind in CannaControl to capture how your feel about your cannabis use or break Accountability Buddy: Share your canna journey with a friend (coming soon) Security and Privacy: Your information is stored securely on your device and in iCloud, and is only available to you on your devices Mood/emotions logged in CannaControl can be optionally synced to Apple Health app via HealthKit, and CannaControl cannot read any other health data Honeycrisp Health does not have access to your personally identifiable information, nor do we share any information with any third parties We collect anonymous non-user identifiable usage information to gain insights on feature adoption and improve the product Legal: End User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://cannacontrol-app.com/privacy Support: https://honeycrisp-health.com/contact-us

6758562324.name: 普拉纳-呼吸训练
6758562324.description: 在每一次呼吸中，找到片刻宁静。 Praana 是你的专属呼吸练习助手，每天只需几分钟，帮助你平静心绪、重启能量、恢复身心平衡。 基于广为认可且有科学依据的呼吸法，Praana 通过引导练习，让你随时随地轻松感觉更好。 精致、美观且直观的体验 清晰的动画指示何时吸气、停留和呼气，无需猜测节奏 轻柔的震动反馈，即使闭眼或关闭屏幕也能保持节奏 禅定模式去除一切干扰，让你更深入地沉浸在练习中 深色模式针对夜间与睡前使用进行优化，减轻眼睛负担 完整的辅助功能支持，可搭配 VoiceOver 和大字使用每一个练习 平静与放松 用这些练习，在忙碌一天后放松身心、缓解焦虑或为入睡做准备。 生理叹息：两次快速吸气配合一次长呼气，在当下快速安抚神经系统 4-7-8 放松呼吸：简单的节奏，帮助你更快自然入睡，安静夜晚纷乱思绪 2-1-4-1 松弛呼吸：温和、适合新手的节奏，释放紧张又不易感到喘不过气 共振呼吸：缓慢而稳定的呼吸，减轻压力并支持健康的心率变异性 专注与能量 重要会议、学习冲刺、锻炼前，或感到疲惫分心时都很适合使用。 盒式呼吸：与特种部队同源的四段式呼吸，在压力下保持专注与稳定 激活呼吸：短促而快速的呼吸，唤醒精神、提升专注、赶走午后疲倦 Wim Hof 法：节奏强劲的引导式呼吸，用于提升能量、增强韧性并支持免疫力 平衡与清明 用这些方法重启情绪，稳定心神，让自己更踏实、更有底气。 交替鼻孔呼吸：传统练习，平衡大脑左右半球活动，缓解精神负荷，稳定情绪 共鸣呼吸：以接近身体自然共鸣频率的节奏呼吸，促进心脑协同与内在稳定 火呼吸：快速而有力的节奏呼吸，在几分钟内清除脑中雾气、激活核心能量 为你的生活节奏而设计 打开 Praana，可以是在会议间隙的一分钟重置，睡前五分钟的安睡准备，或上台前的一次专注练习。每个练习都清晰标注用途，你可以在当下精准选择自己需要的状态： 在紧张时迅速冷静下来 进入更深、更高质量的睡眠 不靠咖啡也能提升能量 提高专注力与思维清晰度 建立稳定、持续的日常呼吸习惯 每一次呼吸之间，都有一刻静止。 Praana 帮你在任何需要的时候，找到那份宁静。

6762570524.name: Drafty Story: Habit Writer
6762570524.description: Your stories belong to you. No cloud. No subscriptions. No AI reading your drafts. Drafty Story is a writing habit app built for people who want to write more and stress less. One-time purchase. Everything stays on your device. Just write. No pressure. Drafty Story's typewriter mode removes the delete key so you stop second-guessing and keep moving forward. A passive stopwatch tracks your time without counting down. If life interrupts, your session pauses automatically when you lock your phone. Shape your story, stay in the flow. New Markdown support lets you add italics, bold, and # headers using simple text symbols. It's a way to give your drafts a little structure without ever touching a menu or breaking your rhythm. Keep your hands on the keys and your focus on the story. Built for how your mind actually works. Flexible scheduling lets you pick the days that suit you. The writing calendar shows your progress over time without punishing you for missing a day. Writing prompts appear gently, never on a countdown, so they inspire rather than pressure. Privacy by design, not by policy. Drafty Story uses zero network connections. There are no accounts to create, no passwords to remember, and no servers storing your work. Export your stories to EPUB 3.0 or plain text at any time: your words, your way. One purchase. Yours forever. No subscriptions. No ads. No data selling. Just a quiet space for your stories.

6760628111.name: ScopeKit
6760628111.description: ScopeKit 把 iPhone 变成一套专业的现场影像与测量工具。 无论你是在拍摄前确认距离、记录深度信息，还是希望把 ProRAW 文件直接写入相册或外置存储，ScopeKit 都把这些能力集中在一个清晰、直接、可随时启动的工具箱里。 主要功能 Apple ProRAW 拍摄 手动控制 ISO、快门、对焦与白平衡。支持将 ProRAW DNG 写入相册或外置存储，更适合现场采集与后期流程衔接。 LiDAR 中心测距 围绕画面中心点进行距离读取，并提供距离、高度与速度测量，让现场判断更快、更直观。 深度预览与颜色映射 将深度数据转换为可读的彩色画面，可自定义近、中、远颜色，并保存当前深度帧，方便观察与记录空间层次。 前后双摄同步记录 在同一次拍摄中同时使用前后摄像头，并管理预览布局、编码格式与文件保存方式，同样支持写入相册或外置存储。 Camera Control 快速启动 已适配 Camera Control，可更快进入你选定的工作模式。 为现场而设计 为拍摄、测量、勘景与记录减少切换和重复操作，把多种系统级能力整理成一个更顺手的工作流。 请注意：部分功能需要特定 iPhone 机型、摄像头硬件或系统能力支持，例如 Apple ProRAW、LiDAR、深度数据与 Camera Control。实际可用功能会因设备而异。

6754611639.name: Smarter IPTV X Pro: M3U Player
6754611639.trackName: Smarter IPTV X Pro: M3U Player
6754611639.description: Smarter IPTV X Pro is the fastest IPTV player for iPhone, iPad, and Android TV. Add any M3U playlist or Xtream Codes connection and instantly access live TV channels, VOD movies, TV series, and catch-up content — all in one place. Everything you need in one IPTV app: Live TV with real-time EPG / TV guide Movies and series with Xtream Codes VOD support M3U and M3U8 playlist manager — unlimited playlists Favorites, channel groups, and custom channel ordering Offline downloads for movies and series Picture-in-Picture (PiP) — watch while multitasking AirPlay and Google Cast / Chromecast support Parental PIN lock for adult content categories External player support (VLC, Infuse, and more) Multi-audio tracks and subtitle selection HLS, RTMP, RTSP, and TS stream compatibility iCloud backup and restore Whether you're streaming 4K live sports, catching up on series, or building the perfect channel list — Smarter IPTV X Pro delivers a fast, clean experience with no ads on the player screen. Important: Smarter IPTV Pro+ does not provide any TV channels or content. You must add your own playlists from your provider. Key features Advanced IPTV player Play live TV, VOD and series from M3U and Xtream Codes playlists. M3U and Xtream support Easily add, edit and manage M3U URLs or Xtream Codes accounts. Live TV with EPG View electronic program guide, channel info and upcoming shows. VOD and series library Browse movies and series with categories, search and resume options. Multiple device support Use Smart IPTV Pro+ on phones, tablets, Android TV and TV boxes. Playlist manager Add multiple IPTV playlists, sort channels, create favorites and hide groups you do not use. Clean and fast interface Simple UI optimized for remote control, touch and TV screens. Parental control Protect specific categories or channels with a PIN code. External player support Option to open streams with compatible external video players. Secure and private Smarter IPTV Pro+ does not store or sell your content. You are always in control of your playlists. How it works 1.	Get a legal IPTV subscription or M3U / Xtream playlist from your provider. 2.	Install Smart IPTV Pro+ on your device. 3.	Open the app and add your playlist (M3U URL or Xtream Codes). 4.	Wait for channels, VOD and EPG to load. 5.	Enjoy live TV, movies and series with a smooth IPTV player. Why Smarter IPTV Pro+ Optimized IPTV player for M3U and Xtream Great for live TV, VOD and series Works on mobile, Android TV and TV boxes Clean interface that even non tech users can handle No ads inside the player in the Pro+ version Disclaimer Smarter IPTV Pro+ is only an IPTV player. It does not include any channels, playlists or subscriptions. You must provide your own content from a third party IPTV provider. We do not support or promote illegal streaming. Whether you're streaming 4K live sports, catching up on series, or building the perfect channel list — Smarter IPTV X Pro delivers a fast, clean experience with no ads on the player screen.

6761606601.name: 速度计简易版
6761606601.description: 速度计简易版 — 为你每一次出行打造的精准 GPS 仪表。 通过精美设计、实时更新的仪表盘追踪你的速度。无论是开车、骑行、骑摩托、扬帆、跑步、徒步、滑雪,还是只是好奇自己有多快——速度计简易版 都能为各类旅程提供顺滑、精准的遥测数据。 实时遥测 即时查看当前速度、海拔与方向。先进的平滑算法在保持读数真实的同时,显着减少 GPS 跳动。 挡风玻璃 HUD 模式 夜间将手机置于仪表台上,镜像显示会反射到挡风玻璃,让你无需移开视线即可安全读取。 15 款惊艳主题 从极简玻璃到赛博朋克霓虹、从复古计时码表到航空战术——总有一款契合你的风格。大多数主题均含明亮与深色变体。 行程记录 开启一次会话,即可自动记录路线、距离、时长、平均速度与最高速度。在历史记录中查看详细分析和速度区间——驾车、骑行、跑步或航行均适用。 自动开始与自动结束 免动手记录——速度计简易版 会在你开始移动时启动,停下时结束,从不漏掉一段行程。 限速提醒 设置你自己的速度限制，超速时立即获得视觉和触觉警告——完全离线。或启用基于道路的实时限速（Pro），自动识别你所在道路的限速，并在你超速的瞬间发出警告（需要联网）。 自定义应用图标 通过 11 款备用图标定制你的主屏幕风格。 离线可用 速度表、HUD 和行程记录无需联网——应用直接读取 GPS 卫星，随时随地可用，即使在开启定位服务的飞行模式下也能使用。 （基于道路的实时限

6762520622.description: 你的日历，是一叠纸。在 Hibi 里，每一天都是一页柔软、带有纹理的纸，你可以在上面涂鸦、贴满贴纸，把它打造成完全属于自己的模样；而这一切，都包裹着一本真实的日历，静静跟上你生活的节奏。 Hibi 通过 iOS 内置系统显示你已有的日历与提醒事项。无需账户、无需注册，也不用做任何设置。只有三种视图： 日：一张张纸卡，轻轻一划就撕下今天 周：让你的每一天汇成温柔的时间流 月：一整片干净、没有杂乱的无尽网格 然后，它把笔递到你手上： 手绘、手写，在 iPad 上支持 Apple Pencil 添加贴纸，或直接从你的照片里抠出主体，做成专属贴纸 挑选纸张、格线和颜色，按自己喜欢的方式布置每一页 每个细节都被悉心打磨：为你的每一个日历精心挑选的柔和粉彩色、来自 Apple 天气的每页实时天气、优雅的衬线字体、完善的深色模式，还有通过 Hibi Plus 解锁的主屏幕小组件，用来显示今日页面与近期安排。 隐私，从设计之初就考虑好了。你的日程只留在你的设备和你自己的 iCloud 里，没有 Hibi 账户，也没有任何追踪。你精心装饰的页面，会在 iPhone 与 iPad 之间悄悄同步。 无需订阅，核心功能全部免费。可选的一次性「Hibi Plus」解锁，还能为你带来主屏幕小组件、备用 App 图标、专属于你的橡皮图章，以及小组件里的互动提醒，一次购买，终身拥有。 Hibi 在日语里意为「日子」。我们用心把它做出来，只希望你每天都愿意翻开属于自己的那一页。

6751279615.description: 轻松查看、编辑或删除照片中隐藏的数据。您拍摄的每一张照片都包含着数字足迹，例如精确的地理位置、相机型号等。我们的应用让您能毫不费力地管理这些信息，从此可以安心地分享生活中的美好瞬间。 无论是在社交平台分享前清除定位信息，还是为照片添加您的署名，我们简洁的界面都能让您快速轻松地完成。完全无需任何专业技术知识。 您能做到： 保护您的隐私： 在几秒钟内彻底删除照片中的 GPS 位置数据。不再分享照片的拍摄地点，保护行踪安全。 署名您的作品： 将您的名字添加为作者，并嵌入版权声明，确保您的创作得到应有的署名。 整理您的相册： 添加或编辑描述和标题，让您的照片更容易被找到和管理。 校正拍摄细节： 轻松修正错误的光圈、ISO、曝光时间或焦距等相机参数，让您的记录保持准确。 掌控您的数字隐私与照片信息。立即下载，安全地分享您的每一张照片

6751024132.name: 临帖宝Pro
6751024132.description: 核心功能，助力书法精进： 海量高清碑帖库 汇聚历代名家碑帖，资源丰富，持续更新。每一幅均经过高清处理，细节清晰可见，助你精准临摹，深入传统精髓。 智能书法字典 输入汉字，即刻检索其在不同名家、不同书体下的经典写法。是你创作时查询字形、汲取灵感的必备工具。 强大集字创作 输入任意诗句或文段，智能从海量字库中提取单字，自由组合生成你专属的书法作品稿，轻松解决创作中的排版与取法难题。 重影对比 使用相机拍摄你的临作，与原帖进行透明度叠加对比。笔迹差异一目了然，帮助你精准发现不足，快速提升临摹水平。 AR上墙预览（ARKit） 将你的书法作品通过增强现实技术，“悬挂”在自家墙壁上预览效果。无需真实打印装裱，即可直观感受作品在不同空间环境中的视觉效果，为创作和展示提供全新视角。 实用拍照识字 遇到不认识的碑帖字或墨迹？拍照即可智能识别，方便随时复习与查询，是读帖学习的得力助手。 创意书法装裱 为完成的书法作品选择多种精美的数字装裱模板，添加印章、题跋等元素，一键生成雅致的效果图，方便分享与展示。 丰富的诗词文库 内置经典诗词文库，涵盖历代名篇，不仅提供临摹内容，更是你寻找创作灵感的宝库。 更多功能：字帖去除米字格、字帖去除背景、字帖无损压缩、字帖画质增强、字帖裁剪、字帖拼接等

6761989945.description: 我们是一款专业的视力训练与视觉检查应用，基于神经可塑性原理，通过科学有效的训练方法，帮助用户改善视力健康。 核心功能： 多样化视力训练 ：提供遮盖训练、精细目力训练、红光训练、双眼视功能训练、对比敏感度训练等多种模式 专业视觉检测 ：内置标准视力检测、散光筛查、斜视筛查，实时监测视力状况 趣味训练方式 ：串珠训练、图形配对、描图训练等游戏化训练，让视力训练变得有趣 智能数据统计 ：记录训练时长、完成率、正确率等数据，生成视力变化趋势图表 个性化训练方案 ：支持定制化训练计划，适配不同用户需求 隐私安全 ：所有数据仅本地存储，保护用户隐私 适用人群： 弱视儿童及成人 近视、远视、散光用户 长时间用眼的上班族 术后视觉康复人群 关注视力健康的任何人 每天只需几分钟，科学训练改善视力！

6762501443.name: ClimeArt: AI weather art
6762501443.description: ClimeArt，把真实天气变成你城市的专属 AI 艺术大片。 不是普通天气 App。每次打开 ClimeArt，AI 就会感知你所在城市此刻的真实气象——温度、云量、风向、天气状况——并以此为灵感，生成一帧只属于今天这座城市的艺术画面。晴天有晴天的光晕，雨天有雨天的氛围，每一次都不一样。 【六种艺术风格，选你所爱】 等距微缩模型：Pixar 风格轴侧城市，精致立体 像素艺术：复古 8-bit 风格，每颗像素都是回忆 水彩画：清新手绘质感，如同明信片 粘土渲染：3D 黏土材质，治愈温柔 中国传统水墨：泼墨山水，东方意境 治愈简笔画：温柔细腻的手绘线条，静心治愈 【你的城市，你的天气】 自动 GPS 定位，获取当前所在地实时气象 支持 Apple 地图搜索全球任意城市 AI 生成画面包含真实地标——上海外滩、北京故宫、东京塔、巴黎铁塔 7 天预报，每天独立生成一幅天气场景图，提前看明天的气象大片 【就在你的主屏幕】 添加 ClimeArt 桌面小组件，无需打开 App，一眼看到今日天气与 AI 生成的城市场景。支持小、中、大三种尺寸，让主屏幕和锁屏都成为你的私人画廊。 【保存你的美学瞬间】 一键保存生成的天气美图至相册 设置为手机壁纸，让每日天气都成为赏心悦目的风景 随时回看曾经心动的天气画作 【实时感知，流式生成】 采用流式 AI 生成技术，你可以看到 AI 创作的每个步骤实时呈现——从感知气象数据、构思画面到完成细节，进度清晰可见，无需干等。本地智能缓存每小时自动更新，无网络时仍可查看最近的天气大片。 【最先进的 AI 生图模型】 由 Nano Banana 2 和 GPT-Image-2 提供图片生成服务。在中国大陆由 seed 和 qwen 模型提供图片生成服务。 ClimeArt 是一款关于「感受天气」的应用。我们相信，好的天气 App 不只是告诉你几度，而是让你真正感知这个世界今天的样子。 EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6763193358.name: 数控车工助手-车工计算编程
6763193358.trackName: 数控车工助手-车工计算编程
6763193358.description: 产品简介 专为数控车工、机械加工人员、编程员打造的专业计算与编程辅助工具。覆盖螺纹计算、切槽编程、宏程序生成、材料计算、锥度计算、切点计算等30+功能模块，支持生成G92/G76代码，内置常用材料密度、公差表、G代码手册，是每位车工手机里不可或缺的“工艺工具箱”。 核心功能 螺纹计算 支持公制螺纹(M)、梯形螺纹(Tr)、矩形螺纹(Square)、公制蜗杆(Worm)、英制螺纹(BSW/BSF)、美制UN系列(UN/UNF/UNC/UNEF)、管螺纹(G/R/Rp/ZG)等。自动生成G92/G76代码，支持刀尖半径补偿、退尾设置、左右借刀、双倍借刀，外螺纹/内螺纹一键切换。 切槽编程 支持V形槽、矩形外槽/内槽、端面V形槽、任意角度V形槽。图形化参数输入，支持切槽刀、尖刀、球刀，自动计算粗车+精车分层切削，生成绝对/相对坐标G代码。 宏程序自动生成 涵盖矩形螺纹、梯形螺纹、爱克母螺纹(ACME)、异形螺纹、公制/英制蜗杆、凹/凸圆弧螺纹、波形螺纹、钻深孔、椭圆、抛物线、网纹、8字油槽等。输入参数即可生成标准宏程序。 材料计算 支持圆管/圆棒/方钢/板料，内置304不锈钢、碳钢、铝合金等常用材料密度，自动计算单件重量、总重量和材料成本，支持自定义密度和单价。 辅助计算工具 切点计算（直线接圆弧、圆弧接圆弧、锥度接圆弧等） 锥度计算（大径、小径、长度、锥度角互算） 三角函数、倒角计算 对角/圆等分、公差查询（H7/h6等） 线速度/粗糙度计算 常用G/M代码查询 特色亮点 计算结果可导出、复制，支持绝对/相对坐标切换 内置螺纹对照表、切削参数推荐库 刀尖半径补偿自动计算 适合FANUC、SIEMENS、广数、华中世纪星等主流数控系统

6763278089.name: 小白学滑冰
6763278089.description: 《小白学滑冰》面向零基础与初学者，把「第一次上冰该注意什么、接下来练什么」说清楚。应用内提供分级学习路径，从装备护具、安全摔倒与起立，到蹬冰、前葫芦与基础转弯，每节配有短文与提示，你可以按自己的节奏标记完成，让进步看得见。 「滑冰百科」汇总冰场礼仪、穿衣保暖与常见不适的小建议；术语词典可随时查阅内刃、蹬冰、前葫芦等说法，听懂讲解更省力。练习中心里有今日计划、练习日历、计时器和技能打卡，你能记录上冰频率、给动作状态打勾，也可以用日记写下当场感受与待改进之处。出门清单与小目标则帮你出门前不丢三落四、训练时更有奔头。 界面用天蓝与冰蓝为主色，搭配可爱的「小白」形象与轻量动效，希望让学滑冰少一点紧张、多一点乐趣。无论你是偶尔娱乐还是认真入门，都能在这里找到属于自己的节奏。应用还支持备份与恢复练习数据，换机也不必从零开始。应用内容用于辅助入门理解，不能替代专业教练与现场指导；请在正规冰场、做好防护，安全享受每一次滑行。

6760998905.name: 小妙背古诗-小学必背古诗词大全
6760998905.trackName: 小妙背古诗-小学必背古诗词大全
6760998905.description: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。 这几句诗，也许是你记忆中最早学会的文字。那时候不懂诗意，只是跟着老师一遍遍地念，念着念着就记住了。小妙背古诗，想帮每个孩子重温这份简单而美好的学习体验。 听读背测，四步成诗： 每首古诗都有它的学习节奏。先听一遍专业朗读，感受诗词的音韵之美；再跟着读一遍，拼音注音和注释随时展开；然后试着背诵，渐进式遮挡从末句到全篇，自然记忆不费力；最后用测试检验成果，选择题、默写、语音三种方式全方位巩固。 语音背诵，解放家长： 不用再盯着孩子一字一句地听背诵了。孩子对着手机大声背诗，AI语音识别自动转文字、逐字对比、即时评分。哪里背对了、哪里漏了，一目了然。所有识别都在设备本地完成，不上传任何语音数据。 闪卡复习，科学记忆： 基于遗忘曲线设计的间隔复习系统，1天、3天、7天、14天、30天自动安排复习。翻转闪卡正面看标题、翻面逐行显示全文，记住了就延长间隔，忘了就从头来过。越练越牢，学过的诗不会轻易忘记。 85首必背，课本同步： 覆盖小学1-6年级教育部新课标要求的全部必背古诗词，按年级和学期分类，与学校教学进度完全对标。每首诗配有拼音标注、白话翻译、名句赏析，帮助理解诗词深层含义。 每日打卡，看见成长： 连续打卡记录学习天数，热力图一眼看出学习节奏，精美分享卡片记录每一个小成就。让背古诗变成一件有成就感的事，而不是一项枯燥的任务。 适用场景 - 课后背诵作业，打开App走一遍四步流程就搞定 期末考前集中复习，闪卡快速过一遍重点篇目 亲子共读时光，和孩子一起感受古诗词的魅力 碎片时间利用，每天10分钟，一首古诗 我们的坚持 - 所有功能完全免费，无内购无广告。 界面简洁温馨，专为儿童设计。 数据仅保存在设备本地，不收集任何个人信息。 隐私政策：https://passmetheplay.github.io/pub_doc/poemcard_privacy.html 联系我们：bo.xu@163.com

6763668092.name: 一行读
6763668092.description: 一行读 — 专为 8-15 岁孩子设计的阅读训练 App 孩子读书总是走神、跳行、读不进去？一行读用科学的方式帮孩子专注阅读，逐步建立阅读习惯。 为什么逐行显示有效？ 普通阅读时，整页文字同时涌入视线，注意力容易分散的孩子会感到无从下手。一行读每次只显示一行文字，从根源上减少视觉干扰，让孩 子自然地把注意力集中在当前内容上。 核心功能 逐行阅读模式 每次只展示一行文字，读完一行再显示下一行。支持自动播放和手动翻行，节奏完全由孩子掌控。 语音朗读 内置中文语音朗读，女声、男声、童声可选。边看边听，加深理解和记忆。 拍照导入课文 对着课本拍一张照片，自动识别文字并导入。也可以从相册选择图片、导入 TXT 和 EPUB 文件，或手动输入文字。 阅读理解检查 读完后用自己的话概括内容，支持文字输入和语音输入。帮助孩子养成边读边思考的习惯。 专注辅助工具 专注遮罩：只高亮当前行，其余内容柔化处理 陪伴角色：可爱的小伙伴在旁边鼓励孩子 呼吸动画：孩子焦躁时可以跟随动画深呼吸，平静下来再继续 禅模式：极简界面，零干扰纯阅读 触感反馈：翻行时轻柔震动，增强沉浸感 激励系统 阅读成就：铜牌、银牌、金牌，记录每一个里程碑 每日挑战和每周挑战，让阅读变成习惯 连续阅读徽章：坚持 3 天、7 天、30 天 家长自定义奖励：看完书可以兑换看电视、去公园、买玩具等真实奖励，家长确认后生效 内置内容 收录 17 篇经典中文寓言故事：狐假虎威、守株待兔、揠苗助长、亡羊补牢、掩耳盗铃……打开即可阅读，无需额外下载。 家长面板 长按顶部区域 3 秒即可进入隐藏的家长面板。在这里可以查看阅读统计、配置奖励、管理成就设置。 安全与隐私 所有数据仅存储在设备本地，不上传任何服务器 不收集任何个人信息 无广告、无内购、无社交功能 不需要注册账号 适合谁？ 阅读时容易走神、注意力不集中的孩子 刚开始培养独立阅读习惯的小学生 需要阅读辅助的注意力缺陷（ADHD）儿童 想用奖励机制激励孩子阅读的家长 一次购买，永久使用。无订阅，无内购，无广告。

6762633422.name: CroReader
6762633422.description: CroReader 是一款专为 iPhone 与 iPad 打造的本地电子书阅读器。没有账号，没有信息流，没有书城，也没有推荐算法。书由你自己带来，App 只负责安静地退到一边。 离线听书 点击「听书」，CroReader 就会用设备本地的神经网络语音，从你当前的阅读位置开始朗读。语音包只需下载一次（约 175 MB），之后完全不需要联网。朗读时当前句子会高亮，页面自动翻动，听书进度与阅读进度始终同步。支持后台与锁屏播放，可快进快退 15 秒、逐句跳转，语速也能实时调节。由于语音合成全部在本地完成，你所读书籍的内容永远不会离开你的 iPhone。 支持导入 TXT、MOBI、EPUB 等主流电子书格式，轻松管理你的本地书库。 多种精心调配的背景主题 多种阅读字体可选，且支持导入自己的字体 自由调节字号、行间距和屏幕边距，打造最舒适的阅读排版 轻点屏幕进入沉浸模式，隐藏导航栏和工具栏，顶部状态栏仅显示时间、电量和阅读进度，最大程度减少视觉干扰。 采用仿真翻页交互，还原纸质书翻阅的真实手感。

6763224025.name: OpenPocket
6763224025.description: Open Pocket is an intelligent assistant that runs large language models entirely on your device. Privacy First: No servers, no data uploads — your conversations belong to you and only you. All inference runs locally, no internet connection needed,and your data never leaves your device. Key Features: Supports Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Phi, Mistral and other popular open-source models Powered by Apple MLX framework, fully utilizing Apple Silicon performance One-tap model download from HuggingFace and ModelScope Streaming conversations with real-time inference output Chain-of-thought models (DeepSeek R1, Qwen 3) with visible reasoning process Multi-session management with full conversation history Built-in performance benchmarks to see real model speed on your device Completely free, no subscriptions, no ads

6762071498.name: DeepReflect · 深思录
6762071498.description: DeepReflect 是一款语音驱动的 AI 写作助手。 对着手机说出你的想法，App实时转写你的声音，并自动检索相关资料、提炼核心论点，最终生成一篇有深度的完整文章——全程只需你说话。 所有数据保存在本地，杜绝隐私泄露可能。 【核心功能】 实时语音转写 说话即转文字，AI 同步理解你的表达，无需手动输入一个字。 智能论点提炼 自动从你的语音中提取核心观点与搜索线索，理清思维脉络。 全球语境增强 联网检索与你主题相关的行业洞察与资料，以支撑、反驳或补充你的论点。 AI 流式生成文章 基于你的原话与检索结果，生成结构清晰的深度长文，风格贴近你的表达习惯。 灵感编辑台 内置 Markdown 编辑器，实时预览与修改 AI 生成稿，支持 GFM 语法（表格、任务列表等）。 文集归档 所有文稿自动保存至本机文集，随时回顾、继续编辑或分享。 【适合人群】 内容创作者、思想记录者、自媒体作者、学者研究者，以及任何有想法却苦于落笔的人。

While it’s not total replacement for dedicated hardware, CineTemp offers an intuitive way to make informed color decisions. The app seamlessly integrates with most iPhone cameras, and the customizable interface keeps essential tools at your fingertips. 6761697917.name: Kombinat4
6761697917.description: KOMBINAT4 is Audio Damage's fourth-generation flagship distortion. Take any sound, split it into up to eight frequency bands, and assign one of 38 distortion engines to each band. Or flip to Serial mode and chain those eight engines end-to-end for stacked, cascading mayhem. THIRTY-EIGHT DISTORTION ENGINES The complete roster from Kombinat Tri returns: Fuzz, Saturate, Distort, Clip, Warp, Degrade, Ring Mod, X Noise, Octaver, Wavy, Rectify, Tube Clip, and the famously unhinged Nerd Rage. Joining them is the entire engine set from our Grind distortion: Tanh, Asym Tanh, Overdrive, Polynomial, Linear Distort, Sine Drive, Var Hard Clip, Gloubi Boulga, MXR, Soft Clip, and Cubic NLD. Plus thirteen brand-new algorithms built specifically for Kombinat4: Wavefold, Chebyshev, Bitwise, Slew Limit, Comparator, Diode Clip, Feedback FM, Fractal, Dropout, Shapeshift, Phase Distortion, Stutter, and Erosion. Every engine has up to three custom-labeled controls plus per-band gain and solo. Pick a different engine for each band and design distortion tones that simply weren't available before. EIGHT BANDS, TWO MODES In Multiband mode, the input is split by Linkwitz-Riley crossovers into up to eight parallel bands. Each band gets its own engine and gain stage, and everything recombines at the output. Drop to two bands for classic low/high splits, push to eight for full-spectrum surgical distortion design, and solo any band to dial it in cleanly. In Serial mode, those same eight slots become a chain — every engine processes the full-bandwidth signal in turn, for layered drive structures impossible to achieve with a single algorithm. OUTPUT SECTION A dedicated output filter with twelve types: 2-pole and 4-pole low-pass, high-pass, and band-pass shapes, a notch, three OTA-style filters, a 914-style ladder bandpass, our Filterpod, and bypass. Built-in Rough Rider compressor at the output with sidechain HPF and external sidechain input. Global feedback path with attack and decay envelope for self-oscillating screams and slow-blooming sustain. Optional AGC for level-matched A/B comparisons across heavy distortion settings. DC blocker. 2x and 4x oversampling for clean high-frequency content. PRESETS AND WORKFLOW Factory preset library covering subtle saturation, mix-bus enhancement, mid-range fattening, lead guitar tones, low-end mangling, full-on industrial destruction, and everything in between. Folder-based user preset browser with favorites and import/export of single presets or full folders as ZIP. XML preset compatibility with the desktop edition — your iOS presets work in your DAW and vice versa. AUv3 plugin for iOS hosts including GarageBand, Logic Pro for iPad, AUM, Cubasis, Loopy Pro, Audiobus, drambo, BeatMaker 3, and others. Standalone app included. Tooltips on every control. Animated band display with realtime spectrum overlay. No DRM, no account, no online activation.

6472106109.name: Japanese Biz conversations
6472106109.description: Notice We have already uploaded an instruction video below which we hope you will find useful. https://youtu.be/oQifDdqT2AY This business conversation app is a language app that we would like to recommend to everyone who is struggling to manage their business activities in Japanese on their own. The concept is “Taking the initiative in Japanese business situations by memorizing whole sentences.” With the app, you can watch a conversation video between two people, like the example below where the Japanese follows the English, in order to memorize the whole sentence. Speaker A : I have to hurry and start making a speech manuscript now. -> 今から、急いでスピーチ原稿を作らないと。 Speaker B : Everyone is a member of the company, so you don't have to be formal. -> みんな、会社のメンバーなので、堅苦しくなくていいですよ。 Speaker A : No, it's my first time, so I shouldn't go that way. -> いや、最初ですし、そういう訳には、行きません。 Speaker B : Then, please leave your luggage at the condominium and come to the company by taxi. -> では、コンドミニアムに荷物を置いて、タクシーで会社まで来てください。 Speaker A : I understand. -> 承知しました。 Speaker A : Do you mind if I ask you a question? -> 一つ質問させてもらってもよろしいでしょうか？ Speaker B : Yes, I do. -> いいえ、困ります。 Speaker A : What? -> えっ？ Speaker B : Just joking, please go ahead. -> 冗談です、どうぞ。 Speaker A : I was a little bit confused. -> 少し焦りました。 The main app features include: You can freely set the number of Japanese pronunciations up to 10 times to memorize the whole thing. You can set the playback speed for English and Japanese from 0.5x to 1.5x to study at a speed that suits your ability. As a learning method that accelerates memorization, you can select and play only your favorite scenes. In addition, as shown below, it can be customized according to each level. You can play only Japanese or English to test your skills. Equipped with a text-format memo function for each scene so that you can add your own expressions and advices to enrich your expressiveness. Unlike travel or general conversations, Japanese business conversations require building a relationship of trust with your business partner. The most important thing to overcome in business situations in Japanese is to be able to express 100% of what you need to convey in sentences. In case you can't understand the Japanese spoken by the other person at all, even if you say something that you already know, such as “もう一度、お願いします。”, if you can't hear something the first time, there's almost no chance you'll catch it the second time, and the atmosphere of the meeting will freeze, leading to sad results. But, if you use a sentence that asks a question such as, “Did you just say this? “, the conversation will proceed based on the content of your sentence. Then, the initiative shifts to you, and you can finally fulfill your responsibilities in your business. If you can speak Japanese at a level that matches the needs of the workplace and learn how to speak in the sentences, you will be able to play an active role in the business scene. What you need in Japanese business conversations is to speak in your own words and always in sentences. The first thing you should train is speaking, not listening. Through the increase in number of memorized phrases, you can instantly respond to and speak during business conversations. Let’s take the initiative in meetings with business partners and have fun playing an active role in the global business scenes. I hope this app is useful to you. I look forward to your continued patronage.

6758611478.name: Morphee - Journal de Rêves
6758611478.description: –Les rêves sont précieux, mais souvent éphémères. Morphée est une application pensée pour vous aider à capturer, conserver et comprendre vos rêves, simplement, nuit après nuit. Que vous vous souveniez d’un détail, d’une émotion ou d’un rêve entier, Morphée vous accompagne pour ne plus les laisser disparaître au réveil. –Morphée vous permet d’enregistrer vos rêves à l’écrit ou à la voix, selon votre envie et votre énergie au réveil. Notes écrites rapides Enregistrements audio pour parler librement Reconnaissance vocale pour transformer votre voix en texte Idéal lorsque les mots viennent plus vite que l’écriture, ou lorsque vous êtes encore à moitié endormi. –Pour mieux se souvenir de ses rêves, la régularité est essentielle. Morphée propose des rappels discrets et intelligents pour vous encourager à penser à vos rêves au bon moment. Ces rappels vous aident à : développer une habitude améliorer la mémorisation des rêves renforcer la conscience onirique favoriser le rêve lucide –Avec le temps, votre journal devient une source d’informations précieuses. Morphée transforme vos entrées en statistiques claires et personnelles : fréquence des rêves évolution au fil des nuits régularité de vos enregistrements tendances sur le long terme Une manière simple de prendre du recul et d’observer votre monde intérieur. –Morphée a été conçue pour une utilisation calme et agréable, même de nuit : Interface épurée et apaisante Pensée pour le confort visuel Navigation simple et intuitive L’application s’efface pour laisser place à vos rêves. –Vos rêves sont intimes. Morphée respecte votre vie privée et ne collecte que les données nécessaires au bon fonctionnement de l’application.

6761837142.name: 眠知 - 睡眠监测与梦话记录
6761837142.trackName: 眠知 - 睡眠监测与梦话记录
6761837142.description: 你的每一夜，都值得被认真对待。 眠知是一款专注于睡眠声音分析与智能复盘的专业工具。睡前一键录制，醒来即可查看整夜的声音事件、睡眠周期与个性化洞察报告——真正听见你的夜晚，读懂你的睡眠。 核心能力 ◉ 整夜声音智能采集 自动录制夜间声音环境，精准捕捉每一个关键时刻。 ◉ 梦话 · 打鼾 · 噪音识别 基于声学分析算法，自动标记梦话片段、打鼾事件与环境干扰噪音，帮你发现"不自知"的夜间状况。 ◉ 睡眠分数 & 周期全景 生成直观的睡眠质量评分，拆解深睡、浅睡、REM（快速眼动）、清醒四大阶段，一目了然。 ◉ 关键片段即时回放 精准定位夜间重点音频段落，支持快速跳转回听，不错过任何细节。 ◉ 7天/30天趋势分析 长周期追踪你的睡眠节律变化，用数据驱动更健康的作息习惯。 ◉ 梦境洞察 & 梦境故事 独家生成梦境分析报告与叙事化梦境故事，帮你回溯和理解昨夜的潜意识旅程。 全新升级 ◉ 治愈白噪音 · 多轨混音台 海浪、雨声、林间篝火、城市咖啡馆……多种自然与环境音源自由叠加混合。支持独立音量调节、定时自动关闭与一键全静音，为你打造专属的沉浸式助眠声场。 ◉ 全球 33 种语言全面支持 从中文、英语、日语到阿拉伯语、泰语、越南语——界面、分析报告、睡眠洞察已实现 33 种语言的全方位母语级适配。无论你在世界哪个角落，眠知都以你最熟悉的语言陪伴入眠。 ◉ 高颜值睡眠分享卡片 新增"极光"、"星云"、"月蚀"等艺术级视觉模板，一键生成精美的睡眠质量分享卡，让健康生活也可以很好看。 更多细节 ◉ 支持自定义睡眠目标与就寝提醒 ◉ 支持睡眠报告本地 PDF 导出 ◉ 深色模式全面适配 ◉ 隐私优先：所有录音数据仅存储在本地设备 适合你吗？ 想知道自己是否打鼾或说梦话 想科学地追踪和改善睡眠质量 想用白噪音营造舒适的入睡环境 想长期观察自己的睡眠节律变化 想保留并回听夜间的关键声音片段 免责声明：眠知提供睡眠记录、分析与复盘能力，不作为医疗诊断依据。部分功能需要麦克风、语音识别与通知权限，以完成录音、转写和提醒体验。

6760789876.name: RentWise Manager
6760789876.description: RentWise Manager is a rental property management app built for landlords who want to stay organized, track performance, and manage day-to-day operations from one place. Manage your rentals with tools for properties, tenants, rent payments, expenses, documents, inspections, maintenance requests, lease reminders, communication logs, and reports. Whether you manage a single unit or a growing portfolio, RentWise Manager helps you keep important information together and accessible on iPhone and iPad. Key Features Track properties, addresses, rent amounts, and occupancy Manage tenant details, lease dates, rent status, and contact information Record rent payments and monitor paid, pending, and late balances Log expenses and review monthly cash flow Store rental documents with file attachments Create inspections with status, score, notes, and property links Track maintenance requests and progress Set property-level rent reminder days Log tenant communication notes in one place Export rent and expense reports as CSV or PDF View dashboards and summaries designed for iPhone and iPad Built for Landlords RentWise Manager is designed to make rental management simpler without the complexity of large property management systems. Use it to stay on top of rent collection, monitor portfolio performance, review lease activity, and keep important records organized. Easy to Use The app is optimized for a clean mobile experience with support for both iPhone and iPad, helping you manage rental operations wherever you are. Privacy and Support Privacy Policy: https://jetriseitsolutions.com/Privacy-Policy/ Terms of Use: https://jetriseitsolutions.com/terms-of-use/ Support: developer@jetriseitsolutions.com

6499589553.name: Time Zones PRO
6499589553.description: Discover the ultimate time zone companion with Time Zone PRO! Seamlessly calculate time differences across UTC, GMT, and 49 other global time zones, from ACDT to WIT. Whether you're a traveler, business professional, or simply curious about world time, this app has you covered. Key Features: Comprehensive time zone coverage including UTC, GMT, and 49 additional time zones worldwide. Quick and intuitive time zone lookup powered by Google integration. Support for both AM/PM and 24-hour time formats, catering to individual preferences. Time Zone PRO is your go-to tool for effortless time conversions and scheduling across continents. Stay connected and efficient no matter where you are in the world!

6761655885.name: LightRoll Camera | Photo Video
6761655885.description: LightRoll is the everyday camera for cleaner photo libraries. Snap receipts, parking spots, whiteboard notes, labels, documents and other utility shots without burying your real memories in camera roll clutter. Choose Keep for moments worth saving, or Temp for photos you only need for now. LightRoll is free to download and try. Start with a 1-month free trial on the annual plan. After the trial, the annual plan renews yearly unless cancelled, or you can choose lifetime access as a one-time purchase. Keep photos save to the album you choose. Temp photos are still saved to your photo gallery but these can all be deleted with one tap. LightRoll tracks when Temp photos expire, reminds you when they are ready to review, and lets you clear them with one tap, subject to confirmation. Now LightRoll also includes a full photo editor, with filters, portrait lighting and advanced depth-of-field controls for giving your shots the right look before you keep them or move on. KEEP WHAT MATTERS Use Keep for photos you want to save long term: Family moments Travel photos Memories Portraits Work worth keeping Anything that belongs in your permanent library Keep photos go to your chosen album, so the photos that matter stay organised from the start. TEMP THE REST Use Temp for photos you only need for now: Receipts Parking spots Whiteboard notes Package labels Measurements Menus Documents Shopping reminders Quick reference photos Anything useful today but not forever Most camera roll clutter starts with photos that were useful for a moment. LightRoll helps you decide what belongs in your library before it becomes clutter. EDIT WITH MORE CONTROL LightRoll is not just a temporary photo camera. It is built to feel like an everyday camera, with editing tools ready when you need them. Use the built-in editor to adjust your photos with: Filters Portrait lighting Manual depth-of-field editing Advanced depth control for supported portrait photos Give important shots a polished look, or quickly improve utility photos before saving, sharing or clearing them later. LESS CAMERA ROLL CLUTTER LightRoll helps you stop saving every throwaway photo like it is a memory. Instead of sorting through hundreds of old receipts, labels, notes and parking photos later, you choose Keep or Temp at the moment you capture. Your camera roll stays cleaner, your important photos stay easier to find, and your photo library stays more intentional over time. BUILT FOR EVERYDAY USE LightRoll is designed to feel like a normal camera, with one extra decision that makes all the difference. Shoot with a simple two-shutter camera Choose Keep or Temp before clutter starts Save Keep photos to the album you choose Save Temp photos knowing you won't have to worry about manually deleting them later Clear expired Temp photos when you are ready with one tap Edit photos with filters, portrait lighting and depth controls Capture real memories without mixing them with throwaway shots WHY LIGHTROLL? Because not every photo deserves to live in your camera roll forever. Some photos are memories. Some photos are reminders. Some photos are useful for a day, a week, or a single task. LightRoll gives each photo the right place from the moment you take it. Shoot now. Sort never. Keep the moments that matter. Temp the ones that don’t. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Your photos should stay yours. No accounts. No ads. No cross-app tracking. No LightRoll photo servers. LightRoll does not upload your photos or videos to its own servers, analyse your images, sell your data, or use advertising identifiers. Terms of Use: https://lightroll.app/terms.html Privacy Policy: https://lightroll.app/privacy-policy.html

6755898890.description: 【为什么需要停车计时？】 在商场停车，本来只停了一小时，却因超时几分钟要多付一小时停车费？ 忘记车停在哪个楼层，找车浪费时间？ 停车计时帮你解决这些烦恼！ 【核心功能】 智能倒计时 圆环显示变价倒计时，一目了然 绿色（安全）→ 橙色（临近）→ 红色（即将变价） 提前几分钟推送提醒，绝不多付冤枉钱 灵活计费规则 支持标准计费和阶梯计费模式，满足多种场景 预设常见停车场规则，一键开始计时 自定义免费时长、计费周期、单价等 实时预估停车费用，心中有数 快速记录车位 开始停车后自动标记停车位置，离场找车不再迷路 拍摄停车位置照片（环境/车位号） 拍摄缴费二维码，离场时快速支付 照片本地保存，不占用系统相册 灵动岛 & 锁屏显示 支持灵动岛实时显示 锁屏实时活动，无需解锁即可查看 桌面小组件，随时掌握停车时长 智能联动启动 支持 CarPlay / 蓝牙断开后自动开始停车计时 结束停车快捷指令，一步完成离场操作 告别手动记录，停车计时更省心 【适合人群】 精打细算型车主：充分利用免费时长，拒绝停车费刺客 健忘型车主：记录车位位置，快速找车 高频停车用户：商场、医院、机场等场景 【特色亮点】 极简设计，操作直观 本地存储，保护隐私 无需注册，打开即用 让停车更省钱、更高效！

6760579229.name: 舒尔特方格 - 注意力反应力专注力训练
6760579229.trackName: 舒尔特方格 - 注意力反应力专注力训练
6760579229.description: 舒尔特方格是一款围绕专注力训练、注意力训练和脑力练习设计的应用。你可以在同一款应用中体验数字训练、字母训练、双人同屏和速算关卡，用更清晰的节奏持续提升观察力、反应力、记忆力与手眼协调。 【核心功能】 数字训练：按顺序点选方格，适合日常专注力与反应速度练习。 字母训练：从字母识别到顺序连点，帮助训练视觉搜索与认知切换。 双人同屏：上下分屏同屏对战，适合朋友或亲子一起挑战。 速算关卡：结合加减乘除和不同方格难度，边算边找，提升心算与算术反应。 训练统计：通过图表分析查看相关训练数据。 签到提醒：支持每日签到和本地提醒，帮助建立稳定训练习惯。 无论你想找一款舒尔特方格应用做专注练习，还是希望通过数字、字母、同屏对战和速算模式进行日常脑力训练，这里都能提供清晰、轻量、持续可用的训练体验。

6755299990.name: Balans – Net Worth Tracker
6755299990.description: Balans – Your Financial Overview, Simplified Balans helps you track your net worth over time — without the noise. No bank connections. No transactions. Just one simple monthly input to give you a clear picture of your finances. Why Balans? Get a complete overview of your assets and liabilities See how your net worth evolves over time Stay focused on the big picture — not daily spending Clean, minimal design built for clarity New: Balans Score (Beta) Get a quick snapshot of your financial health with the new Balans Score. Designed for simplicity Enter your balances once a month. That’s it. Balans turns small effort into powerful insight.

6761878703.description: Calculator+ 外观和功能与真实的计算器完全一致——但输入你的秘密密码并点击"="，即可解锁隐藏其中的完全私密保险箱。 你的照片、视频、笔记和浏览记录均经过加密，仅存储在你的设备上。无云端。无账号。无追踪。一旦切换应用，保险箱消失，任何人看到的都只是 Calculator+。 完美的伪装 Calculator+ 经得起"把手机递给朋友"的考验。它能进行完整的算术运算——加、减、乘、除、百分比、正负号切换。任何拿起你手机的人都会看到一个精致、全功能的计算器。 保险箱功能 从相册导入照片和视频，或直接在应用内拍摄——原始文件不会离开应用 将媒体整理到自定义相册中 批量选择并删除或移动多个项目 全屏查看器，支持捏合缩放和滑动切换 原生视频播放，支持进度拖拽 私密笔记，自动保存，支持全文搜索 私密浏览器，不保留任何历史、Cookie 或缓存 多重安全保障 6位秘密密码，安全存储于 Keychain Face ID / Touch ID 生物识别解锁 离开应用时自动锁定——保险箱不会意外保持开启 后台模糊遮罩，在多任务视图中隐藏保险箱内容 截图保护——录屏仅捕获空白画面 入侵日志记录每次解锁失败的时间戳 隐私至上的设计 所有数据均存储在设备受保护的存储空间中，采用完整文件保护。Calculator+ 没有服务器、无需登录、无分析、无广告，无法访问你的数据。进入保险箱的内容留在保险箱中——只有你才能取出来。 适合将个人珍贵时刻、敏感文件、私密笔记和私密浏览与日常生活完全隔离。

6745807352.name: Ruce
6745807352.description: Ruce - 脉律身语 Ruce - Your Personalized TCM Wellness Companion Ruce是一款结合中医体质、脉象分析，为您量身定制如厕、饮水计划，并追踪情绪与月经周期的智能健康App。通过与我们的另一款App Bamai（模拟中医把脉App）联动，Ruce能够更精准地了解您的身体状况，提供个性化的健康建议。 Ruce is a smart health app that integrates Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) constitution and pulse analysis to create personalized bowel movement and hydration plans, while also tracking emotional and menstrual cycles. By connecting with our other app, Bamai (a simulated TCM pulse-taking app), Ruce gains a more accurate understanding of your body's condition, providing tailored wellness recommendations. 核心功能： Key Features: 个性化如厕计划： 根据您的体质和脉象特点，Ruce会智能推荐最适合您的如厕时间与频率，帮助您养成健康的排便习惯。 Personalized Bowel Movement Plan: Based on your constitution and pulse characteristics, Ruce intelligently recommends the most suitable timing and frequency for bowel movements, helping you develop healthy habits. 智能饮水提醒：基于您的身体数据，Ruce会制定个性化的饮水计划，并在最佳时间提醒您补充水分。 Smart Hydration Reminders: Utilizing your body data, Ruce creates a personalized hydration plan and reminds you to drink water at optimal times. 情绪波动周期监测：记录并分析您的情绪变化，帮助您了解自身的情绪周期，更好地应对情绪波动。 Mood Swing Cycle Tracking: Record and analyze your mood fluctuations, helping you understand your emotional cycles and better manage emotional changes. 月经周期追踪：精准记录和预测您的月经周期，提供经期健康建议和贴心提醒。 Menstrual Cycle Tracking (for female users): Accurately track and predict your menstrual cycle, providing period health advice and thoughtful reminders. Bamai联动：与Bamai无缝连接，获取更全面的脉象信息，提升健康建议的精准度。 Bamai Integration: Seamlessly connects with Bamai to obtain more comprehensive pulse information, enhancing the accuracy of health recommendations.

6763528890.name: 小白学桥牌
6763528890.description: 「小白学桥牌」面向刚接触或想系统入门定约桥牌的朋友，把规则、概念和常见场景拆成好读的小节，配合图示与示例手牌，帮你建立对叫牌、做庄与防守的直观理解。教程从「桥牌是什么」讲到牌力估算、叫牌流程、打牌与得分要点，以及礼仪与公平竞赛，适合按顺序学习，也适合随时点开某一章查漏补缺。 应用内提供大牌点速算、牌型识别、叫牌判断和做庄常识等练习，每题附简明解析，答错的题目会自动收入错题本，方便集中巩固。术语表收录常用名词，支持搜索，遇到陌生说法可以马上查。你可以在教程里收藏重点章节，学习进度与练习记录保存在本机，打开即可继续上次的学习节奏。 界面采用清爽的蓝白配色与卡片式布局，重要内容分层呈现，并加入适度的动效与插图，让阅读更轻松。内容侧重入门与打牢基础，具体叫牌体系与竞赛规则请以当地桥牌组织或裁判解释为准。希望「小白学桥牌」能成为你桌上对局之外的好帮手，陪你从「完全不懂」稳步走到「敢上桌、玩得明白」。

6762997060.description: 每一克都重要。 不是因为你要带更少的装备， 而是因为你要带得更聪明。 GramPack 是一款为轻量化徒步设计的装备规划工具，帮助你从第一份清单开始，建立一套真正适合你的装备体系。 更清晰地规划装备 更精确地掌控重量 一步一步，让背包变轻 免费开始使用 创建你的第一份清单，并在装备库中存储最多 50 件装备。 需要更多？ GramPack 无限版通过一次性购买解锁无限清单和装备库容量，无需订阅。 ● 以清单为核心的沉浸式设计 没有复杂首页，没有多余功能。 你的装备清单就是一切的中心。 从预设基础清单开始，或从零创建。 ● 完整的轻量化重量体系 不仅仅是总重，而是完整的三层结构： 基重（Base Weight） 背负重量（Total Pack Weight） 离身重量（Skin-out Weight） 不仅要了解装备有多轻，更要关注真实背负体验。 ● 自然沉淀的装备库 在整理清单的过程中，装备自动进入你的装备库。 无需额外维护，也可以随时统一管理。 ● 分享你的装备配置 将装备清单与重量结构导出为图片， 清晰、直观，随时分享。 ● 基于真实徒步的装备结构 预设装备系统与类型，帮助你建立清晰、统一的清单结构。 不仅自己看得懂，别人也能一眼理解。 为走得更远的人准备 计划第一次多日徒步的玩家 关注装备重量的徒步者 追求轻量化的进阶爱好者 其他信息 完全本地存储，无需网络 支持公制 / 英制 支持简体中文 / 繁体中文 / English 一次性购买，无订阅 专为轻量化徒步设计

6763258205.name: 祷告札记

6466442961.name: 赢麻了
6466442961.description: 日本麻将（立直麻将）是一种深受欢迎的桌上游戏，然而由于其复杂的规则导致许多玩家难以准确地计算番数和得分。为了解决这一问题，我们开发了“赢麻了-智能日麻助手”，来帮助大家可以面对面和朋友愉快玩耍。 赢麻了是一款强大实用麻将助手软件，其主要功能是通过拍摄和牌后的桌面照片，快速且准确地帮助玩家自动算番算符算分。无论你是新手还是有经验的玩家，在使用我们的应用后，将能够更加便捷地享受日本麻将的乐趣。 【功能】 牌面识别：通过人工智能技术，本软件可以智能识别照片中的麻将牌面，包括数字、花色和风向等信息，确保准确无误地显示出来。 役种判断：役种是日本麻将中用于计算得分的重要指标，我们的应用能够自动分析玩家的手牌和副露，并结合规则快速识别役种，让你专注于游戏本身。 番数符数：我们的应用可以根据牌型、役种等因素自动计算番数和符数，避免了繁琐的手动计算，节省了时间和精力。 得分计算：日本麻将的分数计算极其繁琐，我们的应用能够为你精确计算出得分，方便游戏对局结算，享受和牌的乐趣。 【特色】 用户友好界面：我们的应用拥有简洁直观的用户界面，使得操作更加轻松自然。无需繁琐的设置，只需要拍摄照片即可享受便捷的算番算符算分服务。 强大的智能识别：我们的人工智能算法经过精心训练，可以高效而准确的识别常见麻将牌面。 非凡计算效率：通过应用内置的高效人工智能识别和计算引擎，我们的软件能够快速地在本地运行，节省大量的时间，让你更加专注于游戏体验。 及时更新：我们团队将持续改进和增强该应用的功能，添加更多的辅助功能，如果您有任何的建议，欢迎通过应用内反馈和我们交流。 在您使用“赢麻了”助手后，希望您将会体验到这款应用的强大功能带来的极大便利。无论你是日本麻将的新手还是高手，我们衷心希望“赢麻了”能够为你的游戏之旅增添乐趣和成功的喜悦，享受与朋友们的愉快对局！
