6754662195.name: Learn ErLang | ErLangBook
6754662195.description: Ready to master Erlang, the powerful functional programming language behind massively concurrent and reliable systems? "Learn ErLang" is your complete, pocket-sized guide to take you from beginner to proficient. Our app provides a structured learning path with 93 lessons, interactive quizzes, and detailed progress tracking. Whether you are a new developer or an experienced programmer looking to learn a new skill, our curriculum is designed to make learning Erlang straightforward and effective. Key Features: A COMPREHENSIVE CURRICULUM Master Erlang with 93 total lessons, organized into easy-to-follow modules. Topics include Erlang Overview, Basics, Functions, Modules, Pattern Matching, and more. Track your progress clearly with "lessons completed" counters for each module and for your total journey. INTERACTIVE LEARNING & QUIZZES Test your knowledge at the end of lessons with built-in quizzes. Receive instant feedback with a detailed review of all questions, showing you exactly what you got right and wrong to reinforce your learning. TRACK YOUR SUCCESS Visit the dedicated Stats screen to see your "Overall Progress" at a glance. Stay motivated by tracking your "Best Streak," "Last Active" day, and total "Lessons Completed." Review your "Recent Activities" to pick up right where you left off. POWERFUL SEARCH & HELP Find the exact lesson you need with a powerful search tool. Browse popular topics using tags like #basics, #functions, and #syntax. Stuck on a real-world problem? The integrated "Help Center" lets you search Stack Overflow directly for Erlang-related questions and answers. FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE EXPERIENCE Make the app your own. Toggle between a clean "Light Mode" and a focused "Dark Mode." Choose from over 20 different "Color Themes" to match your style. Organize your home screen modules in a "List View" or a "Grid View" with a simple switch in the settings. Our course covers all the essential topics you need, including: What is Erlang? (History & Background) Features and Advantages of Erlang Erlang Basics and Syntax Functions in Erlang Erlang Modules Pattern Matching and Guards Concurrency and Fault Tolerance Stop reading dry documentation. Start learning interactively. Download "Learn ErLang" today and take the first step toward building highly scalable and fault-tolerant applications.

6743705597.name: Specialty Coffee Trainer
6743705597.description: Embark on a journey to become a coffee connoisseur with BrewMaster Coach, your ultimate companion for mastering the art and science of specialty coffee. Whether you’re a professional barista, a coffee enthusiast, or an aspiring expert, this app offers a comprehensive, immersive learning experience tailored to enhance your coffee knowledge and skills. Key Features: Comprehensive Flashcards Dive into expertly curated flashcards covering every aspect of specialty coffee—from origins and roasting techniques to brewing methods and sensory evaluation. Reinforce your learning effectively with our spaced repetition system. Interactive Multiple-Choice Questions Test your knowledge with a variety of questions designed to deepen your understanding of complex coffee concepts. Realistic Practice Exams Simulate the real Specialty Coffee Association Certification exams with practice tests. Get immediate feedback and explanations to sharpen your skills. Offline Mode Keep learning wherever you are. Access all materials offline—perfect for studying in cafés or during commutes. User-Friendly Design Enjoy a seamless and intuitive learning experience through our clean, easy-to-navigate interface. Progress Tracking Track your strengths and areas for improvement with detailed analytics. Create personalized study plans based on your performance. Why a Coach? 1.	Expertise at Your Fingertips Gain access to distilled industry knowledge in a convenient, accessible format. 2.	Versatile Learning Options Choose the learning style that fits your schedule—from flashcards to full-length practice exams. 3.	Certification Success Equip yourself with the skills and confidence to pass the Specialty Coffee Association Certification and elevate your coffee career.

6762583881.description: 存钱拼图-用 365 天拼出你的小目标 每天存一点，365 天后拼出完整的自己。 存钱拼图是一款极简、治愈的每日存钱打卡 App——把枯燥的攒钱变成一张会慢慢被点亮的拼图，让坚持一整年这件事，真正看得见、摸得着。 为什么选择存钱拼图？ 不同于传统记账 App，我们相信"可视化"才是坚持下去的秘密。 每完成一天打卡，就会解锁一块专属拼图碎片；连续打卡越久，拼图越完整，年末收获的不只是一笔存款，更是一幅只属于你的成就图景。 三种存钱模式，适合任何预算 递增模式：第 1 天存 1 元，第 2 天存 2 元……365 天累计可达 66,795 元，告别"存钱难" 固定金额：每天存入同等金额，简单稳定，适合零花钱规划 随机模式：1~365 元被打乱顺序随机触发，多一份小惊喜 自定义倍率：任意模式都可设置倍率，按自己的节奏放大或缩小目标 三种拼图形状，定制你的年度纪念品 方格：经典网格，整齐干净 心形：温柔治愈，适合送给自己或心爱的人 圆形：圆满收官，象征一整年的圆圆满满 支持自定义拼图底图——把喜欢的照片放进去，每完成一天，就多看见一点完整的它。 和朋友一起存，坚持不再孤单 6 位邀请码添加好友，无需注册手机号 首页直接看到好友的今日进度与总体完成度 只分享昵称、头像和整体进度，绝不涉及任何金额或隐私细节 你追我赶地打卡，让存钱变成一件有温度的小事 Apple Watch + 桌面小组件，一抬手就打卡 Apple Watch App：手腕一抬即可完成今日打卡，同步主 App 进度 iOS 桌面小组件：实时查看今日金额、完成进度和拼图预览 通过 iCloud 在你的 iPhone、iPad、Apple Watch 间自动同步 专为中文用户设计的细节体验 每日打卡动画与奖励弹窗，仪式感满满 连续打卡计数，记录你不间断的坚持 多种主题配色，深浅模式自适应 每日温柔提醒，不唠叨不打扰 过生日跨天智能刷新，跨时区也不会错过任何一天 关于隐私，我们说到做到 所有存钱记录仅保存在你自己的设备中 通过你个人的 iCloud (CloudKit) 在自己的设备之间同步 不上传任何数据到第三方服务器 不收集可识别用户身份的信息 完全免费 · 无广告 · 无内购 存钱拼图从第一天起就坚持：不看广告、不卖内购、不打扰你。 我们只想安安静静地陪你完成 365 天的约定。 现在就开始——给一年后的自己，准备一份看得见的礼物。 如有问题或建议，欢迎通过 lzx252189@gmail.com 联系我们1–3 个工作日内必回复。

6754542772.description: Audio Trimmer – Smart Audio Cutter & Ringtone Maker Create custom ringtones, trim songs, and edit audio with precision — all in one lightweight, native app. Audio Trimmer makes it effortless to cut, fade, adjust volume, and export audio files in high quality, directly on your iPhone or iPad. Key Features: Create Ringtones & Notification Sounds Trim any part of a song or recording and export it as a custom ringtone in seconds. Precise Audio Trimming Drag easy-to-use handles or type exact time values to select your perfect clip. Visual Waveform Editing See your audio visually for accurate trimming and editing. Fade In & Fade Out Effects Smooth transitions for a professional touch. Volume Adjustment Increase or reduce loudness to get the perfect balance. Extract sound from a video Extract the audio from any video, making it easy to save soundtracks from movies or music videos. Small & Fast Built entirely with SwiftUI and AVFoundation, the app is lightweight, efficient, and fully native — no internet required. Multiple Export Formats Save your audio as M4A, WAV, or CAF, optimized for quality and compatibility. Easy Sharing Instantly share your trimmed audio via AirDrop, Messages, Files, or any app. Why Choose Audio Trimmer: Make personalized ringtones and notification sounds Edit podcasts, music, or voice recordings quickly 100% offline, private, and secure Beautifully designed, intuitive, and small in size Thanks for your support! 6763084120.name: Afterbeat私密节奏
6763084120.description: Afterbeat 是一款运行在 Apple Watch 上的私密锻炼记录工具。 用户可在手表上手动开始和结束一次记录，并在结束后查看时长、节奏、动作表现和心率恢复情况摘要。 功能包括： Apple Watch 手动开始和结束 节奏、时长和输出摘要 可选心率信息补充 历史记录保存在本地设备 无需账号 Afterbeat 不是医疗应用，不提供诊断或治疗建议。

6737434592.name: 将星三国 - 单机开放剧情三国游戏
6737434592.trackName: 将星三国 - 单机开放剧情三国游戏

6447479401.name: SongView - Music Live Activity
6447479401.description: SongView creates a custom Live Activity that extends the functionality of the music player. With SongView, you can view the album the current song is playing from as well as artist information quickly and easily. With a press of a button, you can add or remove the currently playing song to your music library. In the app, you can customise the look of your activity by changing the background colour, text colour, and font. SongView works with both Apple Music and Spotify. An internet connection and subscription to Apple Music or Spotify is required to use SongView.

6677019123.name: LumiSync
6677019123.description: The Ultimate Remote Stroboscope App for Physics Experiments Enhance your physics experiments and educational activities with LumiSync, a versatile stroboscope app designed specifically for students, educators, and amateur scientists. Transform your iPhone into a precise tool for studying light, motion, and wave phenomena, complete with customizable strobe and solid light settings. Key Features: Precise Frequency Control (1-60 Hz): Adjust the strobe’s frequency with high accuracy to study periodic motion, resonance, and wave phenomena. Explore the effects of different strobe frequencies on moving objects and analyze motion in real time. Solid Light Mode (Screen & LED): In addition to strobe effects, LumiSync provides a continuous, solid light source. Choose any color for the screen to explore the visible light spectrum, and utilize the iPhone’s LED flashlight for bright, white light. Customizable Screen Light Colors: Experiment with different colors on the screen to study wavelength, diffraction, refraction, and other light-related concepts. Perfect for classroom demonstrations or personal learning. Brightness Adjustment for Optimal Conditions: Control the brightness of the screen to suit different experimental environments, ensuring precise lighting whether you’re in a bright lab or a dark room. Remote Control via Web Portal: Conduct hands-free experiments with LumiSync’s web-based remote control. Each user receives a unique 6-character code, allowing them to control the app remotely—ideal for group experiments or educational demonstrations. Dark Mode UI: LumiSync’s sleek dark mode ensures a comfortable experience in low-light environments, reducing screen glare and making it easier to focus on your experiments. Educational and Experimental Applications: LumiSync is designed to be a valuable tool for physics and science education: Wave and Motion Studies: Use the strobe function to visualize wave patterns, harmonic oscillations, and the motion of rotating objects. Investigate the relationship between frequency and motion in real time. Color and Light Exploration: Experiment with solid light in various colors on the screen to explore concepts such as the visible spectrum, light absorption, and color theory. Switch between the customizable screen and the white LED flashlight for diverse lighting effects. Motion Analysis: The strobe function enables high-frequency flashing, helping you freeze and slow down the motion of fast-moving objects, making it easier to analyze rotational or oscillatory motion in physics experiments. Remote Learning and Classroom Demonstrations: LumiSync’s remote control feature, accessible via the web, allows teachers and students to control the app from any device, facilitating hands-free demonstrations and distance learning. Download LumiSync today and take your physics experiments to the next level with the power of light!

6756301040.description: Low Poly Synth 是一款具有数十亿种独特音色的旋律氛围声音生成器。该应用程序基于 Fractal Bits、Relic Waves 和 Relic Flow 的修改合成算法构建，并添加了纯音生成代码。声音空间分为 4294967296 个预设，每个预设对应一组 8 个样本纹理。单个样本的音量可以在顶部面板中或通过 MIDI（设置 -> MIDI 映射）进行调整。底部面板是一个经典的音乐键盘，用于为组中的声音设置音符。每个音符同时触发所有 8 个样本 - 它们一起触发

6748909342.name: Simple Snake Game
6748909342.description: Rediscover the Timeless Thrill of Snake! Dive into the classic Snake game reimagined for iOS with a sleek, modern twist. Guide your snake across a vibrant grid, gobbling up food to grow longer while dodging your own tail. With wrap-around edges, the action never stops—until you do! Built entirely with SwiftUI, this addictive arcade staple delivers smooth performance and intuitive controls right at your fingertips. Key Features: Classic Gameplay with a Modern Edge: Eat, grow, and survive in the iconic snake format, now with fluid animations and responsive touch controls—including swipe gestures for quick direction changes. Increasing Challenge: Watch the speed ramp up every 20 seconds, testing your reflexes as the game gets faster and more intense. Score and High Score Tracking: Compete against yourself with real-time scoring and persistent high scores—can you beat your best? Intuitive Controls: Use on-screen arrows or swipe anywhere on the board to steer your snake seamlessly. Wrap-Around World: No walls to crash into—the snake loops around the screen edges for endless strategic possibilities. Pause and Restart Anytime: Hit pause during intense moments, and jump back in with a tap. Game over? Restart instantly from the overlay screen. Clean, Grid-Based Design: A simple yet elegant board with subtle grid lines for perfect visibility on any iOS device. Whether you're reliving nostalgic arcade memories or discovering Snake for the first time, this app offers endless fun in bite-sized sessions. Perfect for quick breaks or marathon high-score chases! Download now and see how long you can grow your snake. What's your high score going to be? (Supports iOS 15.6+ | No ads, no in-app purchases—just pure gameplay!)

6749187228.name: Numbers Slide
6749187228.description: Discover NumSlide, the addictive sliding puzzle that challenges your strategy and quick thinking! Slide tiles on a 4x4 grid to merge numbers and rack up the highest score. Start with 1s and 2s, combining them into ever-larger powers of two – can you reach beyond 1024? Key Features: Swipe to slide: Move tiles up, down, left, or right with simple gestures. Smart merging: Combine two 1s into 2, two 2s into 4, and identical tiles from 4 onwards to double up. Score big: Every merge adds to your score – aim for combos by merging multiple pairs in one move! Undo mistakes: Rewind your last move to keep the game going. Endless challenge: New tiles appear after each move, but watch out – fill the board without merges, and it's game over! Track progress: Beat your high score and resume games anytime. Perfect for puzzle lovers seeking a fresh twist on classic number games. Easy to learn, hard to master – download NumSlide and start sliding today!

6738101928.name: Light HDR
6738101928.description: Winner of the Swift Student Challenge 2024 Light HDR turns your iPhone or iPad into a professional-grade lighting panel, perfect for photography and videography. Designed with XDR displays in mind to utilize the full capabilities of your device, this app gives you the ability to fine-tune screen colors with custom sliders while ensuring perfect color accuracy across White Balance, RGB, and HSV. Key Features: Precise Color Control – Adjust your lighting using White Balance, RGB, or HSV to get the exact color output you need. HDR Mode – Unlock the full potential of your device’s XDR display, achieving maximum brightness and true HDR lighting. Light Effect - Light effects can be mimicked to resemble real-life lighting, with more features to come in the future. Metal-Optimized Performance – Enjoy smooth, real-time HDR rendering powered by Metal. Whether you’re a photographer, videographer, or creative professional, Light HDR is the ultimate tool for precision lighting control on the go.

6760211479.name: Watt Charging Speed：瓦特计
6760211479.description: 你的充电器到底有多快？将 iPhone 或 iPad 插上电源，Watt Charging Speed 就会实时估算充电功率（瓦特）——让你分辨快充和慢充，并确认你的数据线是否真正支持快充。 工作原理——坦诚相告 iPhone 和 iPad 不向应用开放硬件功率计。因此，Watt Charging Speed 通过追踪电池电量上升的速度，并结合你设备的精确电池容量来估算功率。这意味着： 显示的读数是审慎的估算值，而非直接测量结果 首次读数会在充电几分钟后出现 充电时应用保持打开的时间越长，估算越准确 实时充电速度 充电时实时显示功率估算 颜色标示的速度等级：快速、正常、缓慢或涓流 动态充电圆环和实时会话图表 预计充满所需时间 基准测试你的充电器 创建电量区间测试（例如 30% → 80%）并精确计时 在相同条件下对比不同充电器和数据线 看看哪个充电器表现最好 充电历史 自动记录充电会话，包括平均功率、时长和电量区间 对比历史会话，发现变慢的数据线或老化的充电器 隐私优先 无广告、无跟踪、无账户 所有数据仅保存在你的设备上 完全离线可用 温馨提示 iOS 会暂停后台应用，因此测量期间请保持 Watt Charging Speed 处于打开状态——应用会在会话期间让屏幕保持常亮，确保测量不被打断。 无论是测试新充电器、诊断充电缓慢的原因，还是弄清哪根数据线该被淘汰，这款应用都是理想之选。

6762169145.name: Ornn闹钟
6762169145.description: Ornn 闹钟不是普通按周重复的闹钟，而是一款更懂中国上班节奏的智能排班闹钟。 无论你是固定工作日通勤、大小周上班，还是上几休几的轮班人群，Ornn 闹钟都能帮你把重复规则设置得更准确，减少节假日前后反复改闹钟的麻烦。 核心特色： 法定工作日闹钟：节假日自动跳过，周末补班日照常响铃 多种重复规则：支持仅一次、每天、工作日、自定义、大小周、轮班 轮班更省心：支持上几天休几天，适合倒班和排班工作 自定义铃声：支持导入多种音频格式，为不同闹钟设置不同提醒音 稍后提醒：支持自定义稍后时长，并配合实时活动与灵动岛展示倒计时 多闹钟管理：查看规则、副标题和下次响铃时间，状态更清楚 适合这些人： 需要根据法定节假日自动调整的上班族 有大小周安排的公司员工 需要上几休几循环排班的轮班用户 想把不同提醒场景分开管理的人 如果你已经受够了普通闹钟只会“周一到周五”，那 Ornn 闹钟会更适合你。 【Ornn 自动续费订阅说明】 1.订阅服务： Ornn VIP 自动续费订阅（提供月会员、年会员等服务，以实际页面展示为准） 2.订阅价格： 具体价格以 App 内展示为准 3.自动续费： 购买自动续费会员的账户，会在每个订阅周期到期前 24 小时内，通过 iTunes 账户自动扣费并延长对应会员有效期。 若扣费成功，则会员有效期自动顺延一个周期。 4.关闭服务： 如需取消订阅，请手动打开 iOS 的“设置” → 点击“Apple ID” → 进入“订阅” → 选择 Ornn VIP 自动续费订阅取消订阅即可。 如未在订阅期结束的至少 24 小时前关闭订阅，本订阅将会自动续订。 5.服务协议（Terms of Use）： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 6.用户协议： https://juejin.cn/post/7628880606123606058 7.隐私协议： https://juejin.cn/post/7628180482584707098

6761487183.name: Spira — Cultive tes rituels
6761487183.description: Chaque habitude que tu cultives fait pousser une fleur unique. Plus tu prends soin de toi, plus ton jardin grandit. Pas de culpabilité. Pas de pression. Juste toi et ton jardin. Les fleurs fanent, elles ne meurent jamais. ◆ TON JARDIN VIVANT Chaque habitude est une fleur générée par un algorithme inspiré des spirales de Fibonacci. Ta fleur est unique — personne d'autre n'a la même. Plus ta série grandit, plus ta fleur s'épanouit. ◆ CHAQUE HABITUDE A SA MÉLODIE Un son de kalimba accompagne chaque geste. Ton jardin compose sa propre musique au fil de tes rituels. 7 univers sonores à explorer. ◆ ZÉRO CULPABILITÉ Tu as raté un jour ? Ta fleur fane doucement, mais elle t'attend. Pas de streak cassé. Pas de punition. Juste une fleur patiente. ◆ RÉCOLTE TON ÉVOLUTION À chaque étape (J14, J30, J66), prends du recul. Compare tes photos. Écris-toi une lettre. Regarde le chemin parcouru. ◆ WIDGET SUR TON ÉCRAN Ton jardin vit sur ton écran d'accueil. Un coup d'œil pour voir tes habitudes du jour. Un tap pour les compléter. ◆ RÉSEAU RACINAIRE Découvre les liens cachés entre tes habitudes. Quand tu médites, tu lis plus. Ton jardin te connaît mieux que tu ne te connais. ◆ 100% PRIVÉ Tes données restent sur ton téléphone. Pas de compte. Pas de serveur. Pas de tracking. Ton jardin, ton sanctuaire. ◆ SPIRA PRO : ∙ Graines illimitées ∙ Tous les sons et thèmes ∙ Éclipse — protège ta série ∙ Récoltes, lettre à soi, bilan émotionnel Conditions d'utilisation : https://sweet-interest-d37.notion.site/Spira-Conditions-d-utilisation-335b4b0d6b6180f2a7bbc61140370db3 Politique de confidentialité : https://sweet-interest-d37.notion.site/Spira-Politique-de-confidentialit-335b4b0d6b61801888bef8517604bf2b

6756538804.name: Rox: Chronic Illness Care
6756538804.description: Rox is the AI companion for people living with POTS, ME/CFS, Fibromyalgia, Long COVID, Endometriosis, EDS, Lupus, and other chronic invisible illness. Living with chronic illness means being told everything looks fine when nothing feels fine. Being handed a diagnosis and no map. Being your own researcher, advocate, and pattern-spotter, all while exhausted. Rox is built for the community that has been failed too many times by systems not designed for them. WHAT MAKES ROX DIFFERENT Rox connects with Oura, Apple Watch, and Garmin. It reads your sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, and activity data alongside how you actually feel. Rox remembers you. The longer you use it, the more it understands your baseline, your patterns, your triggers, and what a normal day looks like versus a flare. Rox is there at 2 AM. When your symptoms don't make sense, when your doctor said everything looks fine, when you need to talk it through. No judgment, no toxic positivity, no "have you tried yoga." HOW ROX HELPS Track symptoms, flares, and recovery in your own words Log medications, treatments, and dose changes See how sleep, stress, and activity affect your body Practice spoon-based energy pacing Walk into appointments with organized health summaries Remember what happened weeks or months ago Spot patterns your daily log can't show on its own BUILT FOR YOUR CONDITION POTS and dysautonomia Fibromyalgia ME/CFS and chronic fatigue Long COVID Endometriosis EDS and hypermobility Lupus and autoimmune conditions Chronic pain and migraine Hormonal and thyroid conditions Undiagnosed chronic illness ASK ROX ANYTHING "Why have I been feeling worse this week?" "What changed before my last flare?" "Is my sleep affecting my symptoms?" "What should I bring up with my next doctor visit?" "Am I actually improving over the last month?" "What patterns am I missing?" MORE THAN A SYMPTOM LOG Chronic illness is not just about symptoms. It affects work, relationships, energy, and every decision you make in a day. Rox learns your health history, your daily reality, and your priorities. The support you get reflects what is actually happening in your life, not just what your last log entry said. The more you use Rox, the clearer your picture becomes. PRIVATE & SECURE Your health data stay yours. We take privacy seriously. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6763717059.name: 病历管家：AI拍照识别&指标趋势&个人家庭健康档案&电子病历
6763717059.trackName: 病历管家：AI拍照识别&指标趋势&个人家庭健康档案&电子病历
6763717059.description: 一款专业的，智能的病历管理，用药提醒，身体指标记录管理工具。 为了个人隐私考虑，病历和用药数据只存在本地设备，我们不会上传用户的数据，你可以把数据同步到苹果的iCloud，更换手机也不用担心数据丢失。 app核心功能大致如下： 1.支持绝大多数国家医院和体检机构所有不同类型医疗图片和体检报告（PDF）识别。 2.智能用药吃药提醒管理（支持处方单和药盒识别并自动加入药品管理）及闹钟闹铃通知多重提醒。 3.支持药品库存管理，库存不足，即将过期，已过期，一目了然，及时提醒。 4.吃药和待办支持桌面小组件，更方便吃药用药和待办提醒及打卡管理。 5.支持iCloud同步，数据永久存储，永不丢失，更换手机也不用担心。 6.支持批量上传识别图片，AI识别准确率高达99.9%，特殊医学符号如↑↓Δ都能精准解读，印章、折痕、手写备注也不再是障碍。 7.信息一目了然，关键信息，精准补抓识别，异常指标一键收藏，指标数据图表趋势一目了然。 8.报告永久保存，原图高清留档。 9.所有报告自动按时间线，按病人名称归档排列，波动曲线直观显示指标变化。 10.支持报告内容全文搜索，查找比纸质快10倍。 11.重要信息随时记录，一键导出整理治疗过程。 12.自动归类整理，省时又省心。 13.同一指标多次检查自动聚合对比（如血常规、肝功能等）。 14.根据疾病类型智能归纳用药记录、检查报告、治疗节点。 15.历史趋势查看每年看医生次数，按年份月份，按用户查询。 16.血压，血糖，血脂，心率，尿酸，血氧饱和度，体温，体重，身体不适，喂药，饮食，大小便，喂奶，备忘录等各种记录&图表趋势可视化。 17.自定义记录各种你想记录的任何指标&图表趋势可视化。 18.批量上传数量无限制，分析时间更快。 19.支持报告的排序和报告的合并。 20.支持相同指标不同名称的合并。 21.支持自定义健康指标数据的记录，你想要记录的都可以记录&趋势图表查看。 22.支持闹钟提醒吃药和待办。 更多贴心的功能等你来体验。 非常重要：本应用不提供任何医疗建议。所有内容仅供参考，不应被视为专业医疗意见。如有健康问题，请咨询专业医生或医疗机构。 订阅服务 部分功能可能需要订阅后使用。 付款将在确认购买时从您的 Apple ID 账户中扣除； 订阅将自动续费，除非您在当前订阅周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续费； 系统将在当前订阅周期结束前 24 小时内从您的账户收取续费费用； 用户可以在购买后前往 Apple ID 账户设置中管理或关闭订阅； 如提供免费试用，用户在试用期内购买订阅后，未使用的试用时间将自动失效。 https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6670213512.name: XP4N
6670213512.description: Based on the legendary XPAN with its unique cinematic panoramic 65x24 images, XP4N turns any scene into a movie set; every shot into a movie still. Shoot in the amazing 65:24 cinematic aspect ratio Simulate 8 distinct film types (some inspired by popular film types, such as Cinestill 800T) NO ADS, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS, NO IN-APP-PURCHASES! Use all available lenses Haptic and visual feedback when taking pictures Use volume up key as shutter button EV compensation by swiping Access to the high-resolution sensor (if available and enabled in settings) Option to save as lossless HEIF files Saves EXIF and GPS data in photos This app is designed to simulate the cinematic qualities of the XPAN, including emulation of 8 distinct film stocks that are often paired with this camera: NIGHT MODE Based on the Cinestill 800T film character with its moody teal cast and signature "halation" (red halos) around bright spots in the image. BALANCED MODE Inspired by Vision3 250D film stock, with its versatile personality and typical Hollywood-style color and contrast curves. DAYLIGHT MODE Based on the popular Portra 400 film; soft and warm hues and moderate contrast profile. Great for skin tones and dreamy landscapes. GRITTY MODE Inspired by the Lomography Metropolis film, which adds a "bleached" look that is reminiscent of gritty 90s movies. BLACK & WHITE MODES Following the characteristics black & white films, one mode offers a punchy and contrasty B&W style, while the other is soft and dreamy. NEON NIGHT (NEW) Enhances bright spots in night photos and adds vibrant, saturated glows for a "cyberpunk" vibe ETHEREAL (NEW) Classic soft focus mode, without the need to put grease on your lens! XP4N is consciously made to be the ultimate one-trick-pony. A point and shoot camera with only a single button: the shutter button. The internal image processing engine does the rest, based on your preferred film mode setting. (so don't expect deep camera controls... ;-). The resulting images are carefully tuned to have the pleasant silky quality of film and to get away from the oversharpened, hyper-punchy look typical of today's digital cameras.

6746082061.name: Corpán
6746082061.description: PURE LEARNING. Respectful, elegant, ad-free language study from a small independent team. Corpán is the continuous evolution of language learning. OUR PRINCIPLES Private. No accounts, no tracking, no data collection. Your study stays on your device. Offline. Your sentence library works without a network. Audio works offline too if you have offline voices installed. Travel, fly, study off-grid. Quiet. No ads. No nagging notifications. Curated. Every sentence is hand-picked. Phrases real people actually say, weighted A1–B2 for daily life, travel, and work. Yours. Set your native language and study from your perspective, not "from English." MANY WAYS TO STUDY, ALL IN ONE APP Phrase book. Tap any sentence to hear it spoken in clear native voices. Filter by topic and CEFR level. Audiobooks. Read full books in your target language with sentence-by-sentence narration and instant translation. Free and premium titles. Pronunciation Coach. Get pronunciation feedback from offline speech-to-text models running entirely on your device. World Radio. Tune in to live stations from anywhere on the planet — true native streaming, lock-screen controls, background playback. Games. Recognize Chinese characters with Hanzipan. Run, jump, and learn in 3D with Hover Runner. And new experiences ship all the time — delivered through Packs, our modular system for adding games, books, readers, and learning modes without bloating the core app. Learn many languages at once, or focus on just one. Switch your primary language any time. Currently practiced in over 50 languages: Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Cantonese (Traditional, Hong Kong), Catalan, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Gujarati, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Kannada, Korean, Lithuanian, Malay, Marathi, Nepali, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Punjabi (Gurmukhi), Punjabi (Shahmukhi), Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, and Vietnamese. The interface, onboarding, and settings are fully localized in every supported language. BUILD WITH US Corpán is open at the edges. Our Packs SDK lets creators build their own language-learning experiences — powered by the same curated corpus, native TTS, and native streaming — and ship them inside Corpán. Join the small team building the language-learning app we always wanted. Start learning with Corpán today. — Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ — Privacy Policy: https://encorpora.io/privacy

6761720212.trackName: 甜蜜記分 - 情侶互評積分，讓愛更甜蜜
6761720212.description: 甜蜜記分是一款專為情侶設計的趣味積分 App，讓你用輕鬆有趣的方式記錄彼此的甜蜜與成長。 買斷制, 無廣告, 無訂閱 一次購買，所有功能永久解鎖。沒有廣告打擾，沒有每月扣款，你的甜蜜時光不被中斷。 [核心功能] 甜蜜加分：另一半做了貼心的事？立刻加分！煮飯、傳訊息、送驚喜禮物，每一個甜蜜的舉動都值得被記錄 獎勵兌換：累積足夠的點數，就能兌換想要的獎勵，像是選餐廳吃大餐、打遊戲免罵、一整天約會，由你們決定！ 扣分提醒：已讀不回、忘記紀念日、遲到？適當的小懲罰讓感情更認真 愛情溫度計：根據總積分顯示你們的甜蜜等級，從「冷戰中」到「熱戀爆表」 [貼心設計] 依性別提供不同的預設項目，開箱即用 自由新增、編輯加分/扣分項目和獎勵 每週統計一目了然：加分次數、獲得點數、最常做的甜蜜事 紀念日倒數，記住每一個重要的日子 密碼鎖保護，防止另一半偷看 完成動畫 + 音效回饋，每次加分都超有成就感 [多裝置同步] 支援 iCloud 自動同步，手機平板資料不遺失 [多語言支援] 繁體中文、簡體中文、English、日本語、한국어 [純淨體驗] 買斷制，一次購買永久使用，不怕每月扣款 零廣告，使用過程完全不受干擾 無內購陷阱，所有功能一次到手 用甜蜜記分，把愛情經營成一場有趣的遊戲吧！

6755445627.name: BodyMorpher: AI饮食身材预测
6755445627.description: 很多人减肥时最大的困惑，不是不知道「要少吃」，而是看不见「少吃的意义在哪里」。一张表格、一串数字，很难真正让人感受到今天的选择和三十天后的身材之间有什么关系。BodyMorpher想解决的就是这件事。 打开应用，拍下你正在吃或刚吃完的这顿饭。AI会在几秒内识别出食物的种类、热量，以及蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂肪的比例，连外卖、餐厅菜肴和家常菜都能识别。这个过程不需要手动查数据库，也不需要扫条形码——拍照就够了，识别完就能知道这顿饭的营养全貌。 识别完成后，BodyMorpher会根据你的体型和近期饮食数据，在你自己的3D虚拟分身上呈现：如果你继续这样吃，7天后、30天后、90天后的身材大概会是什么样子。这个「未来分身」是用你本人的照片生成的，不是套用某个通用模板，而是真正属于你自己的身材预测。吃得好的那几天，你看得到积累的效果；某顿放纵之后，你也能直观感受到它对目标的影响。这种可视化的反馈，是光靠数字做不到的事情。 当减肥的动力不再只是靠意志力撑着，而是每天都能对着一个具体的画面说「我要变成这样」——这件事就变得好坚持多了。很多用户反馈，开始用BodyMorpher之后，不是因为「管住了自己」，而是因为「终于能看到方向」，减脂才真正持续了下来。 应用免费下载，基础功能包括每日拍照记录、热量汇总、三餐营养统计和体重打卡。升级到BodyMorpher Pro之后，可以解锁完整的3D身材模拟与多时间段变化对比、详细的宏量营养素分析报告、个性化饮食建议，以及无限的历史记录查询。Pro还支持设定不同目标——减脂、增肌或体重维持——让分析更贴合你的实际需求，不管你是要瘦、要练还是要保持，都能找到对应的参考数据。 每天三张照片，每张照片背后是一个关于「今天吃的这顿饭会把你带向哪里」的答案。 以上身材预测结果基于饮食数据的算法模拟，仅供参考，不代表医疗建议或诊断意见。如有具体健康、营养或体重管理方面的需求，请咨询专业医生或注册营养师。 用户协议（EULA）：https://bodymorpher.site/eula 隐私政策：https://bodymorpher.site/privacy 服务条款：https://bodymorpher.site/terms

6762970117.name: 限行通
6762970117.description: 限行通是一款面向中国车主的限行查询与出行提醒应用，帮助你更快判断今天和明天能不能开、哪些尾号受限、当前城市天气如何。 你可以： 查看当前城市当日与次日的限行尾号 用可切换日期的限行日历查看整月规则 添加并管理多辆车，切换默认车辆 按城市查看天气，辅助通勤和出行判断 开启限行提醒，支持默认车辆或所有车辆汇总提醒 在设置中自定义提醒时段与提醒条件 限行通强调打开即看和本地优先体验。常用城市、车辆信息与提醒设置保存在设备本地，无需注册账号。 无论是日常通勤、临时换城还是提前规划明天出行，限行通都能帮你更快做决定。 限行信息仅供出行参考，不代表政府部门或执法结论；临时交通管制、道路现场标志及当地交管部门最新通告优先。

6764795413.name: 吃药管家：拍照AI识别药盒&处方单&智能吃药提醒&库存管理
6764795413.trackName: 吃药管家：拍照AI识别药盒&处方单&智能吃药提醒&库存管理
6764795413.description: 一款专业的拍照AI识别药盒&处方单的智能提醒&打卡及库存管理工具 核心功能如下： 1.拍照处方单或药盒AI识别药品信息自动录入 2.打卡日历，每一天吃药信息一目了然 3.通过闹钟提醒吃药，再也不会忘记，错过吃药时间 4.智能库存管理，库存不足，即将过期，已过期，自动减少库存 5.支持记录血压，血糖，血脂，心率，尿酸，血氧饱和度，体温，体重，身体不适，喂药，饮食，大小便，喂奶，备忘录等各种记录&图表趋势可视化 6.自定义记录各种你想记录的任何指标&图表趋势可视化 7.iCloud同步数据，数据导入导出，更换手机也不用担心数据丢失 8.灵活的吃药周期，每一天，每几天，吃几天停几天都支持 9.桌面小组件吃药打卡，待办事项一目了然 10.各种身体健康指标数据趋势图表一目了然 更多细微贴心功能等你来使用 非常重要：本应用不提供任何医疗建议。所有内容仅供参考，不应被视为专业医疗意见。如有健康问题，请咨询专业医生或医疗机构。 订阅服务 部分功能可能需要订阅后使用。 付款将在确认购买时从您的 Apple ID 账户中扣除； 订阅将自动续费，除非您在当前订阅周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续费； 系统将在当前订阅周期结束前 24 小时内从您的账户收取续费费用； 用户可以在购买后前往 Apple ID 账户设置中管理或关闭订阅； 如提供免费试用，用户在试用期内购买订阅后，未使用的试用时间将自动失效。 https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6757759933.name: DuoScene 双摄相机·前后双拍
6757759933.trackName: DuoScene 双摄相机·前后双拍
6757759933.description: 用前后摄同时拍，一次记录你看到的画面，也记录你的反应。 DuoScene 是一款轻量级双摄相机，支持前后摄像头同时录制，也可一次拍摄自动生成竖版和横版两个版本。适用于 Vlog、探店、旅行、Reaction、教程、口播和日常记录。 无需重复拍摄，无需反复导出，拍完即可保存和发布。 核心功能 前后摄同时录制，一次记录现场画面和人物反应 从系统相册导入已有视频，边看边录下实时反应，可开关素材原声 使用图片作为主画面，录制前可缩放并移动构图 支持画中画、上下分屏、对角布局等多种双摄构图 一次拍摄自动生成 9:16 和 16:9 两个版本 支持单镜或双镜照片与 Live Photo 内置提词器，适合口播、教程和产品介绍 支持视频防抖，让手持拍摄更稳定 将完成的照片和视频保存到系统相册 导出异常时尽量保留原始素材，减少拍摄结果丢失 适合谁 想同时记录人物反应和现场画面的用户 需要快速制作横版和竖版内容的创作者 经常拍摄 Vlog、探店、旅行、Reaction 或教程的用户 希望少剪辑、拍完就能发布的轻创作用户 免费使用与 Pro 权益 DuoScene 支持全功能体验，新用户可获得 5 次无水印导出机会。 无水印导出次数用完后，你仍然可以继续使用核心拍摄功能。如需持续导出无水印视频，可以选择订阅或一次性买断 Pro。 使用说明 前后双摄能力依赖支持 MultiCam 的 iPhone 设备 不同设备支持的分辨率、帧率和防抖能力可能不同 DuoScene 专注于拍摄与快速输出，不提供复杂时间线剪辑、音乐、贴纸或云同步功能 订阅与买断 DuoScene 提供订阅和一次性买断选项，具体价格以 App Store 页面显示为准。 订阅将在当前周期结束前 24 小时内自动续费，可随时在 Apple ID 账户设置中取消。取消后，权益将在当前订阅周期结束时失效。 使用条款： https://www.byrobin.app/terms/duoscene 隐私政策： https://www.byrobin.app/privacy/duoscene

6760534918.name: KeepScreenON
6760534918.description: KeepScreenOn prevents your screen from turning off while you read, watch, or follow instructions on a website. Perfect for cooking, tutorials, workouts, or long articles – your screen stays active as long as you need it. How it works: Open a website in Safari Tap the Share button Select “KeepScreenOn” Features: Keeps your screen awake while viewing web content Simple and fast Share Extension integration Save your favorite pages for quick access View your browsing history inside the app Clean and minimal interface Notes: If notifications are enabled, you can reopen the app directly from the notification after sharing a page Otherwise, simply open the app manually after using the Share menu No account required. No tracking. Your data stays on your device.

6745748800.name: 爱图剪拼
6745748800.description: 「爱图剪拼」是一款基于本地 AI 打造的智能抠图与图像合成工具。无需注册、无需上传，离线运行，只需轻点几下，就能完成从抠图、修改图片风格、拼图到导出分享。专为 macOS、iPad 和 iPhone 设计。 功能特征： 一键智能抠图: 基于本地 CoreML 和本地AI模型，自动识别图片，一键抠图，一图多扣。 替换背景: 可以选择透明背景、任意颜色背景，或使用本地图片作为背景。 多图拼接合成: 支持将多张抠图拼接合成，调整各抠图的位置、大小、角度、遮挡层级，自由组合你想要的构图效果。 改变图片风格: 素描、油画、梵高星空、鎏金岁月、吉卜力... 10+种风格可选择, 可以对每个抠图分别使用，也可以对最终合成图使用。 图像编辑更自由: 对每张抠图结果提供旋转、缩放、移动等操作；支持手势控制与图层拖拽，操作直观便捷；针对macOS, iOS分别优化操作方式。 补光融合: 支持对合成图进行补光，可拖拽调整光源位置、颜色、范围、强度, 实时呈现效果，实现图片滤镜风格自由。 多尺寸导出: 对抠图后的结果图、合成图、补光图，多种导出尺寸可供选择，可用于电商、社交媒体、简历、头像等场景。 抠图导出SVG:支持将抠图结果导出为svg文件。 注重保障隐私安全: 完全离线操作，所有图像均在设备本地处理; 图片仅本地保存，手动分享才会外发。 无需高端硬件设备，普通Mac、iPhone,iPad亦可运行，享受AI的便捷。 无广告、无数据收集、无追踪，纯粹的生产力工具。 定价和解锁 免费： AI抠图无算力、次数、点数限制; 无限制对每个抠图进行平移/缩放/旋转操作； 无限制选择更换合成图的背景; 无限制按原尺寸导出抠图、合成图、补光图; 支持同时对不超过2张图进行抠图合成等操作； 一次性购买： 导出单张图的抠图结果; 转换图片风格; 付费订阅功能： 同时对多张图(数量仅受限于设备性能)进行抠图合成等操作； 自由调整补光效果; 多种尺寸自由选择导出抠图、合成图、补光图; 付款将从您的 App Store 帐户中扣除。 订阅功能除非在当前期限结束前 24 小时关闭，否则将自动续订。 在 App Store 设置中管理订阅。 隐私和购买条款 隐私政策：https://h53d.github.io/aiimg/policy.html 使用条款 (EULA)：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 「爱图剪拼」离线、本地、纯净, 使用 AI 抠图更简便，无需担心隐私风险。 有疑问或需要支持？请联系 danjian42@gmail.com。

6763665679.name: Shanghai Ultra
6763665679.description: Shanghai Ultra is mahjong solitaire the way it should be — clean, focused, and beautifully crafted. Match pairs of free tiles to clear the board. Simple to learn, endlessly satisfying to master. Every deal is guaranteed solvable, so the challenge is always fair. Choose from beautifully crafted traditionally inspired tiles or try the fun emoji based sets. Seven board layouts range from a quick 56-tile game to the full 186-tile Turtle. Rich felt-textured backgrounds and five colour themes set the mood. No ads. No interruptions. Just you and the tiles. FEATURES 7 board layouts: Quick, Dragon, Phoenix, Turtle, Fortress, Pyramid, and Cross Multiple tile styles from classic to playful Background themes with subtle felt texture Every deal is guaranteed solvable Score tracking with hints, shuffle, and timer Leaderboard with iCloud sync across devices Game Center support - Leaderboards, Achievements, and Challenges Take part in fun Global Daily Challenges with the Quick layout Light, dark, and system appearance modes Designed for iPhone, iPad, and Mac

6757080678.name: Calendery - 极简农历天气日历
6757080678.trackName: Calendery - 极简农历天气日历
6757080678.description: Calendery 是一款专为中国用户打造的现代化日历应用，它将传统的农历智慧与优雅的现代设计完美融合。无论是查看宜忌、规划假期，还是关注天气、记录重要日子，Calendery 都能为您提供最流畅的体验。 【核心功能】 深度农历集成 完整支持农历日期显示、干支纪年、生肖与节气。 每日黄历宜忌查询，传统择吉文化随手掌握。 智能法定节假日支持，自动标记“休”与“班”，调休安排一目了然。 精准天气服务 实时天气更新，支持全球城市查询。 未来 7 天详细预报，温度趋势图直观呈现。 冷暖色阶视觉反馈，穿衣出行早知道。 倒数日与纪念日 支持公历与农历重复（如：每年农历生日）。 记录重要时刻，不再错过任何生日、纪念日或最后期限。 支持置顶显示与自定义颜色标记。 丰富的小组件 (Widgets) 提供多种尺寸的桌面与锁屏小组件。 灵活配置：单看日历、关注天气，或是一个重要的倒数日。 支持 iOS 待机显示与 watchOS 智能叠放。 Apple Watch 完美适配 独立 Watch App，抬手即看日程与天气。 支持这就是表盘复杂功能，信息一览无余。 更多贴心特性 Siri 捷径：语音查询“今天农历多少”、“添加倒数日”，动口不动手。 iCloud 同步：iPhone、iPad 与 Apple Watch 数据自动同步，安全可靠。 隐私至上：无广告，不通过第三方服务器收集您的任何日历数据。 Calendery，让时间管理变得简单而优雅。

6764498347.name: 分贝测试仪 - 噪音检测
6764498347.trackName: 分贝测试仪 - 噪音检测
6764498347.description: 分贝测试仪是一款用于日常环境声音测量与记录的工具。你可以通过手机麦克风实时查看周围声音分贝，了解当前环境是安静、舒适、活跃、偏吵还是高噪音，并保存每次检测的关键数据。 无论是在家中、办公室、教室、宿舍、学习空间，还是在装修现场周边、设备运行环境中，你都可以用它快速记录声音变化，回看历史数据，并生成更清晰的检测资料。 只需一次购买，即可解锁当前版本提供的全部功能，包括检测历史、录音回放、现场拍照留档和 PDF 检测报告等实用工具。 主要功能： 实时分贝检测：显示当前环境声音分贝读数 频谱分析：观察低频、中频、高频声音变化 环境状态提示：判断安静、舒适、活跃、偏吵、高噪音等状态 检测统计：记录平均值、最低值、峰值和检测时长 检测历史：保存每次检测结果，方便回看和对比 录音回放：保存检测音频，便于复听当时环境 读数校准：可根据设备差异和参考声源调整偏移值 分贝场景参照：了解不同分贝对应的常见生活场景 现场拍照留档：拍摄现场画面并叠加时间、地点、经纬度和分贝数据 照片档案：在应用内查看、管理和分享已生成的现场记录图片 PDF 检测报告：基于检测数据生成报告，包含结论、数据表和分贝变化曲线 适合场景： 居家、办公室、教室、宿舍等环境音量检测 记录装修噪音、设备声音、临时噪音等情况 对比不同时间、不同地点的声音变化 记录现场环境，便于后续回看、整理和沟通 关注长时间高噪音环境下的听觉舒适度 温馨提示： 本应用依赖手机麦克风采集声音，不同设备型号、距离、遮挡、麦克风状态和环境条件都会影响读数。检测结果、现场照片和报告仅供日常参考、记录和沟通使用，不能替代经过校准的专业声级计，也不作为医学、法律或工业安全检测依据。

6762051415.name: 爱羊毛 - 推送+灵动岛=提醒不漏单
6762051415.trackName: 爱羊毛 - 推送+灵动岛=提醒不漏单
6762051415.description: 爱羊毛是一款专为 【记优惠、跟活动、算收益】 打造的本地记录工具 —— 【不注册、不上传】，【数据只存在你的 iPhone】，用得安心。 【它能帮你做什么？】 【今天有什么，一眼就知道】 首页 【六张状态摘要卡】 与筛选条配合，进行中、待开始、已过期、已完成、已取消一目了然，点卡即可切换筛选，再点一下回到「今天」；标题、备注、平台、参与要求、活动规则均可全文搜索；长按即可标记完成、取消或恢复、归档、复制成新活动或删除。重复活动按 【当天这一场】 展示，状态和时间更贴近真实日程。 【日历上，节奏看得见】 【月历与周时间轴】 任你切换，月历点选日期，当天活动集中呈现；圆点与列表色条对应平台色，截止与安排一目了然；下拉可刷新对齐数据。 【该省的省，该赚的记】 活动可填预估收益；真实到手在详情里 【半屏表单记账】，可填金额、可选备注与 【记账日】，单笔可独立删除。统计覆盖今日/本周/本月/本年，还有平台排行与月度趋势，并可按需筛选 —— 【柱状图柱子点开看该时段每笔收益】，活动概览的 【状态行与总数行】 也可点开看完整活动列表。金额随 【所选货币】 展示，【小数位可自定义】（修复日元、韩元、越南盾等无小数货币的显示）。 【重复规则一次设好】 支持每日、每周、每月、每年与自定义间隔；每月/每年还可按规则跨多日展示（表单内有说明）。列表与日历按天展开，详情可带当天上下文，编辑仍指向母活动；详情还会显示 【下一场开始时间】 与 【距离开始倒计时】，单次活动同样适用。 【提醒跟得上】 多条提醒、开始前/截止前等多种预设与自定义分钟，以及每天固定时刻等；配合 【系统本地通知】，回到 App 会整理提醒计划。【已取消】 的活动不再误响；单次活动在完成后的提醒行为也可按你的习惯调整。首页与日历活动行还有 【提醒状态小图示】，是否已登记一眼即知。 【桌面与锁屏也能扫一眼】 多种主屏幕小组件（今日进行中、今日活动、待开始、列表预览、数据概览、收益、一眼摘要、本年平台榜等，【概览大号支持六宫格】 含已过期 / 已完成 / 已取消）与锁屏小组件（系统版本符合时可用）。较新系统上，部分列表类小组件支持 【逐条点按】 进入对应活动。设置内还提供 【小组件使用指南】，含主屏 / 锁屏添加步骤与 FAQ。 【灵动岛与实时活动】（设备与系统支持时）可在设置里开关并调节 【提前多久开始展示】（1 至 480 分钟可调）；时间窗内多场活动可各自展示或轮换；也可在首页/日历对符合条件的活动长按，【手动挂上实时活动】。 【贴心小工具与细节】 活动表单可一键填入 【常用 App 链接】（支付、银行、电商等 scheme），或用 【扫码 / 相册识码】 自动填链；备注、要求、规则与活动链接 【长按可调出 iOS 原生菜单】，含「在对应 App 中打开」「在 Safari 中打开」「拷贝」「分享」；设置里还内置独立 【扫码工具】，二维码、条形码均可识别并一键复制 / 在应用内打开。 【长得顺眼、用得顺手】 多套主题色，浅色/深色/跟随系统，卡片毛玻璃风格；还可换 【多套主屏幕应用图标】。界面支持 【13 种显示语言与多种货币】，并可设置 【桌面角标策略】 与 【分享活动时是否包含收益】（默认关闭，保护金额隐私）。 【数据始终在你手里】 可 【导出全量备份】；导入时支持 【替换整库】 或 【仅追加合并】。【已完成 / 已过期 / 已取消】 可一键归档或单条归档，需要时在设置里 【随时恢复】。 【适合谁？】 常逛电商与外卖优惠、常跟银行与支付活动，想把羊毛记清楚、收益算明白，又希望 【数据留在本机】 的你。

6737737470.name: 英语探宝 English Quest
6737737470.description: English Quest 不是一个单纯让孩子点一点击屏幕的英语游戏。它的核心目标，是帮助孩子从“不愿开口”走向“愿意参与说英语”。 很多孩子不是完全听不懂英语，而是不愿说、不敢说、容易卡住，或者一有压力就回避。English Quest 的设计重点，是降低这种阻力，让孩子更愿意参与。 孩子会在图片、选择和分支路径组成的冒险中前进。每一次选择，都可以成为一次开口表达的机会。 3.0 核心更新： 语音模式：孩子可以通过说出选择来推动主要冒险流程，让“开口说”和“继续前进”直接连接。 触控模式：当孩子暂时不想说、年龄较小、环境不方便，或需要降低挫败感时，仍然可以顺畅使用。 Creator Mode：老师和家长可以快速创建自己的分支故事，用于家庭练习、课堂活动、一对一引导或小组口语任务。 自定义图片：可以直接拍照、从相册导入，或在图片编辑器中制作自己的选择图片。 图片编辑工具：支持图层、背景图片、叠加图片、智能去背景、绘画、形状、emoji 和文字。 自定义旁白：老师或家长可以为页面录制 narration，让孩子在熟悉的声音和个性化提示中练习。 English Quest 适合： 希望提升孩子英语口语参与度的家庭 想让课堂有更多开口机会的老师 需要一个可引导、可定制、低压力口语活动工具的成人 希望把教材主题、节日、动物、地点、人物或孩子兴趣变成英语表达任务的人 English Quest 的价值，不只是内容本身，而是把“图片 + 选择 + 声音 + 分支 + 成人引导 + 个性化内容”组合成一个更容易发生真实参与的系统。 如果你要找的不是一个只让孩子看一看、点一点的应用，而是一个帮助孩子愿意开口、参与表达、建立信心的工具，English Quest 3.0 就是为这个目标而设计的。

6765511365.name: 许愿24小时：倒计时你的愿望
6765511365.trackName: 许愿24小时：倒计时你的愿望
6765511365.description: 随时随地记录心愿，并且24小时见证，陪伴你实现愿望。 软件特色: 1.本机离线：心愿录像、海报和档案都保存在手机里，私密性好。 2.同一时间只进行一条心愿的见证，开始 24 小时计时，聚焦实现。 3.生成心愿海报，分享给朋友或者社交媒体。 4.愿望归纳，可以标记愿望状态，适合各种性格用户。 使用说明: 1.按步骤完成问卷测试，拍下自己的许愿视频；预览无误后保存，即从保存时刻起进入本轮 24 小时见证。 2.见证进行中从首页进入「当前愿望」查看剩余时间、回看本条许愿视频；需要时可于倒计时页终止本轮。 3.倒计时结束后，完成还愿手记即可结束这一轮；结束后才能在首页再次开启新的心愿。 4.相册权限仅在保存海报或视频到系统相册时使用；相机与麦克风仅用于录制心愿；本地存储安全放心。

6761343148.name: Trckify
6761343148.description: Plan. Track. Analyze. Share. Trckify pairs iPhone and Apple Watch recording with deep-dive Mac analysis. Visualize in 3D, share with friends as FIT, GPX, or a story. Buy once — iPhone, Apple Watch, and Mac included. No subscription. ROUTES & NAVIGATION — NEW Plan routes right in the app: road bike, trekking, gravel, MTB or on foot — with elevation profile and round-trip option Follow your route on the map: turn hints, off-route alerts, full-screen navigation Route library with best times — ride a route again and Trckify scores it automatically Share routes as GPX to your bike computer (Wahoo, Garmin & Co.), import GPX routes from anywhere Plan comfortably on the big Mac screen, then just grab your iPhone and ride — routes sync via iCloud SHARE A STORY Turn any session into a beautiful story for Instagram, WhatsApp, or your group chat. Pick a photo, your own route line, or a minimal print-style layout — four designs to choose from, rendered right on your device. Save to Photos or share via the iOS share sheet. RECORD ON IPHONE & APPLE WATCH One-tap start, live speed, distance, elevation, duration Real-time heart rate from Apple Watch, Bluetooth straps — or AirPods Steps and live cadence for hiking and running Standalone Watch mode — leave your phone at home Live Activity with lock-screen controls Automatic GPS fallback between Watch and iPhone ROWING — ON THE WATER & INDOOR Live stroke rate (SPM) and smoothed 500 m pace in real time Boat-mount landscape layout NEW: Pair your Concept2 PM5 over Bluetooth — live pace, power, splits and intervals from the erg Program workouts right from the app: distance, time, intervals CONCEPT2 LOGBOOK & STRAVA Connect your Concept2 account and sync indoor workouts with splits and heart rate to the Logbook Upload outdoor and indoor activities to Strava Manually, or automatically after every session EXPLORE YOUR TRACKS Interactive 3D terrain map with pan, zoom, rotate, tilt Four color modes: Speed, Altitude, Progress, Heatmap Detailed statistics per track and section Touch-to-inspect elevation profile with time and position Place custom markers, share map screenshots MULTI-SPORT Rowing, Indoor Rowing, Skiing, Snowboarding, Hiking, Running, Cycling, Cross-Country Skiing. Automatic lift detection for snow sports. EXPORT Convert GPX or Slopes files to FIT for Strava, Garmin Connect, Komoot, Zwift, TrainingPeaks and other platforms Export as GPX for universal compatibility High-resolution map screenshots with custom markers Designed for iOS 17+ · Apple Watch · Mac. PRIVACY Your tracks live on your device and sync only through your personal iCloud account. Uploads to Strava or Concept2 happen only when you connect those services — at your request. Route planning sends only your chosen waypoints to our routing server — anonymously, without an account, and they are not stored. No analytics, no advertising, no telemetry.

6755662656.name: Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM)
6755662656.description: You could call this a coincidence but the acronym of the Grand Egyptian Museum is an apt title for the GEM, which is truly one! The sprawling museum has the largest indoor space in the world - a whopping five hundred thousand square meters! And needless to say, the museum is full of wonderful gems of antiquity. But what makes a visit a remarkable experience is the grand vision with which the whole museum has been envisaged from start to finish. As you enter its gates a grand bottomless obelisk ushers you into the pyramid-shaped entrance that is filled with cartouches of ancient Egyptian kings and queens - as if they have all joined hands to give you a warm welcome! Now you have truly entered the museum and are standing stupefied at the Grand Hall because before you is a colossal 82-ton statue of Ramesses that has been raised to its feet in a remarkable act of restoration. The pharaoh stands with grace as well as a steely resolve because drilled into him and also into the ground is an extended backbone made of iron that helps him stand upright. By his side are the twin statues of a king and queen that were pulled out from the sea after staying drowned for thousands of years in the Ptolemaic city of Heracleion just off the coast of Alexandria. They are positioned strategically pointing the way to the Grand Staircase. This stairway is like a Jacob’s ladder but it does not lead to heaven but somewhere close - an absolutely stunning mesmerising breathtaking view of the pyramids that you can see from the air-conditioned corridor of the museum as opposed to being baked in the desert sun. There are stunning statues of kings and queens on either side of the Grand Staircase stand silent sentinels to this ultimate collection but never quite prepare you for what is ahead n rest assured every step brings us closer to the ultimate destination. In fact, it is not one but three. Straight ahead is a picture-perfect view of the pyramids a photo click that is worth a billion bucks! To the left, the main collection arranged chronologically and thematically traces the history of Egyptian religion, gods and people for five millennia. Of the thousands of artefacts held here, most people come to see the five thousand that are truly special because they come straight from Tutankhamun’s tomb in the Valley of Kings. This includes the dead boy king’s famous golden mask crafted from solid gold! To see them turn right at the end of the Grand Staircase. You can relive the delight of Howard Carter as he made his breakthrough discovery. When he flashed his lights into the pea-sized hole at the entrance to King Tut’s tomb he saw that all that flittered was gold indeed. And likewise .. With this app, we hope to shine some light on the wonderful collection that awaits you at the Grand Egyptian Museum! Do take your headphones with you as the buddy needs your earbuds!

You can relive the delight of Howard Carter as he made his breakthrough discovery. When he flashed his lights into the pea-sized hole at the entrance to King Tut’s tomb he saw that all that flittered was gold indeed. And likewise .. With this app, we hope to shine some light on the wonderful collection that awaits you at the Grand Egyptian Museum! Do take your headphones with you as the buddy needs your earbuds!

6759991476.name: Weather Cafe
6759991476.description: Weather Cafe — Get your forecast and a fresh outlook! Step inside. The rain is tapping on the window, the espresso is brewing, and your forecast is already on the table. Weather Cafe. Pull up a chair. Your forecast is served. Hourly and daily forecasts, with weather alerts as they happen. Just what you need, nothing you don't. No ads! Just a clock, a cat, and a coffee. Weather Cafe is a weather app that actually feels like somewhere you want to be. Most weather apps feel like staring at a spreadsheet and a bunch of ads. So many numbers and walls of menus and icons. Weather Cafe takes a different approach entirely. It takes you somewhere warm. It presents just the next 3 hours of weather conditions. Just what you need if you are going outside, after your coffee. One swipe also gives you the next 5 days high and low temps, and chance of rain or snow. Weather Cafe also displays Weather Alerts for your location. Keep swiping right on the weather and you get Sunrise/Moonrise local times, and Moon Phase. UV index and Air Pressure trends. Even your outlook for stars to be out at night! A Café That Reacts to the World Outside The moment you open Weather Cafe, the scene outside the window comes alive. Beautiful café backgrounds shift with real conditions — a sun-drenched garden on a clear afternoon, a safe candlelit interior when storms roll in, the moon and stars at night, a sunny golden haze during a warm afternoon. At a glance you get current conditions, the next few hours, and tomorrow's outlook. Swipe the forecast card to reveal a 5-day view — daily highs and lows, weather icons, and rain chance percentages so you know whether to plan outdoor activities. The layout is clean, the type is sharp, and the glass card floats above the scene without hiding it. Severe Weather, Front and Center When alerts are issued for your area — winter storms, high winds, extreme heat — Weather Cafe puts them right in front of you with a single tap to read the full official bulletin. If something serious is happening outside, you'll know the moment you open the app. The Whole World is Your Café Search for any city on the planet and Weather Cafe transforms instantly — conditions, backgrounds, and local time all update to match that location. Whether you're checking the weather in Tokyo before a flight, seeing what's happening in London for a call, or just curious what it's like in New York City right now, the café shifts to meet you there. A Glass Clock You never know you needed this until you see it! A beautifully crafted glass clock face floats on the screen, draggable to top or bottom. Minimalist style with silver hour and minute hands, and a red seconds hand steadily rounding the dial. Tap it to switch between analog and digital. It always shows the local time for whichever city you're viewing, so you're never doing timezone math in your head again. Drag it around the cafe scene just for fun to watch the glass lens effect on the background! Weather Cafe. Pull up a chair. Your forecast is ready. Powered by Apple WeatherKit. Real-time forecasts, hourly conditions, severe weather alerts, and worldwide city search. Internet connection needed for weather data and city search.

Weather Cafe takes a different approach entirely. It takes you somewhere warm. It presents just the next 3 hours of weather conditions. Just what you need if you are going outside, after your coffee. One swipe also gives you the next 5 days high and low temps, and chance of rain or snow. Weather Cafe also displays Weather Alerts for your location. Keep swiping right on the weather and you get Sunrise/Moonrise local times, and Moon Phase. UV index and Air Pressure trends. Even your outlook for stars to be out at night! A Café That Reacts to the World Outside The moment you open Weather Cafe, the scene outside the window comes alive. Beautiful café backgrounds shift with real conditions — a sun-drenched garden on a clear afternoon, a safe candlelit interior when storms roll in, the moon and stars at night, a sunny golden haze during a warm afternoon. At a glance you get current conditions, the next few hours, and tomorrow's outlook. Swipe the forecast card to reveal a 5-day view — daily highs and lows, weather icons, and rain chance percentages so you know whether to plan outdoor activities. The layout is clean, the type is sharp, and the glass card floats above the scene without hiding it. Severe Weather, Front and Center When alerts are issued for your area — winter storms, high winds, extreme heat — Weather Cafe puts them right in front of you with a single tap to read the full official bulletin. If something serious is happening outside, you'll know the moment you open the app. The Whole World is Your Café Search for any city on the planet and Weather Cafe transforms instantly — conditions, backgrounds, and local time all update to match that location. Whether you're checking the weather in Tokyo before a flight, seeing what's happening in London for a call, or just curious what it's like in New York City right now, the café shifts to meet you there. A Glass Clock You never know you needed this until you see it! A beautifully crafted glass clock face floats on the screen, draggable to top or bottom. Minimalist style with silver hour and minute hands, and a red seconds hand steadily rounding the dial. Tap it to switch between analog and digital. It always shows the local time for whichever city you're viewing, so you're never doing timezone math in your head again. Drag it around the cafe scene just for fun to watch the glass lens effect on the background! Weather Cafe. Pull up a chair. Your forecast is ready. Powered by Apple WeatherKit. Real-time forecasts, hourly conditions, severe weather alerts, and worldwide city search. Internet connection needed for weather data and city search.

6762535098.name: Blackout Mode
6762535098.description: You know that person. Phone blazing in a dark cinema. Ringtone cutting through a piano concerto. Flash firing at a concert. Don't be that person. Blackout is a single-tap utility that does three things the moment you activate it: Dims down your screen brightness, silences your volume to zero, and locks your camera flash permanently off within the in-app camera. No settings to dig through. No toggles to remember. Just tap, and disappear into the dark. What Blackout does: Screen blackout. No blinding brightness in the dark, no light pollution for the people around you. Volume zero. Drops to silent instantly. No surprise notifications, no accidental sounds, no embarrassing ringtones mid-performance. Flash locked off. Built-in camera keeps flash disabled permanently. Shoot the moment freely without blinding anyone around you. Made for: Concerts, live music, classical performances, theatres, cinemas, comedy shows, sports events, opera, ballet, lectures, religious services, anywhere you need to be invisible. One tap. That's it.

6753640753.name: Enflo - Visual Focus Timer
6753640753.description: See your focus. Feel your flow. enflo is a focus timer that visualizes your concentration as moving particles. Whether you're studying, working, or reading, watch your focus take shape through the particles on your screen — not just minutes on a clock. Leave it alone, and the particles slowly scatter. Start a session, and they hold their form. Complete your timer, and they regather based on the quality of your focus. Touch and drag to interact, and build your own rhythm of flow. Built for: Students and learners who want to understand their focus patterns Professionals pursuing deep work and real productivity Anyone whose attention feels scattered — and wants to see it rebuild People with ADHD who benefit from visual feedback on concentration Features: Particle visualization — see your focus state come alive Touch & drag — interact with particles as you work 20–90 minute timer with smooth scroll selection Track focus time by activity: study, work, reading, and more Personalized session recommendations based on your history and routine Weekly and monthly flow pattern insights Build lasting focus habits with consistent daily sessions Light & dark themes with customizable particle styles Download enflo and experience your flow, one session at a time. Subscription Required enflo requires a paid subscription or one-time purchase to access all features. Available Plans: Monthly Subscription Yearly Subscription Lifetime Access (one-time purchase) Pricing varies by region and is displayed in the App Store at the time of purchase. 6747786453.name: 如故
6747786453.description: 【如故】—— 您的智能人情往来管家 在快节奏的现代生活中，您是否也曾有过这样的烦恼？ 忘记了上次和重要朋友是什么时候联系的？ 想不起某位亲戚的人情往来，下次见面不知如何应对？ 感觉总是在单方面维系关系，付出与回报不成正比？ 重要的纪念日、生日、人情账目，总是混淆不清？ 别担心，【如故】专为解决这些"中国式"社交难题而生。我们相信，真正的人脉不在于数量，而在于质量和温度。 核心功能 1. 人情往来全记录 交往记录: 轻松记录与每位联系人的互动——无论是日常问候、深度长谈，还是工作协作。 主动性分析: 标记每次互动由谁发起（"我联系"或"TA联系"），直观了解关系互动的主动与被动。 智能分类: 将人脉按"关系密切"、"关系一般"、"关系普通"进行分层，管理更高效。 2. 人情账目清晰管 金钱往来: 无论是"我欠人情"还是"人情有余"，红绿蓝三色标记，让每一笔人情账都一目了然。 礼物记录: 记录收送礼物的价值与情意，为未来回礼提供参考，让您的人情往来有理有节。 分类统计: 按不同联系人、不同事件类型查看账目，告别糊涂账。 3. 智能提醒不缺席 关系维护提醒: 根据您设定的关系等级（如"密切关系"每两周，"一般关系"每月），【如故】会生成每周联系提醒，帮您规划社交，让重要关系永不降温。 重要事件备忘: 生日、纪念日、约定事项，提前设置提醒，不再错过任何一个重要时刻。 4. 关系健康度分析 关系象限: 独创的关系健康度分析模型，通过交往频率和主动性分析，将您的关系定位在"健康维系"、"重点关注"、"失衡预警"、"长期流失"四个象限中，帮您及时调整社交策略。 数据洞察: 查看与单个联系人的互动历史和趋势，深入了解关系动态，避免单方面付出。 【如故】适合谁？ 职场人士: 管理商务人脉，不错过任何合作机会。 家庭CFO: 打理家庭内部、亲戚之间的人情账目。 社交达人: 系统化管理人脉圈，让社交更高效。 重情重义的你: 珍惜每一份情谊，希望用心经营。 立即下载【如故】，告别社交焦虑，让人情往来回归本真。 我们期待与您一起，重拾那些"一见如故"的美好。

6605936418.name: AstroConnexions for iPhone
6605936418.description: AstroConnexions for the iPhone has a unique and powerful design that makes astrological charting a breeze. For beginner and professional alike. Explore the world of astrology! It's never been easier. Designed for iPhone, iOS 17+. ++ Dedicated website (astroconnexions.com) with searchable Knowledge Base. Articles for beginners, support, FAQ, etc. ++ Charts: Natal charts, incl horary, historical etc Solar and Lunar Returns – with relocation and/or precession-correction Transits. Transit relocation. Secondary progressions (by Naibod RA or Long, or Quotidian. Progress MC by Solar Arc in long) Solar Arc directions (by Naibod RA or Long) Synastry – relationship (comparison and composite) Antiscia Annual Profections Zodiacal Releasing from Spirit/Fortune Midpoint Trees Pre-Natal Syzygy" Eclipse – Solar and Lunar Ingress – all major planets, inc Solar and Lunar Gauquelin Sectors Sidereal with Ayanamsha settings Heliocentric Snapshots - transit, sec. prog, solar arcs. Solar Charts (Sun on Asc) Draconic Dark Mode supported. New, Edit, and Save charts. Extensive time zone and geographical database. Use a map to choose lat and long. Use your current location for all new charts. Old Style (OS) dates. New Style (NS) dates. LAT and LMT handled. Over 400 charts provided. Chart notes. Terms (Ptolemy/Egyptian/Chaldean) and triplicities, Decans. Graphs for Qualities and Elements Essential dignities and debilities. Day and Hour Lords. Full set of aspects, incl. bi-wheel aspect lines e.g. progressed to natal. Traditional table of aspects. Midpoint trees. Variety of ways to view aspects by table record. User definable aspect orbs. Moon’s applying aspects can be viewed individually on the chart. Antiscia aspects. Midpoint aspects (Uranian). Show midpoint aspect lines. House Systems: Placidus, Regio, Whole-sign, etc. House Numbers. Single and bi-wheels for transits, progressions, directions SR and LR. Bi-wheel for synastry. Chart animation: Go forward or backwards in time. Choose the step interval: 1-20. By Years, Months, Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds. Chart Listing: Easily find a chart including search ability. Order chart list by name or most recent created date. Filter by natal, horary comparison or composite charts. Filter by category. New, Edit categories. Aspects: Sort by orb, applying, planet, aspect Filter by All, Traditional, Traditional + traditional aspects, antiscia, Midpoint. Display user-selectable aspects lines, eg shown only hard aspects. Show aspect lines or not. Import Charts: Import charts from Solar Fire (Windows) via DropBox. Import Quick*Charts. Import SFcht charts. Export Charts via Dropbox. Batch export. Speculum: Long,, Lat, Declination, RA - Air print (inc aspects). Fixed stars: Prominent fixed stars are shown on the chart. Details available from fixed stars pop-up table. User-defined fixed star prominence. Charts can be coloured to individual taste, including fills. Many colour themes available too. True or mean Lunar Node Lots: Fortune Spirit Eros (Love) or Part of Marriage (Frawley) Necessity Courage Victory Nemesis All parts can be configured for day or night, or fixed POF and POS can be configured as per Frawley for SR and LR charts Moon’s aspects Opening the moons aspect table immediately removes all other aspect lines. This allows you to concentrate on the moon’s aspects Clicking on a record highlights that aspect line by removing all other aspects lines Provided Charts Hundreds of Charts (from Astro Data Bank) provided with Rodden rating. Arranged in groups such as Crime, Politics. Antiscia Antiscia aspects for all charts Bi-wheel Antiscia Charts from Natal Extra Points and asteroids Vertex, East Point, Lilith, Selena Ceres, Pallas, Juno, Vesta Makemake, Sedna, Haumea, Eris. Primary Directions + more ..... see web site https://astroconnexions.com

6447485150.name: NDTimer - Long Exposure
6447485150.description: NDTimer is the ultimate companion for photographers seeking precise control over their long-exposure shots! The app simplifies the complex task of calculating ND filter exposure times, allowing you to focus on capturing stunning images with ease. Key Features: Multi-Filter Support: Whether you're stacking multiple ND filters or using a combination of different types, NDTimer has you covered. Effortlessly calculate exposure times for various filters to achieve the perfect balance of light in your photos. Custom Filter Settings: Tailor the app to your unique setup with our customizable filter feature. Input the specific details of your custom filter, and let the app do the rest, ensuring accurate exposure calculations every time. Intuitive Countdown Timer: A sleek and easy-to-read countdown timer keeps you informed about the remaining exposure time. Watch as your long-exposure masterpiece unfolds before your lens. User-Friendly Interface: The user-friendly interface makes navigating through the app a breeze, ensuring a smooth experience for both amateur and professional photographers. Precision and Accuracy: NDTimer is developed to calculate the optimal long-exposure time allowing you to capture the perfect shot, every time.

6763732138.name: 印度式计算道
6763732138.description: 印度式计算道是一款让你只用 13 步,就能在脑中算出 99 × 99 以内任意两位数乘法的心算 App。 以从 6 级到 7 段循序晋升的「道场」方式,每天 5 秒、一道题,就能轻松坚持下来。 ■ 为什么要学「印度式」 在印度长期流传下来的乘法方法,与你在学校里学的竖式完全是另一种思路。 「两端的数字保持原样,把和插在中间」、「平均数的平方减去差的平方」、「从 100 开始算缺多少」⋯⋯ 只要看懂模式,曾经令人头疼的两位数心算就会变得意外地顺手。 ■ 13 步晋级课程 本 App 把印度式方法整理成 13 种「型」,以级位与段位的形式系统化。 【级位课程 · 打基础】 6 级 ab × 11 5 级 (ab) × (cb),a + c = 10 4 级 (ab) × (ac),b + c = 10 3 级 (1a) × (1b),两数都在 11–19 2 级 (N − d) × (N + d),平均数为整数 1 级 接近 100 的数的乘法 【段位课程 · 进阶应用】 初段 两位数 × 一位数 二段 偶数 × 个位为 5 的数 三段 (a5) × (b5) 四段 偶数 × 25 或 偶数 × 75 五段 (a1) × (b1) 六段 (ab) × (ac),十位相同 七段 普通的两位数 × 两位数(纵向与交叉相乘) 每一步都配有完整讲解:思路、公式、解题步骤、例题。 不只是死记硬背窍门,而是理解「为什么这样算行得通」,真正把可以举一反三的计算力刻进脑里。 ■ 两种课程,自由节奏 大师课程:每题 5 秒、合计 50 秒以内的限时挑战。通过即可晋升下一阶段。 自由课程:无时间限制。可以从容思考,App 会默默为你计时,是冲击大师阶段前的最佳热身。 ■ 适合谁 想培养可量化脑力训练习惯的成年人 希望以游戏化方式提升孩子计算与专注力的家长 学过珠算、想体验另一种心算风格的人 想加快考试解题速度的中学生、高中生 备战面试、能力测试和公考的大学生与求职者 想在会议间、地铁上、排队时让大脑保持灵敏的职场人 ■ 主要功能 全 13 步的学习模块(模式·公式·思路·步骤·例题) 每题 5 秒的大师课程与自由节奏的自由课程 自动记录最佳时间和完整对战历史 完成全部 13 阶段后授予的「印度式计算道 证书」(可保存为图片) 音效、触觉反馈、统一的明暗主题 支持简体中文、日语、英语、法语、韩语 100% 离线运行。无账号、无广告、无追踪、无内购 ■ 从一道题开始,把计算变成乐趣 不擅长乘法也没关系。 印度式计算道用每天 5 秒的小积累,在你的大脑里慢慢搭起「另一套计算回路」。 今天就是你刷新心算最快记录的日子。来,从第一道题开始。 ■ 联系方式 意见与建议:support@indian-mathmatics.app 官方网站:https://indian-mathmatics.app

6764513416.name: 清灰-声波清理灰尘
6764513416.description: 一款面向手机扬声器、听筒与外放场景的离线清灰工具。应用通过连续声波与频率变化，帮助你在日常使用中进行喇叭除尘、积尘清洁与排尘辅助。无账号、无联网、无复杂步骤，打开即可开始。 核心功能 声波清灰：提供稳定的音波输出，帮助进行日常扬声器清理灰尘。 双模式切换：标准模式适合常规清洁，深度模式适合需要更强震动感的场景。 时长预设：支持自由时长、30秒、60秒、90秒，按需选择更方便。 历史记录：自动保存每次清灰结果，方便查看累计次数、平均时长与今日完成情况。 桌面小组件：快速查看今日清灰状态和最近一次记录。 纯离线体验：无需注册登录，无联网使用，操作更直接。 适合这些使用场景： 手机喇叭积尘后的日常清洁 听筒、外放声音发闷时的辅助清灰 需要快速开启音频震动清洁时 希望使用本地工具完成清灰时 为什么选择我呢？ 清灰专注于声波清理灰尘场景，不做复杂功能堆砌。你可以在手机上快速完成扬声器除尘、听筒清洁、外放排尘，并通过历史记录持续观察使用效果。对于关注隐私和效率的用户，离线、本地、轻操作会更省心。 使用建议： 将设备音量调到合适范围后再开始清灰，完成后可立即试听效果。应用适合日常清洁辅助，不替代硬件维修。

6763011668.name: Syno Manager For Synology NAS
6763011668.description: Syno Manager is the beautiful, at-a-glance dashboard for your Synology NAS that DSM's mobile web UI never became. Whether you're running a single DS-series at home or managing a fleet of enterprise RackStations, Syno Manager gives you a fast, native-feel view of everything your NAS is doing - without firing up a browser or squinting at DSM on a phone screen. EVERYTHING YOU WANT TO KNOW, ONE TAP AWAY Real-time system vitals - CPU, RAM, temperature, uptime Storage pools and volumes with drive health (SMART) Network throughput per interface, live Resource monitor with history graphs UPS status - load, battery, runtime estimates Surveillance Station - camera status, recording state Active Backup for Business task health Download Station and Hyper Backup progress Shared folders, connected users, active sessions Service and package state Docker containers with live logs Full system logs with filtering MANAGE, DON'T JUST WATCH Start / stop / restart Synology packages Toggle services Restart or pause Docker containers and tail their logs Update notification preferences Browse the file system MULTI-NAS, NOT MULTI-APP Add every NAS you own - home, office, parents' - and switch between them in one tap. Each gets its own credentials, independent session, and separate dashboard. SECURITY FIRST Full 2FA (OTP) login support with device trust Auto-reauth on session expiry - credentials stored in iOS Keychain Runs entirely over your existing DSM HTTPS endpoint - no relay servers, no telemetry BUILT FOR DSM 7 Syno Manager speaks DSM 7's Web API (publicly documented) and handles the quirks: JWT tokens for 2FA, dependent-package warnings, session recovery. Tested against DS220+, DS923+, RS1221+, DS1522+. BEAUTIFUL ON PHONES AND TABLETS Adaptive layouts for iPhone and iPad. Dark mode first. Designed to match your system appearance. PRIVATE BY DESIGN No cloud relay - app talks directly to your NAS No account, no email required Crash reports via Firebase Crashlytics (anonymous device IDs only) Every value shown comes straight from the official Synology Web API Syno Manager is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Synology Inc. Synology, DSM, and related trademarks are the property of Synology Inc. This app connects to your NAS using publicly documented Synology APIs. 6501991968.description: Capture life's moments beautifully with Timestamp Camera—the perfect app for adding stylish timestamps to your photos. Whether documenting a diet, capturing baby milestones, or recording your workouts, Timestamp Camera enhances your memories with precise date and time stamps. Why Choose Timestamp Camera? Effortless Integration: Seamlessly imports images from your gallery, allowing you to add timestamps even to past moments. Customizable Stamps: Choose from various stamp styles and colors to complement your photos perfectly. Social Media Ready: Share your timestamped photos directly to social media platforms or with friends and family. High-Quality Outputs: Enjoy clear, bright photos with high resolution, ensuring that every detail is captured. Key Features Flexible Stamp Placement: Position the date and time anywhere on your photo. Watermarking: Add a unique logo as a watermark to brand your images. Versatile Camera Use: Utilize both front and rear cameras for versatile shooting options. Lighting Controls: Use the flash and adjust white balance for optimal photo lighting. Easy To Use 1. Select or snap a photo. 2. Pick a stamp type. 3. Customize the stamp’s color. 4. Save your masterpiece. 5. Share it on social media or with friends! Timestamp Camera is designed to perform flawlessly without freezing or reducing image quality, ensuring that your memories are preserved in pristine condition. It's largely free to use, providing premium features with minimal ads. For Everyone Dieters: Motivate yourself by documenting your transformation. Parents: Track your child's growth through vivid photographic memories. Event Planners: Create detailed brochures by timestamping stages of event preparation. Photographers: Offer clients a unique perspective of different seasons and times at specific locations. What’s More? User-Friendly Design: Enjoy a simple, intuitive interface that makes navigation a breeze. Reliable Performance: Count on Timestamp Camera to capture and preserve your important moments without a hitch. Download Timestamp Camera today and start preserving your special moments with elegance and precision! 6763649633.name: STAKD Arcs: Life Habit Tracker
6763649633.description: Build the life you want — one arc at a time. STAKD Arcs organizes your habits, tasks, and personal stats into arcs — focused chapters of your life that you define. Whether you're training for a competition, building a side project, or just trying to drink more water, each arc keeps everything in one place. Track habits with flexible scheduling — daily, weekly, or monthly — and watch your streaks grow. Manage tasks with priorities, due dates, and reminders. Log life stats like your squat PR, savings, or weight over time with sparkline charts that show your trajectory. Pulse gives you the big picture. See your weekly checkmarks, monthly heat grids, and a full-year heatmap of your consistency. Every view answers the same question: am I showing up? What makes STAKD Arcs different: Arcs group your habits and tasks by life area — not just a flat list Chapters let you evolve an arc without losing history Life Stats track anything with a number — manual entries, sparkline graphs, and progress over time Pulse dashboard shows weekly, monthly, yearly, and all-time views of your activity Designed to be minimal and fast — dark interface, no clutter, no social features No ads. No accounts. Your data stays on your device. Privacy policy: https://monroyindustries.xyz/STAKD-Arcs/stakd-arcs-privacy.html Terms: https://monroyindustries.xyz/STAKD-Arcs/stakd-arcs-termsofservice.html

6670686328.description: reLux — 光线追踪电影与影像 reLux 是一款专为重视光线物理特性而非数字滤镜的用户而设计的相机应用。它并非在图像上添加静态叠加层，而是使用本地光线追踪引擎实时处理 RAW 传感器数据。这种方法模拟了光线与场景的实际交互方式，创造出三维深度和独特的 HDR 衰减效果，其感觉更接近光学镜头而非数字传感器。 reLux 中的胶片纹理基于光密度计算。这意味着颗粒并非随机分布，而是呈现出自然的质感，在高光部分更细腻，在阴影部分更深邃，再现了 35mm 银盐胶片的自然特性。这种物理模拟同时适用于黑白和彩色摄影，提供了标准移动设备处理无法企及的密度和色调范围。 电影级视频拍摄也采用了同样的基于物理的动态处理方法。 reLux 采用 16 位分量录制，保留了海量数据，从而呈现出柔和的高光和深邃清晰的阴影，营造出电影般的质感。 为了保持光线追踪和深度计算的完整性，reLux 会绕过所有缩放功能。这是一项技术选择，旨在确保每个像素都直接源自传感器的原始数据，不受数字缩放或多镜头切换的干扰，从而实现尽可能高的保真度。 reLux 的输出专为欣赏胶片质感和厚重感的用户而设计。由于图像和视频均以 16 位分量进行处理，因此保留了丰富的信息，为后续的精细编辑奠定了专业的基础。 用光的逻辑而非算法的逻辑捕捉世界。这就是 reLux。

6764862063.name: 片刻 - 高级感图片制作生成
6764862063.trackName: 片刻 - 高级感图片制作生成
6764862063.description: 片刻是一款为照片、实况照片和视频素材设计的高级感图片制作工具。 它不强调复杂修图，而是帮你把日常瞬间整理成更安静、更有秩序的视觉页面。导入一张照片后，片刻会自动提取主色，读取可用的拍摄时间与地点信息，并套用适合社交分享、封面图、壁纸和生活记录的极简模板。 主要功能： 支持静态照片、实况照片与视频素材 自动提取照片主色，生成智能色卡 多种极简模板：智能色块、智能上下、智能左右、杂志留白、电影字幕、拍立得、Ins 风、壁纸 支持编辑主标题、副标题、字体和字号 支持导出静态图、循环视频和实况图 支持浅色模式、深色模式 支持中文、英文、日文界面 适合这些场景： 日常照片排版 实况照片动态记录 社交平台封面图 手机壁纸素材 旅行、探店、生活碎片整理 简洁、有质感的图片分享 片刻希望减少复杂操作，让一张普通照片也能快速变成安静、干净、有呼吸感的页面。 所有编辑都在设备本地完成。导出的作品会保存到你的系统相册。

6764697990.name: 手持弹幕led-显示屏滚动字幕跑马灯
6764697990.trackName: 手持弹幕led-显示屏滚动字幕跑马灯
6764697990.description: 一款离线可用的全屏 LED 跑马灯工具，适合接机、接站、演唱会应援、摆摊引流、临时提醒和现场告示。输入文字后即可快速生成滚动字幕、大字灯牌和全屏展示内容，无需注册、无需联网，打开就能直接使用。 你可以自由调节字号、速度、颜色、背景和显示方向，支持横屏、竖屏两种展示方式，适合机场接人、车站举牌、商铺提示、活动指引等不同场景。为了提升远距离识别效果，应用提供经典实心、圆点灯珠、方形点阵、粗圆点阵等多种 LED 风格，也支持跑马灯、静态展示、闪烁展示、呼吸闪烁等不同效果。 在展示细节上，手持弹幕支持镜像显示、双行字幕、文字描边、常亮控制和亮度快捷调节，方便你在演唱会应援、夜市摆摊、活动加油、排队提醒、营业告示等场景中更醒目地表达内容。面对面沟通时可开启镜像，远距离举牌时可切换横屏，大字显示更直接。 为了提升使用效率，应用内提供常用预设、最近记录、收藏回填和桌面小组件。接机欢迎、接站提示、营业文案、提醒告示、社交搭话等内容都可以一键套用，减少重复输入。你也可以快速切换常用文案，在不同现场场景中更高效地展示信息。 无论你是需要做手持弹幕、LED 字幕、滚动字幕、灯牌应援、接机举牌、摆摊提示，还是想把一段文字快速放大到全屏展示，手持弹幕都能帮你把内容更大、更亮、更清楚地呈现出来。

6761414271.name: Morphis 番茄钟·白噪音·记账·计数器
6761414271.trackName: Morphis 番茄钟·白噪音·记账·计数器
6761414271.description: 你是否还在为 iPhone 工具类 App 太多而烦恼？冥想、专注、记账、ToDo、白噪音，如果你玩音乐可能还会想要调音器和节拍器，或者玩乐的时候掷骰子。 Morphis 是一款集成了以上所有功能的 App，拥有精致的拟物化界面，集成物理引擎，带来极其逼真的纸张模拟和物理效果，我们还提供逼真小票模拟，可以记录你的支出、专注成果和ToDo完成情况。 而且我们提供了液态玻璃主题和手绘主题，试试定制化你的组件吧！ 小技巧：你甚至可以通过调整光源方向，让界面呈现截然不同的光影变化。 ◆ 番茄钟 — 可自定义专注时长，专注结束后打印专注小票，支持数据统计。 ◆ 记账 — 快速记录日常收支，提供逼真的收据打印效果，支持数据统计。 ◆ 待办事项 — 简洁的 ToDo 列表，帮你管理日常任务。 ◆ 白噪音 — 20+种环境音效（雨声、自然音，小猫的呼噜声），支持后台播放，助你专注或入眠。 ◆ 调音器 — 实时音高检测，精准调音，吉他、尤克里里等弦乐器适用。 ◆ 节拍器 — 稳定节奏引导，自定义 BPM，练琴排练必备。 ◆ 玩具骰子 — 3D 物理引擎模拟，摇晃投掷，滚动自然真实。 ◆ 计算器 — 拟物风格日常计算器，可以打印逼真的小票来辅助记账。 ◆ 计数器 — 在一块屏幕上摆放多个可爱的迷你计数器，点一下就加一，可命名、随手新增，数据云端同步。 服务条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6587569759.name: TibetanMath
6587569759.description: This application provides an opportunity to learn mathematics quiz in tibetan and English languages. In addition, it contains Addition easy, Addition difficult, Subtraction easy, Subtraction difficult, Multiplication, Division, and Word Problem. The numbers given are mostly in tibetan so that you know how numbers are written in tibetan language. When the user selects the correct answer, score gets incremented otherwise levels get stuck. The easy ones have timer also and difficult ones does not have timer. The aim of creating this quiz game is to maintain curiosity and learning at the same time. If you like this, you can rate. Thanks

6477769412.name: Greeks Encyclopedia
6477769412.description: The Greeks have graced humanity with countless inventions throughout history and they deserve an app of their own. For lovers of history and science this is a great app that summarizes all the well known and less known Greek greats and features many search features such as all inventions, by invention, by invention category, all inventors, by inventor, by inventor category and Greek women greats as well with zoomable details views. So next time you meet a Greek say afkharisto which is Greek for thank you.

6746383387.description: Find Visa Sponsorship Jobs Faster — Instantly Know Which UK Companies Sponsor Skilled Worker Visas Tired of applying to jobs only to find out the company doesn’t offer visa sponsorship? Save hours of wasted effort with our powerful tool that shows you companies in the UK officially licensed to sponsor Skilled Worker visas. Whether you’re a skilled professional, recent graduate, or international jobseeker, this app helps you focus only on jobs that can actually hire you. What You Get: Instant Access to the Official UK Sponsor List: Search thousands of companies authorised by the UK Home Office to sponsor Skilled Worker visas. Company Details At Your Fingertips: View sponsor license type, location, and hiring route (Skilled Worker, Global Business Mobility, etc.). Offline Search Instantly search and filter results without needing an internet connection. Save Time & Apply Smarter Stop guessing. Apply only to companies that are able to sponsor your visa. Always Up to Date Built on the official “Register of Licensed Sponsors” data — regularly updated so you’re always in the know. Who’s It For: Skilled professionals looking for Skilled Worker (Tier 2) visa sponsorship International students seeking post-study work opportunities Global talent targeting UK companies hiring overseas workers Download now and stop applying in the dark — land your next job faster with visa-ready companies.

6765699936.name: 年度备忘录
6765699936.description: 年度备忘录是一款简洁高效的年度待办事项管理应用，以独特的十二宫格形式展示全年12个月的待办事项。 主要功能： 年度概览 十二宫格设计，一眼查看全年待办事项分布，轻松规划年度目标。 智能高亮 当前月份橙色高亮显示，快速定位，提升效率。 便捷管理 添加、编辑、删除待办事项，支持标记完成状态，每个任务还可添加详细备注。 智能提醒 每月1日自动提醒新的一月开始，查看本月待办；每月最后一天提醒月底总结，不忘未完成任务；支持为单个待办设置自定义提醒时间。 桌面小组件 在桌面上直接查看当前月份待办事项，无需打开应用，随时掌握待办进度。 数据统计 一键查看年度待办完成情况，包括总数、完成率、最多待办月份等统计数据。 数据安全 所有数据本地存储，保护您的隐私，无需担心数据泄露。 适用场景：年度目标规划与追踪、月度任务管理、重要事项提醒、工作与生活安排。简洁的设计，强大的功能，让您的年度规划更加清晰有序！

6760454895.name: Babel Reader
6760454895.description: Babel Reader is a clean, distraction-free EPUB reader for iPhone and iPad. Import your books, read with beautifully crafted typography, and translate any paragraph with a single tap — all without sending a single byte to any server. READING EXPERIENCE Page-by-page layout with smooth swipe navigation Portrait and landscape support (two-column layout in landscape) Four reading themes: White, Sepia, Night, and Slate Five typefaces: Georgia, Palatino, Baskerville, Iowan Old Style, and System Adjustable text size and line spacing Each book remembers its own display settings — font, size, line spacing, and theme Optional hyphenation and text alignment (flush left, justified, flush right, centred) Clock and chapter progress indicator always visible while you read TRANSLATION Tap any paragraph to translate it in place Tap again to restore the original Translation runs entirely on your device — no text leaves your iPhone or iPad Supports 20+ languages including Arabic (with full RTL support), Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Dutch, English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese Optional Read Aloud & Share: have the original or the translation read aloud, or share either via any app on your device YOUR LIBRARY Import EPUB files from Files, Mail, Safari, and any other app that supports Share Sheet Organise your books into Collections Grid or list view Sort by date added, title, author, language, or most recently read Edit book title, author, and language metadata iCloud sync: keep your entire library and reading progress in sync across all your Apple devices (optional, uses your private iCloud account) AVAILABLE IN 6 LANGUAGES The app interface is fully localised in English, German, French, Dutch, Spanish, and Italian. PRIVACY FIRST Babel Reader collects no personal data. It contains no advertising, no analytics, and no third-party tracking of any kind. On-device translation never sends your text to a server. iCloud sync uses only your own private iCloud account — your data is never accessible to the developer. EPUB FORMAT Babel Reader supports EPUB 2 and EPUB 3 files. PDF, MOBI, and AZW3 are not supported in this version.

6759664844.name: GitQuest - 游戏学Git
6759664844.description: GitQuest是一款通过游戏方式学习Git的互动学习应用。 无需背诵命令。只需点按卡片、拖拽文件，就能直观体验Git操作。 ■ 特色 【可视化学习】 Working Tree·Staging Area·Local Repository·Remote四个区域实时变化。一眼就能看懂"做了什么会发生什么"。 【24节课程】 从git add / commit基础到branch / merge / push / pull，再到stash / revert / tag。7个章节循序渐进地学习。 【挑战模式】 挑战随机生成的题目！从初级到达人5个难度等级。在竞争高分的同时提升Git技能。 【收集要素】 完成课程即可获得Git术语卡片和徽章。收集图鉴的乐趣让学习动力持续不断。 【6种语言】 支持日本語·English·한국어·中文·Français·Deutsch。自动匹配设备语言设置，也可在应用内手动切换。 ■ 适合人群 ・刚开始学编程，对Git感到困惑的人 ・觉得背命令很难的人 ・团队开发中需要使用Git的人 ・想利用碎片时间轻松学习的人 完全不需要文字输入。通勤途中、休息时间，随时随地都能学Git。

6503942992.name: 自律星计划
6503942992.description: 或许你会有这样的困扰：想达成一个目标，但反馈周期太长、任务分散且多。每每鼓足干劲，但由于看不到希望，于是又很快泄气。 自律星计划是为了解决这个困扰而生。人们并非因为懒惰而不自律，不自律的根本原因是缺少正反馈。在这个app中，你的每一个任务都能有所沉淀，你也可以设置阶段性的奖励，激励自己更好前行。 【主要功能】 自定义任务与奖励星星数，完成任务，获取星星 设置目标，关联目标与任务 达成目标，获取更多星星 设置奖励，使用完成任务和目标获得的星星兑换奖励 icloud同步，双端共享数据，安全无广 任务重复设置 更多功能玩法，与你app内相见 联系作者-- 邮箱：dontangrybling@163.com 小红书：@闪闪在开发

6765463711.name: colorMark
6765463711.description: Sephalight 是一款主打电影感创作的拍摄与影像处理 App。它不仅支持照片与视频拍摄，还能在拍摄过程中实时预览 LUT 效果，搭配 21:9 电影画幅、手动曝光/白平衡/对焦控制，帮助你更精准地掌控画面。 除了拍摄，Sephalight 还提供强大的水印编辑能力，可叠加拍摄参数、设备信息、位置、签名与色盘等内容，让作品更具个人风格与专业感。你也可以导入参考图片，使用 AI 分析色彩风格并生成专属 LUT，轻松完成统一调色。 Sephalight is a cinematic camera and image processing app built for creators who care about style and control. It supports both photo and video capture, with real-time LUT preview, 21:9 cinema framing, and manual controls for exposure, white balance, and focus. Beyond capture, Sephalight offers powerful watermark editing tools that let you overlay capture data, device info, location, signatures, and color palettes. You can also import a reference image and use AI to analyze its color style, then generate a custom LUT for a consistent and professional look.

6762558902.name: Counter Plan：倒數日計數器
6762558902.description: Counter Plan 是一款优雅、简单的多功能追踪 App，把私人计数器、Tasbih、截止日、进度追踪与日期记录整合在同一个 App 里。 主要功能： 1. 倒数计数 当你想从一个数字开始，并一步一步减少时，可以使用倒数计数。 例如： 你创建一个主题叫“Study Pages”，并输入 40。 每完成一页或一个步骤，就点一下按钮，App 会自动倒数： 40 → 39 → 38 → 37 每一次点击都会保存日期与时间，让你清楚知道每一步是什么时候完成的。 倒数计数适合用于： 学习页数 治疗或练习次数 剩余运动次数 剩余课程 剩余任务 目标 每日计划 如果不小心点错，也可以删除该条记录，数字会自动修正。 2. 日期与笔记记录 日期与笔记记录可以用来保存重要的个人日期与备注。 你可以新增： 开始日期 结束日期 预计未来日期 备注 经期记录示例： 女性可以创建一条经期记录，并保存： 开始日期：经期开始的日期 结束日期：经期结束的日期 预计日期：下一次预计日期 备注：症状、疼痛、心情或其他重要内容 例如： 主题：Period 开始：5 月 1 日 结束：5 月 5 日 预计：5 月 29 日 备注：第一天疼痛，第三天后正常 日期与笔记记录也可以用于： 个人计划 健康笔记 用药笔记 旅行日期 项目日期 约会与预约 重要事件 日常记录 提醒 私人笔记 预计日期由用户自行选择。Counter Plan 不提供医疗建议，也不提供医疗预测。它只是帮助你清楚整理日期与笔记。 3. 截止日 当你有一个重要的未来日期，并想知道还剩几天时，可以使用截止日功能。 例如： 你选择考试日期、旅行日期、项目上线日期、预约日期或活动日期。 App 会显示： “剩余 20 天” 如果你 10 天后再次打开 App，它会自动重新计算并显示： “剩余 10 天” 你不需要手动更新。Counter Plan 会保存目标日期，并根据今天的日期自动计算剩余天数。 你也可以新增截止日前想完成的任务，完成后直接勾选。 截止日适合用于： 考试 旅行 上线计划 活动 预约 目标 项目 任务规划 重要日期 4. Tasbih 计数器 Tasbih 可以作为数字 Tasbih / Dhikr 计数器使用。 创建一个 Tasbih 主题，选择目标数字，例如 33 或 100，然后点击计数按钮。 App 可以显示： 当前计数 目标计数 总计数 最近计数记录 Tasbih 适合用于： tasbih dhikr zikr tasbeeh 灵修计数 重复计数 每日个人计数 它就像一个干净、简单、带有质感设计的数字计数器。 5. 累加计数 当你想记录自己做了某件事多少次时，可以使用累加计数。 例如： 你创建一个主题叫“Workout”。 每次运动后，点击 Add One。 App 会计算： 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 每一次计数都会保存日期与时间。你也可以为每次计数加入备注。 累加计数适合用于： 运动 习惯 学习次数 练习日 阅读记录 喝水杯数 已完成通话 每日进度 个人追踪 6. 更多 More 分页可以让你前往 INGOAMPT 网站，查看更多 App、工具与文章。 你也可以通过 Apple 官方 App Store 评分提示，用星级支持这款 App。 为什么选择 Counter Plan？ Counter Plan 适合想用简单方式整理日常生活、追踪进度、记住重要日期的人。 使用 Counter Plan，你可以： 从任意数字开始倒数 累加追踪进度 追踪截止日 计算剩余天数 保存开始与结束日期 保存预计未来日期 添加笔记 使用 Tasbih 计数器 勾选截止日前任务 编辑记录 删除错误 整理每日计划 与其分别使用多个 App 来处理计数器、日期记录、Tasbih、截止日、笔记与任务，Counter Plan 将这些功能整合在一个清楚、简单的 App 里。

6449228107.name: 短信小管家-垃圾短信骚扰拦截
6449228107.trackName: 短信小管家-垃圾短信骚扰拦截
6449228107.description: 「短信小管家」基于AI文本学习来识别短信内容，能够精准识别广告、推销、骚扰等垃圾短信，同时也支持用户添加自定义关键词/号码来进行个性化识别 【功能】 智能识别短信内容 支持自定义关键词/号码拦截 机器学习用户提交样本，不断更新进化 【隐私保护】 短信小管家不会收集您的任何敏感信息，这是一款可完全离线使用的小工具，不会上传任何信息。 用户可选择主动向短信小管家提交短信样本，样本数据将仅被用于训练智能模型，不会被分享或用于其它用途 使用过程中遇到任何问题都可以联系官方微信客服号mtao365，我们将在第一时间为您解决！

6450197198.name: WAS: User-Agent Switcher
6450197198.description: WAS 浏览器让您一键切换网站的移动端视图与桌面端视图。现在，您可以通过更改决定网站显示方式的 user-agent 字符串来浏览任意网站或测试您自己的网站。借助内置的 WebView 浏览器，您无需购买设备或安装额外的模拟器，即可查看您的网站在各种智能手机、屏幕和设备上的显示效果。 WAS 提供丰富的内置 user agent，如果不够，您也可以轻松添加或创建自己的。应用还提供多种内置设置，便于进行快速兼容性测试和内容验证。 立即下载此应用，告别在不同设备上测试网站的烦恼！

6756437919.name: PC View Mode for Safari
6756437919.description: 一款在iPhone上显示真正桌面布局的Safari扩展。 将视口宽度更改为1024–1440px，按网站记忆你的偏好，一键切换。 ▼ 为什么Safari的内置功能不够？ Safari的"请求桌面网站"只改变User-Agent。 视口宽度保持与手机屏幕相同，因此响应式网站永远不会切换到桌面布局。 PC View Mode更改实际视口宽度——为你提供真正的桌面布局。 ▼ 与Safari内置功能的区别 内置功能：仅更改User-Agent → 响应式网站保持移动布局 PC View Mode：更改视口宽度 → 显示真正的桌面布局 ▼ 在这些网站上感受差异 YouTube — 完整的桌面UI和所有控件 Amazon / eBay — 完整的筛选、对比表格和排序 Wikipedia — 桌面级信息密度 WordPress / AWS面板 — 正确渲染的管理面板 公司系统 / 内部工具 — 在iPhone上完全可用 ▼ 主要功能 从3种视口宽度中选择（1024px / 1280px / 1440px） 一键切换桌面和移动视图 每个网站的规则自动记忆——无需重复设置 页面上的浮动按钮即时控制 按钮位置可调整到4个角落中的任何一个 不收集数据——完全在设备上运行 ▼ 适合人群 想在手机上看到完整版网站的所有人 偏好桌面布局以舒适浏览的用户 在iPhone上使用管理面板或工作工具的人 开发者和自由职业者 不再需要切换到电脑。 立即下载，在iPhone上获得完整的桌面网页体验。
