6781435834.name: 汉字打僵尸
6781435834.description: 《汉字笔顺练习》是一款专为中文学习者设计的汉字书写练习应用。 【核心功能】 应用中会依次出现待练习的汉字,你只需按屏幕提示一笔一画地写出这个字。每写对一笔立刻变绿反馈,让你实时知道还差几笔,巩固正确笔顺记忆。 【特色】 真实毛笔渲染:起笔、行笔、收笔、飞白拖尾,逼真还原中国书法笔触 智能笔画识别:基于汉字标准笔顺数据库,支持 3000 多个常用汉字 循序渐进:从一笔的「一」开始,由简到繁逐步引入更复杂的汉字 精准笔顺反馈:写错笔画立刻提示,帮你及时纠正 极简纯净:无内购、无广告、无登录、无网络要求 【适合人群】 想巩固汉字笔顺的小学生与家长 学习中文的海外华人子女 对中国书法感兴趣的成年人 在碎片时间想练字的中文爱好者 【离线使用】 完全离线运行,所有进度仅保存在你的设备上,不收集任何个人数据。

Wedding Venue Discovery Browse curated wedding venues by location, style, capacity, and budget View photos, amenities, and availability details Save favorite venues and compare options side-by-side Get helpful planning tips tailored to your preferences Home & Mortgage Insights Explore local housing information to understand nearby neighborhoods Check current interest rates in your area See price trends and helpful stats to guide your next steps Save listings and get personalized insights Plan With Confidence nestReady gives you the tools and information you need—beautifully organized and easy to use. Whether you're selecting the perfect venue or getting ready for your first home, nestReady helps you move forward together with clarity and peace of mind.

6779077763.name: Auto Detailing: Business App
6779077763.description: DetailFlow is the all-in-one field app for mobile auto detailers. Book the job, price it by vehicle size, prove your work with before & after photos, get a signature, and send a professional invoice — right from the customer's driveway, even with no signal. EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR PHONE No account. No cloud. No login. Your clients, jobs, and invoices live on your device — you own your business data, and the core app works 100% offline. PRICE BY VEHICLE SIZE, INSTANTLY Build your service menu once, set prices per vehicle size (sedan, SUV, truck, and your own custom sizes), and DetailFlow quotes every job automatically. No more guessing or back-of-napkin math. CLIENTS & THEIR CARS, ORGANIZED Keep every client with their vehicles, addresses, and full service history. One tap opens directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps, or Waze. JOBS FROM BOOKED TO PAID Schedule jobs on a built-in calendar with arrival reminders. Track every job from scheduled to in progress, completed, invoiced, and paid. Need it fast? Quick Job logs a walk-up wash in seconds. BEFORE & AFTER PROOF Shoot grouped before/after photos with panel tags. Turn them into a branded comparison card — with optional license-plate blur — and share it to win your next customer. SIGN-OFF THAT PROTECTS YOU Capture an on-screen signature and note pre-existing scratches before you start. Export a completion PDF when the job is done. PROFESSIONAL INVOICES IN SECONDS Generate a clean invoice PDF with your business name and logo, send it by text or email, and mark it paid — cash, Zelle, Venmo, whatever you take. REPEAT BUSINESS ON AUTOPILOT Track ceramic coating warranties and maintenance plans per vehicle. DetailFlow reminds you when a client is due, so rebooking is one message away. KNOW YOUR NUMBERS See income from paid invoices and log expenses. Monthly and custom reports show what your business actually makes. YOUR DATA, PORTABLE Back up everything to iCloud Drive or Files and restore it on a new iPhone. Export clients and invoices to CSV/PDF anytime. Optional Face ID lock keeps your client list private. FREE TO START Use DetailFlow free with up to 10 clients, 3 jobs, and the Classic invoice template. DETAILFLOW PRO Go unlimited with DetailFlow Pro: unlimited jobs and clients, all invoice templates, and PDF/CSV sharing & export. Available as a weekly, monthly, or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Terms of Use: https://www.youzou.vip/dflow/terms.html Privacy Policy: https://www.youzou.vip/dflow/privacy.html Built for solo detailers and new detailing businesses — not a bloated enterprise suite. Download DetailFlow and run your whole operation from one app.

6758240763.name: ClipPop
6758240763.description: Clippop 是一款专为提升工作效率而生的 macOS 剪贴板管理工具。我们深知在日常办公与开发中，频繁的复制粘贴往往伴随着信息的遗失，而 Clippop 将为您找回每一条有价值的痕迹。 【核心功能】 全能记录：不仅支持文字，更完美记录图片、视频以及系统文件，打破单一剪贴板的局限。 瞬间呼出：自定义全局快捷键（默认 Alt + Space），在屏幕底部以优雅的卡片流形式展示历史记录。 智能搜索：支持实时关键字过滤，即使有数百条记录，也能在毫秒间精准定位。 来源追踪：自动识别并展示复制内容的来源应用图标，助您快速回溯信息出处。 极致体验：支持左右按键导航、回车粘贴、右键管理，操作逻辑顺应原生 macOS 习惯。 隐私安全：所有数据均本地存储，绝不上传云端，保障您的个人隐私与商业信息绝对安全。 【为什么选择 Clippop？】 轻量化：基于现代架构开发，内存占用极低，即使长时间开启也不会拖慢系统。 无干扰：平时静默运行在状态栏，只在您需要时瞬间响应。 高效流：专为开发者、设计师、文案写作者设计，消除重复劳动，让您的工作流无缝衔接。 让您的剪贴板不再只有“最后一次复制”，而是成为您得心应手的素材库。

6780331546.name: ArrView
6780331546.description: ArrView is a fast, native companion app for the self-hosted media tools you already run. Connect to your own Sonarr, Radarr, SABnzbd, and NZBHydra servers to check your library and keep an eye on downloads — from the couch or away from home. No account. No tracking. No middleman. ArrView talks directly to your servers, and everything you enter stays on your device. WHAT YOU CAN DO Browse your TV series and movies at a glance See what's downloading and track activity in real time Connect multiple services and switch between them easily Designed for both iPhone and iPad EFFORTLESS SETUP Auto-discover ArrView servers on your network over Bonjour Or enter any server address and API key directly Works with plain HTTP on your local network, or HTTPS where your server supports it PRIVATE BY DESIGN No analytics, ads, or third-party tracking of any kind API keys are stored securely in the iOS Keychain Your data never leaves your device except to reach the servers you choose REQUIREMENTS ArrView connects to servers that you host and control. You'll need your own running Sonarr, Radarr, SABnzbd, NZBHydra, or ArrView instance and its API key. The app is a client only — it doesn't host or provide any content. — ArrView is an independent client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Sonarr, Radarr, SABnzbd, or NZBHydra projects. All product names are trademarks of their respective owners.

Lumencam is a pure black and white camera built for photographers who think in light, shadow, and composition — not filters and feeds. Live monochrome. What you see is what you shoot. The preview is always black and white, so you compose with intention. No mental translation from color to mono. No surprises after the shot. Just honest, real-time feedback through the lens. No generated content. No compromises. Every image is yours. Lumencam captures exactly what you see and nothing more. No artificial enhancements, no generative edits, no algorithms deciding what your photo should look like. Built for every kind of photographer. Street. Portrait. Architecture. Documentary. Landscape. If you care about craft, light, and timeless results, Lumencam is your camera. No artificial enhancements, no generative edits, no algorithms deciding what your photo should look like. Built for every kind of photographer. Street. Portrait. Architecture. Documentary. Landscape. If you care about craft, light, and timeless results, Lumencam is your camera. 6783556497.name: 旺财 — 守财狗 GuardDog
6783556497.description: 拍一张借据，旺财帮你把账算明白。 旺财记账是一款完全本地化的 AI 资产与债务管家。 负债不用 Excel，不用记账 App 手动敲——扫一扫借据截图。 AI 自动提取本金、利率、期数，生成清晰的分期还款计划。 每个月该还多少、先还哪个最省钱，一目了然。 日常开销、还款、收入、支出等现金流水清晰呈现。 === 核心功能 === 【快捷记账】 基础功能不用说，快捷方便心不厌，0门槛快速养成记账习惯 支持微信、支付宝、各大银行app的交易对账识别，快速构建历史账目 【AI 扫图识债】 借据、信用报告、还款计划表——拍一下就行。 旺财自动识别金额、利率、期数、还款方式，不用你一个一个敲。 【还款流量图】 可拖拽的时间轴，一眼看清未来每个月要还多少。 点一下柱子，当期明细全部展开——本金多少、利息多少、 还剩几期，清清楚楚。占月收入比例实时计算， 还款压力是否可控，心里有数。 【信用报告导入】 支持人行信用报告 PDF/截图导入，自动解析信用卡 和贷款列表，增量合并、不重复建重复账。导入后可 逐项确认后再保存，你的手动修改不会被覆盖。 【分期还款计划】 等额本息、等额本金、先息后本、到期还本——都支持。 每期金额自动算好，到期日前提醒，每还一期点「已还」 即可，旺财自动更新剩余期数和余额。 【我的资产】 绑定银行卡、基金、房产，总资产实时更新。 净资产 = 总资产 - 总负债，一张图看懂家底。 【旺财健康分】 AI 综合评估你的负债率、月供占比、资产结构， 给出 0-100 的财务健康分和改进建议。分低了， 旺财会告诉你问题在哪里、该怎么调。 【隐私第一】 所有数据存储在您的设备上，绝不上传任何服务器。 AI 识别通过加密传输到deepseek或智谱等大模型官方接口，识别完成后不保留原始内容。 无需注册，打开即用。支持面容 ID / 密码保护。 【附件凭证】 借据原件、还款截图、合同 PDF——直接挂到对应的 债务下面。随时回查，不丢失任何凭证。 === 适合谁用 === 有多笔贷款/信用卡，想汇总月供、利率、优先还哪个 借了钱想管清楚的人——拍照建档，不用 Excel 需要整理信用报告的人——导入后自动归类 对自己财务状况心里没数的人——旺财帮你盯着 === 关于我们 === 守财狗由一支关心普通人财务健康的团队打造。 我们不碰你的数据，不上传你的文件。 每个功能都只为一个目的：让你少一件烦心事。 有建议或反馈？ 邮件：alien1042421622@gmail.com 支持: https://jemarisan.github.io/guarddog-support/support.html 隐私政策: https://jemarisan.github.io/guarddog-support/privacy.html

6768196167.name: 影控台
6768196167.description: 请订阅“视觉矿洞”微信公众号/哔哩哔哩/抖音，查看更多介绍、教程，以及摄影&视觉相关干货文章！ 影控台（Imaging Console）是一款第三方专业相机控制、监看与文件传输应用，兼容尼康 Z 系列微单及电影机。 兼容情况** Expeed 7代机型（Z9、Z8、ZR、Z6III、Z5II、Zf、Z50II）完全兼容，可发挥App所有功能； Expeed 6代机型（Z5、Z6、Z7、Z6II、Z7II、Z50、Z30、Zfc）无法享受群组功能，无线连接方面：使用“连接至智能设备”可进行控制、监看、机内文件访问，使用“连接至计算机”可进行控制、监看。 重要声明 影控台为独立开发的第三方产品，与 Nikon Corporation、RED Digital Cinema 及其关联公司不存在任何隶属、合作、授权或认可关系。文中提及的 Nikon、RED 及相关产品名称仅用于说明设备兼容性。 核心功能 混合连接与状态调度 支持 USB（MTP/PTP）及无线（PTP/IP）连接方式，包括相机热点、Wi-Fi 和移动热点。支持单机控制及多机群组控制。 多机集群控制 支持 1:N 无线群组管理，可同步触发照片、视频及混合拍摄，多机实时监看，并支持部分特殊拍摄模式的同步控制。 Live View 实时监看 提供实时取景及重点参数控制，支持触控对焦，并提供 LUT 实时预览、伪色、斑马纹、直方图、波形图、安全区、水平仪及取景网格等专业监看辅助工具。 机内文件管理 支持浏览、回放、下载、保护、评级及 LUT 预览，支持批量下载及丰富筛选功能。部分旗舰机型支持语音备忘录管理。 即拍即传与快速预览 支持自动下载、自定义保存位置、自动附加 GPS 信息及无卡拍摄自动下载，实现即拍即传。支持拍摄完成后的快速预览，提高现场工作效率。 LUT 与图像优化 支持导入自定义 LUT 与优化校准文件，可应用于实时监看、机内文件浏览、拍摄后快速预览及 App 图库浏览等多种工作流程。 实况照片（LivePhoto）生成导出 支持机内视频文件、图库导入视频文件灵活导出实况照片，支持HDR保留，支持GPS位置自动附加等。 影控台致力于为专业摄影师、影视制作人员及影像创作者提供稳定、高效的专业拍摄工作流。

6784597714.name: 宠物健康提醒
6784597714.description: 宠物健康提醒是一款为养宠用户设计的宠物照护记录工具，帮助你管理宠物的用药、疫苗、驱虫、体重、就医和花费记录。 你可以为每只宠物建立独立档案，设置日常护理和健康提醒，记录体重变化、就医信息和相关费用，让宠物的健康情况更清楚、更容易追踪。 主要功能： 宠物档案：记录宠物名称、品种、性别等基础信息 用药提醒：设置日常用药、护理、驱虫、疫苗等提醒事项 健康记录：记录体重变化、用药完成情况和日常护理 就医记录：保存医院、就医原因、诊断、治疗、费用和复诊信息 花费统计：分类查看药品、就医、保险和其他支出 待办管理：快速查看需要处理的提醒事项 适合场景： 记不清宠物什么时候驱虫 容易忘记疫苗、复查或日常用药 想长期记录猫咪、狗狗的体重变化 想整理宠物就医和花费记录 多只宠物需要分别管理 本 App 仅用于宠物健康记录和提醒管理，不提供医疗诊断、治疗建议或兽医替代服务。如宠物出现异常症状，请及时咨询专业兽医。

6769696357.name: CatLines
6769696357.description: CatLines turns your favorite TV show moments into powerful English lessons. Every day, CatLines gives you one carefully selected sentence from a classic TV show — complete with context, character, vocabulary, and key phrases. Study it deeply, then prove you've learned it through three progressive tests. HOW IT WORKS Daily Sentence Each day you receive one authentic line from a classic TV show. See who said it, what was happening before and after, and break down every key word and phrase — so you don't just memorize a sentence, you understand it. Fill in the Blank Read the sentence with one word missing. Choose the right word from the options. Simple, focused, effective. Dictation Listen to the sentence and type exactly what you hear. Train your ear and sharpen your spelling at the same time. Voice Test Read the sentence aloud and get instant feedback. Build the confidence to actually speak, not just read. Spaced Repetition Review After you learn a sentence, CatLines schedules it for review at 1, 3, 7, 15, and 30 days — the proven spacing that moves knowledge from short-term memory into long-term recall. You'll never forget what you've learned. Daily Streak Build a habit you're proud of. Your streak counter tracks every consecutive day you complete your lesson, keeping you motivated to come back. Check-in Calendar See your full learning history at a glance. Every day you studied is marked — a visual record of your commitment and growth. Library Browse all the sentences in the collection. Revisit lines you love, or preview what's coming next. Achievements Unlock milestones as you learn more sentences, build longer streaks, and master your reviews. Progress feels rewarding every step of the way. WHO IT'S FOR CatLines is designed for intermediate to advanced English learners who want to go beyond textbook phrases and hear how English is actually spoken — with rhythm, personality, and cultural context baked in. Whether you're preparing for a conversation, an exam, or just want to sound more natural, one great sentence a day will get you there. WHY TV SHOW LINES Real dialogue from real shows reflects how native speakers actually talk. The vocabulary is natural, the rhythm is authentic, and the cultural references make each sentence genuinely memorable. You're not just learning English — you're absorbing the culture that shapes it. One line a day. Drops of stone.

6776913214.name: PurePaper - Minimalist Scanner
6776913214.description: PurePaper is a high-end document scanning tool for people who value aesthetics and efficiency. A tool should stay out of the way—it shouldn’t track you, require a subscription, or upload your private documents to someone else’s server. [CORE FEATURES] The “Flatbed Look”: Adaptive shadow removal clears uneven lighting and restores a clean white background. Precision warping: System document edge detection and perspective correction straighten skewed photos into rectangular pages. Text sharpening: Boosts contrast for handwriting, stamps, and print. Four core modes: Magic Color, Flatbed Look, B&W Document, and Original Photo. On-device OCR & full-text search: Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), English, Japanese, German; search titles and page content from Home. Searchable PDF: Optional invisible text layer. Enabled by default for PDF export; disable in Export for image-only PDFs. Sign, annotate & redact: PencilKit markup; redact sensitive text automatically or by hand. 6778358498.name: VideoTrim: 视频无损裁剪与分割
6778358498.trackName: VideoTrim: 视频无损裁剪与分割
6778358498.description: 您知道吗？大多数剪辑软件（甚至手机自带相册）在裁剪视频时，都会进行“重新编码”。这不仅会严重破坏您珍贵的 4K/HDR 画质、耗费大量时间，还会抹除拍摄时间、GPS定位等至关重要的 EXIF 元数据！ 这是为您量身定制的救星： 专为内容创作者、无人机飞手和画质强迫症患者设计，本应用采用底层“数据流直拷 (Stream-copying)”技术。不对像素进行任何二次渲染或压缩，直接对文件进行“物理切割”。 【核心功能】 闪电般的导出速度：无需重新编码，几秒钟即可导出数GB的超大视频。 100% 保留极清原画：全面支持 4K, 8K, 60帧, HDR 及杜比视界。进去什么画质，出来就是什么画质。零偏色、零画质损耗。 完美保留元数据：裁剪后的视频将完整保留原始拍摄日期、时间与 GPS 坐标。让您的相册时间线依然井井有条！ 毫秒级精准裁剪：极简的时间轴操作，精准设定起点与终点，轻松剔除多余废片。 随时随地导入：直接从系统相册或“文件”App导入。外出时在手机上快速处理 DJI 大疆无人机、GoPro 原始素材的完美利器。

6767180995.name: Pontus Focus & ColorChecker
6767180995.description: Three tools I kept wishing existed in a single app, so I fixed it. FOCUS CHART A full-screen Siemens star for verifying lens sharpness on set. Place the phone at your subject distance, open up to your working aperture, and shoot. The radial spokes should stay crisp at the centre. Any smearing or moiré tells you the camera is front- or back-focusing. Fast and practical. No dedicated test chart to carry, no setup. COLORCHECKER CLASSIC An on-screen recreation of the Calibrite ColorChecker Classic. 24 reference patches available in sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, and Rec. 709. Most useful on multi-camera setups. Place the phone in front of each camera under identical exposure settings, shoot the chart, then pull the clips into your colour tool and align the patches. It gives you a consistent colour baseline across every angle before the grade even starts. This isn't a replacement for a physical chart. Real light on real pigment will always be more accurate. But when you're moving between setups quickly and need all your cameras speaking the same language, it gets the job done. DIGITAL SLATE Set your own time or use on-device time. Perfect for syncing multiple cameras. No timecode support unfortunately but on the other hand there is no timecode to worry about.

6785076374.name: Backrooms Piano
6785076374.description: Step out of reality and into a sample-based instrument built for the space between rooms: faded pianos, uneasy pads, room tones and half-remembered melodies. Made for liminal space, dreamcore and the particular dread of a place that's empty when it shouldn't be. Whether you're scoring analogue horror, building dreamcore loops, or just want a keyboard that sounds wrong in interesting ways, Backrooms Piano gives you a deep, atmosphere-first instrument designed around four custom effects. SOUND DESIGN, NOT JUST SAMPLES Presets are grouped into Keys, Pads, Soundscapes and Ambience, each one built to sit somewhere between familiar and not quite right. FOUR EFFECTS BUILT FOR THE GENRE LAPSE: tape-motor drift and seasick wobble, like old machinery losing its grip WEAR: ages the sound, rolling off the top end and adding instability and dust ROOM: from close and dry to a washed-out, oversized reverb DISTANCE: pulls the source away, softening the highs and revealing a filtered echo behind it FULL PERFORMANCE CONTROL A velocity-sensitive, multi-touch keyboard with octave shifting and note latch for hands-free drones and pads. Full ADSR shaping on pitched presets, so you can go from a natural attack to slow, creeping swells. BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD Backrooms Piano runs as a standalone app on both iPhone and iPad, so you can explore ideas, audition presets and play live wherever you are. IMPORTANT: RECORDING REQUIRES AN AUv3 HOST The standalone app is for playing and exploring sounds. It does not record, sequence or save what you play on its own. To record your performance, sequence it, or automate parameters, you need to open Backrooms Piano as an AUv3 instrument inside a host app such as GarageBand, AUM, Cubasis, Logic Pro, or any other AUv3-compatible host. If you want to keep what you play, make sure you have a host app installed before you buy. More presets are on the way in future updates. Disclaimer: This app and its associated content are independent creations inspired by the Backrooms internet phenomenon. They are not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or associated with A24, Kane Parsons, The Backrooms feature film, or any of their respective rights holders.

FOUR EFFECTS BUILT FOR THE GENRE LAPSE: tape-motor drift and seasick wobble, like old machinery losing its grip WEAR: ages the sound, rolling off the top end and adding instability and dust ROOM: from close and dry to a washed-out, oversized reverb DISTANCE: pulls the source away, softening the highs and revealing a filtered echo behind it FULL PERFORMANCE CONTROL A velocity-sensitive, multi-touch keyboard with octave shifting and note latch for hands-free drones and pads. Full ADSR shaping on pitched presets, so you can go from a natural attack to slow, creeping swells. BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD Backrooms Piano runs as a standalone app on both iPhone and iPad, so you can explore ideas, audition presets and play live wherever you are. IMPORTANT: RECORDING REQUIRES AN AUv3 HOST The standalone app is for playing and exploring sounds. It does not record, sequence or save what you play on its own. To record your performance, sequence it, or automate parameters, you need to open Backrooms Piano as an AUv3 instrument inside a host app such as GarageBand, AUM, Cubasis, Logic Pro, or any other AUv3-compatible host. If you want to keep what you play, make sure you have a host app installed before you buy. More presets are on the way in future updates. 6767151538.name: NUMEN：重拾数学直觉
6767151538.description: "不是背公式,而是开始理解的那一刻。" NUMEN 不是一款题库应用。 它是为每一个曾经放弃数学、又想重新找回数学直觉的人而做的应用。 ■ 它,不一样 其他数学应用: 定义 → 公式 → 练习 → 答错 NUMEN: 体验 → 发现规律 → 直觉 → 定义 你用手指触摸,拖动滑块,亲眼看着数值变化。分数的一块,函数曲线上的一点,负数的方向 —— 每一个概念,都作为"会动的数学"重新活过来。 ■ 它为谁而做? 课程中断、放弃了数学的初高中生 厌倦了补习班式讲解的人 想看懂投资、统计、AI 的上班族 想重新感受"我不是笨,只是断了连接"的每一个人 ■ 核心功能 用手指触摸的互动课程 33 节课,10 个阶段 —— 感觉·关系·变化·偶然·形状·旋转·极限·斜率·累积·方向 直觉在先,定义在后 先看现象,再发现规律,然后定义才出现 每天 5〜10 分钟 轻松坚持,却扎实地找回直觉 连续打卡 每天一点点,不中断 四种语言 韩语·英语·日语·简体中文 —— 每节课正文全部翻译 iPhone·iPad 通用 完全离线 无广告,无网络请求,不收集个人信息 ■ 为什么是 NUMEN? 你并不是不擅长数学。 只是概念与概念之间 —— 的连接,断了。 NUMEN 的设计,就是让你 —— 用手,把它们重新接上。 "哦 —— 原来我不笨, 只是连接断了而已。" 愿你再次遇见这句话。 ■ 隐私优先 NUMEN 不收集任何个人信息。所有学习进度只保存在你的设备里。没有广告 SDK,没有分析工具,没有外部 API。 ■ 价格 应用下载 —— 免费 Phase 1–3(12 节课,约 60 分钟)—— 免费 Phase 4–10(21 节课)—— 一次性内购,永久解锁。无广告,无订阅,无续费。 ■ 后续更新 Phase 5–10 内容扩展 学习回顾 / 笔记页面 现在就开始。 数学的直觉 —— 不是背出来的 —— 而是找回来的。

Whether you're just starting out or looking to take your game to the next level, WinPoker provides everything you need to dominate at the poker table. LEARN FROM SCRATCH Understand the rules, hand rankings, and fundamental strategies with our structured lessons. From complete beginner to advanced player - the content adapts to your skill level. TEST YOUR KNOWLEDGE With over 80 quiz questions, you can test your poker knowledge and reinforce what you've learned. Can you achieve 15 perfect rounds in a row? CALCULATE YOUR ODDS The built-in odds calculator helps you understand pot odds and equity in real-time. Learn when a call is profitable and when you should fold. 6763529355.description: 「小白学骑行」是一款面向骑行新手的成长型学习与记录应用，围绕“学得到、做得到、坚持得下去”三件事，提供从入门到进阶的完整陪伴。应用内置系统化图文课程，覆盖选车尺码、头盔灯光、刹车变速、城市通行礼仪、爬坡下坡、骑行姿势、拉伸恢复、补给策略、常见故障处理等高频主题，让你在碎片时间也能快速掌握关键知识。 除了“会看”，更强调“会做”。你可以使用出车安全检查清单，在每次出发前确认胎压、刹车、灯光等重要项目；通过骑行日志记录时长、里程、天气与体感，逐步看见自己的变化；借助每周目标与进度反馈，建立稳定的骑行节奏。应用还提供 4 周训练计划与知识测验，帮助你把学习内容转化为实际动作，减少“看了很多却不知道怎么开始”的困扰。 在日常使用中，「小白学骑行」也注重体验与激励：保养提醒帮助你及时照顾车辆状态，路线笔记便于沉淀常骑线路和注意点，成就徽章记录每一次坚持带来的成长。整体界面采用清晰的分区与轻量动效，信息结构直观，初学者也能快速上手。无论你是刚买第一台车、准备通勤骑行，还是希望更科学地提升体能与安全意识，这款应用都能成为你从“小白”走向“稳定骑行者”的实用助手。

Built for photography, computer vision, engineering, education and scientific imaging, ClearLab combines practical image processing tools with technical analysis in one focused workflow. Image Tools Crop and resize images Scale images up or down Rotate and flip Inspect image properties and dimensions Enhancement White Balance CLAHE Contrast Gamma Sharpening Color Balance and Color Boost Noise Reduction and Median Filtering Image Analysis Histogram with RGB and luminance channels RGB Parade Waveform monitor Horizontal and vertical Line Profile Pixel Inspector with RGB, HSV, Lab, HEX and luminance values Image statistics including mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum values Canny, Sobel and Laplacian edge detection Analysis results can be exported as PNG or CSV where supported, making ClearLab useful alongside MATLAB, Python, Excel and other technical workflows. 6754233437.name: Meowcard AI: Cat Mood Diary
6754233437.description: MY STORY Every photo you take of your cat is a small story. MeowCard began with my own cat, Ribo — a quiet little soul who would come home, meow softly, and sit beside me in silence. I often talked to him about my day, but I never really knew what he was thinking. So I built MeowCard: a gentle mood diary that helps you understand your cat’s little feelings, and lets you leave a note of your own — a living journal for the tiny moments we share with the cats we love. HOW TO USE 1. Upload photos of your cat — anytime, any amount MeowCard turns each photo into a simple, beautiful diary entry. 2. Let AI read your cat’s mood Every photo is softly interpreted using cues from feline behavior research, including ethograms and CATFACs (Cat Facial Action Coding System). MeowCard analyzes expression, posture, ear position, and overall vibe to create a mood card for your cat. 3. Add your own note Swipe to open a small “Surprise Note” and write what you felt in that moment — a thought, a memory, a tiny piece of your day. Your diary grows with every photo. No pressure, no streaks, no schedules — just effortless memories of your cat, one mood card at a time. NOT A TRACKER, NOT A DIAGNOSTIC TOOL MeowCard isn’t built for monitoring or strict logging. It’s for cat lovers who simply want to understand their cats a little better, and keep a warm, shared journal of their life together. You upload the moments — we help you keep them safe, soft, and easy to revisit. IF YOU HAVE ANY FEEDBACK OR QUESTIONS Reach us anytime at meowcard.ai@gmail.com NOTE MeowCard provides light mood interpretation inspired by feline behavior research. It is not a medical, behavioral, or diagnostic tool. 6754233437.fullDescription: MY STORY Every photo you take of your cat is a small story. MeowCard began with my own cat, Ribo — a quiet little soul who would come home, meow softly, and sit beside me in silence. I often talked to him about my day, but I never really knew what he was thinking. So I built MeowCard: a gentle mood diary that helps you understand your cat’s little feelings, and lets you leave a note of your own — a living journal for the tiny moments we share with the cats we love. HOW TO USE 1. Upload photos of your cat — anytime, any amount MeowCard turns each photo into a simple, beautiful diary entry. 2. Let AI read your cat’s mood Every photo is softly interpreted using cues from feline behavior research, including ethograms and CATFACs (Cat Facial Action Coding System). MeowCard analyzes expression, posture, ear position, and overall vibe to create a mood card for your cat. 3. Add your own note Swipe to open a small “Surprise Note” and write what you felt in that moment — a thought, a memory, a tiny piece of your day. Your diary grows with every photo. No pressure, no streaks, no schedules — just effortless memories of your cat, one mood card at a time. NOT A TRACKER, NOT A DIAGNOSTIC TOOL MeowCard isn’t built for monitoring or strict logging. It’s for cat lovers who simply want to understand their cats a little better, and keep a warm, shared journal of their life together. You upload the moments — we help you keep them safe, soft, and easy to revisit. 6473744011.name: Kalimba App With Songs Numbers
6473744011.description: Learn Kalimba fast with numbers. Learn Kalimba with numbers offline. What are the origins of the Kalimba? The origins of the kalimba can be found in Africa where this instrument would have been invented twice: about 3000 years ago on the west coast towards Cameroon, as an instrument completely in wood with bamboo, rattan or palm blades, and there is about 1300 years old in the Zambezi where we find traces of it with keylimba metal strips. Kalimba is the name given by the ethnomusicologist Hugh Tracey in the 1950s when he began to introduce in the West this musical instrument of African origin, called mbira by the Shonas ethnic group of Zimbabwe. The mbira is an emblematic instrument of the Shonas culture. This instrument has several names depending on the geographical area where it is used: likembe, sanza or senza in Cameroon and Congo, mbira in Zimbabwe and Malawi, lukeme, karimba in Uganda … The Europeans called it thumb keylimba or finger piano but It is under the name of kalimba that we now designate all the thumb pianos that are not traditional in Africa. Mbira keylimba remains the generic name used for traditional African thumb pianos. Kalimba number. Learn Kalimba fast. learn Kalimba fast with numbers. You don´t need to learn the music theory! You follow a brilliant number system that we developed and thanks to it you can play famous songs immediately. Learn Kalimba with numbers - Learn Kalimba fast is for anyone looking to learn the Kalimba from scratch or those who have prior knowledge and want to continue learning by practicing playing along with their favorite songs. The app is ideal to improve your memory, coordination, concentration, peripheral vision and last but not least fast reaction and sharp eye. Listen to the rhythm of the Kalimba classic songs and learn how to play it: Jingle bells Christmas song Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star Mary Had a Little Lamb Row Row Row Your Boat Features of Learn Kalimba faster with numbers. Learn Kalimba from scratch. 100% free, reliable, and fast. A highly user-friendly approach. Kalimba learning like never before with an easy interface, full keys, and more. Transform yourself into a Kalimba master with this Kalimba everyone app. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6762054855.name: AllergyBuster: Ingredient Scan
6762054855.description: When you have a food allergy, every ingredient matters. You read every label. You ask questions at every restaurant. You check every snack at every event. Try it completely free for 14 days. After that, unlock lifetime access for a single $7.99 payment — no subscription, no recurring charges, ever. AllergyBuster helps you identify allergens, review ingredients, and make informed decisions quickly. Whether you're shopping, dining out, or attending a party, AllergyBuster puts food allergy information at your fingertips. ANSWERS IN SECONDS At the grocery store, school bake sale, birthday party, restaurant, or on the go, AllergyBuster helps you check food ingredients and allergen information fast. BARCODE SCANNER — Scan product barcodes and receive an instant allergen breakdown. No typing. No searching. INGREDIENT PHOTO SCAN — Take a photo of an ingredient label and AllergyBuster analyzes the ingredients for allergens, including small print and difficult-to-read packaging. FOOD & INGREDIENT SEARCH — Search foods, snacks, beverages, ingredients, and products by name for detailed allergen information. RESTAURANT ALLERGEN SEARCH — Find allergen menus from major restaurant chains and access official allergen information directly from restaurant websites before you order. ASK JEEVES AI ASSISTANT — Research ingredients, allergens, food allergy topics, and safety questions with your personal allergy assistant. DAILY ALLERGY TIPS — Learn practical food allergy safety tips and best practices every day. IDENTIFY HIDDEN ALLERGENS AllergyBuster helps identify allergens and highlights important ingredient information, including "may contain" statements and shared-equipment disclosures when available. Coverage includes major allergens such as: Peanuts • Tree Nuts • Dairy • Milk • Eggs • Wheat • Gluten • Soy • Fish • Shellfish • Sesame • Mustard • Sulfites • Lupin Great for reviewing food products, ingredients, cosmetics, personal care products, and health & beauty items. DESIGNED FOR FAMILIES Parents, caregivers, teachers, students, and individuals with food allergies use AllergyBuster to make shopping and dining decisions with greater confidence. PRIVACY FIRST No account required. No personal information required. No personal allergy profiles stored. Your searches and information remain on your device whenever possible. One Purchase. Full Access. No Subscriptions. No hidden fees.

6746349629.name: Sentry - Just Step Away
6746349629.description: Never worry about leaving your Mac unattended again!** Picture this: you're coding in a coffee shop when nature calls. You don't want to lug your laptop to the restroom, but you're worried about security. Simply activate Sentry and step away with confidence! What Sentry Does:** Smart Detection** - Monitors lid closure, network disconnection, and power unplugging Instant Alerts** - Plays progressive alarm sounds and sends push notifications Video Recording** - Automatically records when suspicious activity is detected Always Visible** - Overlay interface stays on top of all windows Perfect for:** Coffee shops and public spaces Shared workspaces Libraries and study areas Any time you need to step away briefly Key Features:** Real-time monitoring of multiple triggers Automatic video evidence recording Progressive alarm system Remote notifications via Bark Always-on-top status display Protect your Mac the smart way. Activate Sentry and step away worry-free! Tech Notes: You may need to disable sleep using administer privilege in advance. Either to use `pmset` command or install the SleepHoldService. Navigate to GitHub for more information. It is not required but recommended. See the link below. https://github.com/Lakr233/Sentry/?tab=readme-ov-file#installation---disable-auto-sleep Sentry or Sentry Mode is not a feature provided by macOS.**

6758077572.name: Mood Life - 情绪人生 | 心情记录 | 情绪日记
6758077572.trackName: Mood Life - 情绪人生 | 心情记录 | 情绪日记
6758077572.description: 【一个“情绪记录者”的自白，也是为你开发的App】 曾经，我只是想找一个地方，切实记录下每天流动的情绪。 但试遍了市面上的App，却发现它们大多只允许我在一天记录一种情绪。 ——今天，是“开心”，还是“难过”？ 这不对。 我们的内心明明更像一片天气多变的森林，晨间有雾，午后放晴，傍晚或许又掠过一阵微风。 每一天，怎么可能只有一种情绪？ 那一刻我明白，我需要一个工具，它能允许我像呼吸一样自然、随时地，捕捉当下最真实的感受。 于是，我为自己，也为可能有同样困惑的你，开发了 Mood Life。 它不复杂，只专注于做好“记录”这一件事： 随时记录，即刻捕捉：无论是通勤时的片刻安宁，还是会议后的短暂疲惫，随时打开，定格此刻心情的涟漪。 一日千面，尽可收藏：你的“上午高效”、“午后倦怠”和“夜晚灵感”，都值得被分别看见和安放。拒绝为一天强行定义。 情绪气候图：随时回顾，你的情绪不再是模糊的记忆，而是一幅真实的“内心气候图”，清晰、直观，帮你看见自己都未曾察觉的规律。 我们相信，真正的情绪管理，始于不带评判的观察。 而观察的第一步，就是允许所有情绪发生，并忠实地记录它们。 Mood Life 目前就是这个纯粹的开始——一个足够自由、足够包容的情绪记录本。 未来，我们将基于这些真实的记录，为你带来更深度的「东方疗愈」探索。但所有美好旅程的第一步，都是：看见、治愈。 欢迎你，从这里开始，练习对自己保持诚实与好奇。

6781510036.name: 时光药检
6781510036.description: 时光药检（ChronoCure）是一款极简的健康管理应用：以疾病为维度，把每天的用药、定期的检查和报告单照片放在一处，帮你按时服药、按时复查。 【用药提醒与打卡】 自定义药品名称、剂量、颜色与每天的服药时间 今日待办按疾病分组，点一下即可完成打卡 定时推送用药提醒；错过打卡 30 分钟后会再提醒一次，已打卡的时段不再打扰 【疾病管理】 按疾病组织药品与检查计划，康复后可一键结束 已结束的疾病不再生成待办，也不再推送提醒 【检查计划与提醒】 为每个疾病设置检查计划：下次日期、提前 1/3/7 天提醒、固定天数重复周期 标记完成后自动排期下一次；同一天的检查合并为一条提醒 【报告单照片留存】 化验单、报告单拍照或从相册选择，随检查记录保存 全屏查看、缩放翻阅，可随时导出分享 【统计与日历】 日历视图回顾每一天的用药与检查 连续打卡天数、近 7 天与总体完成率、各药品完成率 【iCloud 备份与导出】 一键备份到你自己的 iCloud Drive，换机可整体恢复 自动备份在数据变更后进行（有频控）；也可导出全部数据与照片

6772919070.name: FMO- Dashboard
6772919070.description: FMO-Dashboard 是为业余无线电 FMO 用户设计的实时仪表盘与通联日志工具。 它将 FMO 设备中的通联信息整理成更适合手机和平板查看的界面，帮助你在值守、收听和回顾通联记录时，更快了解当前网络中正在发生什么。 主要功能： 实时仪表盘 打开 App 后可查看当前或最近发言呼号、QTH、网格、相对方位、距离、当前中继以及最近通联列表。 通联日志 支持同步和导入 FMO 通联日志，按时间查看通联记录，并展示呼号、时间、QTH、模式、中继、留言等信息。 老朋友回溯 自动识别历史通联过的呼号，支持查看与某个呼号的历史通联记录，方便快速回忆过往通联情况。 呼号语音播报 支持通联播报和新呼号提示，呼号可按 NATO 字母解释法播报，适合值守时减少频繁看屏幕的需求。 多地址管理 可保存多个 FMO 地址，支持局域网 IP、fmo.local 以及可访问的远程地址，便于在不同网络环境中使用。 数据管理 支持 FMO 日志导入、同步、备份和导出，方便在不同设备间保留和整理通联数据。 本 App 在BH5HSJ的“FMOLogs”项目基础上开发，不是 FMO 官方应用，不提供无线电发射功能。它用于连接用户自己的 FMO 设备或查看用户导入的通联日志数据。

6757598452.name: 空气网球-AerTennis
6757598452.description: 空气网球（AerTennis），一款专为网球爱好者打造的趣味体感网球应用。无需实体球拍、球网与专业场地，依托手机高精度传感器捕捉挥拍动作，在家、户外、通勤途中都能随时体验挥拍乐趣，让网球运动打破空间限制，轻松享受击球快感。 目前应用已正式上线 iOS 平台，适配 iOS 17.0 及以上系统，搭载陀螺仪与加速度计的 iPhone 均可流畅使用。 全程无广告！一次性买断制，永久畅享全部功能，后续版本持续免费更新！ 功能特色 精准体感识别，还原真实挥拍体验 高频采样体感引擎，精准识别正手、反手、发球三大经典网球动作。内置双重防抖机制，有效避免误识别，每一次挥拍都能被精准捕捉，贴合专业击球动作逻辑。 智能球速测算，解锁击球爆发力 采用加速度 + 挥拍幅度双重算法计算球速，测速区间 50~210km/h，从新手轻挥到专业发力全面覆盖。直观展示你的击球时速，清晰感知每一次发力变化。 多维实时反馈，打造沉浸式赛场 融合震动触觉、专属击球音效、动态炫光动画三重反馈，挥拍瞬间同步响应。模拟真实球场击球质感，居家运动也能拥有身临其境的对战体验。 专业数据记录，见证每一步成长 自动留存 7 天击球数据，生成可视化趋势图表。实时统计每日击球次数、历史最高时速，清晰记录训练轨迹，量化运动成果，助力稳步提升球技。 极简交互设计，上手零门槛 界面简洁清爽，动画流畅自然。操作逻辑通俗易懂，点击即可开启监测，实时预览动作状态，新手也能快速上手，一键完成数据查看与记录。 核心亮点详解 【全动作精准识别 适配多种击球姿势】 专注网球经典动作识别，精准区分正手、反手、发球动作，算法经过深度优化，动作识别稳定可靠，无论是日常练习还是趣味挑战都能完美适配。 【专业球速测算 覆盖全阶段球友】 从休闲娱乐到专项发力训练，50-210km/h 超大测速范围满足新手、业余球友、网球爱好者不同需求，客观反馈击球力度与爆发力。 【7 天数据可视化 训练有据可依】 长期记录击球数据，趋势图表直观展现训练状态，告别盲目练习。随时回看历史记录，总结动作问题，让训练更具科学性。 【纯净使用环境 买断畅玩无干扰】 应用全程无开屏广告、无弹窗广告、无强制推送。采用一次性买断模式，一次购买永久使用，所有功能全部开放，版本更新免费体验新内容。 如果你是网球新手、业余球友、居家运动爱好者，在使用过程中有功能改进建议、玩法创意，或是想交流挥拍技巧，欢迎加入专属网球同好社群交流探讨。 网球爱好者交流社群：【微信】melixc 想了解版本更新、趣味玩法、训练小技巧，可关注账号持续跟进。

6780030509.name: 财镜
6780030509.description: 一款简洁、私密的个人净资产记录工具。 记录你拥有的资产和负债，看着净资产随时间变化。资产可用多种货币持有——财镜会按欧洲央行的每日汇率，将所有金额换算为你的基准货币。 你的数据始终属于你 无需账户，无需注册，无需登录。 你的持仓、余额和备注默认只保存在本机。 可选的 iCloud 同步（默认关闭）采用端到端加密，仅同步到你自己的私人 iCloud——数据进入你的 Apple 账户，绝不会发给我们。 唯一从网络获取的是公开的汇率数据 记录真正重要的 资产与负债，分类清晰。 每日净资产快照，让你看清趋势。 可为任意一天添加备注——记住数字变化的原因。 支持多币种，自动换算。 简洁、专注的设计，不打扰你。

6757311508.name: Tuner Pro 手表版
6757311508.description: 忘掉手忙脚乱地找手机或携带笨重的设备吧。Tuner Pro 将您的 Apple Watch 变成一个精准、专业级的半音调音器，随时随地伴您左右。 专为 watchOS 设计，Tuner Pro 利用您手腕上的麦克风以惊人的准确度检测音高，使其非常适合在排练、演出或练习时快速调音。 主要功能： 腕上优先设计：针对 Apple Watch 屏幕优化的界面。清晰、高对比度的视觉效果，即使在弱光或舞台上也能轻松读取。 半音精准：准确检测任何音符。非常适合特殊调音。 独立运行：无需连接 iPhone。随时随地调音。 静音麦克风：不需要调音时，只需轻点一下即可静音麦克风。 调整灵敏度：转动数码表冠即可调整麦克风灵敏度（输入音量）。 触感反馈：当音准完美时，您会感到手腕上的轻微震动（非常适合嘈杂环境）。 电池高效：轻量级引擎设计，旨在最大限度地减少电池使用。 支持乐器： 完美支持原声吉他、电吉他、贝斯、尤克里里、小提琴、大提琴、中提琴、班卓琴、曼陀林和管乐器。 为何选择 TUNER PRO？ 无论您是学习第一个和弦的初学者，还是正在巡演的专业人士，拥有一个真正“附着”在您身上的调音器，都将改变您的演奏体验。不再需要到处寻找夹式调音器。只需抬起手腕，即可开始演奏。 立即下载 Tuner Pro，告别跑调烦恼。

6758022965.name: TranscribeEN: Video to Text
6758022965.description: TranscribeEN converts audio and video in any language into accurate English text transcripts. Whether you're learning a new language, creating subtitles, or need to understand foreign media, TranscribeEN makes it easy. POWERFUL TRANSLATION & TRANSCRIPTION Supports any language: Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic, French, German, Chinese, and more Automatic language detection Accurate English translation and transcription On-device AI processing for privacy and offline use Fast processing powered by advanced speech recognition PROFESSIONAL TRANSCRIPTION FEATURES Real-time synchronized transcript highlighting Word-level and segment-level synchronization Clean, easy-to-read transcript display Save transcripts to your library for later access MEDIA PLAYBACK CONTROLS Watch video or listen to audio while reading English transcript Play, pause, and skip controls 10-second skip forward and backward Seek to any point in your media Background audio playback support FLEXIBLE EXPORT OPTIONS Export as text files (.txt) for documents and notes Export as SRT subtitle files for videos Share transcripts via Messages, Mail, or any app Perfect for YouTube subtitles, language study, or accessibility PERFECT FOR: Language Learners - Understand foreign content in English Content Creators - Add English subtitles to international videos Students - Transcribe foreign language lectures and courses Professionals - Translate international meetings and presentations Accessibility - Make foreign media accessible in English SUPPORTED FILE FORMATS: Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC Video: MP4, MOV, M4V, AVI PRIVACY & SECURITY All processing happens on your device No cloud uploads or data sharing Your files stay private and secure Works completely offline after initial setup HOW IT WORKS: 1. Select an audio or video file from your device 2. TranscribeEN automatically detects the language 3. Watch or listen while reading the English transcript 4. Save to library or export as text/subtitles PROFESSIONAL QUALITY TranscribeEN uses state-of-the-art AI speech recognition technology (Whisper) to deliver accurate transcriptions. The app is designed for productivity with a clean, modern interface that makes transcription fast and easy. Whether you need to translate a Japanese podcast, add English subtitles to a Korean video, transcribe a Spanish lecture, or understand any foreign language content, TranscribeEN is your all-in-one solution.

6753863255.name: GeoPulse: GPS Visualizer Pro
6753863255.description: Experience GPS like never before. GeoPulse: GPS Visualizer Pro transforms raw location data into interactive visual analytics for athletes, drivers, pilots, and explorers. Visualize every movement in real time — speed, altitude, accuracy, distance, and course — with smooth live charts and map overlays powered by Apple Maps. Instant GPS Insight: Watch your live position, speed, and direction update with second-by-second accuracy. Interactive Map View: Auto-centered Apple Map displays your path, ideal for navigation or performance review. Professional-Grade Metrics: Track speed, pace, distance, altitude variance, and horizontal accuracy. Multi-Mode Engine: Switch between Fitness, Automotive, Aviation, and Marine profiles for adaptive data precision. Export Anywhere: Save your sessions as GPX or CSV for import into Strava, Google Earth, or analytics tools. Detailed History: Review your latest 100 readings with visualized graphs for speed and altitude trends. Offline Support: Works without network once GPS signal is active. Perfect for: Athletes optimizing performance, drivers monitoring routes, drone pilots testing stability, or developers analyzing GPS accuracy. Unique Value Unlike typical GPS trackers, GeoPulse combines professional diagnostics, real-time analytics, and custom export options in a sleek, native iOS interface. It’s designed for precision testing, visualization, and performance tracking, not just movement logging. Other GPS apps only show paths — GeoPulse shows the science behind them. True native SwiftUI + Core Location experience for instant responsiveness. Graphical visualization engine that plots live speed and altitude fluctuations. Designed for developers, professionals, and athletes alike. No ads. No unnecessary permissions. 100% on-device. GeoPulse provides a fusion of engineering accuracy and consumer simplicity. It appeals across markets: athletes, pilots, drivers, researchers, travelers, and app testers — each needing precise, visual, exportable GPS data. Its offline reliability, professional polish, and export capability position it among the most advanced GPS utilities ever released for iOS.

6783249633.name: 疯狂小火车 for watch - 手表轨道解谜益智闯关游戏
6783249633.trackName: 疯狂小火车 for watch - 手表轨道解谜益智闯关游戏
6783249633.description: 《疯狂小火车》是一款专为 Apple Watch 设计的轨道连接益智游戏。 你需要旋转每一个轨道方块，让起点和终点成功连通。当路线接好，小火车会自动出发，沿着轨道驶向终点。 游戏节奏轻松，但关卡会逐渐变难。前面的关卡适合快速上手，后面的关卡会加入更多干扰轨道、岔路和更大的地图，需要更仔细地观察和规划。 特色： 专为 Apple Watch 设计，单手即可游玩 旋转轨道，连接起点和终点 小火车自动发车，完成关卡更有成就感 5 个主题场景，300 个关卡 难度逐步提升，适合儿童和成年人 支持中文和英文 无广告，无内购 适合碎片时间游玩，也适合喜欢轻量益智游戏的玩家慢慢挑战。

6763532372.description: 「小白学谈判」面向想系统提升沟通与谈判能力的初学者，用清晰的结构和轻量的学习节奏，把抽象的原则拆成听得懂、用得上的步骤。应用围绕「学—练—用」设计：你可以按章节循序渐进，了解谈判中的常见误区、心理与策略；通过测验与每日一练巩固概念，在情景演练里面对分支式对话，练习临场反应与表达；工具区提供会前清单与谈判备忘，帮助你在重要场合前理清目标、底线与话术要点，并在事后做简短复盘。 内容覆盖从开场、倾听、诉求表达到让步与收尾等常见场景，并辅以案例与术语梳理，方便对照现实工作与生活里的协商、合作与分歧处理。学习进度、连续打卡与收藏等功能，让你能按自己的节奏推进，把零散经验慢慢沉淀成稳定习惯。 界面采用柔和配色与简洁布局，阅读与操作都尽量轻松，适合通勤或碎片时间打开学一点、练一点。无论你是职场新人、创业者，还是需要经常协调资源的普通用户，都可以从这里建立一套属于自己的谈判思维脚手架，在真实对话里更从容、更有章法。

6483687406.name: KingB Organ
6483687406.description: KingB is designed to capture the unique tones of the B and C series tonewheel organs. It uses a fresh modeling approach to generate tonewheel signals in real time, as well as to replicate the complex interplay of components that make the organ “sing”. Absolutely no samples are used. The interplay within the intricate network of tonewheels, components, wiring harnesses, and motor elements is synthesized to a convenient set of parameters. By using them, you are able to change the quirks of the underlying organ model. 6784604835.description: 同览 (BrowSync) 是一款 macOS 原生的跨浏览器分流与同步中枢。它打通 Safari、所有 Chromium 内核浏览器与 Firefox，智能分流链接并实时同步数据，为您统一浏览体验。打通 Safari、所有 Chromium 内核浏览器与 Firefox。根据规则智能分流链接，并实时同步书签与登录状态。纯本地运行，捍卫您的隐私。 主要功能 URL 分流：将同览设为 macOS 默认浏览器后，可根据域名、URL 规则、参数、来源应用或时间段，将链接自动定向到指定的浏览器。 书签同步：在 Safari、所有 Chromium 内核浏览器和 Firefox 之间实时同步书签。 状态同步：在各浏览器之间同步 Cookie、LocalStorage 和 sessionStorage，保持登录状态一致。 标签页共享：跨浏览器查看当前打开的标签页。自动过滤无痕模式及非 HTTP(S) 协议页面，并对重复的 URL 进行去重。 同步策略：支持单向同步（主从模式）、基于访问时间的最后写入者胜出、双向合并。 站点控制：通过白名单/黑名单管理同步范围，支持为特定网站设置独立策略。 本地网络：通信通过本地 WebSocket 守护进程 (ws://127.0.0.1:62333) 进行，不依赖外部服务器。 原生 macOS 应用：使用 SwiftUI 构建，支持深色/浅色主题、菜单栏集成和登录时启动。 iCloud 同步：通过 iCloud 在您的所有 Mac 设备之间自动同步分流规则、偏好设置和站点配置。 Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6774842090.name: AlarmCroc
6774842090.description: AlarmCroc 是一款专为早上难以起床的人打造的闹钟。 设置闹钟并选择一项起床任务。闹钟响起后，只有完成任务才会停止，因此你必须起身活动、动脑思考或开口说话，才能真正开始新的一天。AlarmCroc 专为爱赖床、起床困难，以及厌倦了“再睡五分钟”最后变成一小时的人而设计。 AlarmCroc 的使用方式： 1. 睡前设置闹钟并选择一项起床任务 2. 闹钟响起后，在 App 中完成指定任务 3. 只有完成任务后，闹钟才会停止 不能半睡半醒地关掉闹钟。没有轻松逃避的方法。 起床任务： 解数学题 做俯卧撑 拍摄天空照片 整理床铺 寻找随机物品 大声朗读一段《圣经》经文 大声说出一段自我肯定语 为什么大家选择 AlarmCroc： 彻底摆脱赖床循环 用行动醒来，而不是靠意志力 建立真正能够坚持的晨间习惯 把“起床”变成每天的一次小胜利 在最难起床的早晨依然坚持完成任务 不仅仅是一款普通闹钟： 原生 iOS 闹钟 — 基于 AlarmKit，因此闹钟会显示在锁定屏幕和灵动岛上 任务式唤醒 — 在完成任务之前，闹钟会一直响 App Block — 在完成任务之前，阻止分心应用（甚至防止删除 App） 连续打卡与徽章 — 追踪你的坚持，并随着时间解锁成就 晨间数据 — 查看起床时间、起床耗时、睡眠趋势，以及拍照任务留下的晨间回忆 闹钟日志 — 对比 App 内的闹钟与 iOS 已安排的闹钟，确保不会遗漏任何一个 主屏幕小组件 — 随时查看下一次闹钟和连续打卡记录 无限闹钟 — 工作日、周末、一次性闹钟，随你设置 有问题、建议或反馈？欢迎在 App 内联系我们，或发送邮件至 alarmcroc@gmail.com。 Terms of Use: https://alarmcroc.com/terms Privacy Policy: https://alarmcroc.com/privacy

6754695723.name: 休息提醒 - Step Away
6754695723.description: 在视疲劳发生前，先预防。 Step Away 是 Mac 上最智能的休息提醒应用。专为长时间面对屏幕的开发者、设计师、学生、游戏玩家和远程办公人群打造。 为什么选择 STEP AWAY 大多数休息应用只是弹通知。Step Away 会智能追踪你的工作状态，离开座位时自动暂停，返回后自动恢复，并用真实数据展示你的健康习惯。 护眼 — 20-20-20 规则 眼科医生建议每20分钟远眺20秒以预防视疲劳、头痛和视力模糊。Step Away 帮你完全自动化——无需意志力。 智能休息排程 设置短休息（每20-30分钟）和长休息（每1-3小时）。Step Away 在后台安静运行，在恰当的时刻提醒你。 专注模式 — 深度工作不被打断 激活专注模式暂停所有提醒。可选15、25、30、45、60或90分钟。自动同步 macOS 专注模式和勿扰模式。番茄工作法的理想搭档。 智能离座检测 离开座位，计时器自动暂停。回来后自动恢复。午餐时间永远不会被计入工作时间。 活动追踪 GitHub 风格热力图展示你的休息历史。追踪总休息次数、休息时间和类型——短休、长休、跳过。 引导式锻炼 眼部练习、颈部拉伸和呼吸训练内置于应用中。降低 RSI 风险，让你在一天结束时感觉更好。 原生 macOS 应用 菜单栏集成。开机自动启动。自定义通知。深色模式。一次购买——无订阅。 功能概览 20-20-20 护眼提醒 短休 + 长休智能排程 智能离座检测与自动暂停 专注模式（macOS 集成） 会议与屏幕共享检测（通话期间自动暂停） 专注流状态保护（持续工作时智能延迟提醒） 护眼暖色滤镜叠加（过滤屏幕蓝光） 多屏环境遮罩支持（完美覆盖所有屏幕） 带有番茄钟集成的菜单栏动态倒计时 HUD 活动热力图与休息历史 引导式眼部、颈部和呼吸练习 自定义休息时长和风格 音效和通知自定义 开机自动启动 一次购买——无订阅

6782038076.name: Drop That Due
6782038076.description: Never forget an expiry date again. Drop That Due helps you track all your expiring items in one simple, offline place. Whether it’s food, medicine, cosmetics, documents, or appliances — add them once, and let the app remind you before they expire. Simple & Quick Entry Add items with just a few taps: name, category, expiry date, purchase date, quantity, notes, and custom reminder days. Choose from preset categories like Food, Electronics, Medicine, Cosmetics, Documents, or create your own. Smart Reminders – Even When App Is Closed Schedule local notifications so you never miss a due date. Set a default reminder time or adjust it per item. Notifications appear even if the app is not running – because iOS handles them reliably. Badge Count at a Glance See the number of expiring or soon‑to‑expire items right on your home screen icon. The badge updates automatically as you add, edit, or consume items. Calendar Integration With one tap, add any item to your system calendar as an all‑day event. 6739949388.name: Achromator
6739949388.description: Ever wondered why everyone keeps going on about the beautiful colors of the sunset? Having trouble seeing if a tomato is ripe? What about bananas? Or maybe you just find the world to colorful and want to keep it a little more black-and-white for the day? Achromator translates all color from the phone video stream into unique animated textures. It encodes all hues and shades - without loss of information! It even keeps much of the structure found in color, like mixing, gradual blending and complementary hues. The pattern generator can be adjusted to your personal preference - pattern size, speed and selection of individual colors.

6763279953.name: 小白学瑜伽
6763279953.description: 「小白学瑜伽」面向刚开始接触瑜伽、希望在家就能安全练习的你。我们用最直白的中文讲解体式要领，配合柔和治愈的界面与图解，让你不用被专业术语吓退，也能一步步建立节奏感与身体觉知。 应用内收录多类基础体式，从热身、站姿、平衡到放松，每个动作都配有分步说明、常见错误提醒与安全提示，方便你对照练习、减少受伤风险。内置多套不同时长的跟练组合，适合晨起唤醒、久坐后舒缓肩颈，以及睡前放松；你也可以按喜好自选体式、设定停留时间，组合成专属练习序列，让训练更贴近自己的生活节奏。 此外还提供简单的呼吸引导工具，用清晰的节奏与视觉反馈，帮助你在练习前后快速平静下来。练习数据与收藏仅保存在你的设备上，随时打开就能继续上次的进度。无论你是想改善体态、缓解疲劳，还是培养运动习惯，都可以从这里温柔起步，把瑜伽变成日常里一小段属于自己的时间。

6761026960.name: Weather Time Widget
6761026960.description: Weather, date, and word time — all in one beautiful widget. Weather & Time Widget gives you everything you need at a glance, right on your home screen. No need for separate clock and weather widgets taking up space. One widget does it all. Pay once, enjoy forever. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads. What you get: Current temperature with high/low and feels-like Hourly and daily weather forecasts Live time and date with day of the week Humidity, wind speed, and wind direction UV index City name and location indicator Save your favorite cities: Add as many cities as you like and swipe between them in the app Search any city in the world Pin each widget to its own city, or let it follow your current location Tap a widget to jump straight to that city in the app Three widget sizes: Small — Quick current weather overview, time, date, day of the week and location. Medium — Current and forecast weather (Daily/hourly selectable), time, date, day of the week, location, humidity and wind. Large — The full picture with detailed conditions, forecast weather, wind and UV index. Choose your weather source: Open-Meteo for global coverage, with regional models for higher local accuracy NWS for enhanced accuracy in the United States, using live station observations Apple Weather, if you prefer Apple's own forecasts (in-app) Fully customizable: Dark, light, or auto theme (adapts to time of day) 24-hour or AM/PM time format Celsius or Fahrenheit — mph, m/s, km/h, or knots wind units Hourly or daily forecast view works worldwide Use your current location or search for any city Built to stay out of your way: Designed for low battery use, so a widget on your home screen costs you almost nothing Weather icons follow each city's own sunrise and sunset, so day and night are right wherever you're looking Careful icon matching tells scattered showers from thunderstorms, and broken cloud from overcast Available in English and Turkish Simple setup: Download the app Grant location access Add the widget(s) to your home screen Done

6783389906.name: Music Woo
6783389906.description: Music Woo is a player designed specifically for local music, supporting both iPhone and iPad across multiple platforms. It is ad free, smoothly plays offline music in various mainstream formats, and automatically organizes your collection by album and artist, keeping your music library tidy and your listening experience more enjoyable. It supports Chinese, English, French, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, and Arabic. Supported formats: MP3、AAC、WAV、FLAC AIFF、APE、DSD、DSF M4A、M4R、OGG、OPUS、WMA

6450902756.name: PureClip Photo
6450902756.description: PureClip Photo 简介 – 从视频中提取照片的终极工具。 通过轻松提取高质量照片，揭示您录制的视频或新剪辑中捕捉到的令人惊叹的时刻。 您是否知道每个视频都包含大量高分辨率快照，等待被发现和喜爱？ 通过这款直观且令人愉悦的应用程序，体验逐帧重温视频的魔力。 挖掘动态场景中未被注意到的隐藏宝石，并将它们永远冻结在时间里。 易于使用的应用程序并不意味着基本，该应用程序包含许多出色的功能，例如： 从您的默认视频文件夹、您的收藏夹、LivePhoto、连拍和最近视频中选择视频。 选择期间预览视频（包含日期、大小、持续时间、GPS 位置等信息）。 或者，使用照片扩展直接在照片应用程序中使用该应用程序。 快速操作图标快捷方式可快速打开最近的视频。 使用可滚动列表查找帧，或使用全屏和可缩放视频视图在视频中导航。 图像以与源视频格式匹配的格式保存（或根据需要明确保存为 png、heic、jpeg 文件）。 在较新的设备（和 iOS17）上，例如以 60 fps 的速度打开 4K HDR 视频，然后创建漂亮的 4K HDR 图像，并有大量照片可供选择。 图像可以保存在照片应用程序、文件应用程序中，或以不同方式导出。 GPS 和日期信息保存在导出的图像中。 如果需要，能够一次批量导出多张照片。 能够在导出之前裁剪图像（使用自定义或预定义的宽高比） 浅色和深色主题支持，辅助字体大小支持。

6775256032.description: 一款可在降低屏幕亮度的同时进行高画质录制的视频相机 App。 【主要功能】 ■ 黑屏模式 录制时会让设备屏幕完全变黑。即使在昏暗或安静的环境中，也不用担心屏幕亮光打扰他人，让你可以更安心地进行拍摄。 ■ 浏览器模式 可在 App 内浏览器中查看网页、日程、资料、脚本、地图等参考信息的同时进行录制。 录制的视频会先保存到 App 内的录制库中。录制库可使用 Face ID、Touch ID 或设备密码进行保护。你可以只选择需要的视频，保存到“照片”App，或通过分享菜单导出。 【其他功能】 ・使用音量按钮开始/结束录制 ・打开 App 后立即开始录制 ・支持 4K / 60fps 的高画质录制 ・录制库 ・Face ID / Touch ID 锁定 ・将选中的视频保存到“照片”App ・支持长时间录制 这是一款实用的视频相机 App，旨在让录制更舒适，也让视频整理更轻松。 录制功能仅在 App 打开期间可用。如果关闭 App 或切换到其他 App，录制将会停止，视频会被安全保存。 录制时请负责任地使用本 App，并遵守拍摄地点的规定、适用法律，同时尊重周围人的隐私。

6502768925.name: Photoflare
6502768925.description: Photoflare is the premier native iOS client for PhotoPrism, the AI-powered open-source photo management platform. Access your self-hosted photo library from anywhere with a beautifully designed, privacy-focused app built specifically for iPhone and iPad. Browse Your Entire Library Explore your photos and videos in a stunning, responsive grid that adapts to any screen size. Enjoy smooth scrolling through thousands of images with intelligent thumbnail caching that keeps everything fast and fluid. Servers Add more than 1 server, see you items in a merged view or separated by server. Full Media Support Photos - View your images in full resolution Videos - Built-in video player with native controls Live Photos - Full Live Photo playback support, just like the Photos app Album Management Create, edit, favourite and organise albums directly from your device. Access your labels, faces and moments smart albums. Easy Uploads Upload photos and videos directly to your PhotoPrism server. Select from your photo library or import files, with real-time progress tracking and automatic album assignment. Enable daily backups to auto run your custom sync rules. Setup rules to sync specific local albums to your server albums - optionally ask iOS to delete the images from your local camera roll after import. Secure Authentication Username & password login Two-factor authentication (2FA/OTP) OpenID Connect (OIDC) support (Beta) Seamless Sync Real-time synchronisation keeps your library up-to-date via WebSocket connection (your server must support WebSockets for this). See new photos appear instantly as they're added to your server. Intelligent offline caching for fast image loading and offline browsing. Control the limits directly in the app. Beautiful Design Native interface and controls Full Dark Mode support Optionally enable Apple Intelligence to search your photos (uses on device models only) iPad specific UI iMessage app to allow sharing your library without leaving iMessage! Privacy Photoflare connects directly to YOUR PhotoPrism server. Your photos never pass through our servers. Your data stays yours. Requirements: Requires a self-hosted PhotoPrism server instance.

6785002346.name: 爱车记-您的专属用车管家
6785002346.trackName: 爱车记-您的专属用车管家
6785002346.description: 「爱车记」是一款为私家车主精心打造的用车管理应用，致力于将分散的用车信息收拢于一处：加油充电、保养维修、日常开支、保险年检与到期提醒，都能在这里找到归宿，让养车生活井井有条、从容不迫。 您可以管理多辆爱车，录入品牌型号、车牌与里程，随时切换查看不同车辆的数据。加油充电记录支持自动计算百公里油耗或电耗，帮助您了解用车成本的变化；保养维修、停车过路、美容装饰、保险等各类费用可按类别快速记账，统计页提供分类占比、月度趋势与油耗分析，财务状况一目了然。 应用内置灵活的提醒中心，支持按行驶里程或日历日期设置保养、保险续费、年检等提醒，重要事项临期即知。另有保险档案、违章备忘、事故记录、耗材更换追踪等功能，覆盖用车场景中那些容易遗忘却至关重要的细节。 界面设计简洁大方，首页提供快捷记账入口，记录页以时间线串联全部行程，操作顺手、查看清晰。您的数据可通过备份功能妥善保存与恢复，完整延续用车记忆。 爱车记，不只记录数字，更记录您与爱车共同走过的路程。每一次养护有凭有据，每一次出行心中有数——让对车的爱，看得见、算得清、记得住。

6481421437.name: Song IQ
6481421437.description: Tap the button to listen to any song that you hear. The iphone mic will record a small segment and then recognize the song. You can see the song details and open the track in the Tidal music app. Tap on the cover art to see song details and tap on the artist name to see a career summary. Swipe left on any track in your history to delete it. The best song finder, song recognition, and music identifier for Tidal and Qobuz users. Also support Apple Music and Spotify. Powered by Shazam song recognition. No need to log in and we do not collect any of your personal information.

6762064535.name: Live Step Counter
6762064535.description: Dynamic Island Step Counter shows your daily step count in the Dynamic Island and on your Lock Screen with a clean Live Activity that updates throughout the day. Track progress toward your daily goal at a glance, without opening the app. Dynamic Island Step Counter reads your step count using your iPhone’s motion data, lets you choose a goal that fits your routine, and keeps your Live Activity updated so your progress is always visible.

6758206964.name: Hydrabit
6758206964.description: HYDRABIT – Feel Better, One Sip at a Time Your body knows what it needs. Hydrabit simply helps you listen. Days slip by when you're focused, busy, or stuck in front of a screen. Before you know it, you haven't had a sip of water or a real break in hours. Hydrabit gently brings you back to yourself, helping you feel more energized, clear-headed, and taken care of without disrupting your flow. Hydration becomes effortless. With a simple tap, you log your water in the units you prefer, watch your progress grow throughout the day, and enjoy that quiet sense of accomplishment when you reach your goal. No pressure, no guilt. Just a steady rhythm that supports your well-being. But Hydrabit goes beyond water. It understands that your health isn't just about hydration, it's about balance. Throughout the day, it nudges you to stand up, stretch, or rest your eyes, rotating reminders naturally so you don't have to think about what your body needs next. These small moments add up to less stiffness, less strain, and more energy when it matters most. On Apple Watch, Hydrabit feels even more personal. A gentle tap on your wrist reminds you to drink or take a break, right when you need it. You can log drinks instantly, glance at your progress, and snooze reminders when life gets busy, all without pulling out your phone. Everything adapts to your schedule, not the other way around. Set the hours you want reminders, choose how often they appear, and let Hydrabit quietly work in the background while you stay focused on your day. Over time, you'll start to notice patterns: when you hydrate best, when you forget, and how your habits evolve. Your history is always there for you, and your data stays yours, ready to export whenever you want. Hydrabit is designed to feel calm, not demanding. There are no ads, no in-app purchases, no noisy gamification tactics competing for your attention. Just a clean, peaceful interface that makes caring for yourself feel natural and unforced. Whether you work long hours at a desk, rely on your Apple Watch, struggle with eye strain, or simply want to feel better in your body, Hydrabit fits quietly into your life and makes a real difference. Download Hydrabit today and start showing up for yourself: consistently, gently, and with intention. Your future self will feel it. KEY FEATURES: Set your daily water goal in ml or oz Quick-tap logging with customizable cup sizes Visual progress ring shows your daily achievement Intelligent micro-break reminders designed specifically for office workers and a stationary lifestyle Apple Watch integration for logging drinks directly from your wrist Gentle haptic reminders Snooze a break reminder if you are busy Set active hours (9am-9pm? 6am-midnight? You decide) Choose reminder intervals (60 min to 2 hours) Analytics for daily intake, drinking patterns, and total hydration history Export your data anytime NO gamification tricks NO in-app purchases NO third-party tracking or data collection PERFECT FOR: Remote workers and desk jobs Anyone trying to drink more water People experiencing eye strain Health-conscious individuals Apple Watch owners

6769225722.trackName: 数独时光-无广告经典数独

6760251490.name: TimeSpan: The Day Counter
6760251490.description: Every Second Counts. Whether it’s a long-awaited vacation, a loved one’s birthday, or a fitness goal, Spanoe helps you keep the excitement alive. Beautifully track the time remaining for all your important life events. Why You’ll Love TimeSpan: Stunning Visuals: Choose from a variety of themes and backgrounds to match the mood of your event. Precise Tracking: See exactly how many days, hours, and minutes are left. Smart Notifications: Get reminded as the big day approaches so you’re always prepared. Widgets: View your top countdowns directly from your Home Screen. Privacy First: Your data stays on your device. No tracking, no hassle. From weddings and graduations to simple weekend plans, let TimeSpan turn every wait into a celebration. Start counting down today!

6755321732.name: Timer4 - 重力计时器
6755321732.description: ​​Timer4 是一款创新的计时器应用，根据设备方向自动设置倒计时。 通过 CoreMotion 精准检测角度，并配合响应重力的物理界面即时切换预设时间。 ​-​ 正向 → 5 分钟 ​-​ 左侧 → 10 分钟 ​-​ 上下颠倒 → 30 分钟 ​-​ 右侧 → 1 小时 只需旋转设备，无需按按钮即可快速设定时间。 ​#​ 主要功能 ​-​ 物理互动界面 体验会随重力弹跳、碰撞的物体。界面始终保持水平，并在方向切换时平滑旋转。 ​-​ 即时时间切换 无需进入设置或菜单，仅通过设备方向即可切换常用计时时间。 ​-​ 智能方向感应 借助先进 CoreMotion 技术，实现精准、灵敏、顺畅的角度追踪。 ​-​ 沉浸式触觉反馈 当物体碰到边界时，提供逼真的触觉反馈。 ​#​ 适用于 番茄工作法 烹饪与烘焙 锻炼间歇 冥想、伸展 学习与休息循环 泡茶 快速提醒 四种方向都可以根据日常习惯自由自定义。 简单 — 旋转即可设定 直观 — 方向决定时间 美观 — 流畅动画与真实物理效果 灵活 — 面向高级用户的自定义选项 改变你使用计时器的方式。 立即体验 ​Timer4。 Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6759811127.name: BackCheckers
6759811127.description: BackCheckers is a fast-paced hockey strategy board game built for hockey lovers and board game enthusiasts. Designed for two players, this digital experience combines dice rolling, strategic movement, and real hockey-inspired gameplay in quick, intense matches. Whether you’re playing against a friend locally or challenging the CPU, every move matters. Game Features: Turn-based hockey gameplay Dice rolling with strategic movement 2-player local pass-and-play mode CPU opponent mode Digital scoreboard for physical board game play Built-in stat tracking Matches average 5–20 minutes Strategic, Fast, Competitive BackCheckers captures the look and feel of real hockey inside a structured board game format. 6763529090.name: 小白学围棋
6763529090.description: 「小白学围棋」面向刚接触或想系统补基础的棋友，把规则、术语和基本功放进手机里，随时打开就能学、能练。 课程从棋盘与棋子讲起，用图文配合棋盘示意图，帮你理解「气」、提子、打劫和终局胜负等核心概念；章节里穿插小测验，学完即可自测是否真正理解。术语表收录气、眼、目、劫、定式等常用说法，方便对照查阅，减少「听不懂讲解」的困扰。 练习区提供由浅入深的死活与吃子类题目，聚焦一线紧气、要点与断点等常见棋形，做对即可巩固手感。打谱摆棋支持自由摆子与路数切换，适合复盘、演示或自己设计小局面；双人对弈则方便亲友同机轮流落子，在实战中体会先后手与提子规则。 界面采用温和的纸木色调与简洁布局，棋盘与棋子清晰易点，并配有适度的动效与触感反馈，让学习过程更轻松。进度与做题记录保存在本机，打开应用即可接续上次学习。 无论你是完全零基础，还是想带孩子一起入门，「小白学围棋」都希望用清晰的内容与顺手的工具，陪你迈出围棋路上的前几步。

6466648716.name: DfT Know Your Traffic Signs
6466648716.description: This app will help you keep up to date with all the latest road and traffic signs to keep you safe on the road and pass your theory test. Know Your Traffic Signs is one of the essential source materials for all UK theory tests. This includes car, motorcycle, lorry, bus and coach, and approved driving instructors (ADI). Featuring over 1000 signs, markings and road layouts, this app is vital for learner drivers and riders, everyone who drives for work, approved driving instructors (ADIs) and trainers. Our app is suitable for all road users in the UK. This app can be used offline so that you can learn anytime, anywhere. KNOW YOUR TRAFFIC SIGNS navigate through an interactive copy of the Official Know Your Traffic Signs. It features images, diagrams, and useful links to support your understanding. designed to complement The Highway Code (which only has a limited selection of traffic signs and road markings), Know Your Traffic Signs is the perfect guide for improving your knowledge of UK traffic signs! STUDY AND PRACTICE assess your understanding of UK traffic and road signs by practicing a total of 150 questions. Got a question wrong? See the correct answer, note the explanation, and find out more with references to more useful DVSA guides! SEARCH FEATURE want to know more about ‘contraflow lanes’, ‘roundabouts’, or ‘minimum speed’ signs? Get straight to the content you need with our advanced search tool. ENGLISH VOICEOVER if reading is hard for you, like with dyslexia, or if you learn better by listening, use the voiceover feature in the test section to help you out. PROGRESS GAUGE backed by learning science, use the progress gauge to know when you're ready to pass your theory test! FEEDBACK missing something? Let us know what you’d like to see. 6757776981.name: 钓个鱼 - 钓鱼预录相机
6757776981.trackName: 钓个鱼 - 钓鱼预录相机
6757776981.description: 钓个鱼是一款为钓友准备的钓鱼预录相机和鱼获记录工具。它不是泛用相机，也不是天气地图工具，而是专注解决一个常见场景：中鱼、咬口、回收阶段来得太快，等你反应过来再按录像，精彩片段已经过去。 开启滚动预录后，钓个鱼会持续保留最近视频。中鱼后点一下保存最近片段，就能把刚刚发生的瞬间留下来。你也可以手动录像，或用语音控制减少上鱼时的手忙脚乱。 每段视频都会关联到当前出钓，方便你在收竿后整理鱼获、钓点、备注和中鱼标记。新的剪辑与分享工具还能从长视频里截出短精彩片段，用来复盘、发给朋友，或保存到系统相册。 适合这些场景： 路亚、海钓、台钓、黑坑和野钓 中鱼后保存刚发生的精彩瞬间 用语音指令控制录像和中鱼保存 给片段添加收藏、备注、钓点和标记 按出钓会话整理鱼获视频和钓鱼日记 从完整视频中剪辑并分享短片段 核心功能： 钓鱼预录相机：保存最近片段，不错过咬口和上鱼 中鱼保存：一次完成保存、收藏和标记 手动录像：自动关联当前出钓记录 语音控制：支持自定义短语和安全前缀 剪辑分享：选择精彩片段并导出分享 出钓记录：整理钓点、备注、标记和鱼获视频 片库搜索：按时间、来源、镜头和标签回看 钓个鱼适合想认真记录每次出钓的钓友：少一点补拍和翻找，多留下真正值得回看的中鱼瞬间。 使用条款: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6745477065.name: GRFX - Granular Effects
6745477065.description: GRFX is a powerful and creative granular effects processor that turns ordinary audio into extraordinary sonic landscapes. Slice your sound into grains and reshape them into evolving textures, shimmering chords, rhythmic glitches, haunting drones, and more. At the heart of GRFX is the Harmonic Triangle – an intuitive 3-way pitch controller that lets you morph simple tones into lush pads, arpeggiated patterns, or abstract gestures. Whether you’re aiming for organic soundscapes or synchronized stutters, GRFX gives you precise control over the flow of grains and modulation. Build complexity with four self-modulating LFOs, a multi-effect chain with probabilistic routing, and an elegant drag-and-drop modulation system. Shape your sound, modulate nearly every parameter, and sculpt immersive audio transformations in real time. Key Features: Granular engine for creating textures, rhythms, chords, glitches, drones, ambiences, and more Harmonic Triangle for 3-way pitch control, detuning, and microtonality Built-in Chord Selector with 32 triads for instant harmonic richness Grain envelope shaping for plucky, smooth, or abrupt grains Buffer size, division, sync, and freeze controls Rhythmic synchronization for tempo-synced effects and patterns 4 LFOs with self-modulation and drag-and-drop assignment Modulation panel & view mode for streamlined modulation management 2 Multi-Effect slots (Filter, Distortion, Delay, Peak EQ, Chorus, Phaser, Bitcrusher, Reverb) with probability-based routing Dedicated Send FX with Delay and Reverb in series or parallel mode Flexible mixer section for sculpting wet/dry balance and routing AUv3 Audio Unit plugin – requires an AUv3-compatible host app such as Logic Pro, GarageBand, AUM, or Cubasis. Standalone version included.

6760624826.name: Grainsmith Field
6760624826.description: Grainsmith Field is a granular instrument for iPad and iPhone. Load a sound or record one live, then pull it apart into grains. Stretch and scatter it until it stops sounding like the source, or pitch it and play it like an instrument. It shares its granular engine with our desktop Grainsmith plugin, but it's rebuilt for touch. Field is a single multitouch screen: four XY pads control paired parameters (Density and Size, Jitter and Spread, Pitch and Reverse, Cutoff and Resonance), and a Morph control sweeps several at once. THREE PLAYHEADS Run up to three independent grain streams from one sample at the same time. Each head has its own position, speed, pitch, level, pan, grain size, and spread. Grab a playhead line on the waveform to move it independently, or move them as a group. Double-tap to gather them. Set a second head a fifth or an octave away and the streams blend into a single granular texture. MODULATION Six modulation slots drive the controls: LFOs and Euclidean patterns with per-route depth, assigned by long-pressing a knob. The MOVE dial sets the Morph macro itself in motion, and each destination drifts on its own phase. Rates sync to tempo, in the app or from the host clock. RECORD AND MANGLE Capture audio from your hardware input and granulate it as it comes in, or loop a phrase and let the engine chew on it. Scrub the waveform directly. Freeze the grain cloud to hold a sound for as long as you want. Run the stereo delay to smear the grain tails into echoes; it syncs to tempo too. Export captures as WAV to the Files app. RECORD YOUR PERFORMANCE Start a recording from the presets menu and everything you play is captured to a WAV file. Keep playing through app switches and screen locks; a Lock Screen Live Activity shows while recording runs. Recordings save to the Files app and share straight from Field. PLAY IT AS AN INSTRUMENT Switch to Instrument mode and play the grain engine from a MIDI keyboard: four-voice polyphony, an attack/release envelope, and a root-note control. The pitch ribbon snaps to musical intervals: Free, Chromatic, Scale, Octaves, or Oct+5ths, with twelve scale options and a probability control. Works with hardware MIDI in the standalone app and with host MIDI in AUv3. USE IT IN YOUR HOST The AUv3 music effect loads in AUM, Logic for iPad, and other AUv3 hosts. Parameters are exposed for host automation and MIDI learn. Your patch saves and restores with the session, including head count, every per-head control, the modulation slots, and pitch snap mode. ALSO IN THE BOX Ten factory presets grouped by character, with a browser and a Favorites section for your own Background audio: the standalone keeps playing when you switch apps Reverb, stereo delay with tempo sync, filter, grain-shape windows, pitch randomization Runs on iPhone with a compact layout No account and no subscription. Field collects no data.

6779365453.name: ab Spatial Ambisonics Recorder
6779365453.description: 'ab Spatial Recorder' is an advanced recorder of 1st Order Ambisonics signals LOSSLESSLY for Spatial Audio. Requires iPhone 16 Pro/Pro Max and above! Using your iPhone's built-in microphone array, you can now record Audio in 1OA Ambisonics losslessly. The Ambisonics Audio can later be decoded to any speaker layout in existence: From Stereo all the way to 5.1, or even Dolby Atmos beds! Additionally, 'ab Spatial Recorder' also includes a video recorder that helps you record video WHILE recording Ambisonics audio. That way you can record video and simultaneously have your lossless Ambisonics track. This track is also decoded inside the device and a Stereo audio signal added to the final video. That way, you have your video with stereo audio and your lossless Ambisonics WAV. 'ab Spatial Recorder' comes also with a media player that helps you visualise, and listen to your 1OA recordings in Stereo, so you can watch or listen instantly! Included: Lossless 1st Order Ambisonics recording, straight from your iPhone's microphone array. Video recording, with your Ambisonics track decoded to Stereo and added to the video for you. A built-in player to watch and listen to your 1OA recordings in Stereo, instantly. Recorded Audio can be 16-bit, 24-bit, or even 32-bit Float at 48kHz. Video can be all the way from SD, to 1080p and even 4k, at 24, 30, or 60fps. Recordings can be done in portrait mode, or in landscape mode - the Ambisonics soundfield will adapt to the orientation of your device. Video Stabiliser can be turned on or off. Cameras can be flipped together with the Ambisonics soundfield, meaning that you can use your selfie camera as "Front" or your main cameras as "Front" - it all depends on what YOU want! Available as separate add-ons: GPS Tagging - a GPS tag saved in both your video and your audio files, so you always have the location where the media was recorded. Dual Camera - record BOTH cameras at once, so you can see what's happening in front of and behind the device, great for tracking audio. Works in PiP mode or in DOUBLE 4K! Real-Time Audio - decode the audio to Stereo in real time and write it into your video file while you record, for instant results. Immersive Formats Export - IAMF Audio, to create spatial videos you can upload to YouTube, plus Apple Spatial ASAF. Advanced Camera Controls - for professional takes (Log, Log2, HDR, P3, manual ISO, shutter speed, white balance, focus options, zoom curves - all based on device support). Soundfield Rotation - rotate your Ambisonics files manually or through head rotation (AirPods).

6757073023.name: CCR Junk
6757073023.description: CCR Junk is the decompression planner built specifically for rebreather divers. No tab-switching, no buried menus, no nonsense. Just one powerful screen with every variable you need to plan your dive. Created by CCR divers who were tired of clunky interfaces and planners that treat rebreathers as an afterthought, CCR Junk puts closed-circuit diving first. Plan any CCR dive From recreational rebreather dives to complex cave penetrations with multiple bailout scenarios — CCR Junk handles it all. Multi-level profiles, extended ranges, whatever your dive demands. Algorithms you trust Choose between Bühlmann ZHL-16C with configurable gradient factors or VPM-B. Switch between them instantly to compare profiles and pick your preferred conservatism. True CCR planning Full setpoint management throughout your dive. Track your scrubber time and know exactly where you stand. Plan with the variables that actually matter for rebreather diving. Breathe easy Real-time gas density calculations for every phase of your dive. Know exactly when you're approaching the recommended limits and plan your diluent choice accordingly. Because work of breathing matters. Bailout planning that works Plan realistic bailout scenarios for cave and overhead environments. Configure multiple bailout gases, see your gas requirements, and know you have a solid plan B. Works anywhere No internet required. Plan your dives on the boat, at the dive site, or in the middle of nowhere. Your dive data stays on your device. One screen philosophy Everything visible, everything accessible. Adjust a parameter and instantly see how it affects your profile. No switching between pages, no lost context. This is CCR dive planning the way it should be.

6781080437.name: 瓷砖排版助手-排砖损耗计算2026
6781080437.trackName: 瓷砖排版助手-排砖损耗计算2026
6781080437.description: 瓷砖排版助手是一款面向装修业主、瓦工和小型施工团队的本地离线工具。用户可录入房间尺寸、瓷砖规格、缝宽和起铺方向，生成排砖预览并估算整砖、切砖、损耗率和采购数量。所有方案保存在本机，无需登录、无需联网，适合现场量尺、材料核算和方案对比。

6760924929.name: 卡兜兜-证件扫描卡包
6760924929.description: 卡兜兜是一款主打纯本地隐私的证件扫描与卡包整理工具。把身份证、护照、驾照、医保卡、户口本等常用证件装进一个安全的本地卡包，随时整理、导出和打印，不把敏感资料上传到云端。 核心功能 证件扫描导入：支持相机扫描和相册导入，自动透视裁剪，快速得到清晰证件影像 本地离线 OCR：在设备上识别证件文字，提取姓名、号码和备注内容，隐私更安心 证件卡包管理：支持常用证件分类与自定义分类，敏感号码默认脱敏显示 复印件排版：支持 A4 画布自由拖拽、缩放与拼版，一页排多个证件复印件 水印防盗用：可添加“仅供本人使用”等全屏平铺水印，导出与打印时同步生效 多格式导出：支持导出 PNG、JPEG、PDF，支持分享、保存到相册和 AirPrint 打印 完全本地存储：证件图片、OCR 结果和记录均保存在本机沙盒，不依赖账号和云同步 适合需要整理个人证件、打印复印件、上传材料或重视隐私安全的用户。

6782561995.name: PureSync 节律
6782561995.description: PureSync 是一款本地优先的健康节律记录与执行 App，帮助用户围绕进食窗口、饮食记录、饮水、蛋白质、活动、提醒和 7 日饮食计划，建立稳定、清晰且低打扰的日常节律。 核心特点 1. 主控舱节律状态 记录正餐、甜水、高碳水、加餐或无热量饮品后，PureSync 会结合发生时间、进食窗口和近期记录，通过本地规则更新今日状态，并用动态影像和简洁信号呈现节律变化方向。 相关内容属于规则推演，并非连续血糖、胰岛素或酮体实测。 2. 轻断食与进食窗口 支持 12:12、14:10、16:8 等常见节律。PureSync 会根据用户选择的进食窗口、作息和身体基础信息，调整状态记录、餐食安排与提醒时间。 未记录的日期不会被自动判断为持续断食。长时间没有记录时，App 会提示用户重新确认当天状态。 3. 饮水、蛋白质与活动记录 主控舱集中呈现当日饮水、蛋白质餐次和步行情况。 饮水会跟随无热量饮品记录及提醒完成状态更新；蛋白质根据餐食记录和相关提醒折算；步数可在获得授权后读取 Apple Health 数据，并按一天的不同时段呈现。 4. 饮食结构与 7 日计划 可以先选择地中海、DASH、低碳、高蛋白或本地均衡等饮食结构，再根据默认食材组合进行增减。 PureSync 会根据饮食结构、所选食材和蛋白目标生成： 7 日餐食安排 采购清单 餐前、随餐与备餐提醒 可选补剂安排 计划强调真实食物、蛋白质、蔬菜、适量慢碳和实际可执行性。 5. 低打扰提醒 App 内提醒可以与 Apple Reminders 联动，用于： 确认进食窗口 饮水与餐食准备 第一餐顺序 餐后轻走 摄入截止 记录后的间隔提醒 每周复盘与节律回归 每条提醒均可单独设置启用状态、频率、时间和系统同步。未授权系统提醒时，App 内仍可查看和管理提醒。 6. 科学来源与安全边界 主控舱的状态推演、饮食结构和餐食建议均提供可点击的参考来源，包括公开健康指南、研究文献和相关规则说明。 PureSync 会明确区分设备同步数据、用户记录和规则推演结果，避免将模拟结果描述为医学检测。 7. 五种界面语言 支持简体中文、繁体中文、英语、日语和韩语。主要功能、提醒内容、状态说明和来源入口会随界面语言切换。 8. 本地优先与隐私 核心数据优先保存在设备本地。 开启 iCloud 后，主控舱摄入记录、更新时间及状态推演所需的核心记录，会通过用户自己的私人 iCloud 空间同步。Apple Health 和系统提醒权限均由用户自行决定，并可随时在系统设置中管理。 健康提示 PureSync 仅提供健康节律记录、饮食计划和教育参考，不提供医疗诊断、疾病治疗或用药建议，也不替代医生或营养专业人员的意见。 如患有糖尿病、进食障碍、肾脏疾病、痛风，处于孕期或哺乳期，正在服药，或存在其他特殊身体状况，请在调整断食、饮食或补剂方案前咨询专业医生。

6757803003.name: Cardify - AI错题本
6757803003.description: Cardify是为学生和家长设计的AI错题本。遇到做错的题目，拍照或从相册选择图片，确认题目范围后，Cardify会整理成一条清晰的错题记录，方便之后复盘和追踪。 你可以用Cardify： 拍照或从相册导入错题 确认一道题的范围，减少无关内容干扰 查看题面、学生作答、解题思路、解题过程和反馈 保留原始照片，随时回看题目细节 按日期、学科和知识点整理错题 通过分析页了解主要错在哪些学科和知识点 Cardify适合K12学生日常整理作业、试卷和练习中的错题，也适合家长了解孩子近期的薄弱点。我们希望错题不只是被拍下来，而是变成可以复盘、可以追溯、可以持续改进的学习记录。 在使用AI扫描功能前，Cardify会提示你确认数据处理说明。错题图片和必要请求信息仅用于本次识别与解析请求，不会用于训练AI模型。 【VIP订阅说明】 订阅服务：解锁全部高级功能，享受无限制的使用体验。 订阅价格：具体价格以App内部付费页面展示为准。 付款：用户确认购买并付款后，将计入iTunes账户。 自动续费：苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个订阅周期。 关闭服务：如需取消续订，请在当前订阅周期结束前至少24小时，手动在iTunes/Apple ID设置管理中关闭自动续费功能。 用户协议：https://blynkai.app/cardify/terms 隐私政策：https://blynkai.app/cardify/privacy

6757725138.name: SleepLedger: Sleep Diary
6757725138.description: "I tried sleep apps, but the scores just made me more anxious." SleepLedger is a calm sleep diary for people who want to remember how sleep actually felt, without another score overriding their body. Log last night in about 10 seconds, see weekly patterns, and export a clear 2-week diary when a doctor, therapist, CBT-I session, or personal review needs context. WHAT YOU CAN DO 1. LOG THE MORNING AFTER Capture the part wearables can miss: Sleep quality How rested you felt Energy today Optional context like sleep latency, awakenings, stress, caffeine, exercise, travel, and notes 2. SEE PATTERNS WITHOUT SCORE PRESSURE Your 7-day view helps you notice whether sleep is changing over time, without an algorithm judging your night. 3. ADD STRUCTURE WHEN YOU WANT IT Use the optional weekly ISI (Insomnia Severity Index) check-in when you want a more structured reflection. It is informational self-tracking, not a diagnosis. 4. EXPORT A 2-WEEK SLEEP DIARY Create PDF or CSV exports for personal reflection or care conversations. A recent 14-day range is built in so you do not have to assemble a two-week diary manually. WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE SLEEPLEDGER 10-second morning sleep log Subjective sleep first, not another sleep score Weekly patterns for quality, rest, and energy Optional ISI check-in for more structure Local-first by default FREE VS. UNLOCKED Free: Daily sleep check-ins 7-day trends Weekly ISI assessments One-time unlock: 30-day trends Tag insights PDF export CSV export No subscription. No recurring charge. WHO IT'S FOR People trying to improve insomnia or inconsistent sleep People doing CBT-I or building a steadier sleep routine People preparing for a doctor or therapist conversation People who are tired of confusing sleep scores and overbuilt trackers PRIVACY Local-first by default No account required No ads No third-party analytics or tracking You stay in control of your data DISCLAIMER SleepLedger is for informational and self-tracking purposes only. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The ISI (Insomnia Severity Index) is a screening questionnaire, not a diagnostic instrument. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for any health concerns. Never disregard professional medical advice based on information from this app.

6755075589.name: Overtime Live - Shift Tracker
6755075589.description: Start your shift and watch your pay climb in real time, right on your iPhone Lock Screen. Overtime Live turns every extra hour into live earnings, countdowns and satisfying stats. Free, no subscription, no sign-up. YOUR EARNINGS, LIVE ON THE LOCK SCREEN The moment you start a shift, a Live Activity shows your pay ticking up and the time left, without opening the app. On iPhone 14 Pro and later it appears in the Dynamic Island too. WATCH YOUR PAY TICK UP Enter your hourly rate and Overtime Live counts your earnings up second by second, with overtime tracked separately from regular hours. KNOW YOUR REAL TAKE-HOME PAY See past the gross figure. A built-in tax and take-home estimator and an on-screen Take Home Pay card show what you actually keep, so you know exactly what an overtime shift is worth after tax. Set your pay period to weekly, fortnightly, monthly or a custom date and track every payday. BUILT FOR SHIFT WORKERS Handle the pay that office apps ignore: overtime multipliers (Time and a Third, Time and a Half, Double), unsocial hours enhancements, on-call days with separate call-out pay, and custom rates for any arrangement. Add expenses to any shift and attach photos like receipts to keep your records in one place. PLAN YOUR ROTA Plan with month, week, day and agenda views. Build your shift pattern once and let the app fill in weeks or months ahead, warn about overlaps and export your schedule. Sync shifts to your iPhone calendar and get a notification the moment a shift starts. INSIGHTS, STATS & GOALS See clear patterns across your hours, pay and goals, explore a 12-month activity heatmap and use the What-If calculator to model extra shifts. On compatible iPhones, optional Apple Intelligence creates a short personalised briefing on-device. Standard insights remain available at all times. Track total earnings, hours and averages, set a yearly goal and unlock achievements as your shifts add up. YOUR DATA, YOUR WAY Your shift, pay and goal data stays on your device. Optional iCloud backup uses your personal iCloud account, and Apple Intelligence briefings run on-device. Export your full hours and pay history as CSV or monthly PDF anytime for tax returns or bookkeeping. It is your data. FREE. NO SUBSCRIPTION. NO ADS IN THE WAY. Core features are free, with a one-time No Ads unlock if you want it. No monthly fee, no paywall on the things that matter. WHO IT'S FOR Nurses, doctors and carers. Police, paramedics and firefighters. Retail, hospitality and warehouse staff. Security, delivery drivers and gig workers. Anyone paid by the hour who wants to see what their time is really worth. Available in English, German and Spanish. Download Overtime Live and make every hour count.
