6499437694.name: Minigoal - 2026必备效率工具
6499437694.description: 这是一款围绕日程、目标、任务和记录设计的效率 App，帮助你把每天的安排理清楚，把重要的事情持续推进，把完成过的内容记录下来。 你可以用它管理有明确时间的日程，也可以用目标打卡追踪长期习惯；可以用四象限判断事情优先级，也可以通过每日记录和每周总结回顾自己的节奏。 1、日程管理 支持日、周、月视图查看安排。 会议、课程、运动、出行、吃药等有明确时间的事情，都可以放进日程中管理。 提醒、标签、颜色和完成记录，让每天的安排更清楚。 2、目标打卡 适合管理早睡、喝水、阅读、运动、学习等长期目标。 支持每日目标、每周目标、次数目标和数值目标。 完成情况会被记录，并通过日历、趋势和统计展示，让坚持看得见。 3、四象限管理 用「重要 / 紧急」两个维度整理任务。 当事情很多时，可以更快判断哪些要优先处理，哪些适合计划安排，哪些可以延后或减少投入。 4、每日记录与每周总结 支持记录每天发生的事情、完成情况和想法。 也可以在一周结束时做简单复盘，帮助你看清这一段时间的节奏和变化。 5、数据安全 你的日程、目标、任务和记录都属于个人数据。 App 不会把你的个人内容用于广告推荐，也不会主动公开或展示你的私人数据。 登录后可进行多设备同步，方便更换设备或重新安装后恢复重要数据。 6、适合人群 适合想把每天安排得更清楚的人。 适合想坚持长期目标并查看进度的人。 适合同时管理日程、任务、打卡和记录的人。 适合重视轻量体验和数据安全的人。 7、会员说明 我们提供以下会员方案供您选择： 6元/月 月度会员 48元/年 年度会员 68元 永久会员 我们支持买断和订阅两种购买方式，订阅将通过您的 iTunes 账户扣款并自动续订，除非您在当前订阅期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续订。订阅期间不可取消。购买后可在 App Store 账户设置中管理订阅。 8、用户支持 隐私政策：https://www.moneyease.ltd/supports/privacy 使用协议：https://www.moneyease.ltd/supports/use 如果您有任何的问题，请及时联系我，同时，也十分欢迎您提出需求，帮助我完善这个产品。 9、联系我们 如果你在使用中遇到问题，或有任何建议，欢迎联系： 邮箱：yybblaze860@163.com QQ群：787370163 小红书：echonzz92

6761412435.name: PureOne: AI健康·HRV压力自测·情绪心率睡眠监测
6761412435.trackName: PureOne: AI健康·HRV压力自测·情绪心率睡眠监测
6761412435.description: 您的一体化AI健康伴侣 告别在多个应用之间来回切换。PureOne 将您的 Apple Watch 数据整合到一个智能仪表盘中。借助先进的AI算法，我们不仅仅是展示数字，更告诉您这些数字背后的意义。 核心功能： 智能健康仪表盘：一目了然地监测静息心率（RHR）、心率变异性（HRV）、睡眠和卡路里消耗。我们的AI会根据您的年龄和个人资料计算专属基准值。 实时AI洞察：针对异常信号即时提醒，并根据您身体的压力水平（HRV）和活动量提供个性化指导。 主动健康提醒：不再错过任何健康检查。获取用药、血压和血糖监测提醒。 高级AI对话：与您的健康数据"对话"。随时询问有关恢复状况或健康趋势的问题，即刻获得专家级分析。 全面数据同步：与 Apple 健康无缝集成，追踪从睡眠周期到最大摄氧量（VO2 Max）的所有数据。 为什么选择 PureOne？ 无论您是在管理健身目标，还是监测生命体征，PureOne 都能将复杂的生物指标转化为简单可行的建议。 PureOne 提供自动续订订阅服务，解锁全部高级功能和内容。 订阅价格： 每周 $4.99 / 每月 $9.99 / 每年 $79.99（美元） 订阅将在到期前24小时自动续订；您可随时通过 设置 > [您的姓名] > 订阅 取消。 隐私政策：https://pureoneai-bcbfranw.manus.space 订阅即表示您同意： 开发者《使用条款》：https://eatbetterai-cbhltbgd.manus.space Apple《媒体服务条款》（美国）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/us/terms.html 如两份协议存在冲突，以 Apple 条款为准。

6790142825.name: Golden Ratio Overlay
6790142825.description: Golden Ratio Overlay floats a composition guide over anything on your screen - your photo editor, design tool, video app, or browser - so you can compose against the grid you actually want. Built for one reason: most editors can't rotate or flip their built-in overlays. This one can. Every guide supports all eight orientations; rotate in 90-degree steps or flip horizontally and vertically with one click. GUIDES Rule of Thirds: 3x3 equal grid Phi Grid: golden-proportion grid (1 : 0.618 : 1) Golden Spiral: Fibonacci spiral with its golden-rectangle subdivisions Golden Diagonals: corner diagonals and their reciprocals Harmonic Armature: the classic 14-line armature Center Cross: centered midlines FAST FROM THE KEYBOARD Global shortcuts for every overlay action: show or hide, cycle guides, flip, rotate, and lock - they work while any app is in front Remap every shortcut in Settings, or clear the ones you don't need Hold Option while the overlay is locked to move or resize it; release and it snaps back to click-through Open at login so your guides are always one keystroke away MADE TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY Lives in the menu bar; no Dock icon, no windows to manage Floats above every app, including full-screen ones, without ever stealing focus Lock mode makes the overlay click-through so you keep editing beneath it Drag to move, grab a handle to resize; hold Shift to keep the aspect ratio, Option to resize from center Six line colors with a contrast understroke that stays readable on any image Remembers your guide, color, position, and orientation between launches PRIVATE BY DESIGN No data collection, no analytics, no network access. The complete source code is public on GitHub.

6446279664.name: batchTEXT
6446279664.description: Capture, OCR converting whole folder of your PDF files and/or handwriting images to text document, the '.txt' format! Totally 14 languages are supported, and drag & drop is supported too. Bad experience with other converters of Alpha channel problem and blank output? This app is the cure to free up your tons of PDF collections. And it is the best tool for e-book lovers on modifying their collections. Convert any text from any PDF file, no matter if it is selectable or not. All OCR processing is done on your Mac locally, no upload, no in-app purchase, no subscription, and no internet needed. total 14 languages supported. batchTEXT - capture any text capturer n'importe quel texte catturare qualsiasi testo Erfassen Sie jeden Text capturar cualquier texto capturar qualquer texto 捕获任何文本 모든 텍스트 캡처 あらゆるテキストをキャプチャ захватить любой текст захоплювати будь-який текст Disclaimer: 1. Capture & recognize to pure text only, no language translation. 2. Accuracy of handwriting recognition is not guaranteed, please test with your iPhone first, as they both use Apple's powerful offline engine. 3. Processing speed is related to your Mac's hardware. 6504302882.name: HTTP web server
6504302882.description: The HTTP server allows clients using standard web browsers to download content over the HTTP protocol. HTTPS is not supported; the server is intended for local network use. Upon startup, the server displays its address, enabling access from any browser. On first installation, sample pages are uploaded to the server directory to demonstrate its functionality. Access to the server directory is also possible via the built-in FTP server. The HTTP server transmission preview provides the following information: Client IP address Transmission preview The included FTP server enables full control over the server content. After specifying the port number, username, and password, files can be uploaded or downloaded. All files can also be accessed directly from the Files app via the FTP-Server interface. easily accessed directly from the Files app via FTP-Server.

6776050238.description: 备问（AlwaysOn AI）是一款离线可用的 iPhone AI 助理。 在地下车库、长途航班、偏远山区或陌生街头，当网络信号突然中断，你依然可以打开备问、立即提问。它让你在关键时刻不必等待“网络恢复”，随时获得 AI 的参考建议。 备问采用端侧本地模型：对话、翻译与图片辅助判断都在设备本地完成。你的内容不需要上传到云端，隐私边界更清晰，也更适合旅行、弱网和隐私敏感场景。 你可以把备问当作一个“随时待命的离线备份助手”： 旅行意外与应急：断网时快速获得分步骤参考建议 跨国沟通与翻译：在无稳定网络环境下继续沟通 网络与设备排查：临时离线时先做基础判断与处理 隐私敏感任务：内容留在本机，减少外传风险 核心体验： 无模型时可先进入主界面，不阻塞使用 模型下载后在本地运行，离线也可继续问答 回答按段流式输出，随时可停止 支持图片与短问题的实用参考 备问是在网络不可靠时，依然能随时给你提供建议的端侧 AI 助手。 使用条款： https://beiwen-app.github.io/legal/terms.html 隐私政策： https://beiwen-app.github.io/legal/privacy.html

6769510177.name: Grower Helper: Your grow diary
6769510177.description: GrowerHelper is the private grow journal for indoor growers. Track plants, feedings, pH, EC, VPD, harvests, photos, and every stage of your grow in one organized timeline. Built for real growers who want a clean, fast, and private experience without social features or cloud tracking. Whether you grow tomatoes, herbs, peppers, ornamentals, hydroponics, or microgreens, GrowerHelper helps you stay consistent and improve every cycle. FEATURES Unlimited crops and plants Feed, watering, pH, EC/TDS, runoff, slurry, prune, transplant, harvest, and extraction logs VPD, temperature, and humidity charts with visual target ranges Multi-light fixture tracking with wattage and height Plant status system: Living, Harvested, or Removed Private photos and videos stored locally Beautiful crop timelines and grow summaries Offline-first with local backup export PRIVACY FIRST No signup No ads No tracking No analytics Your grow data stays on your device. Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, and German. Happy growing

6780775612.name: 超级复读机 · 文字&录音&音频重复播报
6780775612.trackName: 超级复读机 · 文字&录音&音频重复播报
6780775612.description: 超级复读机是一款纯本地化运行的语音播报工具，专为需要反复聆听、记忆、巩固内容的场景设计。 核心功能 对你想要的内容进行重复播报，可自定义重复播报次数，支持播报任务的批量管理； 支持多种播报任务的创建方式，包含： 1、文本播报：输入任意文字，系统自动将其转换为语音播报任务，适合记单词、背古文、记句子等磨耳朵的场景； 2、录音播报：直接录制自己的声音，作为重复播报任务，支持预览试听，确认满意后再创建任务，适合语言学习、发音练习、重要代办事项反复提醒等需要真人语音重复听的场景，例如老师的录音文件，反复听； 3、图片识别：拍照或从相册选择图片，采用OCR自动识别图中的文字，支持对文字进行二次编辑，并创建播报任务，适合对纸质的学习材料进行快速拍照输入的场景； 4、音频文件：从本地文件选择 MP3、M4A、WAV 等多种格式的音频文件，作为播报任务，支持音频的预览，适合音频类学习素材的反复播报和记忆。 支持中英文内容的自动识别，英文采用英文语音引擎进行播报，使发音更加标准、地道，无机械感。 设置界面，可以分别针对中文和英文，切换自己喜欢的语音引擎。 播放控制 自定义播报次数，支持自动循环播放，适合需要反复跟读、记忆的学习场景。 首页底部常驻播放控制栏，实时显示当前播放任务和进度。 支持播报任务的播放/暂停/停止操作。 播报时，支持随时调节播报语速。 支持后台播报，锁屏时继续播报，如一边给孩子播放英文单独磨耳朵，一边用手机干自己的事。 支持锁屏、控制中心切换播报任务。 支持连续播报、单条播报的切换。 连续播报：播报完一条自动切换到下一条继续播报，无需人工干预； 单条播报：播报完一条即停止播报，用户手工点击下一条再播报。 隐私与安全 纯本地应用，无需注册账号，不需要网络连接。 所有数据（任务信息、录音文件、音频文件）均存储在设备本地沙箱中。 不使用任何第三方 SDK、统计分析工具或广告服务。 图片 OCR 识别完全在设备端完成，图片和识别结果不会离开你的设备。 应用不收集、不存储、不上传你的任何个人信息。 适用场景 语言学习、课文背诵、知识复习、会议记录回听、重要代办事项提醒、老师讲课录音、音频学习材料，等任何需要反复播放语音的场景。 更多的使用场景，等待您的探索。

6775602955.description: LSC Studio transforms existing videos into stunning long-exposure style photographs directly on your device. Instead of requiring a dedicated camera setup or complicated editing software, LSC Studio analyzes video frames and combines them into a single high-quality image using advanced image accumulation techniques. 6761862109.name: KO Reader
6761862109.description: KO Reader turns web articles, ebooks, and PDFs into natural-sounding speech — entirely on your device. No cloud, no tracking, no subscriptions. Paste a URL or open an EPUB or PDF, and KO Reader reads it aloud with a neural AI voice. Everything runs locally, so your reading stays private and works anywhere — on the train, on a plane, or off-grid. Export your favorite articles or books to m4a or m4b files. WHAT YOU CAN READ Web articles — Wikipedia, news sites, blogs, and Substack Fanfiction — Archive of Our Own, Royal Road, and Wattpad, with chapter detection EPUB ebooks with full chapter navigation PDF documents Plain text — paste or type any content Safari Share Extension — send articles to KO Reader with one tap NATURAL AI VOICES 53 neural voices across 9 languages: American and British English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Mandarin, and Hindi Preview any voice before selecting it Mark favorites for quick access Playback speed from 0.5x to 2.0x Smart heteronym resolution — the voice knows the difference between "lead" (the metal) and "lead" (to guide), "wound" (injury) and "wound" (past of wind) Custom pronunciation dictionary — teach the reader how to say names, jargon, or anything you like READ YOUR WAY Reading queue — line up multiple articles and auto-advance Bookmarks — save passages to come back to Reading history — pick up where you left off, across books and articles Chapter pre-generation — book chapters start instantly, no waiting between them Audio export — save generated audio for offline listening Adjustable article font (system, serif, monospaced, rounded) and Dynamic Type support BUILT FOR ACCESSIBILITY Full VoiceOver support with labeled controls throughout Haptic feedback on transport controls and sleep timer Background audio — listen while you use other apps or with the screen off Sleep timer — stops playback when you drift off Works with AirPods, Bluetooth speakers, and CarPlay RUNS EVERYWHERE Universal app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac macOS keyboard shortcuts (Space to play/pause, Cmd+← and Cmd+→ to skip) Optimized for Apple Silicon with optional CoreML acceleration Adjustable CPU thread count for performance tuning PRIVACY FIRST 100% on-device TTS — your content never leaves your phone No accounts, no analytics, no tracking, no ads No internet required after the one-time model download Reading progress stored locally only KO Reader downloads a ~350 MB neural voice model on first launch. After that, everything works fully offline. Powered by the open-source Kokoro TTS model (Apache 2.0).

6748609933.description: 全能单位换算 —— 33 大类专业换算器，一次买断，永久无广告 还在为复杂的单位换算反复打开网页、忍受满屏广告和强制订阅吗？「全能单位换算」是一款专为效率而生的专业单位转换工具，覆盖日常生活、学习考试、工程技术、科研实验的全部换算场景。一次购买、永久使用，没有订阅陷阱，没有任何广告打扰，更不收集你的任何隐私数据。打开即用，换算结果实时呈现，让每一次计算都干净、精准、专业。 为什么选择全能单位换算？ 市面上的换算器要么功能单薄，只能做长度、重量的基础转换；要么塞满广告、动辄要求订阅会员才能解锁完整功能。我们反其道而行：以一杯咖啡都不到的价格（仅 1.99 美元）一次买断，把 33 个完整专业类别、数百种单位、28 种语言界面，全部一次性交到你手里。没有内购、没有月费、没有"高级版"二次收费，更新持续免费。我们相信，好用的工具应该让你专注于事情本身，而不是不断地为功能付费、为广告分心。 33 6751185069.description: 从今晚开始，享受更安稳的睡眠。 本应用通过科学验证的简单习惯与日常作息，帮助您缓解失眠，获得稳定的睡眠体验，无需复杂功能。 主要功能 基于CBT-I的建议：提供简短实用的提示，涵盖睡眠卫生、规律作息、刺激控制等经过验证的睡眠原则。 睡眠日记与洞察：记录就寝时间、起床时间、夜间醒来情况与心情，帮助您发现睡眠模式与改进点。 夜间急救模式：当您半夜醒来时，提供专门设计的流程，帮助重新入睡。 智能提醒：贴心提醒，支持就寝准备与规律睡眠习惯。 温和唤醒：逐渐响起的闹钟与晨间签到，让您平静开启新的一天。 极简设计：简洁直观的界面，人人都能轻松使用。 预期效果 更快入睡，更深层恢复性的睡眠 减少看钟与焦虑性辗转反侧 简单、可持续的日常睡眠习惯 适合人群 入睡困难或夜间频繁醒来的人 因繁忙日程、时差或不规律睡眠而困扰的人 希望建立稳定睡眠习惯的人 提示：本应用旨在支持睡眠习惯改善，并非医疗器械，不能替代专业诊疗。如失眠持续或加重，请咨询专业人士。 隐私政策: https://best-friend-7a1.notion.site/Privacy-Policy-2535ee0f842981ef829cf160e10901ba?source=copy_link 服务条款: https://best-friend-7a1.notion.site/Terms-of-Service-2535ee0f842981be85c2f35552d95979?source=copy_link

6776704119.name: NotchForge: 耳鸣缓解与凹槽技术
6776704119.trackName: NotchForge: 耳鸣缓解与凹槽技术
6776704119.description: 借助精密的声学工程，缓解持续耳鸣的困扰。NotchForge是专为耳鸣习惯化和缓解焦虑而设计的个性化声学康复助手，100%完全离线运行，严密守护您的健康隐私。 凹槽噪音技术（Notched Noise）是针对稳定单音耳鸣的循证康复方案。通过播放滤除了您精准耳鸣频率的白噪音、粉红噪音、棕色噪音或自然环境声，NotchForge 利用“侧方抑制”机制激活周围健康的听觉神经，从而平息大脑中引起耳鸣的异常活跃区域。 NotchForge 专为夜间使用设计了高对比度暗黑界面与流畅微交互，以确保舒缓而温和的使用体验。 核心功能： 精密声学凹槽技术 量身定制您的声波调理。在 125 Hz 至 20,000 Hz 之间调整滑块，精确匹配您的耳鸣音调。选择背景噪音后，系统将瞬间应用带阻滤波器滤除该频段。 自然环境音混音器 创造最适合放松的音境。可将调理用的凹槽噪音（图层 1）与最多两种自然声（图层 2 & 3，如海浪、细雨、微风）混合播放。 双凹槽同时调理 针对双耳耳鸣频率不同的使用者。支持配置主、副两个中心频率，同时缓解双耳的耳鸣。 每日不适度日记 在每次听音前后，以 1 至 10 的刻度记录您的耳鸣困扰程度。通过 30 天 or 90 天的不适度演变曲线，直观掌握习惯化进度。 PDF 健康报告导出 一键导出排版规范、结构清晰的 PDF 健康报告。报告包含您的聆听时间统计、连续天数及困扰程度演变，方便在面诊听力师或耳鼻喉科（ENT）医生时提供数据参考。 渐干式睡眠定时器 安心伴音入眠。可设定 5 分钟至 8 小时的定时器，在播放结束前音量会极缓下降直至静音，避免惊醒并保护听觉。 听觉安全卫士 当音量水平超过安全阈值时，系统会立即给予视觉警示，帮助您保持健康的用耳习惯。 100% 离线与绝对隐私 您的健康数据完全属于您。NotchForge 无需注册，不使用 any 第三方分析追踪代码，零网络数据交换。所有数据均安全保存在您的本地设备上。 重要声明：NotchForge 并非进度设备。本软件为通用舒缓及耳鸣顺应辅助工具。若有听力下降或其他耳部疾病，请及时前往医院耳鼻喉科面诊专业医生。

6763529061.name: 小白学烹饪
6763529061.description: 「小白学烹饪」面向刚走进厨房的你，把菜谱、知识与常用工具收进一个干净好懂的界面里。想煲一锅暖胃汤、炒一盘下饭小菜，还是把早餐做得又快又稳，都可以按难度、耗时和分类慢慢选，用料与步骤逐项对照，还有小贴士提醒常见误区，让第一次尝试也不慌乱。 「厨房小课堂」用浅显文字讲清安全细节、刀工与火候、调味先后等基础思路；术语词典随查随懂，看得明白才做得踏实。下厨时可用多段计时，焯水、焖煮分开记；出门买菜前，还能从菜谱整理购物清单，逐项勾选不遗漏。遇到喜欢的味道就收藏，随手记下「盐少半勺」「多焖两分钟」之类的心得，让每一次下厨都能变成下一次的进步。 整体视觉温暖、版式清晰，重要信息一眼能找到。愿你在日复一日的烟火气里，把家常菜越做越顺手，也吃出属于自己的踏实与成就感。

6771486124.name: 每日记忆
6771486124.description: 有些话，不想发朋友圈，也不想解释给别人听，只想轻轻记下来。 每日记忆是一个写给自己的地方。想到什么，就记什么。一句话、一张照片、一个心情，或者今天发生的小事，都可以轻轻留下。 应用会按时间轴整理每天的内容，也支持通过日历、搜索和自由回溯慢慢翻回来。今天看似普通的一天，过一阵子再回头，也许就成了值得记住的回忆。 你的内容优先保存在本地设备，并可通过 iCloud 在你的设备之间自动同步。没有公开主页，没有点赞评论，也没有别人能看到你写下的内容。 适合这些时候： 想随手记一句今天的感受 想把照片和文字留在同一天 不想发给别人，但想给自己留个痕迹 想偶尔回头看看，那些被留下的时刻

6773829067.description: 高级承诺：彻底告别烦恼 许多“免费”应用会不断打断您的注意力，与它们不同，这是一款纯净、直观的高级体验。 一次购买，终身畅玩：只需一次低价购买，即可完全解锁整个游戏，绝无后续费用。 绝无视频广告：您永远不会被强制观看任何广告。 无体力或生命限制：随时随地，想玩就玩。您永远不会因输掉游戏而被拒之门外。 100% 离线游玩：无需联网。非常适合在飞机、火车、候诊室或晨间休息时游玩，绝不消耗您的移动流量。 专为极致视觉舒适而设计 告别在拥挤的手机屏幕上眯眼或费力观看的痛苦。 大字体与高对比度：拥有巨大、清晰的数字和干净的线条，在任何光线条件下都清晰易读。 全屏布局：数独网格智能利用您的整个屏幕，让您能轻松精准地点击所需的方格。 纯净无杂质：极简设计，保持屏幕整洁、宁静且井井有条。 纯正的纸质杂志体验 找回昔日解开晨报纸质谜题的怀旧感动。 随心切换墨水颜色：就像使用真正的多色圆珠笔一样，您可以随时在经典黑、传统蓝或活力红之间切换文字颜色，以便梳理您的解题思路。 怀旧纸张美学：采用柔和、温暖的背景纹理，唤起高质量谜题书页的经典质感。 掌控在自己手中的脑力训练 无论您想要晨间的轻松热身，还是高强度的头脑风暴，这款“杂志”都能满足您的需求。 4 种难度级别：自由调节挑战难度，涵盖简单、中等、困难直至专家级别。 无穷谜题：我们的智能生成器可创建数百万个数学上完美且完全独特的盘面。您绝不会遇到重复的谜题。 无限免费提示：卡在困难关卡了？随时获取无限提示和自动错误检测——绝无任何惩罚或隐藏费用。 回归本质 尊重纸质杂志的经典传统，为您的专属大脑奉上一场高品质、充满敬意的谜题盛宴。 立即下载《简约数独杂志》，在绝对的宁静中尽情享受您最爱的爱好。

6756236079.name: Gravity – Minimal Notes
6756236079.description: Gravity is a fast, private notes app with one stream, instant capture, and a simple rule: swipe to bump what matters back to the top. You open your notes app to jot down a quick idea. But first: which folder? What tags? Should you link it to something? By the time you've decided, the thought is gone. Gravity eliminates every barrier between your thoughts and the page. No folders. No tags. No complex systems to maintain. Just one continuous stream, and your attention decides what stays relevant. Syncs privately via your personal iCloud account. No third-party servers. No account required. No sign-up. No tracking. One-time purchase. No subscription. No ads. HOW IT WORKS Append — Open the app and start typing. Your note saves automatically. No tapping "new note." No choosing a location. Just capture Review — Scroll through your stream. New notes live at the top. Older notes naturally drift down over time, like thoughts settling in your mind. Rescue — When something catches your attention, swipe right to bump it back to the top. Your attention becomes your organization system. Archive — When a note has served its purpose, swipe left. Done. FEATURES Quick Capture Start typing the moment you open the app Auto-save means you never lose a thought Hit return twice to save and start fresh The Stream One continuous timeline of all your notes No folders, categories, or nested hierarchies Scroll to review; swipe to act Bump to Top Swipe right on any note to rescue it Your attention naturally sorts what matters No manual organization required Lightweight Prefixes Type todo: or idea: or any prefix at the start of any note Search by prefix to create instant filtered views Color-coded highlighting makes prefixes pop Fast Search Find notes instantly across thousands of entries Partial-word matching catches what you're looking for Built on a high-performance local database Quick Actions Swipe left to reveal: archive, delete, share, copy Every action is one gesture away Undo protection for destructive actions Import and Export Export all your notes anytime to a single json file Import with validation and duplicate protection Your data, your control DESIGNED FOR FOCUS Warm, paper-like aesthetic Satisfying haptics on every interaction Fluid gestures that feel natural Minimal setup Nothing to learn WHO GRAVITY IS FOR Designed for plain-text note taking, quick ideas, and lightweight to-dos. For solo thinkers who want to capture first and organize never. For anyone who's felt the relief of simply writing something down without deciding where it goes. Not a second brain. Not a knowledge graph. Just your thoughts, in one stream. INSPIRED BY SIMPLICITY Gravity is built around Andrej Karpathy's append-and-review method for personal notes: keep one running stream, review it periodically, and let your attention decide what stays relevant. Most notes apps tolerate this workflow. Gravity is designed for it. ONE PRICE. YOURS FOREVER. Pay once. No subscription. No in-app purchases. No ads. Just a thoughtfully crafted notes app that respects your attention and your wallet. Stop organizing. Start thinking. Download Gravity and let your thoughts sink in.

6789847990.name: YesterYears
6789847990.description: YesterYears：日记，让每年今日重现 每天写一句话，轻盈如常。 你是否也曾这样？想写日记，却总在「写多少」「写什么」「能不能坚持」之间卡住，开了头就再也没续上。想看看去年的今天写了什么，要在时间线里一条条往回翻，怎么也找不到「那年今日」的仪式感。日记 App 功能越来越多，社交、打卡、排行榜让人分心——你只是想安安静静写一句话，而已。 YesterYears 让记录变得足够轻，让回望变得足够深。 打开 App，写下一行字，关掉——就像在本子上随手划下一行。 以「月-日」为锚点，纵向回望 不同年份的自己在同一页悄然相逢。当前年份高亮，往年记录依次向下。左右滑动，即可在前后 365 天内自由切换。记下今天，看见那年今日。 日历纵览全貌 双月视图同时浏览两个月的记录。有记录的日期显示圆点标记，点击即达该日详情。 轻盈，而非负担 每天只需一句话，甚至一个词。字数上限可自定义（50–200 字）。没有排版压力，没有模板束缚。中英文各 365+ 条写作提示，帮你轻轻起笔。内容随写随存，无需手动提交。 本地优先，隐私为本 数据默认存储在设备本地，不上传、不分析。可选开启 iCloud 同步，延续跨设备记录。支持将全部记录导出为 JSON。 克制的设计 暖色纸感背景，深浅模式均保持柔和。陶土色点缀，衬线字体承载正文与日期。卡片式布局、轻柔阴影、连续圆角——整体安静、低压力，让你愿意每天回来。 Widget 与快速写作 主屏幕 Widget 小/中两种尺寸，一键落笔。从通知、Widget 或深链以浮层形式快速写作，写完即关，不打断当前使用。每日提醒可自定义时间，嵌入你的日常节奏。 多平台，同一套习惯 支持 iOS（iPhone / iPad）、macOS、visionOS。配合 iCloud 同步，桌面端补写、移动端速记都很自然。 每天打开、写一句、关掉——像在本子上划下一行字。 一年后，你会笑着看见今天的自己。 使用条款（EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 隐私政策：https://mooyu.cc/onewordprivacy.html

6768324980.name: PulseCourier: Health to AI
6768324980.description: Your health, understood on your iPhone, and ready for any AI. PulseCourier reads your Health data and does two things with it. It scores how your body is doing today, and it turns the raw numbers into a clean file you can hand to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or your own scripts. Everything runs on the phone. Nothing is uploaded. DAILY SCORES Open the app to see today's Readiness, Recovery, Sleep, and Strain, each as a single number with a plain read on what it means. Recovery weighs your overnight heart rate, HRV, and sleep. Strain tracks how much cardiovascular work you have put in, with a suggested target range for the day. Tap any score to see the exact formula, the inputs behind it, and a five-day trend. No subscription and no extra band on your wrist. It works from the Apple Watch data you already have. ASK AI ABOUT YOUR HEALTH A library of ready-made prompts across sleep, workouts, activity, heart, and general wellness. Pick a question like "what is hurting my sleep?" and tap once. PulseCourier gathers exactly the right metrics and date range, writes a ready-to-use prompt, and bundles it with your data into one file. Open ChatGPT or Claude, attach, send. EXPORT EVERYTHING Steps, distance, active energy, exercise and stand minutes, heart rate, resting heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, respiratory rate, VO2 max, body measurements, sleep stages (in bed, core, deep, REM, awake), and every workout with duration, distance, calories, route, and per-workout heart rate. Pick today, last week, last month, or any custom range. Or switch to Select Sessions and choose specific workouts and sleep nights one by one. THREE FORMATS NDJSON for AI tools and scripts. CSV for spreadsheets. Markdown for a human-readable summary with tables for activity, heart, sleep, and workouts. A compact mode keeps the file small for long ranges by aggregating per hour instead of per sample. PRIVACY No accounts. No servers. No tracking. PulseCourier has zero networking code. Your health data only leaves your iPhone when you share a file through the system share sheet. Health permissions are read-only. WHAT IT'S NOT PulseCourier is not a background syncer, a social feed, or a subscription. The scores are for information, not medical advice. If you want automated daily uploads to a cloud, you want a different tool. If you want to understand your health and put it in front of an AI in seconds, this is it.

Pick today, last week, last month, or any custom range. Or switch to Select Sessions and choose specific workouts and sleep nights one by one. THREE FORMATS NDJSON for AI tools and scripts. CSV for spreadsheets. Markdown for a human-readable summary with tables for activity, heart, sleep, and workouts. A compact mode keeps the file small for long ranges by aggregating per hour instead of per sample. PRIVACY No accounts. No servers. No tracking. PulseCourier has zero networking code. Your health data only leaves your iPhone when you share a file through the system share sheet. Health permissions are read-only. WHAT IT'S NOT PulseCourier is not a background syncer, a social feed, or a subscription. The scores are for information, not medical advice. If you want automated daily uploads to a cloud, you want a different tool. If you want to understand your health and put it in front of an AI in seconds, this is it.

6775017919.description: Family Walkie Talkie turns nearby iPhones, iPads, and Macs into a simple home radio for families. Open the app on two nearby devices, connect, then press and hold to talk. Release to listen. Perfect for communicating around the house, upstairs and downstairs, the garage, kitchen, backyard, workshop, or nearby rooms. Features Live push to talk communication Speaker Mode for louder family communication Connect nearby family devices Listener count showing connected radios Connect and disconnect devices anytime Optional voice note recordings Device blocking and unblocking Accessibility options with larger controls Voice feedback support High contrast mode Adjustable text size Haptic feedback support Clear talk, listen, and ready status indicators Keep screen awake option No account required No sign in required No cloud server No subscriptions No ads Privacy Voice is sent directly between connected nearby devices Live push to talk communication is not recorded Recording history is optional Saved recordings remain on your device only Clear History removes saved recordings from your device Deleting the app removes saved recordings from your device Nothing is uploaded by this app Family Walkie Talkie is designed for simple, trusted, and private communication at home.

6788655739.name: 魔法VPN
6788655739.description: 魔法VPN是一款面向高级用户的付费下载 VPN 客户端。你可以导入自己的 sing-box 配置、代理链接、订阅 URL 或二维码，在 iPhone 和 iPad 上通过 iOS Packet Tunnel 启动网络连接。 主要功能： 一键连接和断开 VPN。 Dashboard 查看连接状态、当前配置、运行时长和实时流量。 从二维码、相册二维码、剪贴板、文件、订阅 URL 和 URL Scheme 导入配置。 支持 sing-box JSON 配置，并可解析常见代理链接和订阅格式。 支持 Shadowsocks、VMess、VLESS、Trojan、Hysteria2、TUIC 等常见 sing-box 出站配置的导入和转换。 支持虚拟网卡模式设置，包括 Full Tunnel、Split Tunnel、Fake-IP、MTU、路由包含和排除。 支持配置导出、系统分享、二维码导出和本地备份。 提供连接日志、规则日志、DNS 日志和基础网络诊断入口。 支持浅色和深色模式，并提供多语言界面。 魔法VPN不提供内置服务器，不销售节点，不托管用户流量。你的配置保存在本机，并交给系统 Packet Tunnel 扩展处理。实际连接质量和可访问性取决于你导入的配置、服务器和网络环境。

6466815474.name: FiveNotes 3: 快速笔记
6466815474.description: FiveNotes 让您随时轻松访问当前最需要的五项内容。 快速记下电子邮件地址、电话号码、食谱、会议笔记、灵感，或任何不想遗失的内容。通过菜单栏或键盘快捷键打开 FiveNotes，然后只需点击或使用快捷键，即可在五条笔记之间切换。 让 FiveNotes 始终显示在其他窗口上方 - 即使是全屏应用 - 将它用作需要时随时可查的紧凑参考便笺。您也可以将窗口分离出来，像使用普通的可移动窗口一样使用它。 五条笔记，告别杂乱。 这个限制是有意为之：FiveNotes 帮助您专注于眼下重要的事情，而不是再建立一个无穷无尽的笔记档案。 功能： 通过菜单栏或键盘快捷键快速访问 恰好五条按颜色区分的笔记 始终置顶模式，包括显示在全屏应用上方 可分离窗口、屏幕边缘吸附，以及在鼠标光标位置显示 将文本直接拖到菜单栏图标上，即可添加到笔记中 支持 Markdown 格式，包括任务列表、高亮、缩进等 在笔记中搜索 自定义主题、笔记颜色、字体、间距，以及浅色或深色外观 自动本地备份，帮助恢复被覆盖的笔记 通过私有 iCloud 在 Mac、iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Watch 之间同步 支持 Apple Shortcuts、AppleScript 和 URL API 自动化 没有分析、没有遥测，也不会访问您的笔记 适用于 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Watch 的 FiveNotes 需另行购买。登录 iCloud，即可在设备之间同步笔记。 您的数字便笺 - 随时可用。

6789032773.description: 箱唛助手是一款面向小商家、跨境卖家和仓库打包场景的离线箱唛制作工具。你可以为不同发货批次建立箱唛模板，记录SKU、箱号、件数、毛重、净重、尺寸、目的地和备注，并快速生成可打印的外箱标签。 应用不需要登录，不联网，不收集个人数据，所有发货批次和模板都保存在本机，适合希望把箱唛资料整理清楚、减少手写错误、方便重复打印的用户。 核心能力包括：箱唛模板管理、批量箱号生成、尺寸重量记录、A4标签排版、打印预览、PDF导出、本地备份与历史批次复用。

6744972629.name: Nikaya Wavetable and FM Synth
6744972629.description: Nikaya Synth is a compact, expressive wavetable synthesizer designed for musicians and sound designers looking for flexibility without complexity. It features an 8-voice polyphonic engine, with each voice containing two independent wavetable oscillators and a pair of FM operators. Each voice includes its own ADSR amplitude envelope, while modulation and filtering are handled globally for efficient performance and unified control. Explore a variety of ways to generate and import wavetables: Flexible Wavetable Creation Convert images into wavetables using brightness data Slice WAV files into multiple waveforms Import folders of single-cycle waveforms Browse a curated set of factory wavetables Generate up to 128 waveforms from a single source Sound Design Capabilities Nikaya offers a focused feature set for building detailed, evolving sounds: Two wavetable oscillators per voice with independent wave index control Bidirectional FM synthesis using the current wavetable waveforms Global ladder filter with a cycling envelope and morphable curve shapes Two global LFOs with tempo sync and multiple waveforms Clear visual feedback for envelope shaping Workflow and Integration Designed with usability and integration in mind: AUv3 plugin support for host compatibility iCloud sync for presets and wavetables Full parameter automation in supported hosts Community Sharing (iOS 13+) Access user-created presets from the in-app browser Like and download new sounds Share your own presets with others Nikaya Synth offers a practical approach to modern wavetable synthesis—lightweight, responsive, and easy to navigate, while remaining capable of detailed and expressive sound design.

6504628174.name: everies
6504628174.description: Everything around you has a character. A thing to say. Point your camera, and the mug on your desk, the toy on your shelf — each one pops its eyes open and looks right at you. Tap one. Each becomes a one-of-a-kind character called an "everie," ready to start talking. Speak into the mic and your everie talks back. No eyes on an object? Tap it anyway. An everie will pop up. What would my mug sound like if it talked? What is that toy actually thinking? Does the vending machine I walk past every day have a personality? What if everything that normally stays quiet all started speaking? That's everies. A new AR app for play that makes the world a little more interesting to look at. ―― What you can do ―― ■Every object has its own personality. Mugs, stuffed animals, stationery, pet supplies, even a random pebble. Every object your camera picks up gets its own face, voice, personality, and way of speaking. And no two everies are ever the same, even from identical objects. ■Tap the mic and speak to any everie you're curious about. "Why are you round?" "Anything good happen today?" Whatever you ask, you'll get an answer that feels true to that character. ■Keep your favorites. Save the everies you like. Open the app again and pick up right where you left off, same character, same personality. The things around you start to feel like familiar faces. Record fun moments as video and share them with family and friends!

6446443401.name: AAT- MHE-MEWP AR Practice
6446443401.description: If you're looking to learn about material handling equipment (MHE) and want to do so in an interactive and engaging way, look no further than this AR app! This app uses augmented reality technology to bring machineries to life right before your eyes, allowing you to see and interact with a range of different vehicles and equipment in 3D space. Whether you're interested in forklifts, reach trucks, scissor lifts, boom lifts, lorry cranes, or personnel platforms, this app has something for you. With detailed 3D models of each piece of equipment, you can explore and learn about the various parts and functions of each vehicle, as well as how to operate them safely and effectively. The app is designed with learning in mind, and features a range of interactive tools and resources to help you get the most out of your experience. From informative videos and animations, to detailed tutorials and quizzes, this app has everything you need to become an expert in MHE and take your knowledge to the next level. One of the unique features of this app is its use of augmented reality technology, which allows you to place virtual models of MHE directly into your real-world environment. This means you can see and interact with these vehicles in the context of your own workspace or job site, giving you a more realistic and immersive learning experience. In addition to its educational value, this app is also a great tool for training and certification purposes. By using the app to practice operating different types of MHE, you can gain valuable experience and build your skills, which can help you in your career or business. Overall, this AR app is an excellent resource for anyone looking to learn more about MHE, whether you're a novice or an experienced professional. With its engaging and interactive features, you'll be able to explore and learn about different types of equipment in a way that's both fun and informative. Download the app today and start your journey towards becoming proficient in material handling equipment!

6791091619.name: Chroma Pocket
6791091619.description: Chroma Pocket is a camera-first photo app for capturing, importing, grading, and saving photos with original retro camera looks. Choose from 20 camera-inspired presets, each designed with its own color, contrast, softness, grain, glow, vignette, flash feel, CCD-style texture, instant frame, or film curve. Every look is tuned to feel like a different camera instead of a simple color filter. Use Chroma Pocket to: Capture photos with live filtered preview Import existing photos and apply camera looks Adjust intensity, brightness, contrast, fade, warmth, sharpness, and grain Save processed photos to your photo library Save original captures alongside edited versions Add date stamps to photos Mirror front-camera selfies Capture Live Photos on supported devices Chroma Pocket keeps the photo first. Controls stay focused and camera-like, so you can frame, switch looks, adjust, capture, and save without leaving the visual context of the camera. Your photos are processed locally on your device. Chroma Pocket does not upload your images, collect camera content, or track you.

6771758530.name: LogicFlow Pro – DAW Controller
6771758530.description: LogicFloPro turns your wrist into an ultra-low latency, professional control surface. Designed by a creator for creators, it provides tactile wrist boundaries to run your recording session without ever needing to look at your computer or touch your mouse. CORE FEATURES: Studio Transport Surface: Toggle Play, Record, Return-To-Zero, Metronome Clicks, and timeline looping with zero configuration. S/M/R/I Strip Matrix: Mute, Solo, Record-Arm, and toggle Input Monitoring on individual tracks directly from your wrist. Dynamic Crown Volume: Scrub volume faders smoothly on your active tracks using physical Digital Crown rotation. History Controller: Instantly Undo or Redo complex takes with swift tactile buttons. Pro Control Framework: Configured directly over Pro Protocols UPCOMING IN V2.0: Wrist Haptic Metronome: Translate Logic Pro clicks into physical tactile linear ticks on your Watch Taptic Engine. Keep perfect time by sensation, keeping your monitors quiet and headphones off. Requires the free companion LogicFloPro server utility from Appstore Support URL: https://logicflowatch-886999306571.us-west1.run.app/ Marketing URL: https://ais-pre-buttqspt5dcscbumnglxam-636955349281.asia-southeast1.run.app Take control of your workflow, record your takes from the booth, and eliminate the back-and-forth desk shuffle with LogicFlow Pro.

6774984034.name: 英语语法大师
6774984034.description: GrammarMaster 将复杂的语法点拆成易懂讲解与例句，配套即时练习题与错题复习，帮助你在真实语境中巩固知识。课程覆盖名词、冠词、代词、形容词与副词、各类时态、被动语态、非谓语动词、从句、倒装、强调句、情态动词等从基础到进阶的核心知识点。 应用特色： 系统课程：38 节精心编排的课时，从入门到高级逐步深入，每课包含要点、例句与实战练习。 互动练习：每节课配套练习题，立即给出解析与得分，帮助你查漏补缺。 错题管理：自动收集错题，支持按课程筛选、重点复习与清空管理。 间隔重复（Leitner）：内建复习引擎，根据答题情况智能安排复习，有效提升长期记忆。 学习目标与进度：设置每日学习目标，记录连续学习天数、完成课程数与答题正确率。 游戏化练习：多种趣味小游戏（跳跃、射击、塔防、接词等）将练习融入游戏，提高学习动力与沉浸感。 自适应界面：针对 iPhone 与 iPad 优化布局，阅读与练习体验流畅自然。 奖励系统：完成任务可获得积分，用于商店兑换与升级，增强持续学习动力。 离线阅读（静态课程数据）：课程内容以内置数据形式提供，便于随时复习（请以实际版本设置为准）。 适合人群: 英语初学者、希望系统梳理语法的学生、备考托福/雅思/中学/高中语法需要提分的学习者，以及想通过碎片时间巩固语法的上班族和家长。 学习效果承诺: 通过短期集中练习 + 科学复习安排，显著减少遗忘、提升做题准确率与实际应用能力。

6761011882.name: Device Kit - 硬件性能检测与手机管家
6761011882.trackName: Device Kit - 硬件性能检测与手机管家
6761011882.description: Device Kit — 你的 iPhone 全能体检官，实时掌控设备的一切！ 想知道手机到底有多热？充电到底有多快？CPU 是不是快爆了？网速有没有被限速？Device Kit 给你最直观、最实时、最全面的答案。 核心监控，一目了然 ◂◂ CPU 温度检测 — 实时显示设备温度，智能估算电池温度与机身温度，热状态分 6 级预警，手机发烫提前知晓 CPU 占用率 — 实时 CPU 使用率监测，用户/系统/空闲占比一目了然，历史曲线追踪负载变化 网络速度监测 — WiFi + 蜂窝双通道实时网速，上传/下载速度、峰值速度、每日流量统计全掌握 电池状态 — 电量、充电状态、低电量模式、热状态，电池健康尽在掌握 内存与存储 — 已用/总量/分布，存储空间使用率，告别空间焦虑 灵动岛与悬浮窗，桌面实时监测 ◂◂ 灵动岛实时监控 — 不用打开 App，锁屏或使用其他应用时，灵动岛实时显示 CPU 温度、网速、CPU 占用率，数据实时刷新 画中画悬浮窗 — 桌面悬浮窗持续监测网速、温度、CPU，随时拖动，不影响正常使用，真正的桌面级监控体验 移动轨迹灵动岛 — 记录运动轨迹时，灵动岛实时显示距离、时长、速度 充电功率检测 ◂◂ 实时功率估算 — 充电时实时检测充电功率（W），判断是慢充、普通充电还是快充 充电速度等级 — 慢速/普通/快速/高速，一目了然 充电统计 — 检测时长、峰值功率、已充入电量，完整充电报告 历史记录 — 每次充电自动保存，随时回看对比 18 款实用工具 ◂◂ 【系统工具】手电筒（9 种闪烁模式，支持亮度调节）、触感反馈、多点触控、移动轨迹 【网络工具】Ping、Telnet、SSH（Pro） 【实用工具】二维码生成器、分贝仪、密码生成器 【传感器工具】指南针、GPS、陀螺仪、磁力计、气压计、高度计、距离传感器 【显示工具】颜色与亮度 【环境工具】天气（Pro） 桌面小组件 ◂◂ 主屏幕小组件 — 运行时间、天气、CPU、温度、内存、存储、时钟、设备信息、快捷操作，支持 Small/Medium/Large 三种尺寸 锁屏小组件 — 天气、存储、运行时间，锁屏状态一目了然 【自动续订订阅说明】 Pro 会员为自动续期订阅服务，按月/年计费 确认购买后，费用将从您的 Apple 账户中扣除 在当前订阅期结束前 24 小时内，系统将自动续订并扣费 如需取消订阅，请在当前订阅期结束前至少 24 小时，前往「设置」>「Apple ID」>「订阅」中关闭自动续订 购买后，您可随时在账户设置中管理或取消订阅 免费试用期（如有）未使用部分将在购买订阅后失效 【隐私政策与服务条款】 隐私政策：https://device-kit.pages.dev/private 服务条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 下载 Device Kit，让您的设备尽在掌握！

6756213159.name: SilentProof: Noise Complaint
6756213159.description: Recurring apartment noise is hard to explain when all you have is memory. SilentProof helps renters capture noise incidents as clear records: time, duration, reference dB levels, notes, location context, and on-device audio recording. Export a PDF when you need to follow up with a landlord, property manager, building staff, HOA, or 311-style complaint workflow. It is not just a sound meter. It is a calm documentation workflow for repeated noise issues. HOW IT WORKS 1. CAPTURE THE INCIDENT Open SilentProof when the noise starts and begin an incident record in seconds. 2. ADD THE CONTEXT Keep the details people ask for: Reference decibel readings Time and duration Location context On-device audio recording Notes about what happened 3. EXPORT THE RECORD Create a PDF that is easier to send to: Landlords Property managers Building staff HOAs Local complaint workflows BUILT FOR RENTERS WITH RECURRING NOISE Track issues such as: Upstairs neighbors Loud neighbors, bass, or late-night parties Barking dogs Early-morning construction Repeated disturbances that need a pattern, not a guess WHY SILENTPROOF + Built for complaint records, not one-off readings Turn repeated incidents into a timeline you can review and share. + Privacy-first Your evidence stays on your device by default until you choose to export it. + Quick to start Open the app and start a record quickly when noise starts suddenly. FREE AND PRO FREE: Real-time decibel meter Evidence capture and history 3 PDF exports PRO: Unlimited PDF exports Full reporting workflow One-time purchase, no subscription IMPORTANT SilentProof is a documentation tool for recurring noise issues. It is not legal advice and it is not a certified sound level meter. Audio recording laws vary by location. Check and follow local consent requirements before recording.

6777424959.name: Simple Spider - Solitaire
6777424959.description: MY PROMISE: ONE-TIME PAYMENT, ZERO ADS, ZERO SUBSCRIPTIONS Are you tired of intrusive video ads, sneaky in-app purchase traps, and hidden monthly subscriptions that ruin your concentration? As the independent developer behind Simple games, I firmly believe that great classics don't need unnecessary clutter or tricks to empty your wallet. That is why I created Simple Spider, a premium card game designed exclusively for pure relaxation, mental clarity, and the honesty of traditional games. Buy once and play forever: a 100% transparent, distraction-free experience from the very first hand. No Ads or Video Interruptions: No annoying pop-ups ever disrupting your game. No Subscriptions or Hidden Fees: A single purchase to enjoy the complete game without limits. 100% Offline Gameplay: No Wi-Fi or cellular data required. Enjoy your favorite spider solitaire anywhere—on airplanes, trains, or during your quiet morning routine. DESIGNED FOR MAXIMUM VISUAL COMFORT Stop straining your eyes with cluttered screens, complex menus, and microscopic symbols. I have carefully thought out and optimized every detail of Simple Spider to make it one of the cleanest, most accessible, and easy-to-use card games on the market—ideal for seniors or anyone who values high-contrast readability. Large Print Cards: Extra-large numbers and crystal-clear suit designs make every single card completely visible and easy to recognize at a glance. Clean, Relaxing Interface: A minimalist design that keeps your screen peaceful, focused, and beautifully organized. Tap to Play: Move your cards effortlessly with a simple tap or smooth drag mechanics, fully optimized for all iPhone and iPad screens. GAMEPLAY ADAPTED TO ALL LEVELS Whether you want a casual mental warm-up to start your day or a serious strategic challenge to keep your mind sharp, you can adjust the game to match your own pace—no pressure, no timers. 3 Difficulty Levels: Choose your style by playing variants of 1 suit (Easy), 2 suits (Medium), or 4 suits (Expert). Unlimited Free Hints: Stuck on a tricky move? Get infinite, restriction-free smart hints whenever you need them, with no penalties. One-Tap Auto-Complete: Finish your won games seamlessly with a single convenient tap as soon as the path to victory is completely clear. Infinite Unique Shuffles: My generator guarantees millions of mathematically perfect deals so you never play the same game twice. Download Simple Spider today and rediscover the true joy of a great card game in absolute peace, comfort, and total honesty.

6779927785.name: RecallNote
6779927785.description: RecallNote is a study review app that helps you record, review, and retain what you have learned. Designed for both quick exam preparation and long-term memory retention. 1. Add a Review Item Tap the Add button at the bottom of the screen to create a new review item. You can enter a subject, title, and notes. You can also save study images if needed. The title is optional and can be left blank. 2. Subject Management You can register frequently used subjects in advance. When adding or editing review items, you can select an existing subject or enter a new one manually. 3. Memory Rate Memory Rate is a reference value calculated based on review history and elapsed time. After reviewing, the memory rate increases and gradually decreases over time. It indicates how likely you are to remember the studied content. 4. Achievement Score Achievement Score is calculated based on the number of completed reviews. The more you review, the higher your achievement score becomes, up to 100%. 5. Complete Review After reviewing the content, tap the Review Complete button to increase your review count and achievement score. The last review date is also saved and used to calculate the next review date. 6. Next Review Date The next review date is automatically calculated based on the number of completed reviews. As you review more frequently, the review interval becomes longer. 7. Importance Stars You can assign priority levels to important content using star ratings. Items with higher ratings are easier to focus on before an exam. 8. Edit and Delete Saved review items can be edited at any time. 9. Exam Prep Mode RecallNote is designed to help you review quickly before an exam. You can review a specific subject or all subjects in sequence. Before an exam, quickly revisiting what you have already studied is often more effective than solving everything again. Swipe left or right on the review screen to move quickly between items. Select a subject and tap "Exam Prep" to review only that subject. Select "All" and tap "Exam Prep" to review all subjects in sequence. If images are included, you can zoom in and out using touch gestures to view notes, explanations, and study materials in detail. Use RecallNote for your final 5-minute review before entering the exam room. RecallNote helps you quickly recall what you have already studied. 10. Settings You can change the background theme color from the Settings menu. Available themes include Default (Navy), Sky Blue, Pink, Green, and Purple. 11. PDF Annotation (iPad) You can open PDF files and write directly on them using Apple Pencil on iPad. Highlight, annotate, and review your study materials in one place. 12. TIP 1) Exam Prep Mode cards can be shared with friends. 2) On both iPad and iPhone, the memo panel automatically appears in landscape mode. 3) In portrait mode, tap the memo button to display the memo panel at the bottom of the screen. If a memo exists, the button color will change. 4) Tap the Capture button to turn the PDF content and memo into Review Cards and Exam Prep cards. 5) Press and hold the bookmark button to view the bookmark list and quickly jump to the page you want. 6) RecallNote lets you change the app language without changing your device's system language. iPhone / iPad: Settings → Apps → RecallNote → Language → Select your preferred language 7) RecallNote supports memo synchronization across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. You can handwrite memos on iPhone and iPad and type memos using the keyboard on Mac. Tap the memo switch button to easily view memos created on your other devices. 8) If the current page has a landscape-mode memo, an arrow will appear in the upper-right corner of the screen while in portrait mode. The app also supports Greek, Dutch, Danish, Malay, Vietnamese, Norwegian (Bokmål), Indonesian, Traditional Chinese, Czech, Croatian, Thai, Turkish, Portuguese, Polish, and Hungarian.

6789616690.name: RetroNotes Markdown
6789616690.description: RetroNotes Markdown 是一款以本地文件为核心的文字、语音、视觉与绘图笔记应用。你可以自然记录想法，同时让原始内容保持为可阅读的 Markdown 与 TXT 文件。 文字笔记 在专注的三栏工作区中写作。文字笔记会保存为 Markdown 与 TXT 文件，并可通过标题和正文搜索找到。 语音笔记 + 回溯 按住 Voice Note 按钮，说话后松开。RetroNotes 使用系统语音识别，并把转写内容加入当天的语音笔记。原始录音不会保留。 Recall 可以让你向语音笔记提问。RetroNotes 会优先搜索原始记录，并在信息足够时给出结论和支持来源。 视觉笔记 点击 RetroNotes 标志，导入最多九张照片或截图。RetroNotes 会提取可见文字，并保留每个识别文字区域的相对位置和大小。 绘图笔记 长按新建笔记按钮打开 Draw Note。你可以在可选择的 A 系列、B 系列、信封和美国纸张尺寸上自由绘制。 绘图可导出为 SVG、PDF、PNG 或 PPTX。手写线条在 PowerPoint 中仍可编辑。视觉上闭合的图形可以在 PowerPoint 中填充颜色，同时保留原始手绘轮廓。 RETRODISK 使用 RetroDisk，可以通过 Mac 屏幕和 iPhone 或 iPad 摄像头，从 Mac 向 iPhone 或 iPad 传送文件。 RetroDisk 不需要蓝牙、AirDrop、本地网络、连接线或基于账户的云服务。 PAPER DISK 使用 Paper Disk，可以把一个重要小文件变成加密的可打印 A4 PDF 纸质归档。 每页约保存 10KB。完整 1.44MB 的 Paper Disk 约为 144 页。 Paper Disk 适合用于可靠保存个人核心小文件，例如 Markdown 文件、TXT 文件、恢复说明和关键文档。 恢复时依次扫描全部打印页面。每页 9 个 QR 都扫到后，页面会自动确认完成。全部页面完成后，文件会自动恢复。 Paper Disk 会先加密文件内容，再把加密后的数据写入 QR。文件名、页码和 ID 会显示在纸面上；文件内容不会以明文保存在 QR 里。 本地文件 笔记会保持为 Markdown 与 TXT 文件。你可以选择保存位置，方便阅读、备份、移动，也方便在 RetroNotes 之外访问。 Recall 使用可本地重建的索引。Markdown 与 TXT 文件始终是主要数据。 系统键盘、语音识别、文字识别、摄像头或 iCloud 照片可能需要权限或网络访问。RetroNotes 不提供基于账户的云服务。 RetroNotes 不包含广告、分析、追踪服务、订阅或 App 内购买。 主要功能 用于 Markdown 与 TXT 写作的文字笔记 带语音转写的语音笔记 用于语音笔记的 Recall 回溯 带支持来源的结论 从照片和截图中提取文字的视觉笔记 按空间位置呈现识别文字 带可选纸张尺寸的绘图笔记 A0–A7 与 B0–B7 纸张 C4、C5、C6、DL 与 US #10 信封 Letter、Legal 与 Tabloid 纸张 SVG、PDF、PNG 与可编辑 PPTX 导出 搜索文字笔记、视觉笔记和绘图笔记标题 RetroDisk 光学文件传输 Paper Disk 可打印文件归档 加密 A4 PDF 纸质恢复 用户自选数据位置 文件夹管理 搜索高亮 可调整编辑器文字大小 中文和英文界面 支持 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac

6760652297.name: 斗阵骑士
6760652297.description: 战火重燃，王国告急！《斗阵骑士》（Knightica）正式登陆iOS平台！ 这是一款将【背包管理】、【自走棋】与【Roguelike】完美融合的全新创新策略手游。在这里，空间就是战斗力，智慧才是硬道理！准备好接受挑战了吗？用你的智慧填满背包，用你的策略统治战场！ 游戏特色 【空间魔术，背包即是战场】 不仅仅是自走棋，更是空间规划的极致考验！独创的背包管理机制，如何将庞大的巨龙、锋利的神兵、神秘的魔法道具塞进有限的格子？摆放位置、旋转方向、相邻属性触发……每一个格子的微调，都可能让你的骑士团战力飙升，体验严丝合缝的强迫症解压快感！ 【羁绊交织，招募你的传奇军队】 从高傲的巨龙、优雅的公主到威严的帝王，数十种身负绝技的奇幻单位等你招募。发掘他们之间的隐藏协同效果，收集恶魔精魂进行神秘附魔。在这里，没有绝对的弱者，只有最完美的阵容搭配！ 【爽快爽手，全自动策略解压】 烧脑的策略留在备战期，战斗打响，只需解放双手！看你的精妙构筑在战场上全自动爆发，华丽的技能交织、流畅的打击感，享受纯粹的策略胜利反馈。竖屏单手可玩，随时随地来一局！ 【随机千变，肉鸽冒险百玩不厌】 每一次启程都是全新的未知旅途。随机的牌池、出乎意料的怪物组合、充满抉择的随机事件。是稳扎稳打还是兵行险径？多样的难度选择与极具挑战性的【无尽模式】，满足你对策略深度的一切幻想！ 核心玩法 整备阶段：购买单位，合理旋转并放置在格子中，激活最强协同羁绊。 强化阶段：通过附魔、融合恶魔精魂，让你的棋子突破极限。 全自动战斗：无需繁琐操作，你的骑士团会根据你的布局自动迎战强敌。 无尽挑战：跨越重重关卡迎战最终Boss，解锁更高难度！ 拿起你的剑，整理好你的行囊，《斗阵骑士》的号角已经吹响。现在就下载，开启你的指尖策略风暴，解救深陷黑暗的王国！ 注意：本游戏包含丰富的策略元素，请保持大脑高速运转！

6787687497.name: 宠伴星图
6787687497.description: 宠伴星图是一款面向养宠人和准备养宠用户的猫狗品种图鉴与宠友生活应用。 你可以在这里浏览猫猫、狗狗品种资料，了解体型、性格、习性、护理难度和市场参考价格；也可以通过生活方式测试，获得更适合自己的品种推荐。 应用还提供流浪宠物救助登记、喂食点、宠物友好地点、宠物赛事日历、宠友社区和沉浸式刷一刷内容。你可以收藏品种、对比品种、发布救助信息、分享养宠经验，也可以对不合适的内容进行举报、屏蔽或申诉。 主要功能： 猫狗品种图鉴：按品种、价格、体型、运动量、毛发、生活方式等维度浏览和筛选。 智能匹配：通过生活方式测试，找到更适合你的陪伴品种。 流浪宠物救助：发布待救助动物、发现地点、伤情特征和喂食点信息。 宠友生活：浏览宠物友好公园、酒店、餐厅、露营地，并与宠友交流养宠经验。 宠友社区：发布图文、求助、经验内容，支持评论、点赞、举报和屏蔽。 刷一刷：浏览有趣宠物图片或视频，也可以发布自己的宠物作品。 我的账号：按账号保存收藏、对比、发布记录和客服申诉。 重要提示：品种资料、市场价格、城市政策、赛事和地点信息仅供参考，不替代兽医、政府部门、场地方或专业机构的确认。

6758112121.name: Time Stamp Adder: Video Date
6758112121.description: Your security camera captures everything—except the one thing you need most: the time it happened. When you need to prove exactly when an event took place, most camera clips leave you guessing. No timestamp. No documentation. No proof. Time Stamp Adder burns a clear, accurate timestamp into every frame of your video in seconds—so the date and time travel with the footage wherever it goes. WORKS WITH YOUR CAMERAS Built for Blink home security cameras, with support for DJI drones, Lorex, Ring, and virtually any video on your iPhone or iPad. For Blink clips, the recording time is detected automatically from the file name. HOW IT WORKS 1. Import a video from your photo library—or share it straight from the Blink app. 2. The app reads the recording time and previews your timestamp. 3. Tap once to burn it in, then save or share. FEATURES Automatic time detection from Blink file names Adjust the detected time before you stamp, so it's always accurate Camera and location labels (like "Front Door") above the timestamp—auto-filled for Blink clips Multiple date and time formats: 12- or 24-hour, US, ISO, and more Time-zone control for footage recorded elsewhere Place the timestamp anywhere: any corner, an edge, or a full-width bar Custom font size, color, stroke, and background Even-width digits, so the time never jitters as the seconds tick by High-quality, visually lossless output Keep using your phone while videos process in the background—we'll notify you the moment they're ready PERFECT FOR Insurance claims and evidence documentation Security and property records Knowing exactly when an event occurred Sharing footage that speaks for itself Footage without a date is just a clip. Add the proof. Questions or an idea for the app? We'd love to hear from you—reach out any time.

6739975439.name: TrueLoop
6739975439.description: 简介： 你是否在学习语言的过程中，常常为记不住发音、拼写而烦恼？TrueLoop 将为你轻松化解这些难题，成为你语言学习路上的得力伙伴！ 核心功能： 多语言复读：无论你正在学习英语、中文，还是其他任何语言，TrueLoop 都能精准地重复播放你所设定的文案内容。不管是单词、短语还是长篇文章，它都可以帮你循环复读，强化记忆，让那些拗口的发音和复杂的拼写不再是学习的阻碍。 灵活设置：这款 app 提供了丰富且人性化的设置选项。你可以自由设定重复的时间，根据自己的学习节奏，合理规划每次复读的时长；也能调整间隔的时间，让每一次的重复恰到好处；更棒的是，还能控制重复时读词的速度，从缓慢清晰的跟读，到快速流畅的巩固，满足不同学习阶段和学习习惯的需求。而且，所有这些设置完成后，TrueLoop 能够在后台按照你设定的规则持续运行，方便你在做其他事情的同时，依然可以利用碎片化时间学习语言，学习效率倍增。 次时代界面：TrueLoop 不仅功能强大，还拥有极具现代感与科技感的软件风格界面。简洁直观的操作界面，让你可以轻松上手，快速完成各项设置，沉浸在舒适、高效的语言学习氛围之中。每一处细节都彰显着次时代的设计理念，为你的语言学习之旅增添一份别样的精彩。 TrueLoop 就像是一台贴心的语言复读机，时刻陪伴你，助力你攻克语言学习中的发音与拼写难关。无论你是零基础的语言小白，还是想要进一步提升语言能力的进阶学习者，它都将是你不可或缺的学习工具。快来下载 TrueLoop，开启轻松高效的语言学习新体验吧！

6762223403.description: 在手腕上学习挪威语。挪威语英语词典是一款专为智能手表原生打造的强大离线单词翻译器——无需手机，无需网络。 即刻搜索数千个挪威语和英语单词，通过文本转语音聆听正确发音，并通过每日一词功能积累词汇——一切尽在您的手表上。 主要功能： 即时离线搜索 输入任意挪威语或英语单词，实时查看翻译。词典完全离线工作——非常适合旅行、学习或没有网络的环境。 自动语言检测 应用自动检测您输入的是英语还是挪威语，并切换搜索方向——无需手动切换。 收藏与历史记录 用星号标记想记住的单词，并随时在历史记录页面查看最近的搜索。 每日一词 每天发现一个新挪威语单词，轻松积累词汇。 按主题分类的常用短语 浏览按主题分类的即用短语：问候、旅行、饮食、数字、时间、方向、健康等。 文本转语音发音 点击扬声器图标，听取任何单词或短语的正确发音。 专为智能手表打造 在所有手表型号上均能获得快速、轻量且省电的体验。 无论您是学生、旅行者还是语言爱好者，挪威语英语词典都能让您在手腕上拥有完整词典的强大功能——随时可用，始终离线。

6780652230.name: 工单台账-派工维修记录2026
6780652230.trackName: 工单台账-派工维修记录2026
6780652230.description: 工单台账是一款面向小微企业、门店后勤、物业现场和维修团队的离线工单管理工具。无需账号、无需联网，所有派工、维修、验收和费用记录都保存在本机。 你可以快速建立工单，记录客户或部门、故障描述、负责人、优先级、处理进度、材料费用和验收结果。应用提供状态看板、逾期筛选、编号搜索、照片凭证和PDF导出，适合替代纸质工单和零散表格。 核心功能： 1. 工单登记：支持自动编号、客户/部门、地点、联系人、故障描述、优先级和负责人记录。 2. 进度跟踪：待处理、处理中、待验收、已完成等状态看板，支持逾期标记和条件筛选。 3. 维修归档：记录处理过程、材料费用、工时、照片凭证、验收备注和签收信息。 4. 本地搜索与统计：按编号、客户、负责人、状态和日期快速检索，查看月度工单数量与费用汇总。 5. 离线导出：生成本地PDF工单或汇总表，便于打印、交接和归档。

6786744002.description: 每天接单几百单，月底一算却不知道究竟赚了多少？哪道菜在赚钱、哪道菜在亏钱，全凭感觉？平台抽成、活动分摊、包装耗材、食材损耗，一笔笔藏在账里看不见？「外卖菜品毛利」就是为解决这些问题而生。它把外卖经营中最关键的「菜品级成本与毛利」算到最细，让你不再糊里糊涂地接单，而是清清楚楚地赚钱。 【一款 App，看透每道菜的真实利润】 不同于只记流水的记账软件，「外卖菜品毛利」围绕「菜品」这一核心颗粒度展开：每一道菜都有自己的原料清单（BOM）、包装成本、售价与毛利率。结合订单数据，App 自动帮你算出营收、毛利、实收与净利，让经营状况一目了然。无论你是单店经营者、夫妻店老板，还是连锁门店的店长，都能用它把账算明白。 【四大核心模块，覆盖经营全链路】 1. 首页经营看板 打开 App 即可看到本月四大核心指标：营收、毛利、实收、净利。每项指标配独立趋势小图，支持最近 7 天、本月每日、近 12 个月多维度切换。一眼掌握经营走势，及时发现异常。看板还内置低毛利预警卡片，自动识别利润率偏低的菜品并提醒优化。担心数据被旁人看见？轻触指标卡即可一键隐藏金额，长按可查看指标说明，兼顾隐私与易用。下拉刷新实时同步最新数据。 2. 订单管理与导入 支持从美团、饿了么等平台导出的 CSV / XLSX 订单文件一键导入，App 自动解析菜品名称、数量、金额，并按日期归档。支持自定义平台费率、配送补贴、活动分摊，让「实收」与「净利」更贴近真实经营。除文件导入外，也提供手动录入与粘贴解析模式，灵活适配不同平台导出格式。导入完成后可在「历史」中按日查看明细，支持按月快速切换与清空。从微信、邮件、文件 App 直接打开订单文件也能跳转导入，工作流一气呵成。首次使用还可通过「导入帮助」自定义字段映射，让解析更精准。 3. 菜品与原料管理 为每道菜建立专属档案：售价、包装成本、分类、排序、图片。重点功能是「原料清单」——逐项录入食材名称、用量、单位、单价，App 即时计算该菜的食材成本、总成本、毛利与毛利率，并以颜色直观标注利润健康度。内置常用原料库与最近使用记录，录入更高效；支持分类管理（重命名、删除、菜品自动归入「未分类」），以及批量调价（按金额或百分比）与批量删除，菜品上下架维护事半功倍。原料单位可在「设置」中默认为克（g）或毫升（ml），新增时自动带入。 4. 毛利分析与决策辅助 「分析」模块提供四个高价值工具： 毛利排行：以柱状图直观呈现各菜品毛利率排名，谁是利润担当、谁在拖后腿，一秒看清。 套餐模拟：选择主菜并搭配若干配菜，即时计算套餐综合毛利，辅助设计高性价比套餐组合。 定价模拟：拖动价格滑块，实时查看不同售价下的毛利变化，科学定价有据可依。 报损记录：按日期、菜品、数量、金额、原因（过期、损坏、退单等）登记损耗，自动汇总当月报损，让「净利」更真实。 【为什么选择「外卖菜品毛利」】 算得细：菜品级 BOM 成本核算，毛利率精确到每道菜，告别「差不多」的糊涂账。 看得清：首页看板 + 多维趋势图 + 低毛利预警，经营健康度一屏掌握。 导得快：兼容主流平台 CSV/XLSX 订单文件，支持系统级「打开方式」跳转导入。 决策强：套餐模拟、定价模拟、毛利排行、报损追踪，把「拍脑袋」变成「看数据」。 用得安：数据本地存储，无需注册联网，离线可用，隐私政策清晰透明。 体验好：原生 iOS 设计语言，卡片式布局、弹簧触感反馈、深浅适配，操作顺手。 【适合谁用】 外卖专营店主：想要精确掌握每道菜毛利，优化菜单结构。 堂食+外卖餐饮老板：需要把平台抽成、包装、损耗都算清楚的经营者。 连锁门店店长：希望快速复盘点位盈利情况，做菜单与定价调整。 餐饮创业新手：建立科学的成本核算意识，从第一天就把账算明白。 【数据安全与隐私】 所有经营数据均保存在设备本地，App 不强制注册登录，不联网上传你的经营信息。使用相机仅用于拍摄菜品图片，使用文件访问仅用于读取订单文件，权限申请均有明确用途说明。详细的隐私政策可在「设置」中随时查看。 【持续进化】 我们持续优化解析能力与交互体验，让每一位餐饮经营者都能用更少的时间，看清更准的利润。如果你也想知道「今天到底赚了多少」，那就从下载「外卖菜品毛利」开始，把每一道菜、每一笔单、每一分毛利都算得清清楚楚。 下载「外卖菜品毛利」，让每一道菜都成为你赚钱的依据。

6778277614.name: ShopCAM: CNC G-Code Generator
6778277614.description: ShopCAM Pro turns your phone into a shop-floor CAM station. Describe the operation, get clean Fanuc-flavor G-code — no PC, no CAD file, no waiting. WHAT IT DOES Conversational input: pick the operation, fill in the numbers, generate code Covers drilling, peck drilling, milling, boring, tapping, threadmilling, and more Fanuc-compatible ISO output — drops straight into Haas, Mazak, Centroid, LinuxCNC, Mach3/4 2D toolpath preview so you can visually verify the path before cutting Machine profiles: save your tool offsets, rapid heights, and feed defaults Full G-code editor with copy and share FREE TIER Drill and peck drilling operations — full featured, no time limit. SHOPCAM PRO Unlock all operations including milling, boring, tapping, threadmilling, and every future template. Three ways to subscribe: Monthly: flexible, cancel any time Annual: ~30% savings vs monthly Lifetime: one payment, own it forever BUILT FOR THE SHOP FLOOR Works completely offline. No account required. Designed to be usable with one hand while standing at a machine. Always single-block, reduced rapid, and dry-run before cutting. ShopCAM handles the math — you handle the machine. Subscriptions auto-renew until cancelled. Manage in your Apple ID Subscription Settings. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://doublevision.company/privacy

6761420688.name: Photo Statistic
6761420688.description: Photo Statistic turns the photos and videos already on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac into a picture of your own life: how many you took, when you took them, and where. Nothing is imported, nothing is uploaded, and nothing in your library is changed - the app simply reads what is already there and counts it. There is no account to create, no setup to work through, and no file to import. Open the app, allow access to your library, and start exploring. KEY FEATURES From Years Down to Hours Your library becomes a timeline you can open like nested drawers: years, then months, then days, then hours, and finally the pictures themselves Stacked bars show photos and videos side by side, so you can see at a glance which years and months you shot the most Tap any bar for the exact numbers, or jump straight into that period Switch between photos, videos, or both at any level Watch your library grow over time on a chart Group titles stay pinned while you scroll, so you always know where you are A Map Made of Hexagons Photos that carry a location cluster into honeycomb cells, each labeled with how many pictures were taken there Adjust the cell size from 1 to 100 kilometers, from a single neighborhood out to a whole continent Tap any cell to see the pictures behind it The map is drawn only from coordinates already saved in your photos - the app never asks for your device location Mark the Ones You Love Browse thumbnails grouped by period, and pinch to resize the grid Select several pictures at once, or a whole group by tapping its title Collect everything you marked into a real album in the Photos app with a single tap, and clear it again whenever you like Ask Instead of Tapping Apple Intelligence: describe what you want in plain language and the app opens at the matching year, month, or day - no phrase to memorize Siri answers out loud without opening the app - ask for a photo report for last month, or how many videos you took this year Leave out the time period and Siri simply asks for it Four Shortcuts actions turn your library into a report, a spreadsheet, or a plain number: Get Photo Statistics, Get Photo Statistics Breakdown, Export Photo Statistics, and Count Photos Export as CSV or JSON, or build a PDF report inside a shortcut Choose today, last month, a specific year, a date range, or any number of days back Private By Design Every calculation happens on your device, using Apple's own PhotoKit Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared; no photo ever leaves your device On the Mac the app runs in Apple's App Sandbox with no permission to make outgoing network connections, enforced by the system rather than by our promise alone The app never deletes or edits anything in your library; the only thing it writes is the album you ask it to create No account, no ads, no usage tracking, no analytics Also Included Handoff: start on your iPhone and pick up on your Mac exactly where you left off Dark Mode One app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac Available in English, German, Spanish, and French Completely free, with no in-app purchases and no subscription Photo Statistic only ever reads and counts - it never moves, edits, or deletes a single picture, so you can explore your entire library without putting any of it at risk. Terms of Use (EULA): https://apps.schwarz-interactive.de/terms-of-use.html

6790363960.name: 球球打砖块 for watch：手腕上的弹球消方块消除小游戏
6790363960.trackName: 球球打砖块 for watch：手腕上的弹球消方块消除小游戏
6790363960.description: 在手腕上体验经典又轻松的打砖块游戏！ 控制挡板左右移动，接住不断落下的小球，让它持续反弹并击碎上方的砖块。看似简单的操作，却需要你判断小球的落点、及时调整挡板位置，并寻找更合适的反弹角度。 游戏提供闯关模式和挑战模式。你可以逐步完成精心设计的100个关卡，也可以进入挑战模式，不断打破砖块并刷新自己的最高分纪录。 【两种游戏模式】 闯关模式 包含100个关卡。控制小球击碎砖块，完成当前关卡后继续迎接新的挑战。 挑战模式 没有固定关卡目标，尽可能坚持更长时间、击碎更多砖块，不断刷新自己的最高分。 【游戏玩法】 控制挡板移动，接住落下的小球 利用挡板改变小球的反弹方向 让小球不断撞击并击碎砖块 避免小球从挡板下方掉落 观察运动轨迹，把握每一次接球时机 【游戏特色】 经典打砖块玩法，简单直观 100个关卡，逐步挑战不同砖块布局 挑战模式，冲击更高分数纪录 小球反弹与砖块碰撞，节奏轻快 操作容易上手，也考验反应与判断 专为 Apple Watch 操作体验设计 适合利用碎片时间随时挑战 移动挡板，接住小球，击碎砖块。 完成100个关卡，或者在挑战模式中刷新最高分，开始你的手腕打砖块挑战吧！

6781997361.name: LUT工坊：相机风格
6781997361.description: 在 iPhone 上设计自定义相机风格，并导出行业标准 .cube LUT。 LUT Smith 帮助影片创作者、摄影师和内容创作者为相机 App 与剪辑流程制作可复用的色彩风格，而不是把手机变成完整的视频编辑器。 功能： 从标准照片、iOS 支持的 RAW 照片、选定的视频帧或内置样张创建 LUT。 调整曝光、对比度、饱和度、色调、曲线、分离色调和宽域 HSL 色带。 在肤色、风景、夜景、美食和色卡样张上预览风格。 以 17x、33x 或 65x 尺寸导出 .cube LUT，并附带色彩配置和目标提示。 保存、搜索、复制、标记并整理你的本地 LUT 库。 使用目标预设和导出后的说明适配相机与剪辑工作流。 源媒体处理保留在设备上，除非你主动导出或分享。 Pro： LUT Smith Pro 解锁无限 LUT 导出、33x 与 65x 导出、高级色彩工具、目标预设、ZIP 打包导出，以及对现有 .cube LUT 的导入和微调流程。 重要说明： 标准 .cube LUT 保存的是全局色彩变换。颗粒、蒙版、模糊、辉光和局部调整等效果仅用于预览，除非它们可以表示为全局颜色变化。 使用条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6781699989.name: SportVitals: Recovery & HRV
6781699989.description: Turn your Apple Health data into clear, practical guidance for recovery, sleep and training. SportVitals brings advanced fitness insights to iPhone and Apple Watch without another wearable or recurring subscription. Your core health calculations and explanations run on device. No account, ads, third-party analytics or developer-operated cloud. KNOW WHAT YOUR BODY IS READY FOR Daily Readiness A 0–100 score that combines sleep, recovery time, HRV status, stress history and training load so you can choose between hard training, easy work and rest. All-day energy and stress Follow how rest, sleep, activity and physiological stress change your energy through the day, with detailed intraday charts. HRV status Track overnight RMSSD against your personal 21-day baseline and see whether your recent trend is balanced, low or outside your usual range. SLEEP WITH CONTEXT Use Sleep Score, sleep stages, efficiency, fragmentation, schedule consistency, Sleep Bank and circadian guidance to understand both last night and your longer recovery pattern. TRAIN SMARTER OVER TIME Training Load and Status using TRIMP, ATL, CTL, TSB and ACWR Exertion and a daily target adjusted to your recovery Recovery Time, Training Focus and personalized heart-rate zones VO₂ max insights for running and cycling, Endurance Score, Hill Score, Race Predictor and Lactate Threshold Detailed workout history, routes, heart-rate zones, running dynamics and cycling power when available MORE THAN A DASHBOARD Educational Biological Age estimate with the factors that influence it Morning and evening reports Customizable dashboard and metric order Home Screen widgets and Apple Watch complications Vital-sign trends, body weight/body fat, calories, mindfulness and blood pressure from Apple Health On-device metric explanations; personalized workout suggestions and WorkoutKit export on supported Apple Intelligence devices PRIVACY AND OWNERSHIP Buy once. No subscription. No signup. No ads. No tracking SDKs. SportVitals does not sell or upload your health data to developer servers. REQUIREMENTS SportVitals requires iOS 18 or later and access to Apple Health. An Apple Watch worn overnight is recommended for sleep and HRV features. Feature availability depends on the data provided by your devices. On-device AI workout suggestions require a compatible Apple Intelligence device with iOS 26 or later. Weather context in daily reports uses Apple’s Weather service and is optional. SportVitals provides fitness and wellness information only. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions.

6789223079.name: Tessera Sequenced Resonator
6789223079.description: Tessera is a tuned resonator. Play a drum loop, a guitar, a vocal, or a field recording into it, and it blooms that sound into twelve pitched voices that ring, shimmer, and decay in tune. At its core are twelve parallel resonators, each locked to a note of a chord or scale you choose. Whatever you feed them excites those voices, so a single hit becomes a lush chord, a sustained pad, or a slowly evolving cloud. Pick a root and a scale, from majors and minors through ninths, elevenths, whole tone, and chromatic, and the whole instrument retunes at once. Choose from eleven resonator models: plucked strings, struck bells, singing bowls, glass, membranes, tuned bars, plates, and hollow tubes. Shape each one with decay, damping, brightness, and stereo spread, moving from tight and percussive to vast and cathedral-like. Five motion engines decide how the voices arrive: Contour spreads them into shimmering, arpeggiated waves. SEQ steps each voice through its own rhythmic pattern. Strum rakes across the chord like fingers on strings. Arp cycles the voices one note at a time. Swarm lets them weave and drift around a moving center. Any of it can lock to your host tempo, so rhythmic patches stay in time. Play Tessera three ways: leave MIDI off and let the resonators sound on their own tuning, key them live from a keyboard, or gate them with held chords. Balance the effect with the dry and wet mix, blur the tails with the diffusion stage, and add motion with the built-in vibrato LFO. Microtonal tunings are supported for the pitch-obsessed. One hundred factory presets get you going, from plucks and drones to bells, rhythmic sequences, strummed chords, arpeggios, and dark cinematic textures. Tessera runs as an AUv3 plug-in inside your favorite host, and as a standalone app.

6790069435.name: 事件计时-纪念日倒计时与循环闹钟提醒
6790069435.trackName: 事件计时-纪念日倒计时与循环闹钟提醒
6790069435.description: 事件计时帮你把「已经多久」和「还有多久」放在一起管理：纪念日、考试、项目节点、还款日、健身课、浇水提醒……登记一次，按时间与是否重复自动进入正计时、倒计时或循环计时。 自定义显示口径 每个事件可单独选择显示年、月、天、小时、分 秒与毫秒始终可见；点标题可进入精确模式查看毫秒跳动 关闭上级单位时会自动换算到下一级（例如只显示「366 天」或「1090 小时」） 三列表，自动归位 正计时：已发生的一次性事件，显示「已经多久」 倒计时：尚未到来的一次性事件，显示「还有多久」；到期后自动转入正计时 循环计时：按年 / 月 / 周 / 日或自定义间隔（如每 2 天、每 3 周）重复，始终显示距下一次还有多久 真实闹钟与提醒 可为事件开启系统级闹钟（默认铃声） 换新手机后，已开启闹钟的事件可能需要重新授权并重建 桌面与主题 桌面小组件与锁屏布局，一眼看到临近事件 主题库可为 App 列表与组件设置风格 同步与隐私 可选 iCloud 同步事件与分组，方便换机恢复 数据保存在你的 Apple 账号下，不上传到其他第三方服务 生日与纪念日 生日分组显示新历周岁与农历虚岁，可选择显示方式 纪念日分组显示已满年数 归档 可为事件设置归档时间；到期后进入「归档」并定格计时 关闭归档或改到未来时间可恢复到原列表 清新外观 默认「清新卡片」主题：彩色图标、浅色渐变与轻水印；原有主题仍可选用 可按分组自动配图标与颜色，也可在编辑页单独设置 桌面组件 新增奶油暖光、柔和风景、星空玻璃、云朵宫格四种插画主题 「列表」组件支持中号与大号，只显示能完整放下的事件 其他 支持公历 / 农历日期 分组管理、名称筛选、最多 500 条事件 专为较新的 iOS 系统设计，列表刷新兼顾实时与省电 事件计时——把重要时刻，算得清楚、记得准时。

6761292407.name: gtsync: Sync Tasks & Reminders
6761292407.description: Two-way sync between Google Tasks (including tasks in Google Calendar) and the Reminders app (including Reminders in the Calendar app). A seamless way to keep everything you need to do synchronized across both platforms. gtsync securely connects Google Tasks to the Reminders app. Add a reminder using Siri on your commute, and it's waiting for you alongside your tasks in Google Calendar on your laptop. Check an item off in your browser, and it clears from your iPhone. One unified workflow, zero friction. Sync and organization Bi-directional sync between the Reminders and Google Tasks apps Sync reminders in the native Calendar app and tasks in the Google Calendar app Sync titles, notes, completion status, and due dates Discover and match task lists and reminder lists Choose which lists are included Automatically include new lists if you want Create a missing list automatically when needed Review and resolve changes See pending creates, updates, and deletions before applying them Review the direction, list, timestamp, and changed fields for each item Compare both versions when an item changed in both services Choose whether to keep the Google Tasks or Reminders version Optionally resolve conflicts automatically using the most recently modified version Automatic and on-demand sync Optional background sync takes care of staying in sync Use the Siri Shortcuts action to sync on demand, in an automation, or when you open a task app Get notified about conflicts and other issues that need your attention Safety and visibility Configurable safety threshold for large batches of automatic changes Automatic sync pauses when the threshold is exceeded so you can review first Activity history with sync actions, errors, and timestamps Progress indicators and the ability to stop an in-progress sync Statistics Day, week, and month views of your sync activity, with quick navigation between periods At-a-glance totals for items synced, completed, conflicts, and errors Activity chart showing creates, edits, completions, uncompletions, and deletions over time Breakdowns by direction, action, and list Tap any breakdown to see the matching entries in your activity history Privacy Sync processing and sync history stay on your device Connects directly to Reminders and your Google account Limitations gtsync syncs titles, notes, completion state, and due dates between Reminders and Google Tasks. The following fields do not sync due to platform differences and limitations: Attachments Alerts / reminders Priority Recurrence (repeating tasks) Time-specific due dates (reduced to date-only values)

6767444130.name: Cleave for EPUB
6767444130.description: Cleave is an on-device EPUB metadata editor for iPhone and iPad. Drop a book in, and it cleans up the messy title, author, and publisher fields in seconds — no account, no uploads, no tracking. Designed for readers who sideload books onto a Kindle, a Boox, a Palma, a Kobo, or into KOReader and Calibre. If you've ever had a library full of files named "The_Book_(z-lib.org)_(1).epub" with title "The Book (z-lib.org) - Copy", Cleave fixes them. FEATURES Auto-clean on load Strips source-site watermarks from title, author, and publisher. Normalizes author-name order ("Austen, Jane" → "Jane Austen" or vice versa). Cleans file junk like "(1)", " - copy", " final". All rules are configurable. Web enrichment Fills missing description, publisher, date, ISBN, series, and subjects from Apple Books, Open Library, and optionally Google Books. Anonymous queries — no account, no identifier sent. Cover picker Fetches candidate covers from Apple Books and Open Library in one tap. Pick one, revert anytime, or use your own image from Photos. Source-watermark page stripping Detects and removes the one-page "downloaded from" ad pages that some redistributors inject. Rename by template Rebuild filenames from {author}, {title}, {series}, {seriesIndex}, {year}. Presets: Default, Calibre, Year-suffix, Series-first, Title-only. Directory structure Save directly into a Calibre-style Author/ subfolder if your reader expects it. Share sheet integration Share any EPUB from Files, Safari, Mail, or another app — Cleave picks it up, cleans it, and hands it back for saving. Batch support Drop a bunch of files at once. Cleave walks you through them one by one with a running counter. PRIVACY Cleave does not collect any personal data. There is no account, no backend, no analytics, and no advertising SDK. The only network requests are anonymous metadata/cover queries to three public APIs (Apple Books, Open Library, Google Books) — none of which receive any user identifier. File processing happens entirely on your device. Your books never leave your iPhone or iPad. For power users: a diagnostics screen shows the share-extension log, the App Group inbox, and all settings. Everything is editable. SUPPORT Questions, bug reports, feature requests: cleave-whidbey.vercel.app/support Privacy policy: cleave-whidbey.vercel.app/privacy Cleave is designed by a small team who sideload books every week. If it saves you ten minutes a month, it's doing its job.

6760493013.name: AuraCanvas
6760493013.description: AuraCanvas transforms your touch into living, evolving artwork and a few quiet minutes into something that genuinely settles the mind. No artistic experience needed. No goals. No pressure. Perfect for kids and adults alike. Just draw, breathe, and watch something beautiful emerge. A MOMENT OF CALM In a world of constant noise, AuraCanvas gives you somewhere to go. Drawing slowly on a dark canvas — watching light respond to your touch, seeing something unexpected grow from a single stroke — is deeply meditative. Many users reach for AuraCanvas when anxiety creeps in, when the day feels too loud, or when they need a few minutes of creative flow to reset. There are no wrong moves here. Everything you draw becomes something worth keeping. DRAW Ten generative styles each transform your strokes differently: Flow — fluid tendrils that drift like ink in water Particle — glowing bursts and softly scattered blooms Radial — hypnotic symmetrical explosions of light Kaleidoscope — every gesture mirrored into infinite patterns Vortex — spiral arms that pull inward like a living galaxy Mandala — sacred geometry from a single stroke Crystal Growth — crystalline structures growing like minerals under a microscope Mosaic — tessellated geometric fragments Mixed — a new style chosen for every stroke Reaction Diffusion — organic patterns from the same mathematics that creates animal markings Combine any two styles with Blend Mode. Customize brushes from precision lines to wide spray strokes — each one previewed so you see exactly how it draws. Choose from curated palettes — Neon Aurora, Monochrome, Earth Tones, Sunset, Ocean Deep, Pastel Dream, Fire & Ice, and Cyberpunk — or build your own. EVOLVE Tap Evolve and step back. AuraCanvas reads your drawing and grows something new from what you made. Particle blooms emerge from stroke endpoints. Patterns deepen and strengthen. Each evolution is completely unique — the same drawing evolved twice will never look the same. AUDIO REACTIVE CANVAS Evolution unfolds in three stages: Growth, Refinement, and Crystallization. Adjust intensity in real time. Evolve once for a first transformation. Evolve again to go deeper. There is no wrong place to stop. LIVING MOTION Turn your finished canvas into a living video. Choose from five moods — Breathing, Drifting, Dreaming, Awakening, and Unfolding — each animating your artwork differently. Preview in real time, adjust intensity, and export as Wallpaper, Reel, Story, Square Post, Ambient loop, or cinematic Reveal — up to 4K at 60fps. EXPORT Export stills at up to 8× resolution — genuinely print-ready at 300 DPI for posters and gallery-scale output. Every export re-renders from your original stroke data for maximum clarity. Image — wallpapers and sharing Animated GIF — your canvas in motion Poster — gallery-framed and ready to print Video — living motion in multiple formats GALLERY Every piece saves automatically to a private gallery on your device. Revisit old work. Re-evolve pieces from months ago. No login required. No internet connection needed. No accounts. No cloud. No data collected. PREMIUM : Buy once. Own forever. No subscription. Ever. Free to draw, evolve, and export at standard resolution. One purchase unlocks everything: All styles including Kaleidoscope, Vortex, Mandala, Crystal Growth, Mosaic, Mixed, and Reaction Diffusion All color palettes High-resolution and print export Living Motion video export Watermark-free GIF and Poster export WHAT PEOPLE CREATE Neon wallpapers. Symmetrical mandalas. Abstract poster prints. Living wallpaper videos. A few minutes of quiet in a loud day. Gifts that feel genuinely handmade. Something beautiful from a moment of anxiety. Things that have no name yet. AuraCanvas doesn't tell you what to make or how to feel. It turns whatever you draw — and whatever you're carrying when you draw it — into something more than you expected.

6745764555.name: Jetz
6745764555.description: Jetz makes it easy to transfer any file using AirDrop. Long gone are the days of hunting down the AirDrop tab in Finder. With Jetz, you'll drag your files directly into the dock prompting a seamless transfer every time. AirDrop has never been simpler! Quick, easy, done. Features: AirDrop multiple files at the same time (any type)! Open at Login: Automatically start QuickDrop when you restart your computer or log in after logging out. Instructions: Download Jetz, put the app icon in your dock. Take the file(s) you wish to transfer, and drag it into the app icon in your dock. The AirDrop extension will slide open. Select your device, and you're flying!

6760649275.name: QuizTables - 心算训练
6760649275.description: QuizTables是学习和练习心算的完美应用。专为儿童和成人设计，将数学学习变成有趣且充满动力的挑战。 五种游戏模式 加法 — 掌握数字加法 减法 — 练习减法（结果始终为正） 乘法 — 复习乘法口诀表 除法 — 练习整除运算 混合 — 打乱所有运算，迎接终极挑战 三个难度等级 初级 — 1到10的数字，适合入门 中级 — 数字最大到100，适合进阶 高级 — 数字最大到1000，适合计算高手 功能特色 每局20道题，内置计时器 集成数字键盘，简单直观 积分系统：基础分 + 速度奖励 支持多个玩家档案，全家共享 带奖牌的成绩排行榜（金、银、铜） 按运算类型和难度筛选成绩 答对和答错时的触觉反馈 iCloud跨设备同步 界面完全本地化，支持9种语言 无内购。无广告。不收集个人数据。

6781687689.name: 交接板-班组交班记录2026
6781687689.description: 交接板是一款面向轮班岗位的离线交接记录应用，适合门店值班、物业客服、仓库现场、前台行政、工厂班组等需要清晰交班的场景。 应用不需要账号、不联网、不收集个人数据，所有交接内容仅保存在本机。用户可以按班次记录待办事项、异常问题、物品交接、责任人和完成状态，快速生成可复制的交接摘要，减少漏交、漏办和口头交接不清的问题。 核心功能包括：交班模板、事项分组、完成勾选、异常标记、班次筛选、本地搜索、交接摘要复制、历史归档和离线导出。

6790077986.name: 漂流瓶·星座

6745784968.name: 条码扫描 - 包裹扫码
6745784968.trackName: 条码扫描 - 包裹扫码
6745784968.description: TrackingScan – 智能扫码与包裹追踪助手 TrackingScan 专为包裹追踪、库存处理和仓储管理打造，提供快速、精准、语音辅助的扫码体验，助力物流与仓储效率全面提升。 主要功能： 条码与二维码扫描 扫描后自动识别快递单号是否属于 USPS、UPS、FedEx 或 Amazon (TBA)，便于快速分类与分拣。 语音播报功能 自动播报当前已扫描的追踪数量，便于在无需查看屏幕的情况下确认进度。 内置签名功能 + PDF 导出 在收发货流程中支持直接在设备上签名，并可导出为 PDF 文件用于打印或合规存档。 追踪记录导出 所有扫描记录可导出为结构化数据，方便对接仓储或 ERP 系统。 重复扫描提醒 即时检测当前批次或历史记录中的重复追踪号，避免操作失误。 历史记录查询 可根据时间、批次或追踪号搜索历史记录，快速定位所需数据。 低光环境下的手电筒按钮 在较暗环境中，扫码界面将自动显示手电筒开关，确保扫码顺利进行。 无论您是管理仓库、处理物流，还是进行末端配送，TrackingScan 都是您高效、安全、无误地完成扫码与追踪任务的理想工具。

6775230759.name: TravelPins: World Map
6775230759.description: TravelPins is your premium travel companion — a beautiful, offline-first app to track every country and city you've visited, document your travel memories, and visualize your personal world map. INTERACTIVE WORLD MAP Tap any country on the fully offline world map to mark it as visited or add it to your bucket list. Pinch to zoom in, explore continents, and watch your personal map come to life as you travel more. COUNTRY & CITY TRACKING Log every country and city you've visited with dates, ratings, notes, and photos. See your travels grouped by continent, sorted by date, and organized the way you like it. TRAVEL MEMORIES Create rich travel journals with photos, mood tags, and location references. Relive your adventures with a beautiful card-based gallery of your best moments. TRAVEL GOALS Set personal travel goals — visit 50 countries, explore all 7 continents, discover 100 cities. Watch your progress with visual trackers and celebrate milestones. ACHIEVEMENTS Unlock travel achievements as you explore. From "First Stamp" to "World Explorer" — your journey is celebrated every step of the way. TRAVEL STATS See your world exploration percentage, continent breakdown, yearly travel reports, and favorite destinations at a glance. BUCKET LIST Plan your future adventures with a dedicated bucket list. Mark dream destinations and turn them into visited ones. COMPLETE PRIVACY All data stays on your device. No accounts required. No data collection. No cloud sync. No tracking. Your travel memories are yours alone. EXPORT YOUR DATA Export your travel history as PDF or CSV. Share your journey your way. 15 LANGUAGES Available in English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), and Russian. No ads. No subscriptions. No accounts. Just travel. Pay once, travel forever.

6791393409.trackName: 课时记-兴趣班课时管家
6791393409.description: 时记帮你把孩子的兴趣班安排得明明白白——哪天上课、上了几节、还剩多少、花了多少钱，全记在一处。 【今日】打开就看到当天的课，点一下完成打卡，课时自动扣减，状态一眼可见。支持批量打卡，机构也能用。 【课程】多孩子、多课程按颜色标签分组；每周固定、单双周、补课请假都能设，上课时间也能改；同一节课可分别给多个学生扣课。 【缴费】缴费、退费、收据拍照都记下，课时包自动关联，不再算错账。 【统计】剩余课时、本月上课、本年花费一屏看清，趋势图帮你回顾孩子的学习投入。 数据默认存在本机，需要时再开云同步，随时可导出。一次付费 ¥8，无广告、无订阅。 把孩子的每一节课，都记得明明白白。

6782787044.name: 纸间 · 简单笔记
6782787044.description: 纸间是一款本地优先、轻量而专注的笔记应用。 笔记默认保存在你的设备上，无需注册账号，也可以完全离线使用。需要跨设备使用时，你可以连接自己的 WebDAV 服务，并在需要时手动同步。 主要功能： 本地优先：笔记保存在本机，离线也能随时查看和编辑 手动保存：由你决定何时保存修改，减少误操作 WebDAV 同步：使用你自己的 WebDAV 空间，不依赖专用云端账号 Markdown 与 HTML：支持源码编辑和内容预览 LaTeX 公式：在 Markdown 笔记中渲染行内及块级数学公式 插入图片：选择图片后以 Base64 形式直接保存在笔记正文中 分类管理：新增、重命名和删除分类，快速整理内容 快速搜索：搜索笔记标题、正文，以及当前笔记中的关键词 多种主题：提供清爽浅色、深色工作台和暖色纸感主题 iPhone 与 iPad：支持不同屏幕尺寸和横竖屏使用 关于数据： 纸间不会要求你注册开发者提供的账号。笔记保存在本机 SQLite 数据库中；WebDAV 密码保存在系统 Keychain。只有在你主动执行同步时，应用才会连接你设置的 WebDAV 地址。 提示：WebDAV 为可选功能，需要用户自行准备兼容的 WebDAV 服务。

6787737491.name: ProCam MK II - 专业摄影相机

6771076366.name: GGEMU Retro Go
6771076366.description: GGEMU Retro Go is a powerful all-in-one emulator for iOS, bringing your favorite retro games together in one seamless experience. From classic arcade titles to portable consoles, DOS, and even Flash games — everything you love, all in one place. Key Features Wide Platform Support Play games across a broad range of systems: Nintendo: NES / Famicom, SNES / Super Famicom, Game Boy (GB/GBC/GBA), Nintendo 64, Nintendo DS, Virtual Boy Sony: PlayStation 1 (PS1), PlayStation Portable (PSP) Sega: Genesis / Mega Drive, Master System, Game Gear, Sega CD, 32X, Saturn Retro PC & More: DOS (.jsdos / .zip), Flash (.swf), PC Engine, Neo Geo Pocket, WonderSwan, Atari Jaguar Instant Play, Zero Setup No complicated configuration. Just drag and drop your ROMs into the app, or browse your local files to start playing instantly. Local Network Multiplayer Enjoy smooth, low-latency multiplayer over your local network. Extensive Controller Support Play your way with support for: Nintendo Switch Pro Controller and Joy-Con Nintendo Switch Online controllers (NES, SNES, N64) PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 controllers Xbox One S and Xbox Series X controllers MFi game controllers Bluetooth and wired keyboards Save Anytime Save and load game states at any moment — pick up right where you left off. Capture & Share Record gameplay or take high-quality screenshots with built-in FFmpeg-powered media export. Local Sharing Easily share your gameplay experience with others on the same network. Disclaimer GGEMU Retro Go is a shell application designed to run user-provided game files. The app does not include or distribute any game ROMs, copyrighted software, or digital assets. Users are responsible for ensuring they have the legal rights to use any files loaded into the app.
